entry.summary: Evaluates uncertainty methods for threshold-gated robot autonomy, finding a dataset-dependent competence regime below which uncertainty provides weak error ranking. Shows simple methods perform similarly above this threshold.

entry.title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution

author.name: Han Li, Jinyu Tian, Rili Feng, Yuqiao Du, Chong Zheng, Chenyu Wang, Chenchen Liu, Shihao Li, Xinping Lei, Yifan Yao, Weihao Xie, Letian Zhu, Jiaheng Liu

entry.summary: Solvita is an agentic framework for competitive programming that enables continuous learning without weight updates through four specialized agents (Planner, Solver, Oracle, Hacker) maintaining evolving memory across problems.

entry.title: Can We Trust AI-Inferred User States. A Psychometric Framework for Validating the Reliability of Users States Classification by LLMs in Operational Environments

author.name: Izabella Krzeminska, Michal Butkiewicz, Ewa Komkowska

entry.summary: Proposes a psychometric framework for validating the reliability of LLM-inferred user states, testing three bimodal LLMs (GPT-4o audio, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash) on repeatability of user state measurements.

entry.title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents

author.name: Chinmay Savadikar, Mingyu Zhao, Yuanzheng Zhu, Han Li, Shuang Xie, Alberto Castelo, Tianfu Wu, Lingyun Wang

entry.summary: ShopGym is a framework for realistic, controllable, and reproducible e-commerce web agent evaluation that bridges the gap between live storefronts (realistic but irreproducible) and sandbox benchmarks (controlled but narrow).

entry.title: Ensuring Logic in the Fog: Sound POMDP Synthesis with LTL Objectives

author.name: Can Zhou, Yulong Gao, Pian Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a sound reward-shaping mechanism for POMDPs with LTL objectives that generates belief-dependent rewards grounded in certified LTL satisfaction, integrated into Monte Carlo Planning.

entry.title: A3D: Agentic AI flow for autonomous Accelerator Design

author.name: Abinand Nallathambi, Christopher Knight, Shantanu Ganguly, Wilfried Haensch, Anand Raghunathan

entry.summary: A3D proposes an agentic AI flow for autonomous hardware accelerator design, using LLM agents for planning, reasoning, and execution across the full accelerator design pipeline.

entry.title: GESD: Beyond Outcome-Oriented Fairness

author.name: Gideon Popoola, John Sheppard

entry.summary: Proposes GESD, a procedural fairness metric that measures disparities in the stability and robustness of model explanations across subgroups, going beyond outcome-oriented metrics.

entry.title: Diagonal Adaptive Non-local Observables on Quantum Neural Networks

author.name: Huan-Hsin Tseng, Yan Li, Hsin-Yi Lin, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes diagonal adaptive non-local observables for quantum neural networks that significantly reduce parameter count while maintaining expressivity, since diagonal matrices are canonical representatives of the full observable space modulo unitary similarity.

entry.title: Pretraining Objective Matters in Extreme Low-Data FGVC: A Backbone-Controlled Study

author.name: Alexander Hackett, Srikanth Thudumu, Ginny Fisher, Mahule Roy, Aisha Sartaj, Jason Fisher

entry.summary: Studies how pretraining objectives (supervised, contrastive, masked reconstruction, self-distillation) affect downstream fine-grained visual classification in extreme low-data regimes using frozen ViT-B/16 encoders.

entry.title: Toward Natural and Companionable Virtual Agents via Cross-Temporal Emotional Modeling

author.name: Feier Qin, Xiao Li, Yi Zheng, Haibin Huang, Hanyao Wang, Xiaoyu Wang, Yan Lu, Yuan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-Temporal Emotion Modeling (CTEM) for virtual companion agents, creating a closed loop where past experiences update emotional state and emotions shape future behavioral expression.

entry.title: SLIP & ETHICS: Graduated Intervention for AI Emotional Companions

author.name: Minseo Kim

entry.summary: Presents SLIP (graduated intervention protocol) and ETHICS (taxonomy for human-AI interaction signals) for AI emotional companions, balancing safety with supportive rapport. Small-scale evaluation shows 0% false positives for normal interactions.

entry.title: Decomposed Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

author.name: Chenhao Wang, Yingrui Ji, Yu Meng, Yao Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a decomposed vision-language alignment framework that factorizes text prompts into concept and attribute tokens for open-vocabulary segmentation, with feature-gated cross-attention for compositional semantics.

entry.title: Towards Foundation Models for Relational Databases with Language Models and Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Jingcheng Wu, Ratan Bahadur Thapa, Mojtaba Nayyeri, Lucas Etteldorf, Max Finkenbeiner, Fabian Leeske, Steffen Staab

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid architecture combining fine-tuned BART encoder for intra-row semantics with GraphSAGE-based GNN over relational entity graphs for learning on relational databases.

entry.title: Designing Datacenter Power Delivery Hierarchies for the AI Era

author.name: Grant Wilkins, Fiodar Kazhamiaka, Alok Gautam Kumbhare, Chaojie Zhang, Ricardo Bianchini

entry.summary: Studies datacenter power delivery hierarchy design for AI workloads approaching 1MW per rack, analyzing trade-offs between power utilization, cost, and long-term adaptability across hardware generations.

entry.title: When Actions Disappear: Adversarial Action Removal in Self-Play Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Arahan Kujur

entry.summary: Studies adversarial action masking in self-play RL where an attacker removes legal actions from a victim's action set, showing it causes more damage than perturbation-based attacks across multiple games and algorithms.

entry.title: PIMSM: Physics-Informed Multi-Scale Mamba for Stable Neural Representations under Distribution Shift

author.name: Sangyoon Bae, Shinjae Yoo, Jiook Cha

entry.summary: Proposes PIMSM, a physics-informed multi-scale Mamba architecture for stable neural representations under distribution shift, formalizing temporal kernel mismatch as a failure mode.

entry.title: Physics-Guided Geometric Diffusion for Macro Placement Generation

author.name: Jongho Yoon, Jinsung Jeon, Seokhyeong Kang

entry.summary: MacroDiff+ uses physics-guided geometric diffusion for VLSI macro placement, combining topological connectivity from heterogeneous GNNs with global geometric context from Transformers, plus physics-guided sampling during inference.

entry.title: EfficientTDMPC: Improved MPC Objectives for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control

author.name: Thomas Evers, Cristian Meo, Wendelin Bohmer, Justin Dauwels, Yaniv Oren

entry.summary: EfficientTDMPC improves sample efficiency in model-based RL by using ensembles of dynamics models with averaged return estimates across depths and an uncertainty penalty for conservative planning.

entry.title: Informative Graph Structure Learning

author.name: Shen Han, Zhiyao Zhou, Jiawei Chen, Sheng Zhou, Canghong Jin, Hai Lin, Da Zhong Li, Bingde Hu, Can Wang

entry.summary: Reveals that graph structure learning's effectiveness comes at the cost of dramatic edge expansion, proposes informative GSL that connects diverse rather than merely similar neighbors to reduce overhead.

entry.title: Emulating the Forced Response of Climate Models with Flow Matching

author.name: Graham Clyne, Julia Kaltenborn, Peer Nowack, Claire Monteleoni, Anasatase Charantonis

entry.summary: Uses flow matching to emulate climate model forced responses across Shared Socioeconomic Pathways, providing a computationally cheaper alternative to running full climate models for projecting future climate scenarios.

entry.title: Mechanism Learning: Prototype-Anchored Mechanism Inference for Scientific Forecasting

author.name: Qian Jiang, Liping Sun

entry.summary: Introduces mechanism learning, a framework that forecasts future states by estimating active local evolution rules from data using prototype-anchored mechanism descriptors, rather than direct state prediction.

entry.title: When Bits Break Recourse: Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization

author.name: Chaymae Yahyati, Ismail Lamaakal, Khalid El Makkaoui, Ibrahim Ouahbi

entry.summary: Formalizes how quantization can break algorithmic recourse (actionable decision changes), introduces metrics for recourse failures, and proposes Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization (CFQ) to preserve counterfactual behavior under quantization.

entry.title: Active Budget Allocation for Efficient Scaling Law Estimation via Surrogate-Guided Pruning

author.name: Viktoria Schram, Markus Hiller, Daniel Beck, Trevor Cohn

entry.summary: Explores Successive Halving and surrogate models for efficient budget allocation in scaling law estimation, reducing the computational burden of empirical scaling law research.

entry.title: IVF-TQ: Streaming-Robust Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search via a Codebook-Free Residual Layer

author.name: Tarun Sharma

entry.summary: Proposes IVF-TQ, an ANN index with codebook-free residual layer using fixed random rotation and precomputed scalar quantization that avoids staleness under streaming data ingestion, unlike trained-codebook methods.

entry.title: MATE: Solving Contextual Markov Decision Processes with Memory of Accumulated Transition Embeddings

author.name: Himchan Hwang, Hyeokju Jeong, Gene Chung, Seungyeon Kim, Sangwoong Yoon, Frank Chongwoo Park

entry.summary: Proposes MATE, a sum-aggregated memory architecture for Contextual MDPs that leverages posterior permutation invariance, avoiding Transformer's growing cost and RNN gradient issues while maintaining sufficient expressiveness.

entry.title: Form and Function: Machine Unlearning as a Problem of Misaligned States

author.name: Kennon Stewart

entry.summary: Formulates machine unlearning for online L-BFGS as a counterfactual state-alignment problem, introducing state-aware metrics that separately measure parameter error, memory-operator error, and update-direction error. Derives recursive bounds on counterfactual state deviation under convexity.

entry.title: AURORA: Contextual Orthogonalization for Geometric Representation Learning in Healthcare Foundation Models

author.name: Yuanyun Zhang, Shi Li

entry.summary: AURORA decomposes healthcare foundation model representations into orthogonal subspaces separating physiologic severity, intervention intensity, observational structure, and institutional workflow for improved interpretability and robustness.

entry.title: Enhancing the Code Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs via Consistency-based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhanyue Qin, Jia Feng, Yibo Lyu, Yun Peng, Dianbo Sui, Cuiyun Gao, Qing Liao

entry.summary: CodeThinker uses consistency-driven reinforcement learning for code reasoning, designing rewards based on stepwise reasoning consistency rather than just final outputs, addressing sparse reward and reward hacking problems.

entry.title: SAFE-SVD: Sensitivity-Aware Fidelity-Enforcing SVD for Physics Foundation Models

author.name: Chengjie Hong, Feixiang He, Yiheng Zeng, Lulu Kang, He Wang

entry.summary: SAFE-SVD proposes sensitivity-aware SVD compression for physics foundation models, explicitly modeling how compression affects partial derivatives that encode spatiotemporal dynamics.

entry.title: Interaction-Breaking Adversarial Learning Framework for Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Sunwoo Lee, Mingu Kang, Yonghyeon Jo, Seungyul Han

entry.summary: IBAL proposes an information-theoretic framework for robust multi-agent RL that constructs attacks disrupting inter-agent coordination and trains agents to be robust to such interaction-breaking perturbations.

entry.title: FLAG: Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion Alignment via Graph for spatial gene expression prediction

author.name: Qi Si, Penglei Wang, Yushuai Wu, Yifeng Jiao, Xuyang Liu, Xin Guo, Yuan Qi, Yuan Cheng

entry.summary: FLAG uses a diffusion-based framework with spatial graph encoding and gene foundation model alignment for predicting spatial gene expression from H&E images, addressing the 'Gene Dimension Curse' in high-dimensional joint modeling.

entry.title: DiPRL: Learning Discrete Programmatic Policies via Architecture Entropy Regularization

author.name: Chengpeng Hu, Yingqian Zhang, Hendrik Baier

entry.title: XCTFormer: Leveraging Cross-Channel and Cross-Time Dependencies for Enhanced Time-Series Analysis

author.name: Israel Zexer, Omri Azencot

entry.title: Efficient and Noise-Tolerant PAC Learning of Multiclass Linear Classifiers

author.name: Rita Adhikari, Shiwei Zeng

entry.title: Distilling Tabular Foundation Models for Structured Health Data

entry.title: Reducing Hallucination in Vision-Language Models via Stage-wise Preference Optimization under Distribution Shift

author.name: Qinwu Xu

entry.title: Universal Graph Backdoor Defense: A Feature-based Homophily Perspective

author.name: Mengting Pan, Fan Li, Chen Chen, Xiaoyang Wang

entry.title: Topo-GS: Continuous Volumetric Embedding of High-Dimensional Data via Topological Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Prem Seetharaman, Rithesh Kumar

entry.title: Multi-task Linear Regression without Eigenvalue Lower Bounds: Adaptivity, Robustness and Safety

author.name: Seok-Jin Kim

entry.title: Stable Routing for Mixture-of-Experts in Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Taolin Zhang, Dongyang Li, Chen Chen, Qizhou Chen, Jiuheng Wan, Xiaofeng He, Chengyu Wang, Richang Hong

author.name: Gunjan Balde, Soumyadeep Roy, Mainack Mondal, Niloy Ganguly

entry.title: Hilbert-Geo: Solving Solid Geometric Problems by Neural-Symbolic Reasoning

author.name: Jinzhou Tang, Sidi Liu, Waikit Xiu, Weixing Chen, Keze Wang

entry.summary: Introduces LASAR with dual-memory system for embodied AI spatial reasoning, using Spatio-temporal Contextual Representation Learning to force encoding of fine-grained spatial relationships.

author.name: Danyang Li, Tianhao Wu, Bin Li, Zhenyuan Chen, Yang Zhang, Yuxuan Li, Ming-Ming Cheng, Xiang Li

author.name: Saeed Firouzi Daghigh, Majid Iranpour Mobarekeh, Mostafa Alavi, Mehdi Bagheri

entry.summary: Presents HighSync, a diffusion-based lip synchronization framework operating at 512x512 resolution, identifying and eliminating a data leakage phenomenon that silently plagued prior methods.

entry.title: P2GS: Physical Prior-guided Gaussian Splatting for Photometrically Consistent Urban Reconstruction

author.name: Kota Shimomura, Hidehisa Arai, Tsubasa Takahashi, Takayoshi Yamashita, Hironobu Fujiyoshi

entry.summary: Proposes P2GS for photometrically consistent urban 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction that handles varying exposure and tone mapping in real driving data for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.summary: Proposes OmniVL-Guard Pro, a tool-augmented agent for vision-language forensics that extends from closed-world prediction to open-world investigation using external tools for real-time verification.

entry.title: DreamEdit3D: Personalization of Multi-View Diffusion Models for 3D Editing

author.name: Jinxin Ai, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner, Ziya Erko\c{c}

entry.summary: Presents DreamEdit3D for personalization of multi-view diffusion models for 3D editing, learning distinct token embeddings for scene components through multi-view textual inversion and fine-tuning.

author.name: Guanyiman Fu, Jingtao Li, Zihang Cheng, Zhuanfeng Li, Diqi Chen, Yan Xu, Fengchao Xiong, Jianfeng Lu, Jun Zhou

entry.title: SpecSem-Net: Integrating Spectral and Semantic Features for Robust AI-generated Video Detection

author.name: Zixi Wei, Huixuaun Zhang, Xiaojun Wan

entry.summary: Proposes SpecSem-Net, the first framework combining semantic-guided spectral denoising for detecting high-fidelity AI-generated videos from models like Sora and Veo.

entry.title: VISTA: Triplet-Supervised Video Style Transfer with Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Yiren Song, Wangzi Yao, Haofan Wang, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Introduces VISTA-1000 dataset with 1,000 styles and motion-aligned triplets for video style transfer, enabling principled training that jointly models style, content, and motion disentanglement.

entry.title: GCE-MIL: Faithful and Recoverable Evidence for Multiple Instance Learning in Whole-Slide Imaging

author.name: Jeongeun Park, Janghyeok Han, Geonung Kim, Hyun-Seung Lee, Kyuha Choi, Youngseok Han, Sunghyun Cho

entry.title: TouchMap-OR: Multi-View 3D Mapping of Hand-Surface Contacts

author.name: Bin Luo, Runmin Dong, Zhaoyang Luo, Jinxiao Zhang, Jiyao Zhao, Fan Wei, Haohuan Fu

entry.title: DSAA: Dual-Stage Attribute Activation for Fine-grained Open Vocabulary Detection

author.name: Donghong Jiang, Endian Lin, Hanqing Liu, Mingjie Liu, Luoping Cui, Zhao Yang, Chuang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes DSAA, a dual-stage attribute activation framework for fine-grained open-vocabulary detection that strengthens attribute semantics when category signals dominate.

entry.title: DanceHMR: Hand-Aware Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery from Monocular Videos

author.name: Wenhao Shen, Ming Zhou, Hengyuan Zhang, Siyuan Bian, Youjiang Xu, Xi Lin

entry.summary: Presents DanceHMR, a whole-body human mesh recovery framework for monocular videos that unifies body motion and hand articulation through residual body-hand fusion in a temporal architecture.

entry.title: Best Segmentation Buddies for Image-Shape Correspondence

author.name: Itai Lang, Dongwei Lyu, Dale Decatur, Rana Hanocka

entry.summary: Addresses the underexplored task of finding segmentation correspondences between 2D images and untextured 3D shapes by distilling deep visual features from 2D vision models onto 3D surfaces and computing Best Segmentation Buddies for matching.

entry.title: Enhancing Train-Free Infinite-Frame Generation for Consistent Long Videos

author.name: X. Feng, J. Zhu, M. Wu, C. Chen, F. Mao, H. Guo, J. Wu, X. Chu, K. Huang

entry.summary: Proposes MIGA for train-free infinite-frame long video generation with a two-stage alignment mechanism to reduce training-inference gap and maintain long-term consistency in autoregressive frame generation frameworks.

entry.title: Code-as-Room: Generating 3D Rooms from Top-Down View Images via Agentic Code Synthesis

author.name: Yixuan Yang, Zhen Luo, Wanshui Gan, Jinkun Hao, Junru Lu, Jinghao Yan, Zhaoyang Lyu, Xudong Xu

entry.summary: Code-as-Room proposes an MLLM-based agentic framework that generates 3D rooms from top-down view images using Blender code synthesis, with a structured execution harness to prevent instability and infinite looping.

entry.title: Articulation in Prime: Primitive-Based Articulated Object Understanding from a Single Casual Video

author.name: Arslan Artykov, Tom Ravaud, Nicol\'as Violante-Grezzi, Vincent Lepetit

entry.summary: Proposes a category-agnostic optimization framework for articulated object understanding from monocular video using geometric primitives as proxy representations, avoiding reliance on point tracking or category-specific training.

entry.title: Flow Matching with Optimized Subclass Priors for Medical Image Augmentation

author.name: Felix N\"utzel, Mischa Dombrowski, Bernhard Kainz

entry.summary: Proposes flow matching with optimized subclass priors for medical image augmentation of rare diseases, using Gaussian mixture modeling to partition coarse labels into coherent submodes and provide informative source distributions.

entry.title: CATRF: Codec-Adaptive TriPlane Radiance Fields for Volumetric Content Delivery

author.name: Tung-I Chen, Lingdong Wang, Subhransu Maji, Ramesh K. Sitaraman

entry.summary: Presents CATRF, a codec-in-the-loop training framework for compressing radiance fields by quantizing feature planes into codec-friendly canvases and running standard codec roundtrips during training. Uses straight-through estimators to make non-differentiable codecs trainable.

entry.title: Nori Bot: A Sub-$1,000 Floor-to-Counter Mobile Manipulator

author.name: Antonio Li, Sungjoon Park, Wen Ni Chew

entry.summary: Presents Nori Bot, a $947 17-DoF dual-arm mobile manipulator with a Z-axis lift, proactive agent runtime, and software safety stack. Addresses key limitations of existing sub-$1000 platforms.

entry.title: Beyond Safety Filtering: Control Barrier Function-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles

author.name: Jianye Xu, Bassam Alrifaee

entry.summary: Proposes CBF-informed reward design for multi-agent RL in autonomous driving, converting control barrier function constraint values into reward signals. Outperforms heuristic baselines at a four-way intersection.

entry.title: CosFly-Track: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Dataset for UAV Visual Tracking via Multi-Constraint Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Xiangyue Wang, Hanxuan Chen, Songsheng Cheng, Ruilong Ren, Jie Zheng, Shuai Yuan, Tianle Zeng, Hanzhong Guo, Kangli Wang, Ji Pei

entry.summary: Introduces CosFlyTrack, a large-scale multi-modal dataset (12,000 trajectories, 2.4M timesteps, 334 hours) for UAV visual tracking with multi-constraint trajectory optimization in urban environments.

entry.title: TacSE3: Equivariant SE(3) Motion Estimation from Low-Texture Visuotactile Images for In-Gripper Tracking and Compensation

author.name: Zhongyuan Liao, Junzhe Wang, Qingyang Liu, Zhenmin Huang, Jun Ma, Yi Cai, Fei Meng, Haobo Liang, Michael Yu Wang

entry.summary: Presents TacSE3, a tactile motion estimation pipeline that converts low-texture visuotactile observations into force fields and estimates SE(3) rigid-body motion for in-gripper tracking and compensation.

entry.title: From Saddle Points Toward Global Minima: A Newton-Type Method on Wasserstein Space

author.name: Razvan-Andrei Lascu, Taiji Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes Wasserstein Saddle-Free Newton (WSFN), a second-order optimization method on Wasserstein space that escapes saddle points while providing fast local convergence near global minimizers of non-convex functionals.

entry.title: RoPE Distinguishes Neither Positions Nor Tokens in Long Contexts, Provably

author.name: Yufeng Du, Phillip Harris, Minyang Tian, Eliu A Huerta, Srikanth Ronanki, Subendhu Rongali, Aram Galstyan, Hao Peng

entry.summary: As first covered in Research yesterday, Proves that RoPE (Rotary Positional Embeddings) loses both locality bias and token relevance consistency as context length increases, with failure probability approaching 0.5 (random chance). Provides theoretical explanation for long-context degradation.

entry.title: Verifiable Agentic Infrastructure: Proof-Derived Authorization for Sovereign AI Systems

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a proof-derived authorization system for AI agents in cloud/sovereign systems, where agents must submit intents with cryptographic proofs of safety before execution is permitted.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Goal Recognition with Large Language Models

author.name: Kin Max Piamolini Gusm\~ao, Nathan Gavenski, Nir Oren, Felipe Meneguzzi

entry.summary: First systematic zero-shot evaluation of frontier LLMs as goal recognizers on classical PDDL benchmarks, finding that LLM competence is uneven - some models scale with evidence while others remain anchored to world-knowledge priors.

entry.title: PRISM: Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring for Enterprise Conversational AI

author.name: Keshava Chaitanya, Jahnavi Gundakaram

entry.summary: PRISM treats prompt engineering as continuous reliability engineering, detecting and repairing prompt regressions caused by silent LLM behavior changes over time through iterative simulation and monitoring.

entry.title: Sign-Separated Finite-Time Error Analysis of Q-Learning

author.name: Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Develops sign-separated finite-time error analysis for Q-learning, decomposing error into positive and negative parts and connecting the asymmetry to overestimation bias.

entry.title: AgentStop: Terminating Local AI Agents Early to Save Energy in Consumer Devices

author.name: Dzung Pham, Kleomenis Katevas, Ali Shahin Shamsabadi, Hamed Haddadi

entry.summary: AgentStop investigates early termination of local LLM agents to save energy on consumer devices, addressing the resource-intensive nature of agentic workflows that often fail without completing tasks.

entry.title: MR2-ByteTrack: CNN and Transformer-based Video Object Detection for AI-augmented Embedded Vision Sensor Nodes

author.name: Luca Bompani, Manuele Rusci, Luca Benini, Daniele Palossi, Francesco Conti

entry.summary: Introduces MR2-ByteTrack, a video object detection method for ultra-low-power microcontrollers that alternates between full and low-resolution inference and uses ByteTrack for frame linking, achieving real-time performance on embedded devices.

entry.title: Bridging Silicon and the Hippocampus: Algebro-Deterministic Memory "VaCoAl" as a Substrate for Vector-HaSH and TEM

author.name: Hiroyuki Chuma, Kanji Otsuka, Yoichi Sato

entry.summary: Bridges hippocampal neuroscience models (Vector-HaSH, TEM) with an algebraic deterministic memory system (VaCoAl) using Galois-field operations, proposing hardware-friendly alternatives to random projections for associative memory.

entry.title: Bidirectional Fusion Guided by Cardiac Patterns for Semi-Supervised ECG Segmentation

author.name: Jeonghwa Lim, Minje Park, Sunghoon Joo

entry.summary: Introduces CardioMix, a semi-supervised ECG segmentation framework using bidirectional CutMix guided by cardiac patterns to exchange information between labeled and unlabeled sets.

entry.title: A Topology-Aware Spatiotemporal Handover Framework for Continuous Multi-UAV Tracking

author.name: Jianlin Ye, Christos Kyrkou, Panayiotis Kolios

entry.summary: Presents a topology-aware multi-UAV tracking framework for maintaining vehicle identity persistence across multiple drone fields of view, enabling network-level traffic analysis.

entry.title: Can Vision Language Models Be Adaptive in Mathematics Education? A Learner Model-based Rubric Study

author.name: Jie Gao, Yongan Yu, Junzhu Su, Yiran Lin, Adam K. Dube, Jackie Chi Kit Cheung

entry.summary: Evaluates whether vision-language models can adapt their mathematical tutoring to different learner profiles, proposing an evaluation framework based on learner model theory from education.

entry.title: XSearch: Explainable Code Search via Concept-to-Code Alignment

author.name: Yiming Liu, Ruofan Liu, Yun Lin, Zicong Zhang, Weiyu Kong, Pengnian Qi, Xiao Cheng, Weinan Zhang, Qianxiang Wang, Linpeng Huang

entry.summary: Proposes XSearch, an explainable code search framework that decomposes queries and code into aligned concepts, providing intrinsic explanations for retrieval results while improving generalization under distribution shift.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy and Explainable AI for Perception Models: From Concept to Prototype Vehicle Deployment

author.name: Till Beemelmanns, Shayan Sharifi, Manas Mehrotra, Ayushman Choudhuri, Lutz Eckstein

entry.summary: Proposes a Trustworthy AI perception module for autonomous driving with attention-based explanations, calibrated uncertainty estimates, and deployment on a prototype vehicle.

entry.title: Phase Transitions in Driven Informational Systems: A Two-Field Perspective on Learning Theory and Non-Equilibrium Chemistry

author.name: Truong Xuan Khanh

entry.summary: Proposes a two-field perspective connecting phase transitions in deep learning (grokking, emergence) with non-equilibrium chemistry, describing both as driven informational systems governed by entropy production and information rate fields.

entry.title: Federated Nested Learning: Collaborative Training of Self-Referential Memories for Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Hong Chen, Pengcheng Wu, Yuanguo Lin, Peilin Zhao, Xiuze Zhou, Fan Lin, Han Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Federated Nested Learning, reformulating FL as three-level nested optimization with Titans-based linear attention enabling zero-shot test-time adaptation for non-IID data.

entry.title: Two-Valued Symmetric Circulant Matrices: Applications in Deep Learning

author.name: Jayakrishna Amathi, Venkata Prasanth Yanambaka, Saraju P. Mohanty, Elias Kougianos

entry.summary: Proposes Two-Valued Symmetric Circulant Matrix (TVSCM) for extreme compression of fully connected layers, using only two weights per layer while maintaining circulant and symmetric structure for negligible storage costs.

entry.title: Automatic Unsupervised Ensemble Outlier Model Selection--Extended Version

author.name: Hong-Phuc Phan, Tuan-Anh Vu, Tung Kieu, Son Ha Xuan, Bin Yang, Christian S. Jensen

entry.summary: MetaEns learns to predict marginal ensemble gains for composing outlier detection ensembles without labeled data, avoiding ensemble saturation where redundant models degrade performance.

entry.title: Learning What Evaluators Value: A Reliable Approach to Modeling Evaluator Preferences

author.name: Madeline Celi Kitch, Nihar B. Shah

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of learning evaluator preferences from criteria-to-overall-evaluation mappings, developing reliable methods without restrictive modeling assumptions about how evaluators combine criteria.

entry.title: MedMIX: Modality-Internal Expert Fusion for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis

author.name: Seungik Cho, Anqi Li, Wei Qiu

entry.summary: MedMIX combines intra-modality expert fusion from multiple foundation models, learned inter-modality fusion, and teacher-student collaboration for robust medical prediction under missing modalities.

entry.title: Extending Pretrained 10-Second ECG Foundation Models to Longer Horizons

author.name: Wei Tang, Jinpei Han, Kangning Cui, Mattia Carletti, Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Shreyank N Gowda, Patitapaban Palo, Anshul Thakur, Lei Clifton, Jean-michel Morel, Raymond H. Chan, David A. Clifton, Xiao Gu

entry.summary: Proposes a parameter-efficient framework to extend pretrained 10-second ECG foundation models to longer and variable-length recordings without retraining, addressing structural and semantic challenges of temporal aggregation.

entry.title: When Dynamics Shift, Robust Task Inference Wins: Offline Imitation Learning with Behavior Foundation Models Revisited

author.name: Rishabh Agrawal, Rahul Jain, Ashutosh Nayyar

entry.title: Anytime and Difficulty-Adaptive PAC-Bayes for Constrained Density-Ratio Network with Continual Learning Guarantees

author.name: Paulo Akira F. Enabe

entry.summary: Presents a unified PAC-Bayes framework for learning under covariate shift with a constrained density-ratio network, providing anytime generalization certificates and difficulty-adaptive bounds for continual learning.

entry.title: Fidelity Probes for Specification--Code Alignment

author.name: Ferhat Erata, Hao Zhou, Luke Huan

entry.summary: Introduces fidelity probes: natural-language questions with code-derived ground truth used to measure specification-code alignment, achieving 0.63→0.94 fidelity improvement on a COBOL benchmark through iterative spec refinement.

entry.title: When Molecular Similarity Works: Property Cliffs Reveal Hidden Errors

author.name: Di Hu, Kun Li, Haojie Rao, Longtao Hu, Jiameng Chen, Wenbin Hu, Yizhen Zheng, Jiajun Yu, Duanhua Cao

entry.summary: Introduces CliffSplit (cliff-aware evaluation) and CliffLoss (training mitigation) for molecular property prediction, exposing failures where structurally similar molecules have vastly different properties.

entry.title: Radial-Angular Geometry for Reliable Update Diagnosis in Noisy-Label Learning

author.name: Ningkang Peng, Jingyang Mao, Xiaoqian Peng, Weiguang Qu, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Proposes radial-angular geometry for noisy label detection using the empirical Fisher trace decomposed into prediction-residual and feature-sensitivity terms, providing backward-space reliability diagnosis.

entry.title: The Silent Brush: Evaluating Artistic Style Leakage in AI Art Generation

author.name: Ninad Joshi, Ashutosh Ranjan, Vivek Srivastava, Shirish Karande

entry.summary: Evaluates 'The Silent Brush' phenomenon where generative models reproduce learned artistic styles without explicit prompting, proposing evaluation methods for unintended stylistic resurfacing across prompts.

entry.title: MARR: Module-Adaptive Residual Reconstruction for Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization

author.name: Le Su, Xing Luo, Zhi Jin

entry.summary: MARR proposes module-adaptive residual reconstruction for low-bit post-training quantization, using per-module scaling coefficients to balance Hessian approximation bias correction against accumulated error correction.

entry.title: S2Aligner: Pair-Efficient and Transferable Pre-Training for Sparse Text-Attributed Graphs

author.name: Yuhan Wang, Haopeng Zhang, Yibo Ding, Jiaqi Yu, Xinyu Zhao, Yuhang Liu, Ziwei Zhang, Xiao Wang, Ruijie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes S2Aligner for pre-training on sparse text-attributed graphs, addressing the challenge of weak or missing textual anchors in real-world graphs through a sparsity-aware LLM-as-Aligner framework.

entry.title: A No-Defense Defense Against Gradient-Based Adversarial Attacks on ML-NIDS: Is Less More?

author.name: Mohamed elShehaby, Ashraf Matrawy

entry.summary: Investigates whether careful architectural choices (shallow networks, reduced features, ReLU) alone can make DNN-based network intrusion detection systems robust to gradient-based adversarial attacks without explicit defenses.

entry.title: Public-Decay Homomorphic State Space Models for Private Sequence Inference

author.name: Luis Brito

entry.summary: Presents public-decay homomorphic state space models (HSSMs) for privacy-preserving sequence inference, keeping encrypted state updates through ciphertext-plaintext operations while minimizing expensive ciphertext-ciphertext multiplications.

entry.title: VolTA-3D: Self-Supervised Learning for Brain MRI using 3D Volumetric Token Alignment

author.name: Amy Makawana, Abhijeet Parida, Marius George Linguraru, Julia Ive, Syed Muhammad Anwar

entry.summary: Presents VolTA-3D, a self-supervised 3D Vision Transformer for brain MRI that jointly aligns global and local tokens in a student-teacher paradigm, enabling transferable volumetric representations across tasks.

entry.title: Diffusion-Based Stochastic Operator Networks for Uncertainty Quantification in Stochastic Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Phuoc-Toan Huynh, Richard Archibald, Feng Bao

entry.summary: Introduces Stochastic Operator Networks combining DeepONet with diffusion-based generative modeling for uncertainty quantification in stochastic PDEs, learning from noisy data to output mean solutions and uncertainty estimates.

entry.title: Position: Age Estimation Models Do Not Process Biometric Data

author.name: Nikita Marshalkin

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that age estimation neural networks do not process biometric data in a legal sense, providing empirical evidence across 14 models showing they fall far short of identification thresholds on face verification benchmarks.

entry.title: On Gaussian approximation for entropy-regularized Q-learning with function approximation

author.name: Artemy Rubtsov, Rahul Singh, Eric Moulines, Alexey Naumov, Sergey Samsonov

entry.summary: Derives convergence rates for the central limit theorem of Polyak-Ruppert averaged iterates in entropy-regularized Q-learning with linear function approximation, establishing Gaussian approximation bounds.

entry.title: Dynamic robotic cloth folding with efficient Koopman operator-based model predictive control

author.name: Edoardo Caldarelli, Franco Coltraro, Adri\`a Colom\'e, Lorenzo Rosasco, Carme Torras

entry.summary: Tackles dynamic robotic cloth folding using Koopman operator-based model predictive control, generating fast folding trajectories that leverage cloth dynamics while maintaining precision.

entry.title: Beyond Morphology: Quantifying the Diagnostic Power of Color Features in Cancer Classification

author.name: Farnaz Kheiri, Shahryar Rahnamayan, Masoud Makrehchi

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates standalone discriminative power of global color features (excluding morphology) for cancer classification in histopathology. Shows that pixel intensity alone can achieve surprisingly strong classification performance across multiple experimental settings.

entry.title: Scaling Accessible Mathematics on arXiv: HTML Conversion and MathML 4

author.name: Deyan Ginev, Brian Caruso, Bruce Miller, Jeff Sank, Jacob Weiskoff

entry.summary: Reports on arXiv's HTML Papers conversion effort, covering community-driven improvements, MathML 4 intent annotations for accessibility, and an in-progress Rust port of LaTeXML. Currently at 75% error-free HTML, targeting 90%.

entry.title: JSPG: Dynamic Dictionary Filtering via Joint Semantic-Pinyin-Glyph Retrieval for Chinese Contextual ASR

author.name: Shilin Zhou, Zhenghua Li

entry.summary: Proposes JSPG, a dynamic dictionary filtering framework for Chinese contextual ASR that jointly integrates semantic, pinyin, and glyph features to handle homophonic errors that defeat standard semantic retrieval.

entry.title: NewsLens: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adversarial News Bias Navigation

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: Presents NewsLens, a five-agent adversarial pipeline for structured news bias navigation that exposes ideological omissions and framing boundaries rather than just classifying bias labels.

entry.title: From Documents to Segments: A Contextual Reformulation for Topic Assignment

author.name: Hoonsang Yoon, Takyoung Kim, Wonkee Lee, Ilmin Cho, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur, Stanley Jungkyu Choi

entry.title: WASIL: In-the-Wild Arabic Spoken Interactions with LLMs

author.name: Zien Sheikh Ali, Hamdy Mubarak, Soon-Gyo Jung, Hunzalah Hassan Bhatti, Firoj Alam, Shammur Absar Chowdhury

entry.summary: Releases WASIL, an Arabic spoken interaction dataset with audio, ASR hypotheses, assistant responses, and like/dislike feedback (8,529 turns). Covers MSA and four major dialects with gold transcripts and answerability annotations.

entry.title: Recall Isn't Enough: Bounding Commitments in Personalized Language Systems

author.name: Rui Tang, Yichi Zhang, Xi Chen, Chen Dong, Youwei Yang, Yumeng Shen

entry.summary: Introduces Contract-Bounded Evidence Activation (CBEA) with Lexicographic Commitment Validation (LCV) for personalized language systems, addressing failure modes where systems turn noisy hints into hard constraints or forget obligations.

entry.title: RAG-based EEG-to-Text Translation Using Deep Learning and LLMs

author.name: Enrico Collautti, Xiaopeng Mao, Luca Tonin, Stefano Tortora, Sadasivan Puthusserypady

entry.summary: Proposes a RAG-based pipeline for EEG-to-text decoding combining an EEG encoder aligned with semantic embeddings, vector retrieval, and LLM refinement. Claims to surpass random baselines without teacher forcing.

entry.title: NERVE: A Neuromorphic Vision and Radar Ensemble for Multi-Sensor Fusion Research

author.name: Omar Mansour, Pietro Martinello, Ethan Milon, YingFu Xu, Manolis Sifalakis, Guangzhi Tang, Amirreza Yousefzadeh

entry.summary: Presents NERVE, a multi-sensor dataset with 257 minutes of synchronized DVS, RGB-D, and radar data for evaluating neuromorphic vision and radar fusion in office environments.

entry.title: CT-DegradBench: A Physics-Informed Benchmark for CT Degradation Detection and Severity Estimation

author.name: Yousra Nabila Taifour, Marouane Tliba, Zuheng Ming, Marie Luong, Nour Aburaed, Aladine Chetouani, Gorkem Durak, Alessandro Bruno, Faouzi Alaya Cheikh, Habib Zaidi, Ulas Bagci, Azeddine Beghdadi
