entry.title: MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation

author.name: Shuowei Li, Yuming Zhao, Parth Bhalerao, Oana Ignat

entry.summary: Introduces MAVEN, a multi-agent framework for culturally faithful text-to-video generation using specialized agents for person, action, and location dimensions across Chinese, American, and Romanian cultures.

entry.title: Diffeomorphic Cortical Alignment via Direct Warping of Streamline Endpoints

author.name: Yang Xiang, Martin Cole, Zhengwu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a connectivity-based cortical surface registration method that aligns surfaces using white-matter fiber-tract endpoints directly, modeling them as point clouds on a product manifold.

entry.title: NeuroLiDAR: Adaptive Frame Rate Depth Sensing via Neuromorphic Event-LiDAR Fusion

author.name: Darshana Rathnayake, Dulanga Weerakoon, Meera Radhakrishnan, Archan Misra

entry.summary: Presents NeuroLiDAR, an adaptive depth sensing framework achieving ~66 Hz effective frame rates by fusing sparse LiDAR with dense neuromorphic event camera inputs, dynamically adjusting sensing rate based on scene dynamics.

entry.title: DecoRec: Decomposed 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single-View Images via Object-Level Diffusion

author.name: Yuhan Ping, Yuan Liu, Xiaoxiao Long, Peng Wang, Junhui Hou, Jianyi Zheng, Jia Pan, Xin Li, Cheng Lin

entry.summary: Introduces DecoRec, a system for single-view to decomposed 3D scene mesh reconstruction using diffusion-based object-level reconstruction with a refinement pipeline for scene-level consistency.

entry.title: Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion for Efficient Document Recognition

author.name: Mingxu Chai, Ziyu Shen, Chenyu Liu, Kaidi Zhang, Jiazheng Zhang, Dingwei Zhu, Zhiheng Xi, Ruoyu Chen, Jun Long, Jihua Kang, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PA-BDM for document recognition, replacing bidirectional block denoising with causal denoising and adaptive block sizes, enabling more efficient KV caching and better structure-sensitive recognition.

entry.title: VGGT-Occ: Geometry-Grounded and Density-Aware Gated Fusion for 3D Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Xun Chen, Tianchen Deng, Rui Wang, Fangjinhua Wang, Junyi Ma, Hongming Shen, Hesheng Wang, Danwei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VGGT-Occ for 3D occupancy prediction with geometry tokens throughout the pipeline, using Projection-Aware Deformable Attention to inject camera geometry into attention stages.

entry.title: StreamingEffect: Real-Time Human-Centric Video Effect Generation

author.name: Yiren Song, Cheng Liu, Yuxin Jiang, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Presents StreamingEffect for real-time human-centric video effects using in-context video editing with efficient distillation, enabling live streaming applications like e-commerce and entertainment.

entry.title: iMiGUE-3K: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Micro-Gesture Analysis with Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Chengyan Wang, Haoyu Chen, Hui Wei, Yueyi Yang, Yunquan Chen, Guoying Zhao

entry.summary: Presents iMiGUE-3K, a large-scale benchmark for micro-gesture-based emotion understanding with a new dataset and foundation models, addressing the lack of pre-training data for micro-gesture recognition.

entry.title: LongDPM: Overlap-Aware 4D Reconstruction from Long Monocular Videos

author.name: Chenyi Xu, Yihao Wu, Liqi Yan, Chao Yang, Jianhui Zhang, Fangli Guan, Pan Li

entry.summary: Proposes LongDPM for overlap-aware 4D reconstruction from long monocular videos using overlapping chunks with confidence-weighted alignment between chunk-local coordinate systems.

entry.title: MSIQ: Moment-based Scale-Invariant Quality Measure for Single Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Leonid Bedratyuk

entry.summary: Proposes MSIQ, a scale-invariant quality metric for super-resolution based on normalized central geometric moments, enabling direct comparison of images with different spatial resolutions without forced resizing.

entry.title: Unleashing the Representational Power of Fourier Shapes for Attacking Infrared Object Detection

author.name: Yixing Yong, Jian Wang, Ming Lei, Lijun He, Fan Li

entry.summary: Introduces learnable Fourier shapes for infrared adversarial attacks, providing a differentiable framework where compact Fourier coefficients define adversarial thermal shape boundaries.

entry.title: Rad-VLSM: A Cross-Modal Framework with Semantics-Assisted Prompting for Medical Segmentation and Diagnosis

author.name: Fengyi Zhang, Xujie Zeng, Mohan Liu, Zengyi Wang, Yalong Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes Rad-VLSM, a two-stage cross-modal framework combining BLIP-2 for lesion focusing with SAM for segmentation and visually grounded diagnosis in medical images.

entry.title: GaussianZoom: Progressive Zoom-in Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting with Geometric and Semantic Guidance

author.name: Jiale Shi, Jiarui Hu, Zesong Yang, Kaixuan Luan, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui

entry.summary: GaussianZoom introduces a progressive zoom-in 3D reconstruction system combining geometry-consistent modeling with multi-scale semantic reasoning using depth-based feature warping and VLM-driven detail synthesis for extreme zoom-in rendering from low-resolution inputs.

entry.title: Benchmarking transferability of SSL pretraining to same and different modality segmentation tasks

author.name: Jue Jiang, Harini Veeraraghavan

entry.summary: Benchmarks nine SSL pretext-task families pretrained on 10K 3D CT scans for transferability across nine segmentation tasks, analyzing convergence speed, CT-to-MRI transfer, and feature-reuse patterns.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Cross-Modal Learning for 4D Radar Scene Flow Estimation

author.name: Jingyun Fu, Zhiyu Xiang, Na Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a weakly supervised framework for 4D radar scene flow estimation using only images and odometry for supervision during training, avoiding the need for expensive LiDAR sensors to generate pseudo labels.

entry.title: Efficient Feature-Free Initialization for Monocular Visual-Inertial Systems Using a Feed-Forward 3D Model

author.name: Yuantai Zhang, Jiaqi Yang, Huajian Zeng, Changhao Chen, Haoang Li, Liang Li, Dezhen Song, Xingxing Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes a feature-free visual-inertial initialization framework using feed-forward 3D models to predict point clouds from images, eliminating the need for visual feature correspondences and reducing initialization time from 3-4 seconds.

entry.title: Von Economo neurons enable reliable social skill acquisition in recurrent spiking neural networks: a computational account with clinical predictions

author.name: Esila Keskin

entry.summary: Models Von Economo neurons in a spiking neural network to study their computational role in social learning. VEN-intact networks converge reliably (98%) vs VEN-ablated (70%), offering predictions relevant to frontotemporal dementia and autism.

entry.title: Pedestrian-Aware LLM-Driven Behavioral Planning for Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Aidana Baimbetova, Haruki Yonekura, Hamada Rizk, Hirozumi Yamaguchi

entry.summary: Introduces an LLM-based decision-making framework for pedestrian-aware autonomous vehicle behavioral planning, converting scene observations into natural-language reasoning prompts for safe driving decisions.

entry.title: Generalizable and Actionable Parts Pose Estimation with Symmetry Annotation-Free Learning Strategy

author.name: Wenxiao Chen, Xueyu Yuan, Liu Liu, Di Wu, Dan Guo

entry.summary: Proposes SAFAG, a symmetry annotation-free framework for generalizable and actionable parts pose estimation. Uses stepwise refinement for quaternion regression without requiring rich symmetry annotations.

entry.title: Visual Sculpting: Visually-Aligned Planning Representations for Long-Horizon Robot Clay Sculpting

author.name: Peter Schaldenbrand, Jean Oh

entry.summary: Proposes Visual Sculpting, a method for robotic clay sculpting using visually-aligned dynamics modeling that captures lighting and texture features, enabling long-horizon deformable material manipulation planning.

entry.title: Learning-Based Adaptive Control for Surgical Robotic Exposure Task on Deformable Tissues

author.name: Jiayi Liu, Kaiqi Wei, Yiwei Wang, Huan Zhao, Han Ding

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based adaptive control framework for autonomous surgical tissue retraction, using online optimization based on visual boundary monitoring and a deep deformation estimation model.

entry.title: FUSE: A Framework for Unified State Estimation in Robotic SLAM Systems

author.name: Wei Wu, Honglin Chen, Wenhan Cao, Yao Lyu, Jiangtao Li, Tao Zhang, Shengbo Eben Li

entry.summary: Presents FUSE, a modular framework for unified state estimation in SLAM that separates temporal processing, geometric association, estimator formulation, and map-update policy into interchangeable components.

entry.title: Conditional Predictive Inference for General Structured Data with Group Symmetries

author.name: Yichen Shen, Mengxin Yu

entry.summary: Studies distribution-free predictive inference for data with group symmetries, establishing near-conditional coverage guarantees beyond exchangeability for structured data like networks, clusters, and imaging.

entry.title: Stable Causal Discovery via Directed Acyclic Graph Aggregation

author.name: Yunan Wu, Yue Wang, Chunlin Li, Chenglong Ye

entry.summary: Proposes DAGgr, a model averaging framework that aggregates multiple candidate DAGs into a stable causal graph weighted by out-of-sample predictive likelihood, with guarantees that the result preserves acyclicity.

entry.title: Hidden in Memory: Sleeper Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents

author.name: Sidharth Pulipaka, Stanislau Hlebik, Leonidas Raghav, Sahar Abdelnabi, Vyas Raina, Ivaxi Sheth, Mario Fritz

entry.summary: As first covered in Research yesterday, Introduces 'sleeper memory poisoning' - a novel attack where adversaries manipulate external content to inject fabricated memories into LLM assistants with persistent memory, which can remain dormant and re-emerge across future conversations. This reveals a fundamental security risk in stateful AI assistants.

entry.title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning

author.name: Jingjing Wang, Xiwen Chen, Wenhui Zhu, Huayu Li, Zhengxiao He, Feiyang Cai, Ana S. Carreon-Rascon, Xuanzhao Dong, Feng Luo

entry.summary: LaMR decomposes code relevance for context pruning into two interpretable dimensions (semantic evidence and dependency support) using dedicated CRF models, reducing token costs for coding agents.

entry.title: X-SYNTH: Beyond Retrieval -- Enterprise Context Synthesis from Observed Human Attention

author.name: Guruprasad Raghavan, George Nychis, Rohan Narayana Murthy

entry.summary: X-SYNTH proposes synthesizing enterprise context for AI agents by learning from observed human attention patterns rather than traditional retrieval, addressing the gap between what's stored in systems and what knowledge workers actually need.

entry.title: Petri Net Induced Heuristic Search for Resource Constrained Scheduling

author.name: Ido Lublin, Dor Atzmon, Izack Cohen

entry.summary: Formulates the Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem as optimal search over Petri Net reachability graphs, using A* with consistent heuristics that outperform MILP baselines on PSPLIB benchmarks.

entry.title: Agent4POI: Agentic Context-Conditioned Affordance Reasoning for Multimodal Point-of-Interest Recommendation

author.name: Jinze Wang, Yangchen Zeng, Tiehua Zhang, Lu Zhang, Yuze Liu, Yongchao Liu, Xingjun Ma, Zhu Sun

entry.summary: Agent4POI generates dynamic context-conditioned representations for POI recommendation at inference time rather than using static pre-computed embeddings, formally proving static encoders cannot satisfy context-sensitive ranking.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Schema-Constrained Clinical Information Extraction

author.name: A H M Rezaul Karim, Ozlem Uzuner

entry.summary: Proposes a modular RAG pipeline for extracting structured observations from nurse-patient transcripts, combining schema-constrained prompting with retrieval from training exemplars.

entry.title: Lamarckian Inheritance in Dynamic Environments: How Key Variables Affect Evolutionary Dynamics

author.name: K. Ege de Bruin, Kyrre Glette, Kai Olav Ellefsen

entry.summary: Studies how key variables affect the benefit of Lamarckian inheritance in evolutionary robotics with dynamic environments, reconciling conflicting evidence in the literature.

entry.title: CHoE: Cross-Domain Heterogeneous Graph Prompt Learning via Structure-Conditioned Experts

author.name: Peiyuan Li, Yongqi Huang, Jitao Zhao, Dongxiao He, Di Jin, Weixiong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CHoE for cross-domain heterogeneous graph prompt learning using expert networks to handle distribution shifts between pre-training and downstream domains. Addresses a real limitation of existing graph prompt methods that only work in-domain.

entry.title: Multi-level Self-supervised Pretraining on Compositional Hierarchical Graph for Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Xiayu Liu, Zhengyi Lu, Hou-biao Li

entry.summary: Proposes MolCHG, a multi-level self-supervised pretraining framework on a compositional hierarchical molecular graph that elevates bond-level information to independent node representations.

entry.title: paper.json: A Coordination Convention for LLM-Agent-Actionable Papers

author.name: Arquimedes Canedo

entry.summary: Proposes paper.json, a JSON companion file for academic papers to make them more actionable by LLM agents, with stable claim IDs, explicit scope limitations, and reproducibility commands.

entry.title: ReTAMamba: Reliability-Aware Temporal Aggregation with Mamba for Irregular Clinical Time Series Prediction

author.name: Jinwoong Kim, Sangjin Park

entry.summary: ReTAMamba combines Mamba architecture with reliability-aware temporal aggregation for irregular clinical time series, estimating observation reliability from missingness and elapsed time to handle the decay of information quality.

entry.title: Nested Spatio-Temporal Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yinghao Ai, Yukai Zhou, Ruoxi Jiang, Junyi An, Chao Qu, Zhijian Zhou, Shiyu Wang, Fenglei Cao, Zenglin Xu, Furao Shen, Yuan Qi

entry.summary: Proposes a nested spatiotemporal forecasting framework that couples macro-level regional trends with micro-level observations, using spectral clustering to construct semantically coherent regions for top-down guidance.

entry.title: World Model-Enabled Causal Digital Twins for Semantic Communications in Physical AI Systems

author.name: Lingyi Wang, Tingyu Shui, Walid Saad, Pascal Adjakple

entry.summary: Proposes world model-enabled causal digital twins for semantic communications in physical AI systems, formulating goal-oriented communications as a long-horizon optimization problem for closed-loop sensing-communication-inference-control.

entry.title: Isolating Nonlinear Independent Sources in fMRI with $\beta$-TCVAE Models

author.name: Qiang Li, Shujian Yu, Jesus Malo, Jingyu Liu, T\"ulay Adali, Vince D. Calhoun

entry.summary: Uses β-TCVAE to learn nonlinear independent sources from fMRI data, going beyond linear ICA to capture complex brain dynamics with validation on real neuroimaging data.

entry.title: PULSE: Generative Phase Evolution for Non-Stationary Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yangyou Liu, Zezhi Shao, Xinyu Chen, Hu Chen, Fei Wang, Yuankai Wu

entry.summary: PULSE formalizes non-stationary time series dynamics through physical hypotheses and proposes phase-anchored disentanglement to address 'Phase Amnesia' where models lose track of evolving global context.

entry.title: Learning Multi-Timescale Abstractions for Hierarchical Combinatorial Planning

author.name: Vivienne Huiling Wang, Tinghuai Wang, Joni Pajarinen

entry.summary: Introduces a model-based hierarchical RL framework for sequential stochastic combinatorial optimization, combining latent-space tree-search with an SMDP-aware world model that handles variable-duration actions.

entry.title: Towards Principled Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Haochun Wang, Ruichen Xu, Georgios Kementzidis, Karen Cho, Sebastian Ramirez Villarreal, Yuefan Deng

entry.summary: Proposes principled test-time adaptation for time series forecasting using a clean protocol based on matured ground truth, with frequency-domain diagnosis revealing existing adapters make limited spectral modifications.

entry.title: Learning Higher-Order Structure from Incomplete Spatiotemporal Data: Multi-Scale Hypergraph Laplacians with Neural Refinement

author.name: Keshu Wu, Sixu Li, Zihao Li, Zhiwen Fan, Xiaopeng Li, Yang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Scale Hypergraph Laplacians for imputing spatiotemporal sensor data with structured (non-random) missingness patterns, capturing higher-order relations among sensor groups.

entry.title: Q-LocalAdam: Memory-Efficient Client-Side Adaptive Optimization for Edge Federated Learning

author.name: Vedant Waykole, Haroon R. Lone

entry.summary: Proposes Q-LocalAdam with distribution-aware 8-bit quantization of Adam optimizer states for federated edge learning, exploiting the observation that momentum is symmetric while variance is log-normal.

entry.title: Beyond Accuracy: Robustness, Interpretability and Expressiveness of EEG Foundation Models

author.name: Urban \v{S}irca, Maryam Alimardani, Stefanos Zafeiriou, Konstantinos Barmpas

entry.summary: Benchmarks six EEG foundation models beyond accuracy, testing robustness to noise/dropout, interpretability via attribution methods, and representational quality, finding no model dominates all dimensions.

entry.title: Counterfactual Explanations Under Concept Drift

author.name: Marcin Kostrzewa, Jerzy Stefanowski, Maciej Zi\k{e}ba

entry.summary: Identifies that counterfactual explanations become invalid under concept drift in streaming settings and proposes a lightweight model-agnostic update scheme to repair existing explanations while preserving proximity to original instances.

entry.title: Efficient Bilevel Optimization for Meta Label Correction in Noisy Label Learning

author.name: Ba Hoang Anh Nguyen, Viet Cuong Ta

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic barrier gradient descent for meta label correction to reduce computational cost of hypergradient computation, achieving approximately first-order complexity while preventing leakage of noisy labels.

entry.title: Improving Spatio-Temporal Residual Error Propagation by Mitigating Over-Squashing

author.name: Seyed Mohamad Moghadas, Esther Rodrigo Bonet, Bruno Cornelis, Adrian Munteanu

entry.summary: Teger proposes a structured uncertainty module for multivariate time series forecasting that models both spatial and temporal error correlations, mitigating over-squashing in residual error propagation.

entry.title: Attacking the First-Principle: A Black-Box, Query-Free Targeted Mimicry Attack on Binary Function Classifiers

author.name: Gabriel Sauger (UL, CNRS, LORIA, Inria), Jean-Yves Marion (UL, CNRS, LORIA, Inria), Sazzadur Rahaman (CNRS, UL, LORIA, Inria), Victor Matrat (CNRS, UL, LORIA, Inria), Vincent Tourneur (UL, CNRS, LORIA, Inria), Muaz Ali

entry.summary: Kelpie is a framework for black-box, zero-query targeted mimicry attacks on binary function classifiers using code transformations that preserve malicious functionality while causing misclassification.

entry.title: KairosHope: A Next-Generation Time-Series Foundation Model for Specialized Classification via Dual-Memory Architecture

author.name: Luis Balderas, Jos\'e Alberto Rodr\'iguez, Miguel Lastra, Antonio Arauzo-Azofra, Jos\'e M. Ben\'itez

entry.summary: Introduces KairosHope, a time-series foundation model for classification using a dual-memory architecture (Titans modules + Continuum Memory System) replacing standard attention to address computational bottlenecks.

entry.title: Helping Customers in Distress: An LLM-powered Agent that Converses, Probes, and Routes

author.name: Alankar Atreya, Stefan Sylvius Wanger, Devesh Batra, Robert Hankache, Cristovao Iglesias Jr, Patrick Sinclair, Giulio Pelosio, Michael McMillan, Greig A. Cowan, Raad Khraishi

entry.summary: Develops an LLM-powered triaging agent for bank fraud/scam reports that conducts multi-turn conversations and routes customers to appropriate specialist teams, using synthetic digital twins for evaluation.

entry.title: Overcoming the Intrinsic Performance Limitations of MEMS IMU via Diffusion-Based Generative Learning

author.name: Jiarui Lv, Feng Zhu, Xiaohong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based framework for synthesizing high-fidelity virtual IMU data from low-cost MEMS IMU measurements, using conditional diffusion to overcome inherent hardware limitations.

entry.title: Multilingual OCR-Aware Fine-Tuning and Prompt-Guided Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Qinwu Xu, Xin Liu, Yifan Jiang, Haoyu Ren

entry.summary: Presents an OCR-aware multilingual training framework combining synthetic data generation, LoRA fine-tuning, and visual chain-of-thought prompting to improve multimodal LLM performance on challenging OCR tasks.

entry.title: Isotonic Survival Regression: Calibrated Survival Distributions from Deep Cox Models

author.name: Anchit Jain, Kevin Zhang, Stephen Bates

entry.summary: Proposes a post-hoc calibration method for Deep Cox survival models using isotonic regression to improve predicted survival probabilities without affecting discriminative power.

entry.title: Learning Relative Representations for Fine-Grained Multimodal Alignment with Limited Data

author.name: Shiwon Kim, Yu Rang Park

entry.summary: Proposes a post-hoc multimodal alignment method using relative representations at the token level, enabling fine-grained cross-modal matching with limited paired data.

entry.title: CAST: Causal Anchored Simplex Transport for Distribution-Valued Time Series

author.name: Jiecheng Lu, Jieqi Di, Runhua Wu, Yuwei Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces CAST for causal forecasting of distribution-valued time series on the probability simplex, using successor retrieval, persistence anchoring, and bounded local transport.

entry.title: SHED: Style-Homogenized Embedding Alignment for Domain Generalization

author.name: Kai Gan, Tong Wei

entry.summary: Proposes SHED, a CLIP-based domain generalization method that aligns style-homogenized embeddings by removing domain-specific visual styles before alignment to address information asymmetry between image and text modalities.

entry.title: Empirical evaluation of Time Series Foundation Models for Day-ahead and Imbalance Electricity Price Forecasting in Belgium

author.name: Chi Bui, Maria Margarida Mascarenhas, Arnaud Verstraeten, Hussain Kazmi

entry.summary: Evaluates time series foundation models (Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5) for Belgian electricity price forecasting, finding Chronos-2 in ARX mode produces most accurate forecasts with 18.8% lower MAE than best ML ensemble.

entry.title: Weighted Flow Matching and Physics-Informed Nonlinear Filtering for Parameter Estimation in Digital Twins

author.name: Yasar Yanik, Himadri Basu, Ricardo G. Sanfelice, Daniele Venturi

entry.summary: Develops weighted flow matching integrated with physics-informed nonlinear filtering for parameter estimation in digital twins, using dynamic sample reweighting to focus on informative parameter regimes.

entry.title: StatQAT: Statistical Quantizer Optimization for Deep Networks

author.name: Mehmet Aktukmak, Daniel Huang, Ke Ding

entry.summary: Presents StatQAT, a statistical error analysis framework for uniform and floating-point quantization, proposing iterative quantizers for arbitrary distributions and analytic quantizers for Gaussian-like weights.

entry.title: The MixCount Dataset: Bridging the Data Gap for Open-Vocabulary Object Counting

author.name: Corentin Dumery, Niki Amini-Naieni, Shervin Naini, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: Introduces MixCount dataset for mixed-object counting, addressing systematic failures of current models in multi-class counting scenarios, with an automated pipeline for generating diverse synthetic counting scenes.

entry.title: SIREM: Speech-Informed MRI Reconstruction with Learned Sampling

author.name: Md Hasan, Nyvenn Castro, Daiqi Liu, Lukas Mulzer, Jana Hutter, Jonghye Woo, Moritz Zaiss, Andreas Maier, Paula A. Perez-Toro

entry.summary: Proposes SIREM, a speech-informed MRI reconstruction framework that uses synchronized speech audio as cross-modal prior to improve real-time vocal tract MRI quality under k-space undersampling.

entry.title: Better Together: Evaluating the Complementarity of Earth Embedding Models

author.name: Thijs L van der Plas, Jacob JW Bakermans, Vishal Nedungadi, Gabriel\.e Tij\=unaityt\.e, Marc Ru{\ss}wurm, Ioannis N Athanasiadis

entry.summary: Evaluates complementarity of Earth embedding models (AlphaEarth, Tessera, GeoCLIP, SatCLIP) by measuring performance gains from fusion. Introduces an embedding complementarity index to assess how well different models combine.

entry.title: Closing the Gap at CRAC 2026: Two-Stage Adaptation for LLM-Based Multilingual Coreference Resolution

author.name: Antoine Bourgois, Olga Seminck, Thierry Poibeau

entry.summary: Presents a Gemma-3-27b based system for multilingual coreference resolution that ranked first in the LLM track at CRAC 2026, using two-stage adaptation with multilingual base adapter followed by dataset-specific adapters.

entry.title: Agentic AI Translate: An Agentic Translator Prototype for Translation as Communication Design

author.name: Masaru Yamada

entry.summary: Presents Agentic AI Translate, a prototype implementing four-stage agentic translation cycle grounded in translation studies theory (skopos theory, register, audience), replacing the standard text-in/text-out MT paradigm.

entry.title: Analyzing Error Propagation in Korean Spoken QA with ASR-LLM Cascades

author.name: Donghyuk Jung, Youngwon Choi

entry.summary: Analyzes how ASR errors propagate through ASR-LLM cascades in Korean spoken QA, finding that relative degradation is consistent across LLMs and identifying single-character Korean errors as a distinct semantic-failure channel.

entry.title: Vector RAG vs LLM-Compiled Wiki: A Preregistered Comparison on a Small Multi-Domain Research

author.name: Theodore O. Cochran

entry.summary: Preregistered comparison of Vector RAG vs. LLM-compiled wiki for answering questions over a small research corpus. Finds wiki better at cross-paper connections but RAG better for single-fact lookups, with wiki using more query tokens than expected.

entry.title: DriveSafe: A Framework for Risk Detection and Safety Suggestions in Driving Scenarios

author.name: Sainithin Artham, Shankar Gangisetty, Avijit Dasgupta, C. V. Jawahar

entry.summary: Proposes DriveSafe, a framework for risk-aware scene understanding in autonomous driving that generates spatially grounded captions with multimodal context (motion, spatial, depth) for fine-grained risk assessment.

entry.title: RAGA: Reading-And-Graph-building-Agent for Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction and Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Chengrui Han, Zesheng Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes RAGA, an LLM-based autonomous knowledge graph construction and retrieval framework with atomic CRUD operations and a Read-Search-Verify-Construct cognitive constraint in a ReAct loop.

entry.title: UCSF-PDGM-VQA: Visual Question Answering dataset for brain tumor MRI interpretation

author.name: Shiv Ghosh (Catherine), Junayd Lateef (Catherine), Chih-Hua (Catherine), Liu, Yannan Yu, Andreas M. Rauschecker, Madhumita Sushil

entry.summary: Introduces UCSF-PDGM-VQA, a clinically relevant Visual Question Answering dataset for brain tumor MRI interpretation, aimed at evaluating VLMs for semi-automated neuro-oncology image analysis.

entry.title: Stabilizing Temporal Inference Dynamics for Online Surgical Phase Recognition

author.name: Yang Liu, Ning Zhu, Jingjing Peng, Xiwu Chen, Alejandro Granados, Guotai Wang, Sebastien Ourselin

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for online surgical phase recognition that addresses temporal instability through error cascade prevention and evidence-accumulation-based phase transition detection.

entry.title: ChronoSC: Task-Oriented Semantic Communication via Temporal-to-Color Encoding

author.name: Phuc H. Nguyen, Trung T. Nguyen, Quy N. Duong, Van-Dinh Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes ChronoSC, a semantic communication framework for video QA that encodes temporal dynamics into a single static image via Chrono-Color Stacking, enabling extreme temporal compression before transmission.

entry.title: Contrastive-SDXL: Annotation-Preserving Night-Time Augmentation for Pedestrian Detection

author.name: Franky George, Muhammad Khalid, Adil Khan

entry.summary: Presents Contrastive-SDXL, a day-to-night augmentation framework for pedestrian detection using SDXL-Turbo with LoRA fine-tuning, preserving semantic correspondence between domains.

entry.title: Agentic Pipeline for Self-Synchronized Multiview Joint Angle Monitoring in Uncalibrated Environments

author.name: Juncheng Yu, Lusi A, Haoxuan Xie, Weiming Wang

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic pipeline using multimodal LLMs for automatic video synchronization and joint angle monitoring in rehabilitation from uncalibrated multi-view cameras without hardware triggers.

entry.title: REC-RL: Referring expression counting via Gaussian and range-based reward optimization

author.name: Hui Liu, Yunlai Teng, Kunlong Bai, Pengfei Qi, Haotian Yan, Liang Li, Junlan Feng

entry.summary: Proposes REC-RL for referring expression counting using reinforcement learning with a think-range-answer paradigm and dual rewards (Gaussian accuracy + range supervision) to improve visual reasoning quality.

entry.title: MHMamba: Multi-Head Mamba for 3D Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Hanjun Tao, Hua Wang, Fan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MHMamba for 3D brain tumor segmentation using a multi-head state-space model in U-shaped architecture, splitting channels into parallel SSM heads to balance long-range modeling with efficiency.

entry.title: Employing Vision-Language Models for Face Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Erdi Sar{\i}ta\c{s}, Eren Onaran, Vitomir \v{S}truc, Haz{\i}m Kemal Ekenel

entry.summary: Investigates using off-the-shelf Vision-Language Models for Face Image Quality Assessment in zero-shot settings, providing human-interpretable justifications unlike black-box FIQA methods.

entry.title: UST-Hand: An Uncertainty-aware Spatiotemporal Point Cloud Interaction Network for 3D Self-supervised Hand Pose Estimation

author.name: Tianhao Han, Haoyang Zhang, Liang Xie, Haochen Chang, Kun Gao, Yuan Cheng, Pengfei Ren, Erwei Yin

entry.summary: Proposes UST-Hand, a self-supervised hand pose estimation framework using uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal point cloud interactions to handle noisy pseudo-labels.

entry.title: Network Knowledge Prior Guided Learning for Data-Efficient Surface Defect Detection

author.name: Hang-Cheng Dong, Guodong Liu, Dong Ye, Bingguo Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a knowledge-guided loss function for data-efficient surface defect detection that integrates saliency-based interpretability into training without additional inference cost.

entry.title: Dance Across Shifts: Forward-Facilitation Continual Test-Time Adaptation through Dynamic Style Bridging

author.name: Zhilin Zhu, Yabin Wang, Zhiheng Ma, Yaguang Song, Yaowei Wang, Xiaopeng Hong

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Style Bridging for Continual Test-Time Adaptation, introducing a forward-facilitation paradigm that adapts generated class exemplars to incoming test data through multi-level bridging, rather than backward alignment to source domain.

entry.title: A Large-Scale Study on the Accuracy vs Cost Trade-offs of Training and Evaluation Settings in Fine-Grained Image Recognition

author.name: Edwin Arkel Rios, Augusto Christian Surya, Oswin Gosal, Fernando Mikael, Mary Madeline Nicole, Kisoon Jang, Bo-Cheng Lai, Min-Chun Hu

entry.summary: Large-scale empirical study (2000+ experiments) examining accuracy-vs-cost trade-offs in fine-grained image recognition across training/evaluation settings, backbones, and datasets. Extends CAL with cross-image discriminative region mixing.

entry.title: BIDO: A Biometric Identity Online Authentication Framework

author.name: Aditya Mithra, Sibi Chakkaravarthy S, Srinivas Kankanala

entry.summary: BIDO presents a device-free biometric authentication standard achieving AAL2 without storing biometric templates, deriving ECDSA keys deterministically from live biometric measurements at each authentication event.

entry.title: Fixed External Cameras as Common Prior Maps for Active 3D Scene Graph Generation

author.name: Giorgia Modi, Davide Buoso, Giuseppe Averta, Daniele De Martini

entry.summary: Proposes using fixed external RGB cameras as Common Prior Maps for active 3D scene graph generation, initializing semantic and geometric priors before robot motion begins. Uses a hardware-agnostic RGB-only pipeline.

entry.title: RGB-only Active 3D Scene Graph Generation for Indoor Mobile Robots

author.name: Giorgia Modi, Davide Buoso, Giuseppe Averta, Daniele De Martini

entry.summary: Presents a fully visual RGB-only framework for active, incremental 3D scene graph construction without depth sensors, using active viewpoint selection based on partially built scene representations.

entry.title: A Mechanistic Model for Collective Motion from Sensorimotor Regularities

author.name: Vito Mengers, Bao Duc Cao, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Presents a mechanistic model for collective animal motion based on sensorimotor regularities rather than abstract interaction forces, where agents perceive neighbors through limited sensing and execute physically grounded behaviors.

entry.title: SSTL: Self-Sensing Tendon Loop for Hysteresis Modeling and Compensation in Tendon-Sheath Mechanisms

author.name: Myeongbo Park, Junhyun Park, Ihsan Ullah, Chunggil An, Minho Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes the Self-Sensing Tendon Loop (SSTL), a double-pass tendon mechanism that enables proximal measurement of both input and output tensions for hysteresis modeling and compensation in flexible endoscopic robots.

entry.title: Generating Realistic Safety-Critical Scenarios for Vehicle-Pedestrian Interactions

author.name: Qingwen Pu, Kun Xie, Yuan Zhu, Guocong Zhai

entry.summary: Proposes a three-stage framework combining real-world grounding with adaptive simulation to generate realistic safety-critical vehicle-pedestrian scenarios at scale, using multi-agent state-space Transformer-enhanced DDPG.

entry.title: Motion-Uncertainty-Aware Next-Best-View Planning for Moving Object Reconstruction

author.name: Karen Li, Mattia Mantovani, Robert J. Wood, Lorenzo Sabattini, Stephanie Gil

entry.summary: Presents a motion-uncertainty-aware next-best-view framework for reconstructing unknown moving objects, accounting for motion uncertainty during decision-to-execution delay.

entry.title: Active Defense Against False Data Injection Attacks in Robotic Manipulators

author.name: Gabriele Gualandi, Carl Mikael Larsson, Alessandro V. Papadopoulos

entry.summary: Addresses active defense against False Data Injection Attacks on robotic manipulators, proposing anomaly-aware virtual damping and manipulability reduction with probabilistic guarantees on task execution.

entry.title: Consent Chain Degradation in Embodied Multi-Agent Systems: Bridging the Gap Between AI Agent Governance and Robot Ethics

author.name: Mehmet Haklidir

entry.summary: Introduces 'consent chain degradation' (CCD), a conceptual framework analyzing how human consent degrades when physical robots delegate tasks to other robots in multi-agent systems affecting humans.

entry.title: DRS-GUI: Dynamic Region Search for Training-Free GUI Grounding

author.name: Yichao Liu, Huawen Shen, Liu Yu, Shiyu Liu, Zeyu Chen, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: DRS-GUI proposes a training-free dynamic region search framework for GUI grounding that mimics human perceptual strategies (Focus, Shift, Scatter) to progressively locate task-relevant UI elements in high-resolution screenshots.

entry.title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration

author.name: Michael Solodko, Justin Wagle

entry.summary: ScreenSearch combines structural screen retrieval with an ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration, addressing partial observability in GUI agent environments.

entry.title: Learning Sim-Grounded Policies for Bimanual Rope Manipulation from Human Teleoperation Data

author.name: Gina Wigginghaus, Tim Missal, Berk Guler, Simon Manschitz, Jan Peters

entry.summary: Investigates whether lack of generalization in egocentric visual policies for bimanual rope manipulation stems from the observation space rather than policy architecture, comparing visual vs. sim-grounded approaches.

entry.title: Federated Imputation under Heterogeneous Feature Spaces

author.name: Imane Hocine, Chaimaa Medjadji, Sylvain Kubler, Gregoire Danoy, Yves Le Traon

entry.summary: Proposes FedHF-Impute for federated imputation under heterogeneous feature spaces, using a shared global feature graph to propagate information across partially overlapping feature subsets.

entry.title: MA$^{2}$P: A Meta-Cognitive Autonomous Intelligent Agents Framework for Complex Persuasion

author.name: Dingyi Zhang, Ziqing Zhuang, Linhai Zhang, Ziyang Gao, Deyu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes MA²P, a meta-cognitive autonomous agent framework for complex persuasion that infers persuadee's latent mental states (beliefs, desires) and translates them into targeted, strategy-consistent persuasive actions.

entry.title: Diffusion Attention Expert Model for Predicting and Semi-automatic Localizing STAS in Lung Cancer Histopathological Images

author.name: Liangrui Pan, Jiadi Luo, Yuxuan Xiao, Chenchen Nie, Xiaoshuai Wu, Songqing Fan, Ling Chu, Manqiu Li, Rongfang He, Zhenyu Zhao, Ruixing Wang, Shulin Liu, Yiyi Liang, Xiang Wang, Qingchun Liang, Shaoliang Peng

entry.summary: Proposes DAEM for detecting spread through air spaces (STAS) in lung cancer histopathology using diffusion attention with full attention aggregation for multi-scale features across frozen and paraffin sections.

entry.title: VGGT-CD: Training-Free Robust Registration for 3D Change Detection

author.name: Wei Zhang (Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an, China), Songhua Li (Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an, China), Yihang Wu (Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an, China), Qiang Li (Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an, China), Qi Wang (Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an, China)

entry.summary: Presents VGGT-CD, a training-free pipeline for 3D change detection from multi-view images that decouples cross-temporal registration from dynamic-change interference using visual geometry foundation models.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Faithful Textual Explanations via Directional-Derivative Influence on Predictions

author.name: Toshinori Yamauchi, Hiroshi Kera, Kazuhiko Kawamoto

entry.summary: Proposes FaithTrace for zero-shot textual explanations of image classifiers by measuring how much explanation-induced representations influence class logits via directional derivatives.

entry.title: Motion Cues from Image-based Point Tracking for LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation

author.name: Youngdong Jang, Gyeongrok Oh, Jong Wook Kim, Hyunju Ryu, Hyung-gun Chi, SeungHyeon Kim, Seungryong Kim, Jonghyun Choi, Sangpil Kim

entry.summary: Introduces TrackCue, a tracking-guided framework that uses image-based point tracking to provide dense motion cues for LiDAR scene flow estimation, improving dynamic object representation.

entry.title: Neuroscience-inspired Staged Representation Learning with Disentangled Coarse- and Fine-Grained Semantics for EEG Visual Decoding

author.name: Xiang Gao, Hui Tian, Yanming Zhu, Xuefei Yin, Alan Wee-Chung Liew

entry.summary: Proposes neuroscience-inspired staged representation learning for EEG visual decoding that decomposes learning into low-level, high-level semantic, and fine-grained phases following human visual processing stages.

entry.title: Thermal-Only Crowd Counting with Deployment-Time Privacy Protection

author.name: Yifei Qian, Zhongliang Guo, Chun Tong Lei, Bowen Deng, Chun Pong Lau, Xiaopeng Hong, Michael P. Pound

entry.summary: Proposes the first thermal-only framework for privacy-conscious crowd counting that eliminates RGB dependency at inference, using depth-to-RGB diffusion models as cross-modal bridge to enhance thermal representations.

entry.title: CAM-VFD: Cross-Attention Multimodal Video Forgery Detection

author.name: Hoda Osama Elkhodary, Sherin Mostafa Youssef, Marwa Elshenawy, Dalia Sobhy

entry.summary: Proposes CAM-VFD for video forgery detection using cross-attention multimodal fusion that models cross-modal contradictions between appearance (CLIP), geometry, and motion as directional forensic signals.

entry.title: Beyond Detection: A Structure-Aware Framework for Scene Text Tracking

author.name: Chenmin Yu, Liu Yu, Daiqing Wu, Gengluo Li, Zeyu Chen, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Formalizes Scene Text Tracking as a specific task and proposes SymTrack, a detection-free framework with dual-branch architecture addressing geometric distortions, visual ambiguity, and structural sensitivity.

entry.title: StyleText: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Stylized Scene Text Inpainting

author.name: Aleksandr Simonyan, Nipun Jindal

entry.summary: Presents StyleText, a large-scale dataset (28,518 triplets) and benchmark for stylized scene text inpainting with automated construction pipeline combining LLMs, Flux generation, OCR filtering, and reproducible evaluation.

entry.title: GraphMAR: Geometry-Aware Graph Learning Framework for Spatially Adaptive CT Metal Artifact Reduction

entry.title: MARS: Technical Report for the CASTLE Challenge at EgoVis 2026

author.name: Haoyu Zhang, Qiaohui Chu, Yisen Feng, Meng Liu, Weili Guan, Yaowei Wang, Liqiang Nie

entry.title: CineMatte: Background Matting for Virtual Production and Beyond

entry.title: NeRF-based Spacecraft Reconstruction from Close-Range Monocular Imagery Under Illumination Variability and Pose Uncertainty

author.name: Antoine Legrand, Renaud Detry, Christophe De Vleeschouwer

entry.summary: Extends NeRF for spacecraft 3D reconstruction from monocular imagery with per-image learnable appearance embeddings for illumination variability and pose corrections for orbit uncertainty.

entry.title: Speech-Guided Multimodal Learning for Vocal Tract Segmentation in Real-Time MRI

author.name: Daiqi Liu, Lukas Mulzer, Md Hasan, Nyvenn de Castro, Fangxu Xing, Xingjian Kang, Chengze Ye, Siyuan Mei, Yipeng Sun, Tom\'as Arias-Vergara, Jana Hutter, Jonghye Woo, Andreas Maier, Paula Andrea P\'erez-Toro

entry.title: Adaptive Fused Prior Transfer for Controllable Generative Image Compression

author.name: Yifei Pei, Ying Liu, Nam Ling

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive fused prior transfer for controllable generative image compression at very low bitrates, using multiple prior sources rather than single-codebook approaches to better handle severe bit constraints.

entry.title: Real-Time Neural Hair Denoising

author.name: Chenghao Wu, Yuefan Shen, Tao Huang, Kai Yan, Zahra Montazeri, Kui Wu

Achieves higher quality than existing hair denoising techniques for physically-based deferred shading.

entry.title: "I'm Not Mad, Just Focused'': Understanding Human Emotions in Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Seung Chan Hong, Dana Kuli\'c, Leimin Tian

entry.summary: Proposes a VLM-based emotion recognition system for human-robot collaboration that leverages contextual understanding. User study shows emotional awareness improves collaboration quality despite misclassification concerns.

entry.title: Stretch-ICP: A Continuous-Trajectory Registration and Deskewing Algorithm in Scenarios of Aggressive Motions

author.name: Simon-Pierre Desch\^enes, Veronica Vannini, Philippe Gigu\`ere, Fran\c{c}ois Pomerleau

entry.summary: Introduces Stretch-ICP for continuous-trajectory registration and deskewing under aggressive motions, along with the TIGS dataset of a LiDAR tumbling down a hill with extreme angular velocities.

entry.title: Rapid Vibration Suppression and Trajectory Tracking of a Serial Manipulator with Multi-Flexible Links

author.name: Chengyi Wang, Yilong Huang, Ji Wang

entry.title: Optimal Knock-Pick Planning for Tightly Packed Tabletop Blocks With Parallel Grippers

author.name: Hao Lu, Rahul Shome

entry.summary: Studies optimal knock-pick planning for densely packed tabletop blocks where parallel grippers lack clearance, introducing directional knock primitives and solving via maximum-weight perfect matching.

entry.title: A Dexterous and Compliant Gripper With Soft Hydraulic Actuation for Microgravity Manipulation

author.name: William Su, Jordan Kam, Yixiao Wang, Jianshu Zhou

entry.summary: Presents DexCoHand, a dexterous 6-DOF soft hydraulic gripper integrated with Astrobee for microgravity manipulation on the ISS, evaluated in MuJoCo simulation for handrail perching sequences.

entry.title: Scenario Generation in Roundabouts with Adjustable Interaction Intensity

author.name: Li Li, Till Temmen, Tobias Brinkmann, Bj\"orn Krautwig, Markus Eisenbarth, Jakob Andert

entry.summary: Presents an interaction-aware roundabout scenario generator with continuously adjustable interaction intensity using latent-space autoencoders, enabling systematic AV safety testing.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Surrogate for Real-Time Hydrodynamics Estimation of Autonomous Ground Vehicles in Amphibious Environments

author.name: Ammar Waheed, Luke Gallantree, Zohaib Hasnain

entry.summary: Develops a per-surface neural network surrogate for real-time hydrodynamics estimation of autonomous ground vehicles in water, trained on CFD data using signed distance fields for geometry-resolved force prediction.

entry.title: ATRACT: A Trustworthy Robotic Autonomous system to support Casualty Triage

author.name: Tasweer Ahmad, Rafael Pina, Sandip Pradhan, Arindam Sikdar, Mindula Illeperuma, Khizer Saeed, Peter Lee, Varuna De Silva, Ardhendu Behera

entry.summary: Presents ATRACT, a drone-based decision support system for battlefield casualty triage, integrating drone video with wearable sensor data to assist frontline medics during the critical post-trauma period.

entry.title: A data-driven Fourier-mixture neural-network method for density estimation

author.name: Duy-Minh Dang, Volter Entoma

entry.summary: Proposes a neural network method for density estimation trained in Fourier space using empirical characteristic functions. The estimator uses a positive Gaussian-Laplace mixture ensuring nonnegativity and unit mass, with theoretical error bounds.

entry.title: Computational aspects of the Volterra Signature

author.name: Paul P. Hager, Fabian N. Harang, Luca Pelizzari, Samy Tindel

entry.summary: Develops efficient algorithms for computing the Volterra signature (generalizing the classical path signature with matrix-valued kernels), achieving quadratic general complexity and FFT-based acceleration for specific kernel classes.

entry.title: Coordinal: A Postmortem.

author.name: Ronak_Mehta

entry.summary: Postmortem of Coordinal Research, a startup that aimed to build an automated AI safety research platform. Describes the arc from MATS through funding to shutdown, with lessons about scope, ego, and startup failure modes.

entry.title: PAGER: Bridging the Semantic-Execution Gap in Point-Precise Geometric GUI Control

author.name: Jingxuan Wei, Xi Bai, Shan Liu, Caijun Jia, Zheng Sun, Xinglong Xu, Siyuan Li, Linzhuang Sun, Bihui Yu, Conghui He, Cheng Tan

entry.summary: PAGER addresses precision-sensitive GUI tasks (like geometric construction) where actions must land on exact points rather than tolerant regions, requiring point-level accuracy and geometry-aware verification.

entry.title: Presupposition and Reasoning in Conditionals: A Theory-Based Study of Humans and LLMs

author.name: Tara Azin, Yongan Yu, Raj Singh, Olessia Jouravlev

entry.summary: Compares human and LLM processing of presupposition projection in conditionals through parallel behavioral studies. Finds humans integrate probabilistic and pragmatic cues while LLMs show variable alignment with human patterns.

entry.title: RTL-BenchMT: Dynamic Maintenance of RTL Generation Benchmark Through Agent-Assisted Analysis and Revision

author.name: Jing Wang, Shang Liu, Hangan Zhou, Zhiyao Xie

entry.summary: RTL-BenchMT is an agentic framework for dynamically maintaining RTL generation benchmarks, automatically identifying flawed cases and detecting overfitting in hardware design benchmarks.

entry.title: TopoEvo: A Topology-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices

author.name: Junle Wang, Xingchuang Liao, Wenjun Wu

entry.summary: TopoEvo is a topology-aware self-evolving multi-agent framework for root cause analysis in microservices that couples graph representation learning with topology-constrained reasoning to avoid symptom-amplification bias.

entry.title: CitePrism: Human-in-the-Loop AI for Citation Auditing and Editorial Integrity

author.name: Gowrika Mahesh, Budanur Madappa Darshan Gowda, Kavana Gopladevarahalli Papegowda, Prajwal Basavaraj, Binh Vu, Swati Chandna, Mehrdad Jalali

entry.summary: Presents CitePrism, a hybrid human-in-the-loop system for editorial citation auditing combining LLM reasoning, semantic similarity, metadata verification, and integrity flags to support manuscript review.

entry.title: Mirror Descent-Type Algorithms for the Variational Inequality Problem with Functional Constraints

author.name: Mohammad S. Alkousa, Fedor S. Stonyakin, Belal A. Alashqar, Seydamet S. Ablaev

entry.summary: Proposes mirror descent algorithms for variational inequality problems with functional constraints, with optimal convergence rates for bounded and monotone operators.

entry.title: Peak-Detector: Explainable Peak Detection via Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models in Physiological Sign

author.name: Jiahui Li, Yida Zhang, Zixuan Zeng, Jiayu Chen, Yingjian Song, Yin Xiao, Nishan Dong, Junjie Lu, Younghoon Kwon, Xiang Zhang, Jin Lu, Wenzhan Song, Fei Dou

entry.title: Learning Fill-in Reduction Ordering via Graph Policy Optimization for Sparse Matrices

author.name: Ziwei Li, Shuzi Niu, Huiyuan Li, Tao Yuan, Wenjia Wu

entry.summary: Proposes graph policy optimization for sparse matrix fill-in reduction, using multi-hop GNN with symbolic factorization feedback for both global and local fill-in views.

entry.title: Uncertainty Reliability Under Domain Shift: An Investigation for Data-Driven Blood Pressure Estimation in Photoplethysmography

entry.title: Bridging the Version Gap: Multi-version Training Improves ICD Code Prediction, Especially for Rare Codes

entry.title: Synthetic Aperture Radar Image Change Detection Based on Global Dynamic Context-Aware Network

entry.title: Inter-LPCM: Learning-based Inter-Frame Predictive Coding for LiDAR Point Cloud Compression

entry.title: Mapping the Fitness Landscape: A Structure-Guided Approach to Multi-Modal Optimization

entry.title: Virtues of Ordered Chaos: Planning with Topple Actions in Tabletop Stack Rearrangement

author.name: Hao Lu, Rahul Shome

entry.summary: Studies augmenting tabletop stack rearrangement with topple actions that can compress long sequences of intermediate relocations, introducing a novel aggregating gadget for planning with both pick-and-place and topple.

entry.title: Towards Ubiquitous Mapping and Localization for Dynamic Indoor Environments

entry.title: Learning Gaussian Graphical Models under Total Positivity via Spectral Graph Sparsification

author.name: Ignacio Echave-Sustaeta Rodr\'iguez, Aida Abiad, Frank R\"ottger

entry.summary: Proposes a spectral graph sparsification approach for learning Gaussian graphical models under total positivity (MTP2) constraints, addressing the problem that MTP2-constrained graphs are typically too dense.

entry.title: NIMO Controller: a self-driving laboratory orchestrator based on the Model Context Protocol

author.name: Naruki Yoshikawa, Ryo Tamura

entry.title: See Before You Code: Learning Visual Priors for Spatially Aware Educational Animation Generation

author.name: Yuejia Li, Ke He, Junheng Li, Shutong Chen, Jingkang Xia, Zhiyue Su, Junchi Zhang, Mang Ye

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Wildfire Smoke Density Classification from Satellite Imagery via CBAM-Augmented EfficientNet with Evidential Deep Learning

author.name: Ranjith Chodavarapu

entry.title: DeepArrhythmia: Segment-Contextualized ECG Arrhythmia Classification via Selective Evidence Acquisition

author.name: Jiahui Li, Ruili Fang, Zishuai Liu, WenZhan Song, Jin Lu, Fei Dou

entry.title: UNR-Explainer: Counterfactual Explanations for Unsupervised Node Representation Learning Models

author.name: Hyunju Kang, Geonhee Han, Hogun Park

entry.title: UniAlign: A Model-Agnostic Framework for Robust Network Traffic Classification under Distribution Shifts

author.name: Tongze Wang, Xiaohui Xie, Wenduo Wang, Chuyi Wang, Yong Cui

It addresses a practical problem in deploying ML models in changing network conditions.

author.name: Barsat Khadka, Prasant Koirala, Kshitiz Neupane, Nick Rahimi

author.name: Tianyue Yang, Sandro Tacchella, Xiao Xue

entry.title: Exploring Lightweight Large Language Models for Court View Generation

author.name: Zhitian Hou, Tianyong Hao, Nanli Zeng, Zhixiong Chao, Kun Zeng

entry.title: Response-free item difficulty modelling for multiple-choice items with fine-tuned transformers: Component-wise representation and multi-task learning

entry.summary: Proposes fine-tuning transformer encoders end-to-end for response-free item difficulty prediction on reading comprehension items, with component-wise and multi-task extensions that avoid manual feature engineering.

author.name: Qingwen Zhao, Hongao Zhu, Yunqi He, Rui Wang, Aijun Huang, Hai Hu

author.name: M. Mikail Demir, M. Abdullah Canbaz

entry.title: See Silhouettes in Motion with Neuromorphic Vision

author.name: Pei Zhang, Shijie Lin, Zhou Ge, Jinpeng Chen, Wei Pu

entry.summary: Proposes using neuromorphic event cameras for binarization of quasi-bimodal objects (text, signs, barcodes) on mobile platforms, leveraging microsecond temporal resolution to overcome motion blur and harsh lighting challenges.

entry.title: MR-SLAM: Immersive Spatial Supervision for Multi-Robot Mapping via Mixed Reality

author.name: Prakash Aryan, Cem Erdogdu, Kavinaya Kumarchokkappan, Timo Kehrer, Sebastiano Panichella

entry.title: Policy Learning with Observational Data: The Case of Hepatitis C Treatment for HIV/HCV Co-Infected Patients

author.name: Rapha\"el Langevin

entry.title: STAR: A Stage-attributed Triage and Repair framework for RCA Agents in Microservices

author.name: Junle Wang, Xingchuang Liao, Wenjun Wu

entry.summary: STAR is a framework for repairing erroneous root cause analysis traces in microservice systems by decomposing RCA workflows into structured stages and treating failures as stage-localizable reasoning bugs.

entry.title: An Algebraic Exposition of the Theory of Dyadic Morality

author.name: Kush R. Varshney

entry.summary: Provides an algebraic formalization of the Theory of Dyadic Morality using structural causal models, identifying three psychological operators and addressing scalability through node collapse.

entry.title: Autonomous Intelligent Agents for Natural-Language-Driven Web Execution with Integrated Security Assurance

author.name: Vinil Pasupuleti, Siva Rama Krishna Varma Bayyavarapu, Shrey Tyagi

entry.summary: Presents an AI-driven autonomous web testing framework with five integrated strategies that improves script generation success from 55% to 93% and achieves 8x reduction in navigation failures.

entry.title: Fortress: A Case Study in Stabilizing Search Recommendations via Temporal Data Augmentation and Feature Pruning

author.name: Milind Pandurang Jagre, Jia Huang, Dayvid V. R. Oliveira, Zhinan Cheng, Babak Seyed Aghazadeh, Puja Das, Chris Alvino, Jinda Han, Kailash Thiyagarajan

entry.summary: Experimentally compares centralized, decentralized, and semi-decentralized federated learning architectures to understand trade-offs in performance, communication, and scalability.

entry.title: Systematic Optimization of Real-Time Diffusion Model Inference on Apple M3 Ultra

entry.title: QuantFPFlow: Quantum Amplitude Estimation for Fokker--Planck Policy Optimisation in Continuous Reinforcement Learning

entry.title: OPTNet: Ordering Point Transformer Network for Post-disaster 3D Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Nhut Le, Ehsan Karimi, Maryam Rahnemoonfar

entry.summary: Proposes OPTNet with a learnable Point Sorter module for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation in post-disaster scenes, replacing fixed serialization orderings with learned ones optimized for complex disaster geometry.

entry.title: Learning in Position-Aware Multinomial Logit Bandits: From Multiplicative to General Position Effects

author.name: Xi Chen, Shibo Dai, Jiameng Lyu, Yuan Zhou

entry.summary: Studies dynamic assortment selection and positioning under MNL choice models, designing round-based learning algorithms with regret-optimal characterization for both multiplicative and general position effects.

entry.title: BESplit: Bias-Compensated Split Federated Learning with Evidential Aggregation

author.name: Yuhan Xie, Chen Lyu, Jingrong Huang

entry.summary: Proposes BESplit for split federated learning under non-IID data, using architecture-aware bias compensation and evidential aggregation that exploit the inherent structure of split learning.

entry.title: Memisis: Orchestrating and Evaluating Synthetic Data for Tabular Health Datasets

author.name: Nitish Nagesh, Mahdi Bagheri, Arshia Harish Puthran, Pengbao Zhou, Muhjaazee Love, Aadi Sharma, Ian Harris, Amir M. Rahmani

entry.title: Lightweight Gaussian Process Inference in C++ on Metal and CUDA

author.name: Yu-Hsueh Fang

entry.summary: LightGP is a dependency-free C++17 library for Gaussian process regression with Metal and CUDA backends, achieving 2.6-8.7x speedup over GPyTorch on Apple M4 for exact GP and scaling to N=500,000.

entry.title: UTOPYA: A Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Physics-Informed Anomaly Detection and Time-Series Prediction

author.name: Robson W. S. Pessoa, Julien Amblard, Alessandra Russo, Idelfonso B. R. Nogueira

entry.summary: UTOPYA is a 15.2M-parameter multimodal framework for anomaly detection, time-series prediction, and phase classification in batch distillation, fusing eight data modalities with physics-informed regularization.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Tasks Offloading in Vehicular Edge Computing: A Federated Meta Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach

author.name: Yaorong Huang, Jingtao Luo, Xuechao Wang

entry.title: A Machine Learning Framework for EEG-Based Prediction of Treatment Efficacy in Chronic Neck Pain

author.name: Xiru Wang, Aiden Li, Hongzhao Tan, Stevie Foglia, Aimee Nelson, Zhen Gao

entry.summary: Presents an ML framework using EEG to predict treatment efficacy for chronic neck pain, with separate preprocessing pipelines for resting-state and motor execution EEG recordings.

entry.title: Cross-Source Supervision for Bone Infection Segmentation in Dual-Modality PET-CT

author.name: Zonglin Yang, Xiaolei Diao, Jishizhan Chen, Xiaozhuang Man, Wei Kong, Gen Wen, Pengfei Cheng, Daqian Shi

entry.summary: Develops a cross-source supervision framework for bone infection segmentation in PET-CT, addressing annotation discrepancy through early-fusion multimodal representation.

entry.title: CheckSupport: A Local LLM-Powered Tool for Automated Manuscript Submission Checklist Selection and Completion

author.name: Satvik Tripathi, Don Enwerem, Kevin Song, Kristian Quevada, Jacinta Arnold, Tessa S. Cook

entry.summary: Presents CheckSupport, an open-source tool using local LLMs to automate selection and completion of reporting checklists for scientific manuscripts, using staged prompting for faithful extraction.

entry.title: Deep Learning for MRI Slice Interpolation: The Critical Role of Problem Formulation

author.name: Shamit Savant

entry.summary: Evaluates deep learning architectures for MRI slice interpolation in prostate imaging, finding that problem formulation (using adjacent vs. distant slices) matters more than architecture choice, achieving 58% SSIM improvement.

entry.title: SeamCam: Quantifying Seamless Camouflage via Multi-Cue Visual Detectability

entry.title: Research Summary: May 18, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research centers on fundamental limitations of AI oversight, theoretical bounds on self-improvement, and security vulnerabilities in deployed systems.

  • CoT Obfuscation demonstrates models learn to hide reasoning when exposed to monitoring-related documents — a direct threat to alignment-via-interpretability strategies
  • NOVA framework proves formal coverage conditions and failure modes for recursive AI knowledge discovery
  • RoPE is shown to provably lose positional discrimination in long contexts, affecting virtually all modern LLMs
  • Imperfect World Models proves exploitation is inevitable when RL agents optimize against approximate dynamics
  • Sleeper Memory Poisoning reveals a novel persistent attack vector in LLM agents through manipulated external context

On the constructive side, AIRA-Compose/Design demonstrates autonomous architecture discovery beyond standard Transformers, while an LLM-guided tree search system matches CDC experts in prospective multi-pathogen forecasting. Theoretical work reframes grokking as Bayesian inference over task graphs, and Judge Circuits applies causal interpretability to the LLM-as-judge paradigm. VLM analysis reveals self-reflective statements like "let me check again" are learned linguistic patterns rather than genuine visual re-examination.

entry.title: Training on Documents About Monitoring Leads to CoT Obfuscation

author.name: Reilly Haskins, Bilal Chughtai and Joshua Engels

entry.summary: Shows that exposing models to documents describing CoT monitoring leads to obfuscation of reasoning traces, with monitor-aware models achieving higher rates of undetected misbehavior.

entry.title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI

author.name: Salman Avestimehr, Ken Duffy, and Muriel M\'edard

entry.summary: Introduces NOVA framework modeling AI self-improvement as adaptive sampling over knowledge space, proving coverage conditions and identifying failure modes including a 'contamination trap' where false positives overwhelm genuine discoveries.

entry.title: Hidden in Memory: Sleeper Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents

author.name: Sidharth Pulipaka, Stanislau Hlebik, Leonidas Raghav, Sahar Abdelnabi, Vyas Raina, Ivaxi Sheth, Mario Fritz

entry.summary: Proposes and studies sleeper memory poisoning, where adversaries manipulate external context to cause LLM assistants to store fabricated memories that re-emerge across conversations to steal user actions or data.

entry.title: RoPE Distinguishes Neither Positions Nor Tokens in Long Contexts, Provably

author.name: Yufeng Du, Phillip Harris, Minyang Tian, Eliu A Huerta, Srikanth Ronanki, Subendhu Rongali, Aram Galstyan, Hao Peng

entry.summary: Proves fundamental limitations of RoPE in long-context models: as context grows, attention loses locality bias and consistency in token relevance, with failure probability approaching 0.5 (random guessing). Provides theoretical explanation for long-context degradation.

entry.title: Grokking as Structural Inference: Transformers Need Bayesian Lottery Tickets

author.name: Kai Hidajat, Solden Stoll, Joseph An

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework explaining grokking in Transformers through the lens of Bayesian inference over task dependency graphs. Proves generalization requires both bounded MLP capacity and a structural condition on attention placing sufficient mass on informative tokens.

entry.title: Agentic Discovery of Neural Architectures: AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design

entry.summary: Introduces AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design, dual frameworks where LLM agents autonomously discover neural architectures beyond standard Transformers. Using 11 agents under 24-hour budget, discovers 14 architectures that outperform Llama 3.2 when pre-trained at 1B scale.

entry.title: Imperfect World Models are Exploitable

author.name: Logan Mondal Bhamidipaty (University of Edinburgh), Esmeralda S. Whitammer (University of Edinburgh), David Abel (University of Edinburgh), Mykel J. Kochenderfer (Stanford University), Subramanian Ramamoorthy (University of Edinburgh)

entry.summary: Proposes a formal definition of model exploitation in RL where imperfect world models lead to incorrect policy preferences. Proves that exploitation is essentially unavoidable for large policy sets and develops a general theory unifying reward hacking and model exploitation. Notable for theoretical contributions from strong authors (David Abel, Mykel Kochenderfer).

entry.summary: Presents an autonomous system using LLM-guided tree search to iteratively generate, evaluate, and optimize infectious disease forecasting software. In prospective real-time evaluation during 2025-2026 US respiratory season, the system matched or outperformed the human-curated CDC FluSight ensemble.

entry.title: Quantization Undoes Alignment: Bias Emergence in Compressed LLMs Across Models and Precision Levels

author.name: Plawan Kumar Rath, Rahul Maliakkal

entry.summary: Conducts a large-scale empirical study showing that 3-bit quantization systematically reintroduces biases in instruction-tuned LLMs across three model families, revealing that alignment can be undone by aggressive compression.

entry.title: HoloMotion-1 Technical Report

author.name: Maiyue Chen, Kaihui Wang, Bo Zhang, Xihan Ma, Zhiyuan Yang, Yi Ren, Qijun Huang, Zihao Zhu, Yucheng Wang, and Zhizhong Su

entry.summary: Presents HoloMotion-1, a humanoid motion foundation model for zero-shot whole-body motion tracking trained on a large-scale hybrid corpus combining video-reconstructed motions, motion capture, and in-house data.

entry.title: Video Models Can Reason with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Tinghui Zhu, Sheng Zhang, James Y. Huang, Selena Song, Xiaofei Wen, Yuankai Li, Hoifung Poon, Muhao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces VideoRLVR, a method for optimizing video diffusion models with rule-based verifiable rewards for reasoning tasks, including SDE-GRPO optimization, dense decomposed rewards, and Early-Step Focus strategy.

entry.title: A Few GPUs, A Whole Lotta Scale: Faithful LLM Training Emulation with PrismLLM

author.name: Shaoke Xi, ChonLam Lao, Boyi Jia, Jiaqi Gao, Zhipeng Zhang, Jiamin Cao, Brian Sutioso, Erci Xu, Minlan Yu, Kui Ren, Yong Li, Zhengping Qian, Ennan Zhai, and Jingren Zhou

entry.summary: Presents PrismLLM, a system that enables faithful emulation of large-scale LLM training behaviors using only a few GPUs. Decouples the need for production-scale clusters when debugging, developing, or tuning training frameworks by faithfully reproducing scale-dependent behaviors.

entry.title: SaaS-Bench: Can Computer-Use Agents Leverage Real-World SaaS to Solve Professional Workflows?

author.name: Kean Shi, Zihang Li, Tianyi Ma, Zengji Tu, Jialong Wu, Xinbo Xu, Qingyao Yang, Ruoyu Wu, Weichu Xie, Ming Wu, Jason Zeng, Michael Heinrich, Elvis Zhang, Liang Chen, Kuan Li, Baobao Chang

entry.summary: Introduces SaaS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating computer-using agents on realistic professional workflows across 23 deployable SaaS systems. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks that rely on simplified settings and short-horizon interactions.

entry.title: Sparse Autoencoders enable Robust and Interpretable Fine-tuning of CLIP models

author.name: Fabian Morelli, Arnas Uselis, Ankit Sonthalia, Seong Joon Oh

entry.summary: Proposes SAE-FT, a method using Sparse Autoencoders to enable robust and interpretable fine-tuning of CLIP models by regularizing changes to visual representations. The approach penalizes addition/removal of semantically meaningful features, preventing catastrophic forgetting while making fine-tuning interpretable.

entry.title: Look Before You Leap: Autonomous Exploration for LLM Agents

author.name: Ziang Ye, Wentao Shi, Yuxin Liu, Yu Wang, Zhengzhou Cai, Yaorui Shi, Qi Gu, Xunliang Cai, Fuli Feng

entry.summary: Identifies autonomous exploration as a critical underexplored capability for LLM agents, introduces Exploration Checkpoint Coverage metric, and develops a training strategy interleaving exploration and task execution rollouts to prevent premature exploitation.

entry.title: AI-Mediated Communication Can Steer Collective Opinion

author.name: Stratis Tsirtsis, Kai Rawal, Chris Russell, Brent Mittelstadt, Sandra Wachter

entry.summary: Shows empirically that LLMs introduce directional biases when editing human-written texts on contested topics, and theoretically analyzes how these biases compound during human-to-human communication mediated by AI. Demonstrates potential for AI-mediated communication to steer collective opinion.

entry.title: A Cross-Modal Prompt Injection Attack against Large Vision-Language Models with Image-Only Perturbation

author.name: Hao Yang, Zhuo Ma, Yang Liu, Yilong Yang, Guancheng Wang, and JianFeng Ma

entry.summary: Introduces CrossMPI, a cross-modal prompt injection attack against LVLMs that can steer interpretation of both textual and visual inputs through image-only perturbation. A significant expansion of the attack surface.

entry.title: Reasoning Models Don't Just Think Longer, They Move Differently

author.name: Anders Gj{\o}lbye, Lars Kai Hansen, Sanmi Koyejo

entry.summary: Studies hidden-state trajectories during chain-of-thought generation in reasoning models, showing that after controlling for generation length, difficulty remains coupled to trajectory geometry, especially in code domains.

entry.title: Propagating Unsafe Actions in LLM Controlled Multi-Robot Collaboration via Single Robot Compromise

author.name: Zhen Huang, Zhihuang Liu, Weishang Wu, Zhiping Cai

entry.summary: Proposes a novel attack paradigm for LLM-controlled multi-robot systems where an adversary compromises a single entry robot that then propagates malicious instructions through inter-robot communication to cause unsafe actions across the system.

entry.title: Reversing the Flow: Generation-to-Understanding Synergy in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Yujun Tong, Dongliang Chang, Zijin Yin, Xintong Liu, Yuanchen Fang, Zhanyu Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Generation-to-Understanding (G2U) synergy where visual generation serves as an explicit intermediate reasoning step for VLMs. The model performs controlled generative acts (detail enhancement, context expansion) to produce self-generated visual thoughts that refine perception.

entry.title: Looped SSMs: Depth-Recurrence and Input Reshaping for Time Series Classification

author.name: M\'onika Farsang, Ramin Hasani, Daniela Rus, Radu Grosu

entry.summary: Shows that looped SSMs (reusing the same block across layers) consistently match or outperform standard SSMs with independently parameterized layers, despite operating in a strictly smaller hypothesis space. This points to parameter sharing as a beneficial inductive bias.

entry.title: Energy Use of AI Inference: Efficiency Pathways and Test-Time Compute

author.name: Felipe Oviedo, Fiodar Kazhamiaka, Esha Choukse, Allen Kim, Amy Luers, Melanie Nakagawa, Ricardo Bianchini, Juan M. Lavista Ferres

entry.summary: Introduces a bottom-up methodology for estimating per-query energy of LLM inference systems, finding median energy of 0.34 Wh for frontier models on H100 nodes, and quantifying how test-time compute scaling increases energy demands.

entry.title: Reducing the Safety Tax in LLM Safety Alignment with On-Policy Self-Distillation

author.name: Yu Fu, Longxuan Yu, Haz Sameen Shahgir, Zhipeng Wei, Hui Liu, N.Benjamin Erichson, Yue Dong

entry.summary: Identifies off-policy training mismatch as a source of the 'safety tax' in LLM alignment and proposes OPSA, on-policy self-distillation where the model generates its own rollouts supervised by a frozen teacher with safety context.

entry.title: Minerva-Ego: Spatiotemporal Hints for Egocentric Video Understanding

author.name: Arsha Nagrani, Jasper Uijilings, Shyamal Buch, Tobias Weyand, Sudheendra Vijayanarasimhan, Bo Hu, Ramin Mehran, David A Ross, Cordelia Schmid

entry.summary: Introduces Minerva-Ego, a benchmark for evaluating complex egocentric visual reasoning with multi-step multimodal questions and spatiotemporally-dense human-annotated reasoning traces. Shows large gap between SOTA models and human performance.

entry.title: Ensemble Monitoring for AI Control: Diverse Signals Outweigh More Compute

author.name: Eugene Koran, Yejun Yun, Samantha Tetef, Benjamin Arnav, Pablo Bernabeu-P\'erez

entry.summary: Shows that combining diverse monitoring signals into ensembles improves detection of misaligned AI agent actions. Best 3-monitor ensemble achieves 2.4x greater detection over individual monitors on coding tasks with adversarial inputs.

entry.title: $\phi$-Balancing for Mixture-of-Experts Training

author.name: Lizhang Chen, Jonathan Li, Qi Wang, Runlong Liao, Shuozhe Li, Chen Liang, Ni Lao, Qiang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes φ-balancing for MoE models, a principled framework targeting population-level expert balance through strictly convex potential minimization, yielding a simple EMA-based routing adjustment via mirror descent.

entry.title: Lagrangian Flow Matching: A Least-Action Framework for Principled Path Design

author.name: Shukai Du, Junzhe Zhang, Yiming Li

entry.summary: Proposes Lagrangian flow matching, a physics-based framework where probability paths are determined by minimizing action functionals with general Lagrangians, extending beyond straight-line trajectories.

entry.title: Learning Normalized Energy Models for Linear Inverse Problems

author.name: Nicolas Zilberstein, Santiago Segarra, Eero Simoncelli, Florentin Guth

entry.summary: Introduces a normalized energy-based model for inverse problems in imaging that computes normalized posterior densities without retraining. Addresses limitations of diffusion priors by enabling exact likelihood computation and energy-guided sampling.

entry.title: Process Rewards with Learned Reliability

author.name: Jinyuan Li, Langlin Huang, Chengsong Huang, Shaoyang Xu, Donghong Cai, Yuyi Yang, Wenxuan Zhang, Jiaxin Huang

entry.summary: Proposes BetaPRM, a distributional Process Reward Model that predicts both step-level success probability and reliability via Beta-Binomial likelihood, enabling downstream methods to know when step rewards should be trusted.

entry.title: PSD: Pushing the Pareto Frontier of Diffusion LLMs via Parallel Speculative Decoding

author.name: Shengyin Sun, Yiming Li, Renxi Liu, Xinqi Li, Hui-Ling Zhen, Weizhe Lin, Chen Chen, Xianzhi Yu, Mingxuan Yuan, Chen Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Parallel Speculative Decoding (PSD), a training-free framework for diffusion language models that jointly improves inference efficiency along spatial (unmasking multiple tokens) and temporal (collapsing denoising steps) axes. Uses confidence scores from a single forward pass to construct multi-depth speculative drafts without extra model calls.

entry.title: Nudging Beyond the Comfort Zone: Efficient Strategy-Guided Exploration for RLVR

author.name: Chanuk Lee, Sangwoo Park, Minki Kang, Sung Ju Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes NudgeRL for structured exploration in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Uses Strategy Nudging to condition rollouts on lightweight strategy-level contexts, inducing diverse reasoning trajectories without expensive reward model guidance.

entry.title: UAM: A Dual-Stream Perspective on Forgetting in VLA Training

author.name: Jianke Zhang, Yuanfei Luo, Yucheng Hu, Xiaoyu Chen, Yanjiang Guo, Ziyang Liu, Hongbin Xu, Tian Lan, Jianyu Chen

entry.summary: Identifies the 'embodiment tax' where VLA fine-tuning erodes VLM multimodal competence, and proposes UAM with a parallel Dorsal Expert pathway inspired by biological two-stream vision organization. Separates language-grounded semantics from control-relevant visual features.

entry.title: A Unified Perturbation Framework for Analyzing Leaderboard Stability and Manipulation

author.name: Hosna Oyarhoseini, Jimmy Lin, Amir-Hossein Karimi

entry.summary: Presents a unified perturbation framework for analyzing robustness of Bradley-Terry leaderboards (like Chatbot Arena) under structured modifications. Shows that modern leaderboards are non-robust: sub-1% targeted perturbations can change top-k membership.

entry.title: GRASP: Learning to Ground Social Reasoning in Multi-Person Non-Verbal Interactions

author.name: Junho Kim, Xu Cao, Houze Yang, Bikram Boote, Ana Jojic, Fiona Ryan, Bolin Lai, Sangmin Lee, James M. Rehg

entry.summary: Introduces GRASP, a large-scale dataset (290K QA pairs, 46K videos, 749 hours) connecting social reasoning with fine-grained gaze and gesture events for evaluating multimodal LLMs on multi-person non-verbal interaction understanding. Reveals that current MLLMs fail to identify who interacts with whom in multi-person videos.

entry.title: RoadmapBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Agentic Software Development Across Version Upgrades

author.name: Xinbo Xu, Ruihan Yang, Haiyang Shen, Wendong Xu, Bofei Gao, Ruoyu Wu, Kean Shi, Weichu Xie, Xuanzhong Chen, Ming Wu, Jason Zeng, Michael Heinrich, Elvis Zhang, Liang Chen, Kuan Li, Baobao Chang

entry.summary: Introduces RoadmapBench, a benchmark of 115 long-horizon coding tasks from real open-source version upgrades across 17 repos and 5 languages, requiring agents to implement functionality from target versions given source-version snapshots.

entry.title: Echo-Forcing: A Scene Memory Framework for Interactive Long Video Generation

author.name: Mingqiang Wu, Weilun Feng, Zhefeng Zhang, Haotong Qin, Yuqi Li, Guoxin Fan, Xiaokun Liu, Zhulin An, Libo Huang, Yongjun Xu, Chuanguang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Echo-Forcing, a training-free scene memory framework for interactive long video generation that addresses KV cache functional entanglement. Enables prompt switching, scene recall, and prevents outdated background contamination in autoregressive video diffusion.

entry.title: RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents

author.name: Zijie Dai, Shiyuan Deng, Sheng Guan, Yizhou Tian, Xin Yao, Xiao Yan, James Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes RecMem, a memory system for long-running LLM agents that uses recurrence-based consolidation - only invoking LLMs for memory extraction when sustained recurrence is observed for semantically similar interactions, dramatically reducing token consumption.

entry.title: Misspecified Explore-then-Exploit Leads to Supra-Competitive Prices

author.name: Jackie Baek, Vivek F. Farias, Farrell Wu

entry.summary: Studies how simple explore-then-exploit algorithmic pricing with misspecified (monopoly-style) demand models can systematically produce collusive-like supra-competitive prices above Nash equilibrium, without any explicit coordination between firms.

entry.title: Property-Guided LLM Program Synthesis for Planning
