author.name: Augusto B. Corr\^ea, Andr\'e G. Pereira, Jendrik Seipp

entry.summary: Proposes property-guided LLM program synthesis for planning, where formal property violations provide concrete counterexamples as feedback rather than simple numeric scores. This drastically reduces needed candidates and evaluation costs.

entry.title: Learn Where Outcomes Diverge: Efficient VLA RL via Probabilistic Chunk Masking

author.name: Vaidehi Bagaria, Nikshep Grampurohit, Pulkit Verma

entry.summary: Identifies that in GRPO-based VLA reinforcement learning, gradient computation dominates wall-clock time (78%) rather than rollout collection (21%). Proposes probabilistic chunk masking to focus gradient computation on phases where successful and failed rollouts diverge, significantly improving training efficiency.

entry.title: GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Large Language Model Decoding

author.name: Fanxu Meng

entry.summary: Proposes GQLA (Group-Query Latent Attention), a modification of DeepSeek's MLA that exposes two algebraically equivalent decoding paths (MQA and GQA) from the same weights, enabling hardware-adaptive inference.

entry.title: SMCEvolve: Principled Scientific Discovery via Sequential Monte Carlo Evolution

author.name: Jiachen Jiang and Huminhao Zhu and Zhihui Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces SMCEvolve, recasting LLM-driven program evolution as Sequential Monte Carlo sampling with principled components (adaptive resampling, mutation with acceptance, convergence control) and finite-sample complexity bounds.

entry.title: From I/O to Code with Discovery Agent

author.name: Yihong Dong, Jiaru Qian, Haoran Zhang, Peixu Wang, Binhua Li, Zhi Jin, Yongbin Li, Ge Li, Xiaokang Yang, Xue Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes DIO-Agent, a discovery agent for synthesizing programs from input-output behavior (IO2Code) using evolutionary search over program space with LLMs as mutation operators and error signals for guidance.

entry.title: PACER: Acyclic Causal Discovery from Large-Scale Interventional Data

author.name: Ramon Vi\~nas Torn\'e, S\'ilvia F\`abregas Salazar, Soyon Park, Ivo Alexander Ban, Artyom Gadetsky, Nikita Doikov, Maria Brbi\'c

entry.summary: Introduces PACER, a scalable causal discovery framework that guarantees acyclicity by construction through parameterizing distributions over DAGs via joint models of variable permutations and edge probabilities.

entry.title: STS: Efficient Sparse Attention with Speculative Token Sparsity

author.name: Ceyu Xu, Jiangnan Yu, Yongji Wu, Yuan Xie

entry.summary: Proposes STS, a sparse attention mechanism that uses a draft model's attention scores to predict important tokens for a larger target model, achieving 2.67x speedup without retraining by integrating into speculative decoding frameworks.

entry.title: CrystalBoltz: End-to-End Protein Structure Determination via Experiment-Guided Diffusion for X-Ray Crystallography

author.name: Minseo Kim, Huanghao Mai, Jay Shenoy, Alec Follmer, Gordon Wetzstein, Frederic Poitevin

entry.summary: Proposes CrystalBoltz, combining generative protein structure models with X-ray crystallographic measurements for end-to-end structure determination, conditioning diffusion models on experimental data to solve the phase problem.

entry.title: Latent Video Prediction Learns Better World Models

author.name: Ali J Alrasheed, Aryan Yazdan Parast, Basim Azam, James Bailey, Naveed Akhtar

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic study comparing video foundation models (V-JEPA 2.1, V-JEPA 2, VideoPrism, VideoMAEv2) as world models across five robustness axes. Finds that latent-prediction models form a distinct profile with more graceful degradation under corruption.

entry.title: Dynamic Chunking for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Yichen Zhu, Xiaoming Shi, Peng Zhao, Weiyu Chen, Debing Zhang, James Kwok

entry.summary: Introduces Dynamic Chunking Diffusion Model (DCDM) that replaces fixed positional blocks with content-defined semantic chunks in block discrete diffusion LLMs. Uses differentiable Chunking Attention to route tokens into learned clusters shaped by the diffusion objective.

entry.title: Contexting as Recommendation: Evolutionary Collaborative Filtering for Context Engineering

author.name: Jiachen Zhu, Zhuoying Ou, Congmin Zheng, Yuxiang Chen, Zeyu Zheng, Rong Shan, Lingyu Yang, Lionel Z. Wang, Weiwen Liu, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang, Jianghao Lin

entry.summary: Proposes Neural Collaborative Context Engineering (NCCE), framing context engineering for LLMs as a recommendation problem rather than global optimization. Routes instances to appropriate context strategies dynamically.

entry.title: Intrinsic Wasserstein Rates for Score-Based Generative Models on Smooth Manifolds

author.name: Guoji Fu, Taiji Suzuki, Wee Sun Lee, Atsushi Nitanda

entry.summary: Proves intrinsic Wasserstein-1 convergence rates for score-based generative models on compact smooth manifolds, showing the sample complexity depends on the intrinsic dimension d rather than the ambient dimension D, with explicit geometry and density factors.

entry.title: Thermodynamic Networks: Harnessing Non-Equilibrium Steady States for Computation

author.name: Patryk Lipka-Bartosik, Gianmichele Blasi, Javier Lalueza Pu\'ertolas, G\'eraldine Haack, Mart\'i Perarnau-Llobet, Nicolas Brunner

entry.summary: Introduces thermodynamic networks that use non-equilibrium steady states for computation, modeling them as finite-size reservoirs exchanging conserved quantities. Identifies Negative Differential Conductance as the key property enabling universal function approximation.

entry.title: Mind Dreamer: Untethering Imagination via Active Latent Intervention on Latent Manifolds

author.name: Shaojun Xu, Xiaoling Zhou, Yihan Lin, Yapeng Meng, Xinglong Ji, Luping Shi, Rong Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Mind Dreamer, an MBRL framework that uses Active Latent Intervention to generate imagination starting states from a learned generator rather than only from observed states. Uses adversarial generation to synthesize latent jumps to epistemic blind spots.

entry.title: Reasoners or Translators? Contamination-aware Evaluation and Neuro-Symbolic Robustness in Tax Law

author.name: Parisa Kordjamshidi and Samer Aslan and Madhavan Seshadri and Leslie Barrett and Enrico Santus

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive study of LLM legal reasoning in tax law with contamination detection, comparing monolithic LLMs with hybrid neuro-symbolic systems that translate statute text to formal representations. Shows contamination inflates performance and hybrid systems generalize better.

entry.title: VideoSeeker: Incentivizing Instance-level Video Understanding via Native Agentic Tool Invocation

author.name: Yiming Zhao, Yu Zeng, Wenxuan Huang, Zhen Fang, Qing Miao, Qisheng Su, Jiawei Zhao, Jiayin Cai, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Yukun Qi, Yao Hu, Xiaolong Jiang, Feng Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes VideoSeeker, a paradigm for instance-level video understanding through visual prompts that enables LVLMs to perform precise spatiotemporal localization via native agentic tool invocation for tracking, segmentation, and grounding.

entry.title: Entropy Across the Bridge: Conditional-Marginal Discretization for Flow and Schr\"odinger Samplers

author.name: Bruno Trentini, Dejan Stancevic, Michael M. Bronstein, Alexander Tong, Luca Ambrogioni

entry.summary: Derives a conditional-marginal entropy-rate objective for bridge-aware discretization of flow matching and Schrödinger bridge samplers. Provides a training-free entropic inference-time scheduler from first principles with closed-form solution for Gaussian bridges.

entry.title: TeamTR: Trust-Region Fine-Tuning for Multi-Agent LLM Coordination

author.name: Yi Xie, Siao Liu, Falong Fan, Yuanqi Yao, Yue Zhao, Bo Liu

entry.summary: Identifies 'compounding occupancy shift' in multi-agent LLM fine-tuning where updating one agent shifts context for others, proves quadratic penalty scaling, and proposes TeamTR with trust-region constraints and trajectory resampling.

entry.title: ICRL: Learning to Internalize Self-Critique with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jianbo Lin, Xiaomin Yu, Yi Xin, Yifu Guo, Zhuosong Jiang, Zhongqi Yue, Weishi Wang, Heqing Zou, Chengwei Qin and Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes ICRL, a framework jointly training a solver and critic from shared backbone using RL to internalize self-critique into the model's capabilities without needing external critique at inference time.

entry.title: Tadpole: Autoencoders as Foundation Models for 3D PDEs with Online Learning

author.name: Qiang Liu and Felix Koehler and Benjamin Holzschuh and Nils Thuerey

entry.summary: Introduces Tadpole, a foundation model for 3D PDEs pre-trained as an autoencoder on synthetic data generated via online learning, scaling to hundreds of terabytes equivalent and transferring across physical systems.

entry.title: GQA-{\mu}P: The maximal parameterization update for grouped query attention

author.name: Kyle R. Chickering, Huijuan Wang, Mengxi Wu, Alexander Moreno, Muhao Chen, Xuezhe Ma, Daria Soboleva, Joel Hestness, Zhengzhong Liu, Eric Xing

entry.summary: Derives the maximal update parameterization (μP) for grouped query attention, enabling hyperparameter transfer across different GQA configurations without expensive re-tuning.

entry.title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning

author.name: Jingjing Wang, Xiwen Chen, Wenhui Zhu, Huayu Li, Zhengxiao He, Feiyang Cai, Ana S. Carreon-Rascon, Xuanzhao Dong, Feng Luo

entry.summary: Proposes LaMR, a structured pruning framework for coding agents that decomposes code relevance into semantic evidence and dependency support dimensions, each modeled by a dedicated CRF. Reduces token costs while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Controllable Molecular Generative Foundation Models

author.name: Yihan Zhu, Yuhan Liu, Weijiang Li, Tengfei Luo, Meng Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes CoMole, a controllable molecular generative foundation model using motif-aware graph diffusion with RL post-training. Learns a motif-aware graph space to enable chemically meaningful RL optimization.

entry.title: LPDS: Evaluating LLM Robustness Through Logic-Preserving Difficulty Scaling

author.name: Philipp Mondorf, Samuel J. Bell, Jesse Dodge, Dieuwke Hupkes

entry.summary: Introduces LPDS, a method for systematically scaling difficulty of LLM evaluation problems while preserving underlying logic. Identifies which logic-preserving variations are most likely to cause model failures.

entry.title: DrugSAGE:Self-evolving Agent Experience for Efficient State-of-the-Art Drug Discovery

author.name: Yikun Zhang, Xiwei Cheng, Tianyu Liu, Yuanqi Du, and Wengong Jin

entry.summary: Proposes DrugSAGE, a self-evolving agent framework that accumulates and reuses experience across drug discovery tasks, maintaining cross-task memory of skills and strategies to reduce search costs.

entry.title: EgoExo-WM: Unlocking Exo Video for Ego World Models

author.name: Danny Tran, Roberto Mart\'in-Mart\'in, Kristen Grauman

entry.summary: Proposes EgoExo-WM, a method to bridge exocentric and egocentric video by extracting body poses from exo video and transforming them for ego world model training, using human kinematics priors. Enables leveraging abundant exo data for ego prediction.

entry.title: Stochastic Non-Smooth Convex Optimization with Unbounded Gradients

author.name: Dmitry Kovalev

entry.summary: Introduces a class of generalized Lipschitz functions where gradient norms are bounded by an affine function of the optimality gap, and proves AdamW with clipped updates achieves best convergence rates in this setting.

entry.title: DeltaPrompts: Escaping the Zero-Delta Trap in Multimodal Distillation

author.name: Jaehun Jung, Hyunwoo Kim, Brandon Cui, Ximing Lu, David Acuna, Prithviraj Ammanabrolu, Yejin Choi

entry.summary: Reveals that up to 69% of prompts in VLM distillation datasets are 'zero-delta' (teacher and student already agree), and proposes DeltaPrompts to identify and prioritize prompts that expose capability gaps for efficient distillation.

entry.title: Transformer-like Inference from Optimal Control

author.name: Aditya Kudre, Heng-Sheng Chang, Prashant G. Mehta

entry.summary: Derives transformer-like inference architectures from optimal control theory, showing that the prediction problem formulated as optimal control yields a 'dual filter' with layer structure mirroring decoder-only transformers.

entry.title: Toward LLMs Beyond English-Centric Development

author.name: Sho Takase, Ukyo Honda

entry.summary: Demonstrates that open-weight LLMs are heavily biased toward English and shows that continual pre-training doesn't offer cost advantages over training from scratch for adapting to target languages. Argues for dedicated per-language investment in LLM development.

entry.title: Position: Zeroth-Order Optimization in Deep Learning Is Underexplored, Not Underpowered

author.name: Sijia Liu, Yicheng Lang, Soumyadeep Pal, Changsheng Wang, Yancheng Huang, Chongyu Fan, James Diffenderfer, Bhavya Kailkhura, Yihua Zhang

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that zeroth-order optimization for deep learning is underexplored rather than underpowered. Identifies that perceived limitations stem from myopic development practices and articulates six positions spanning algorithmic, systems, and evaluation improvements.

entry.title: Feedback World Model Enables Precise Guidance of Diffusion Policy

author.name: Tuo An, Jindou Jia, Gen Li, Jingliang Li, Chuhao Zhou, Pengfei Liu, Bofan Lyu, Jiaqi Bai, Xinying Guo, Geng Li, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes feedback world model, a new paradigm that closes the loop between world model prediction and actual observation at inference time. Maintains a lightweight feedback state updated online to iteratively correct future predictions for robotic policy guidance.

entry.title: Martingale Neural Operators: Learning Stochastic Marginals via Doob-Meyer Factorization

author.name: Kai Hidajat

entry.summary: Introduces Martingale Neural Operators (MNO) that leverage the Doob-Meyer decomposition to map initial conditions directly to conditional mean and covariance of stochastic PDE solutions in one shot, avoiding Monte Carlo rollouts while preserving variance and tail structure.

entry.title: Learning Bilevel Policies over Symbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Planning

author.name: Dillon Z. Chen and Till Hofmann and Toryn Q. Klassen and Sheila A. McIlraith

entry.summary: Proposes bilevel policies combining low-level imitation learning for manipulation with high-level symbolic abstractions for long-horizon planning. Addresses the challenge of generating long-horizon plans from imitation learning alone by leveraging symbolic world models.

entry.title: Beyond Content: A Comprehensive Speech Toxicity Dataset and Detection Framework Incorporating Paralinguistic Cues

author.name: Zhongjie Ba, Liang Yi, Peng Cheng, Qingcao Li, Qinglong Wang, Li Lu

entry.summary: Introduces ToxiAlert-Bench, a large-scale audio dataset of 30,000+ clips for toxic speech detection incorporating paralinguistic cues like emotion, intonation, and speech rate. Distinguishes between textual content and paralinguistic origins of toxicity.

entry.title: Explainable AI Isn't Enough! Rethinking Algorithmic Contestability

author.name: Timo Freiesleben, Kristof Meding, Gunnar K\"onig

entry.summary: Argues that explainable AI is insufficient for algorithmic contestability - the ability of individuals to review and correct erroneous algorithmic decisions. Proposes formal definitions and systematic operationalization of contestability as an algorithmic problem.

entry.title: Multi-Fidelity Flow Matching: Cascaded Refinement of PDE Solutions

author.name: Sipeng Chen, Junliang Liu, Hewei Tang, Shibo Li

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Fidelity Flow Matching (MFFM) for PDE solutions, where the source distribution is calibrated to low-to-high-fidelity residuals and the velocity network is conditioned on low-fidelity solutions, creating a cascade refinement framework.

entry.title: Registers Matter for Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Nikita Starodubcev, Ilia Sudakov, Ilya Drobyshevskiy, Artem Babenko, Dmitry Baranchuk

entry.summary: Shows that while Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) don't exhibit the high-norm patch-token outliers seen in Vision Transformers, register tokens still significantly improve convergence and generation quality for pixel-space DiTs. Analysis reveals register tokens produce cleaner feature maps at high noise levels, explaining their effectiveness.

entry.title: Optimized Three-Dimensional Photovoltaic Structures with LLM guided Tree Search

author.name: Michael P. Brenner, Lizzie Dorfman, John C. Platt

entry.summary: Demonstrates using Google's AntiGravity coding agent combined with LLM-driven tree search (ERA) to autonomously generate optimized 3D photovoltaic structures. The system discovers high-efficiency designs that overcome losses limiting flat solar panels at mid-latitudes.

entry.title: Argus: Evidence Assembly for Scalable Deep Research Agents

author.name: Zhen Zhang, Liangcai Su, Zhuo Chen, Xiang Lin, Haotian Xu, Simon Shaolei Du, Kaiyu Yang, Bo An, Lidong Bing, Xinyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Argus, a deep research agent system where a Searcher and Navigator cooperate to treat research as assembling complementary evidence pieces rather than parallel brute-force search. Addresses the problem of parallel rollouts duplicating rather than completing evidence.

entry.title: IO-SVD: Input-Output Whitened SVD for Adaptive-Rank LLM Compression

author.name: Ali Abbasi, Chayne Thrash, Haoran Qin, Hamed Pirsiavash, and Soheil Kolouri

entry.summary: Proposes IO-SVD, a post-training compression method for LLMs using KL-aware double-sided whitening that considers both input and output spaces. Achieves better preservation of model quality under aggressive compression through adaptive rank allocation.

entry.title: Ada-Diffuser: Latent-Aware Adaptive Diffusion for Decision-Making

author.name: Fan Feng, Selena Ge, Minghao Fu, Zijian Li, Yujia Zheng, Zeyu Tang, Yingyao Hu, Biwei Huang, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Ada-Diffuser, a framework that incorporates latent dynamic inference into diffusion-based decision-making. Theoretically shows latent processes can be identified from small temporal blocks and introduces an adaptive diffusion model conditioned on inferred latent dynamics.

entry.title: LRCP: Low-Rank Compressibility Guided Visual Token Pruning for Efficient LVLMs

author.name: Hongyu Lu, Feng Zhang, Wenwei Jin, Huanling Hu, Tianjun Shi, Shikai Jiang, Yao Hu, Jiawei Li

entry.summary: Proposes LRCP, a visual token pruning method for large vision-language models based on low-rank compressibility. Observes that visual token representations exhibit pronounced low-rank structure with a stable dominant subspace, enabling efficient compression without attention-based positional bias.

entry.title: Segmentation, Detection and Explanation: A Unified Framework for CT Appearance Reasoning

author.name: Yuyuan Liu, Can Peng, Yingyu Yang, Qianye Yang, Cheng Ouyang, and J. Alison Noble

entry.summary: Proposes a unified autoregressive framework for CT image analysis that integrates segmentation, detection, and explanation through task-routing tokens and language-guided visual reasoning. Addresses the gap between single-task methods and clinical workflow needs.

entry.title: MIND: Decoupling Model-Induced Label Noise via Latent Manifold Disentanglement

author.name: Dayong Ren

entry.summary: Proposes MIND, a framework for handling model-induced label noise from automated annotations by Foundation Models. Uses Latent Manifold Disentanglement to decompose noise manifolds into tractable subspace-dependent components.

entry.title: Runtime-Orchestrated Second-Order Optimization for Scalable LLM Training

author.name: Yishun Lu, Junhao Zhang, Zeyu Yang, and Wes Armour

entry.summary: Introduces Asteria, a runtime system that enables practical second-order optimization for LLM training by distributing optimizer state across GPU, CPU, and NVMe storage. Separates preconditioner computation from the critical GPU training path through asynchronous host-side computation.

entry.title: Does Theory of Mind Improvement Really Benefit Human-AI Interactions? Empirical Findings from Interactive Evaluations

author.name: Nanxu Gong, Zixin Chen, Haotian Li, Zishu Zhao, Jianxun Lian, Huamin Qu, Yanjie Fu, and Xing Xie

entry.summary: Examines whether Theory of Mind improvements in LLMs actually benefit human-AI interactions through a new interactive evaluation paradigm, revealing gaps between third-person benchmarks and first-person interactive performance.

entry.title: Always Learning, Always Mixing: Efficient and Simple Data Mixing All The Time

author.name: Michael Y. Hu and Apurva Gandhi and Kyunghyun Cho and Tal Linzen and Pratyusha Sharma

entry.summary: Proposes OP-Mix, a unified online data mixing algorithm that works across pretraining, continual learning, and adaptation phases of language model training, treating data mixing as an online decision-making problem.

entry.title: Is Agentic AI Ready for Real-World Hardware Engineering? A Deep Dive with Phoenix-bench

author.name: Qingyun Zou, Feng Yu, Hongshi Tan, Bingsheng He, WengFai Wong

entry.summary: Introduces Phoenix-bench, a benchmark of 511 verified hardware engineering tasks testing whether software-focused agentic AI transfers to hardware design including EDA verification and maintenance patching.

entry.title: Reading the Cell, Designing the Cure: Perturbation-Conditioned Molecular Diffusion for Function-Oriented Drug Design

author.name: Ziyu Xu, Zijian Zhang, Liang Wang, Zhiyuan Liu, Qiang Liu, Shu Wu, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Formalizes Transcriptome-based Drug Design as generating molecules conditioned on desired gene expression changes, proposing ACURE, a multi-resolution transcriptome-guided diffusion framework.

entry.title: Universal Approximation of Nonlinear Operators and Their Derivatives

author.name: Filippo de Feo

entry.summary: Proves the first universal approximation theorems for k-times differentiable nonlinear operators between Banach spaces and their derivatives, generalizing classical results to infinite-dimensional settings.

entry.title: PhysBrain 1.0 Technical Report

author.name: Shijie Lian, Bin Yu, Xiaopeng Lin, Changti Wu, Hang Yuan, Xiaolin Hu, Zhaolong Shen, Yuzhuo Miao, Haishan Liu, Yuxuan Tian, Yukun Shi, Cong Huang, and Kai Chen

entry.summary: PhysBrain 1.0 converts large-scale human egocentric video into structured physical commonsense supervision for VLMs, then transfers to robot control via capability-preserving adaptation, achieving SOTA on multiple embodied benchmarks.

entry.title: Unified Simulation of Lagrangian Particle Dynamics via Transformer

author.name: Caoliwen Wang, Minghao Guo, Siyuan Chen, Heng Zhang, Mengdi Wang, Xingyu Ni, Hanson Sun, Kunyi Wang, Zherong Pan, Kui Wu, Lingjie Liu, Yin Yang, Chenfanfu Jiang, Taku Komura, Wojciech Matusik, Peter Yichen Chen

entry.summary: Presents a unified transformer-based particle simulator modeling cloth, elastic solids, fluids, granular materials, and molecular dynamics through a prediction-correction design on Lagrangian particle representations.

entry.title: FFAvatar: Few-Shot, Feed-Forward, and Generalizable Avatar Reconstruction

author.name: Thuan Hoang Nguyen, Jiahao Luo, Yinyu Nie, Hao Li, Gordon Guocheng Qian, Jian Wang

entry.summary: Introduces FFAvatar, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing animatable 3D Gaussian head avatars from few-shot unposed portrait images in seconds, using a Multi-View Query-Former and three-stage training curriculum.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Goal Recognition with Large Language Models

author.name: Kin Max Piamolini Gusm\~ao and Nathan Gavenski and Nir Oren and Felipe Meneguzzi

entry.summary: Provides the first systematic zero-shot evaluation of frontier LLMs as goal recognizers on classical PDDL benchmarks. Finds uneven competence: some models scale with evidence while others remain anchored to priors.

entry.title: LEAP: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLMs in Iterative Scientific Design

author.name: Marilyn Zhang, Tianfeng Chen, Fabi\'an Barzuna, Ankita Rathod, Mark E. Whiting

entry.summary: Introduces LEAPBench for evaluating LLM learning efficiency in iterative scientific design, measuring trajectory-level performance rather than just final outcomes. Examines evaluation choices that change conclusions about LLM learning efficiency.

entry.title: Is One Score Enough? Rethinking the Evaluation of Sequentially Evolving LLM Memory

author.name: Songwei Dong, Zihan Chen, Chengshuai Shi, Peng Wang, Jundong Li, Cong Shen

entry.summary: Introduces SeqMem-Eval, a diagnostic framework for evaluating sequentially evolving LLM memory that measures how memory states evolve, generalize, and consolidate over time, rather than just final performance.

entry.title: PanoWorld: Geometry-Consistent Panoramic Video World Modeling

author.name: Le Jiang, Xiangyu Bai, Bishoy Galoaa, Shayda Moezzi, Caleb James Lee, Tooba Imtiaz, Edmund Yeh, Jennifer Dy, Yanzhi Wang, Sarah Ostadabbas

entry.summary: Presents PanoWorld, a panoramic video world model generating geometry-consistent 360° video from a single image and caption, using depth consistency and trajectory consistency losses as regularizers.

entry.title: Breakeven complexity: A new perspective on neural partial differential equation solvers

author.name: Yijing Zhang, Nicholas Roberts, Tanya Marwah, Mikhail Khodak

entry.summary: Proposes breakeven complexity as an evaluation metric for neural PDE solvers that accounts for upfront training costs and compares against error-equivalent classical solvers. Uses scaling laws to determine cost-effectiveness thresholds.

entry.title: $f$-Trajectory Balance: A Loss Family for Tuning GFlowNets, Generative Models, and LLMs with Off- and On-Policy Data

author.name: Jake Fawkes, Jason Hartford

entry.summary: Extends the mean square error loss in GFlowNets to the full family of f-divergences, showing on-policy gradients correspond to the f-divergence while maintaining the same global minimizer off-policy.

entry.title: Why are language models less surprised than humans? Testing the Parse Multiplicity Mismatch Hypothesis

author.name: William Timkey, Brian Dillon, Tal Linzen

entry.summary: Tests the hypothesis that LMs underpredict garden-path difficulty because they simultaneously consider more sentence interpretations than humans, using RNNGs with controlled parse beam sizes.

entry.title: From LLM-Generated Conjectures to Lean Formalizations: Automated Polynomial Inequality Proving via Sum-of-Squares Certificates

author.name: Ruobing Zuo, Hanrui Zhao, Gaolei He, Zhengfeng Yang, Jianlin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes NSPI, a neuro-symbolic framework combining LLMs with sum-of-squares certificates for automated proving of polynomial inequalities. LLMs propose conjectures that are verified symbolically.

entry.title: GRLO: Towards Generalizable Reinforcement Learning in Open-Ended Environments from Zero

author.name: Shangjian Yin, Yu Fu, Yue Dong, Zhouxing Shi

entry.summary: Proposes GRLO for generalizable RL post-training of LLMs in open-ended environments, addressing the compute barrier of domain-specific RLVR training through more efficient generalization.

entry.title: Entity-Centric World Models: Interaction-Aware Masking for Causal Video Prediction

author.name: Santosh Kumar Paidi

entry.summary: Proposes Interaction-Aware JEPA (IA-JEPA) that uses motion-centric masking strategy targeting entities engaged in collisions/momentum transfers to learn physics-aware world models from video.

entry.title: Ghosted Layers: Unconstrained Activation Alignment for Recovering Layer-Pruned LLMs

author.name: Vincent-Daniel Yun, Junhyuk Jo, Sai Praneeth Karimireddy, Sunwoo Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Ghosted Layers, a training-free recovery method for layer-pruned LLMs that derives a closed-form optimal linear operator to align activations across pruned boundaries, outperforming existing constrained approaches.

entry.title: On the Fragility of Data Attribution When Learning Is Distributed

author.name: Xian Gao, Bo Hui, Min-Te Sun, Wei-Shinn Ku

entry.summary: Shows that a single participant in distributed training can inflate its measured data attribution value while preserving model utility, demonstrating fragility of attribution methods under adversarial conditions.

entry.title: Syntax Without Semantics: Teaching Large Language Models to Code in an Unseen Language

author.name: Vinayshekhar Bannihatti Kumar, Disha Makhija, Manoj Ghuhan Arivazhagan, Rashmi Gangadharaiah

entry.summary: Introduces PyLang, a minimal language absent from pretraining corpora, showing LLMs can quickly learn syntax but fail to transfer semantic competence - Python outperforms PyLang by up to 19% despite identical algorithms being selected 80% of the time.

entry.title: Pessimistic Risk-Aware Policy Learning in Contextual Bandits

author.name: Yilong Wan, Yuqiang Li, Xianyi Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a unified distributional framework for risk-aware offline policy learning that optimizes Lipschitz-continuous risk functionals (including mean-variance, CVaR, entropic risk) in contextual bandits. Develops novel concentration inequalities for importance sampling-based distributional estimators.

entry.title: Sharp Spectral Thresholds for Logit Fixed Points

author.name: Tongxi Wang

entry.summary: Proves sharp spectral thresholds for stability of softmax feedback systems (relevant to entropy-regularized RL, logit games, mean-field updates). Shows the classical conservative threshold misses an entire stable regime and identifies the true phase transition point.

entry.title: VLMs Trace Without Tracking: Diagnosing Failures in Visual Path Following

author.name: Hyesoo Hong, Minsoo Kim, Wonje Jeung, Sangyeon Yoon, Dongjae Jeon, Albert No

entry.summary: Studies line tracing in VLMs - the ability to follow a visual path through successive local continuations. Finds that even state-of-the-art VLMs frequently lose target paths when nearby alternatives look locally similar, indicating fundamental limitations in visual tracking.

entry.title: Interaction-Aware Influence Functions for Group Attribution

author.name: Jaeseung Heo, Kyeongheung Yun, Youngbin Choi, Sehyun Hwang, Jungseul Ok, Dongwoo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes interaction-aware influence functions that capture how training examples jointly affect model behavior, augmenting standard individual influence sums with pairwise interaction terms. Addresses the limitation that standard influence functions cannot distinguish redundant from complementary examples.

entry.title: Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents Incentivizes Swarm Intelligence of Large Language Models

author.name: Xingjian Wu, Junkai Lu, Siyu Yan, Xiangfei Qiu, Jilin Hu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Differentiable Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA), a self-evolving multi-agent framework enabling elastic and adaptive agent collaboration during inference. Uses differentiable context-aware routing to dynamically activate agents at each reasoning step.

entry.title: EntropyScan: Towards Model-level Backdoor Detection in LVLMs via Visual Attention Entropy

author.name: Xuanyu Ge, Zhongqi Wang, Jie Zhang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes EntropyScan, a lightweight model-level backdoor detection method for Large Vision-Language Models based on visual attention entropy anomalies. Observes that backdoor injection disrupts cross-modal alignment, creating detectable attention deviations.

entry.title: DiLA: Disentangled Latent Action World Models

author.name: Tianqiu Zhang, Muyang Lyu, Yufan Zhang, Fang Fang, Si Wu

entry.summary: Introduces DiLA, a Disentangled Latent Action world model that resolves the tradeoff between action abstraction and generation fidelity via content-structure disentanglement. Shows that latent action learning itself drives disentanglement through its predictive bottleneck.

entry.title: BARRIER: Bounded Activation Regions for Robust Information Erasure

author.name: Jan Miksa, Patryk Krukowski, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek, Dawid Damian Rymarczyk, Marcin Sendera

entry.summary: Proposes BARRIER for machine unlearning that shifts intervention from static model weights to dynamic geometry of hidden-layer activations using Interval Arithmetic on SVD-based bounded regions. Provides mathematical guarantees for preserving neutral concepts.

entry.title: Continual Learning of Domain-Invariant Representations

author.name: Pascal Janetzky, Tobias Schlagenhauf, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Introduces a class of continual learning methods that learn domain-invariant representations to avoid shortcut learning, motivated by causal mechanisms. Addresses the limitation that existing CL methods optimize for in-domain performance and learn spurious domain-specific cues.

entry.title: AOT-POT: Adaptive Operator Transformation for Large-Scale PDE Pre-training

author.name: Qitan Lv, Hong Wang, Zhongkai Hao, Wen Wu, Xuenan Xu, Bowen Zhou, Feng Wu, Chao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes AOT-POT, a method for pre-training neural operators on diverse PDE datasets by transforming complex solution operators into simpler, better-aligned forms rather than just increasing model capacity. Inspired by classical numerical analysis techniques like preconditioning.

entry.title: Do Less, Achieve More: Do We Need Every-Step Optimization for RL Fine-tuning of Diffusion Models?

author.name: Renye Yan, Jikang Cheng, Shikun Sun, Yi Sun, You Wu, Wei Peng, Zongwei Wang, Ling Liang, Junliang Xing, Yimao Cai

entry.summary: Shows that RL fine-tuning of diffusion models doesn't need to be applied at every denoising step - early steps have unstable structures with delayed rewards, while late steps have saturating gains. Proposes stage-selective RL application for efficiency and quality.

entry.title: Symplectic Neural Operators for Learning Infinite Dimensional Hamiltonian Systems

author.name: Yeang Makara, Yusuke Tanaka, Takashi Matsubara, Takaharu Yaguchi

entry.summary: Introduces Symplectic Neural Operators that preserve symplectic structure of Hamiltonian PDEs, with theoretical characterization and long-term stability guarantees based on structure preservation combined with learning accuracy.

entry.title: From Layers to Networks: Comparing Neural Representations via Diffusion Geometry

author.name: Atharva Khandait and Jan E. Gerken

entry.summary: Proposes using diffusion geometry and tools from multi-view learning to compare neural representations across layers and networks. Shows RSM-based similarity measures have closed-form equivalents in terms of Markov matrices, enabling multi-scale analysis.

entry.title: Towards Generalization of Block Attention via Automatic Segmentation and Block Distillation

author.name: Shuaiyi Li, Zhisong Zhang, Yan Wang, Lei Zhu, Dongyang Ma, Chenlong Deng, Yang Deng, Wai Lam

entry.summary: Addresses generalization of block attention through automatic semantic segmentation of input text and block distillation. Constructs SemanticSeg dataset (30k+ instances, 16 categories) and trains a lightweight segmenter for efficient KV cache reuse in RAG scenarios.

entry.title: When and Why Adversarial Training Improves PINNs: A Neural Tangent Kernel Perspective

author.name: Yuan-dong Cao, Chi Chiu SO, Jun-Min Wang, He Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a Neural Tangent Kernel analysis framework for understanding why and when adversarial training (GAN-based) improves Physics-Informed Neural Networks, showing how the discriminator influences training dynamics and provides theoretical grounding.

entry.title: WorldVLN: Autoregressive World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Baining Zhao, Jiacheng Xu, Weicheng Feng, Xin Zhang, Zhaolu Wang, Haoyang Wang, Shilong Ji, Ziyou Wang, Jianjie Fang, Zhiheng Zheng, Weichen Zhang, Yu Shang, Wei Wu, Chen Gao, Xinlei Chen, Yong Li

entry.summary: Introduces WorldVLN, the first autoregressive world action model for aerial vision-language navigation. Unlike full-sequence video generation, it predicts short-horizon world-state transitions and decodes them into executable waypoint actions, with closed-loop observation feedback.

entry.title: Deterministic Event-Graph Substrates as World Models for Counterfactual Reasoning

author.name: Fabio Rovai

entry.summary: Introduces deterministic event-graph substrates as world models using append-only RDF triple logs for counterfactual reasoning. Proves a duality between explanatory and counterfactual queries and achieves strong results on CLEVRER benchmark, exceeding the NS-DR symbolic oracle on all four categories.

entry.title: From Flat Language Labels to Typological Priors: Structured Language Conditioning for Multilingual Speech-to-Speech Translation

author.name: Yu Pan, Yang Hou, Xiongfei Wu, Liang Zhang, Yves Le Traon, Lei Ma, Jianjun Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes S2ST-Omni 2, a speech-to-speech translation framework that replaces flat language labels with structured typological priors from WALS. Enables more data-efficient multilingual adaptation by exploiting shared linguistic structure.

entry.title: ITGPT: Generative Pretraining on Irregular Timeseries

author.name: Antoine Honor\'e, Ming Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces ITGPT, a transformer architecture for generative pretraining on irregular, multimodal time series with missing values. Designed for domains like healthcare where data is irregularly sampled and labels are expensive.

entry.title: Attention Dispersion in Dynamic Graph Transformers: Diagnosis and a Transferable Fix

author.name: Jinhao Zhang, Kangfei Zhao, Qiuhao Zeng, Long-Kai Huang

entry.summary: Identifies attention dispersion as a failure mode of dynamic graph Transformers under temporal distribution shift. Proposes a transferable fix based on focusing attention on critical nodes that carry more predictive signal.

entry.title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents

author.name: Chinmay Savadikar, Mingyu Zhao, Yuanzheng Zhu, Han Li, Shuang Xie, Alberto Castelo, Tianfu Wu, Lingyun Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ShopGym, an integrated framework for realistic e-commerce web agent simulation and benchmarking that bridges the gap between live storefronts and hand-built sandboxes. Enables controllable, reproducible, and diverse evaluation.

entry.title: GenShield: Unified Detection and Artifact Correction for AI-Generated Images

author.name: Zhipei Xu, Xuanyu Zhang, Youmin Xu, Qing Huang, Shen Chen, Taiping Yao, Shouhong Ding, Jian Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GenShield, a unified autoregressive framework for joint AI-generated image detection and artifact correction. Establishes a mutually reinforcing relationship between detection and correction in a closed-loop system.

entry.title: Entropic Auto-Encoding via Implicit Free-Energy Minimization

author.name: Hazhir Aliahmadi, Irina Babayan, Greg van Anders

entry.summary: Introduces Entropic Autoencoders (EAEs) that address VAE posterior collapse by making reconstruction loss the only explicit objective, with entropy generating the prior implicitly through a free energy-minimizing ensemble of encoders. This avoids the explicit prior imposition that drives optimization toward uninformative latent representations.

entry.title: Formal Methods Meet LLMs: Auditing, Monitoring, and Intervention for Compliance of Advanced AI Systems

author.name: Parand A. Alamdari, Toryn Q. Klassen, Sheila A. McIlraith

entry.summary: Proposes combining formal methods with machine learning for AI governance: offline auditing and online runtime monitoring of behavioral constraints for black-box LLM systems. Introduces intervening monitors and predictive monitoring techniques including sampling-based methods.

entry.title: Fully Open Meditron: An Auditable Pipeline for Clinical LLMs

author.name: Xavier Theimer-Lienhard, Mushtaha El-Amin, Fay Elhassan, Sahaj Vaidya, Victor Cartier-Negadi, David Sasu, Lars Klein, Mary-Anne Hartley

entry.summary: Introduces Fully Open Meditron, the first fully open pipeline for clinical LLM development that exposes the complete training stack including data provenance, curation procedures, and generation pipelines. Goes beyond open-weight by providing clinician-audited training corpus and reproducible framework.

entry.title: Universal Magnetic Structure Prediction from Atomic Coordinates with Near-Experimental Accuracy

author.name: Abhijatmedhi Chotrattanapituk, Ryotaro Okabe, Eunbi Rha, Mariya Al-Hinai, Eugene Jiang, Daniel Pajerowski, Yongqiang Cheng, Joshua J. Turner, Mingda Li

entry.summary: Introduces MSN, an E(3) equivariant graph neural network that predicts collinear and non-collinear magnetic structures directly from crystal structures. Trained on experimentally determined structures from MAGNDATA, using a novel primitive modulated structure representation for unified encoding.

entry.title: Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for MT: A Seq2Seq Perspective

author.name: Ernesto Garcia-Estrada, Carlos Escolano, Jos\'e A. R. Fonallosa

entry.summary: Applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to encoder-decoder machine translation models (NLLB-200) using reference-free rewards, achieving up to +5.03 chrF++ improvement across 13 languages without parallel data at fine-tuning time.

entry.title: Multi-Level Contextual Token Relation Modeling for Machine-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Chenwang Wu, Yiuming Cheung, Bo Han, Shuhai Zhang, Defu Lian

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for metric-based machine-generated text detection using multi-level contextual token relations, analyzing multi-hop transitions of token-level detection scores and their local/global relations.

entry.title: Embedding-perturbed Exploration Preference Optimization for Flow Models

author.name: Sujie Hu, Chubin Chen, Jiashu Zhu, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu, Xiu Li

entry.summary: Proposes Embedding-perturbed Exploration Preference Optimization (EEPO) for flow models, addressing the critical limitation of intra-group variance decay in group-based RL optimization (like GRPO) that causes premature stagnation. Perturbs embeddings to maintain exploration diversity.

entry.title: EndoGSim: Physics-Aware 4D Dynamic Endoscopic Scene Simulations via MLLM-Guided Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Changjing Liu, Yiming Huang, Long Bai, Beilei Cui, Hongliang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes EndoGSim, a framework for physics-aware endoscopic scene reconstruction and simulation using MLLM-guided 4D Gaussian Splatting. Uses MLLMs to automatically infer physical material properties for surgical scene simulation.

entry.title: Do All Individual Layers Help? An Empirical Study of Task-Interfering Layers in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Zhiming Liu, Yujie Wei, Lei Feng, Xiu Su, Xiaobo Xia, Weili Guan, Zeke Xie, Shuo Yang

entry.summary: Discovers and systematically investigates 'Task-Interfering Layers' in Vision-Language Models - layers that hinder rather than help downstream tasks when engaged, showing that bypassing specific layers improves performance.

entry.title: Effective Harness Engineering for Algorithm Discovery with Coding Agents

author.name: Yoichi Ishibashi, Taro Yano, Masafumi Oyamada

entry.summary: Investigates harness design for LLM-based algorithm discovery (à la AlphaEvolve/FunSearch), studying tradeoffs between thought depth vs. quantity, handling evaluation hacks, and safe parallel execution.

entry.title: One Pass Is Not Enough: Recursive Latent Refinement for Generative Models

author.name: Mehdi Esmaeilzadeh, Alexia Jolicoeur-Martineau, Chirag Vashist, Ke Li

entry.summary: Introduces RTM, a recursive latent refinement method for style-based generators that replaces single-pass latent mapping with iterative refinement to improve diversity and mode coverage. Argues that FID is saturated and precision/recall are better metrics for evaluating generative models.

entry.title: Bounded-Rationality, Hedging, and Generalization

author.name: Pedro A. Ortega

entry.summary: Studies learning as a bounded-rational decision problem, analyzing the channel from samples to outputs. Shows how f-divergence regularizers determine tradeoff curves between training loss and sample dependence, with KL as the Shannon information special case.

entry.title: Diffusion Policy for Coordinated Control of a Nonholonomic Mobile Base and Dual Arms in Door Opening and Passing

author.name: Shangqun Yu, Matthew En, Daniel Wu, Sangjun Park, Ziyi Zhou, Seyed Fakoorian, Donghyun Kim

entry.summary: Applies diffusion policy to coordinate a nonholonomic mobile base with dual arms for opening and passing through heavy, self-closing doors. Replaces hand-crafted state machines with learned policies from demonstrations.

entry.title: Greedy or not, here I come: Language production under vocabulary constraints in humans and resource-rational models

author.name: Thomas Hikaru Clark, Sihan Chen, Laura Nicolae

entry.summary: Investigates how humans communicate under vocabulary constraints, comparing behavior to greedy and globally optimal sampling algorithms using Sequential Monte Carlo with LLMs. Finds humans generally resemble greedy sampling.

entry.title: Njord: A Probabilistic Graph Neural Network for Ensemble Ocean Forecasting

author.name: Daniel Holmberg, Joel Oskarsson, Erik Larsson, Fredrik Lindsten, Teemu Roos

entry.summary: Introduces Njord, a probabilistic ocean forecasting model combining deep latent variables with graph neural networks, enabling ensemble forecasts with uncertainty estimates at both global and regional scales. Uses K-means cluster meshes for scalability.

entry.title: CAPS: Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection for Efficient Parallel Reasoning

author.name: Fangzhou Lin, Shuo Xing, Peiran Li, Siyuan Yang, Qianwen Ge, Kazunori Yamada, Ziming Zhang, Haichong Zhang, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Introduces CAPS, a cascaded adaptive framework for parallel reasoning that allocates verifier compute non-uniformly by adapting how much of each candidate the judge sees and how comparisons are distributed across the pool.

entry.title: Measuring Maximum Activations in Open Large Language Models

author.name: Luxuan Chen, Han Tian, Xinran Chen, Rui Kong, Fang Wang, Jiamin Chen, Yuchen Li, Jiashu Zhao, Shuaiqiang Wang, Haoyi Xiong, Dawei Yin

entry.summary: Systematically measures maximum activations across 27 checkpoints from 8 open LLM families, providing updated characterization of outlier features and massive activations in post-LLaMA models relevant to quantization.

entry.title: VSPO: Vector-Steered Policy Optimization for Behavioral Control

author.name: Xuechen Zhang, Zijian Huang, Kai Yang, Weijia Zhang, Jiasi Chen, Samet Oymak

entry.summary: Introduces VSPO (Vector-Steered Policy Optimization), which uses steering vectors to control behavioral intensity in LLM rollouts during GRPO training, addressing the sparse behavioral reward bottleneck in multi-objective optimization.

entry.title: Neutral-Reference Prompting for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Senmao Tian, Xiang Wei, Shunli Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies asymmetric confusion in VLMs where class A is mispredicted as B but not vice versa, and proposes Neutral-Reference Prompting to address the Base-New Trade-off in efficient transfer learning. Addresses pretraining-induced bias that persists for unseen classes.

entry.title: VAGS: Velocity Adaptive Guidance Scale for Image Editing and Generation

author.name: Yan Luo, Ahmadou Aidara, Jingyi Lu, Jeremy Moebel, Kai Han, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Velocity-Adaptive Guidance Scale (VAGS), a training-free replacement for fixed classifier-free guidance that adapts the scale based on temporal signal levels and cosine similarity between task-relevant velocity fields during flow-based sampling.

entry.title: PRISM: Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring for Enterprise Conversational AI

author.name: Keshava Chaitanya, Jahnavi Gundakaram

entry.summary: Presents PRISM, a closed-loop framework treating prompt engineering as continuous reliability engineering rather than one-time authorship. Detects and repairs prompt regressions caused by silent LLM behavior changes over time in enterprise conversational AI.

entry.title: ASRU: Activation Steering Meets Reinforcement Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Jiahui Guang, Yingjie Zhu, Cuiyun Gao, Haiyan Wang, Jing Li, Di Shao, Zhaoquan Gu

entry.summary: Proposes ASRU, a multimodal unlearning framework combining activation steering with reinforcement learning to achieve controllable unlearning in MLLMs while maintaining generation quality. Addresses the overlooked problem of hallucinated/rigid responses after unlearning.

entry.title: SEED: Targeted Data Selection by Weighted Independent Set

author.name: Yuan Zhang, Lifeng Guo, Junwen Pan, Chang Liu, Wenzhao Zheng, Kuan Cheng, Kurt Keutzer, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SEED, a data selection method formulating the problem as Weighted Independent Set on a similarity graph. Addresses challenges of noisy influence weights and structurally imbalanced graphs from heterogeneous domain distributions.

entry.title: SMMBench: A Benchmark for Source-Distributed Multimodal Agent Memory

author.name: Huacan Chai, Yukai Wang, Yingxuan Yang, Dan Peng, Yuanyi Song, Zhihui Fu, Weiwen Liu, Jianghao Lin, Jun Wang, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SMMBench for evaluating whether agents can retrieve, align, and compose multimodal evidence distributed across multiple independently originated sources. Tests four core capabilities beyond reasoning within single curated contexts.

entry.title: ALSO: Adversarial Online Strategy Optimization for Social Agents

author.name: Xiang Li, Liping Yi, Mingze Kong, Min Zhang, Zhongxiang Dai, QingHua Hu

entry.summary: Proposes ALSO, a framework for online strategy optimization of LLM-based social agents in non-stationary environments. Addresses the gap where most LLM agents use static personas and existing approaches assume stationarity, enabling dynamic strategy adaptation through adversarial interactions.

entry.title: BootstrapAgent: Distilling Repository Setup into Reusable Agent Knowledge

author.name: Sihan Fu, Oucheng Liu, Shiyuan Wang, Jin Shi, Chengkun Wei

entry.summary: Introduces BootstrapAgent, a multi-agent framework that distills repository setup knowledge (resolved dependencies, repair strategies) into persistent, verifiable .bootstrap contracts that can be reused by future agents, addressing the costly prerequisite of getting unfamiliar repos into a usable state.

entry.title: GHOST: Geometry-Hierarchical Online Streaming Token Eviction for Efficient 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Leyang Chen, Junyi Wu, Zhiteng Li, and Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GHOST, a training-free KV cache management framework for streaming 3D reconstruction that uses the model's own 3D geometry outputs to evict redundant tokens, addressing memory bottlenecks from linearly growing KV caches in long video sequences.

entry.title: Unlocking Dense Metric Depth Estimation in VLMs

author.name: Hanxun Yu, Xuan Qu, Yuxin Wang, Jianke Zhu, Lei ke

entry.summary: Proposes DepthVLM, a framework that transforms a VLM into a native dense depth predictor by attaching a lightweight depth head to the LLM backbone, trained under unified vision-text supervision while preserving multimodal capabilities.

entry.title: Invaria: Learning Scale and Density Invariance in Point Clouds via Next-Resolution Prediction

author.name: Chun-Peng Chang, Shaoxiang Wang, Alain Pagani, Dariu Gavrila, Holger Caesar

entry.summary: Proposes Invaria, a point cloud encoder achieving scale and density invariance through next-resolution prediction and receptive field calibration, addressing the sensitivity of 3D encoders to sampling resolution and scale changes.

entry.title: PAGER: Bridging the Semantic-Execution Gap in Point-Precise Geometric GUI Control

author.name: Jingxuan Wei, Xi Bai, Shan Liu, Caijun Jia, Zheng Sun, Xinglong Xu, Siyuan Li, Linzhuang Sun, Bihui Yu, Conghui He, Cheng Tan

entry.summary: Identifies a gap in GUI agents: precision-sensitive tasks where actions must land on exact points rather than tolerant regions. Introduces PAGER benchmark and framework for point-precise geometric GUI control, addressing cascading errors from coordinate imprecision.

entry.title: Accelerated Gradient Descent for Faster Convergence with Minimal Overhead

author.name: Manuel Graca, L. Miguel Silveira, Arlindo Oliveira, Frank Liu

entry.summary: Presents CT-AGD, an optimization method that accelerates first-order gradient methods for deep learning by capturing local curvature using finite-difference quotients. Claims 33% reduction in training epochs on average with comparable overhead to Adam.

entry.title: Health-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Models for Malfunction-Aware Robot Control

author.name: H\"useyin Arslan, \"Ozg\"ur Erkent

entry.summary: Introduces health-conditioned VLA models that take a health vector describing robot joint capabilities and adapt predictions to complete tasks with degraded joints. Trains on malfunction data collected in the LIBERO environment.

entry.title: DebiasRAG: A Tuning-Free Path to Fair Generation in Large Language Models through Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Rui Chu, Bingyin Zhao, Thanh Quoc Hung Le, Duy Cao Hoang, Huawei Lin, Ping Li, Weijie Zhao, Khoa D Doan, Yingjie Lao

entry.summary: Proposes DebiasRAG, a tuning-free approach to mitigating social biases in LLMs through retrieval-augmented generation with dynamically constructed debiasing contexts. Requires no fine-tuning or domain knowledge.

entry.title: Scalable neuromorphic computing from autonomous spiking dynamics in a clockless reconfigurable chip

author.name: Eric Oliveira Gomes and Damien Rontani

entry.summary: Proposes a scalable neuromorphic architecture using spiking dynamics from clockless digital circuits on FPGAs. Demonstrates competitive audio classification with significantly lower power consumption than traditional digital implementations.

entry.title: Navigating Potholes with Geometry-Aware Sharpness Minimization

author.name: Simon Dufort-Labb\'e, Mehrab Hamidi, Razvan Pascanu, Ioannis Mitliagkas, Damien Scieur, Aristide Baratin

entry.summary: Introduces LLQR+SAM, combining Sharpness-Aware Minimization with a learned preconditioner from the LLQR framework that captures smoothed loss geometry. Operates on two timescales: slow geometry learning and fast curvature probing.

entry.title: STABLE: Simulation-Ready Tabletop Layout Generation via a Semantics-Physics Dual System

author.name: Zhen Luo, Yixuan Yang, Xudong Xu, Jinkun Hao, Zhaoyang Lyu, Feng Zheng, Jiangmiao Pang and Yanwei Fu

entry.summary: Presents STABLE, a dual-system for simulation-ready tabletop scene generation combining a Semantic Reasoner (fine-tuned LLM) for coarse layouts with a Physics Corrector (flow-based denoising) for physically valid arrangements.

entry.title: Second-Order Multi-Level Variance Correction for Modality Competition in Multimodal Models

author.name: Yishun Lu, Wes Armour

entry.summary: Proposes ML-FOP-SOAP, a second-order optimization framework for autoregressive multimodal models that addresses modality competition between image generation and text understanding. Uses Fisher-Orthogonal Projection to suppress variance-induced modality conflicts and introduces techniques for practical large-batch training.

entry.title: Artificial Aphasias in Lesioned Language Models

author.name: Nathan Roll, Jill Kries, Laura Gwilliams, Cory Shain

entry.summary: Introduces an aphasia-inspired technique to characterize functional organization of language models by lesioning (zeroing out) model parameters and measuring effects against clinical aphasia symptom profiles. Finds the full range of evaluated symptoms surface but in distributions distinct from humans.

entry.title: Layer Equivalence Is Not a Property of Layers Alone: How You Test Redundancy Changes What You Find

author.name: Gabriel Garcia

entry.summary: Shows that different protocols for testing layer equivalence in transformers (replacement vs interchange) can yield dramatically different conclusions about which layers are safe to prune. The gap between protocols grows during training and varies across architectures.

entry.title: From Clever Hans to Scientific Discovery: Interpreting EEG Foundational Transformers with LRP

author.name: Justus Meyer zu Bexten, Nico Scherf, Bogdan Franczyk, Simon M. Hofmann

entry.summary: Applies attention-aware Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) to EEG foundation models, revealing both 'Clever Hans' artifacts and novel biological hypotheses in motor imagery and affect prediction tasks.

entry.title: PerfCodeBench: Benchmarking LLMs for System-Level High-Performance Code Optimization

author.name: Huihao Jing, Wenbin Hu, Haochen Shi, Hanyu Yang, Sirui Zhang, Shaojin Chen, Haoran Li, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: Introduces PerfCodeBench, an executable benchmark for evaluating LLMs on system-level high-performance code optimization including hardware-aware choices and performance bottleneck handling.

entry.title: PBT-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Property-Based Testing

author.name: Lucas Jing, Xinqi Wang, Liao Zhang, Simon S. Du

entry.summary: Introduces PBT-Bench, a benchmark of 100 property-based testing problems across 40 Python libraries requiring agents to derive semantic invariants and construct precise input-generation strategies to find injected bugs.

entry.title: COPRA: Conditional Parameter Adaptation with Reinforcement Learning for Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Darryl Cherian Jacob, Xinyu Liu, Kai Wang, Pan He

entry.summary: Proposes COPRA, a conditional parameter adaptation framework using reinforcement learning for video anomaly detection with VLMs. Addresses train-test distribution mismatch in VLM-based anomaly detection through dynamic adaptation.

entry.title: Belief Engine: Configurable and Inspectable Stance Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation

author.name: Joshua C. Yang, Maurice Flechtner, Damian Dailisan, and Michiel A. Bakker

entry.summary: Introduces the Belief Engine, an auditable belief-update layer for multi-agent LLM deliberation that treats belief as an evidential state and exposes it as scalar stance with controllable evidence uptake and prior anchoring parameters.

entry.title: MorphoHELM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Representations for Microscopy-Based Morphology Assays

author.name: Emre Hayir, Lorin Crawford, Alex X. Lu

entry.summary: Introduces MorphoHELM, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating feature extraction methods for Cell Painting microscopy, consolidating evaluation standards and correcting existing metrics across multiple datasets.

entry.title: Capability Conditioned Scaffolding for Professional Human LLM Collaboration

author.name: Sen Yang, Yinglei Ma

entry.summary: Introduces Capability Conditioned Scaffolding, a framework that partitions user expertise into domains and conditions LLM intervention behavior on structured capability profiles to prevent Professional Domain Drift.

entry.title: From Feedback Loops to Policy Updates: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for LLM-Based Alpha Factor Discovery

author.name: Lingzhe Zhang, Tong Jia, Yunpeng Zhai, Zixuan Xie, Chiming Duan, Minghua He, Philip S. Yu, and Ying Li

entry.summary: Proposes reinforcement fine-tuning for LLM-based alpha factor discovery in quantitative trading, replacing iterative prompt-feedback loops with RL to avoid context explosion and generate more diverse factors.

entry.title: Runtime-Structured Task Decomposition for Agentic Coding Systems

author.name: Shubhi Asthana, Bing Zhang, Chad DeLuca, Hima Patel, Ruchi Mahindru

entry.summary: Proposes runtime-structured task decomposition for agentic coding systems where task partitioning is managed through executable control logic rather than monolithic prompts, reducing brittleness and retry costs.

entry.title: On the Stability of Growth in Structural Plasticity

author.name: Lute Lillo, Nick Cheney

entry.summary: Analyzes stability challenges in structural plasticity (growing neural networks during training), showing newborn units are forward-active but backward-starved, receiving weaker gradients than incumbent units.

entry.title: SurvivalPFN: Amortizing Survival Prediction via In-Context Bayesian Inference

author.name: Shi-ang Qi, Vahid Balazadeh, Michael Cooper, Russell Greiner, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: Introduces SurvivalPFN, a prior-data fitted network that performs Bayesian inference for survival analysis in a single forward pass via in-context learning, eliminating need for task-specific training or hyperparameter tuning.

entry.title: PrismQuant: Rate-Distortion-Optimal Vector Quantization for Gaussian-Mixture Sources

author.name: Bumsu Park, Chanho Park, Youngmok Park, Namyoon Lee

entry.summary: Develops PrismQuant, a constructive rate-distortion theory for Gaussian-mixture sources, proving the mixture structure incurs only a component label cost and enabling practical vector quantization for multimodal distributions.

entry.title: Rethinking Neural Network Learning Rates: A Stackelberg Perspective

author.name: Sihan Zeng, Sujay Bhatt, Sumitra Ganesh

entry.summary: Proposes viewing non-uniform learning rates across neural network layers through Stackelberg optimization, showing smaller body learning rates and larger final layer rates correspond to two-time-scale alternating gradient descent with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: AstraFlow: Dataflow-Oriented Reinforcement Learning for Agentic LLMs

author.name: Haizhong Zheng, Yizhuo Di, Jiahui Wang, Shuowei Jin, Xueshen Liu, Yongji Wu, Z. Morley Mao, Ion Stoica, Jiawei Zhao, Beidi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AstraFlow, a dataflow-oriented RL system for agentic LLMs that replaces trainer-centered control with principled component abstractions, supporting multi-policy collaborative training on heterogeneous compute.

entry.title: On the Power of Adaptivity for $\varepsilon$-Best Arm Identification in Linear Bandits

author.name: Arnab Maiti, Yunbei Xu, Kevin Jamieson

entry.summary: Studies minimax sample complexity of ε-best arm identification in linear bandits. Presents a non-adaptive fixed-design method with matching upper and lower bounds, proving that adaptivity provides no minimax improvement in certain regimes.

entry.title: Rule2DRC: Benchmarking LLM Agents for DRC Script Synthesis with Execution-Guided Test Generation

author.name: Jinuk Kim, Junsoo Byun, Donghwi Hwang, Seong-Jin Park, Hyun Oh Song

entry.summary: Introduces Rule2DRC, a large-scale benchmark for DRC script synthesis agents with 1,000 rule-to-script tasks and 13,921 evaluation chip layouts. Tests LLM agents' ability to translate natural language design rules into executable checking scripts.

entry.title: ElasticDiT: Efficient Diffusion Transformers via Elastic Architecture and Sparse Attention for High-Resolution Image Generation on Mobile Devices

author.name: Kunpeng Du, Haizhen Xie, Sen Lu, Lei Yu, Binglei Bao, Huaao Tang, Chuntao Liu, Hao Wu, Yang Zhao, Zhicai Huang, Heyuan Gao, Zhijun Tu, Jie Hu, Xinghao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces ElasticDiT for efficient Diffusion Transformer inference on mobile devices through dynamic spatial compression ratios and block depths. Integrates Shift Sparse Block Attention and a Tiny DWT-Distilled VAE for reduced latency.

entry.title: $\alpha$-TCAV: A Unified Framework for Testing with Concept Activation Vectors

author.name: Ekkehard Schnoor, Jawher Said, Malik Tiomoko, Wojciech Samek, Alexander Jung

entry.summary: Identifies a fundamental flaw in standard TCAV scores due to discontinuous indicator functions and proposes α-TCAV, a generalized framework using parameterized smooth functions. Derives distributions of major CAV classes and provides statistical guarantees.

entry.title: H-Mem: A Novel Memory Mechanism for Evolving and Retrieving Agent Memory via a Hybrid Structure

author.name: Jiawei Yu, Yixiang Fang, Xilin Liu, Yuchi Ma

entry.summary: Proposes H-Mem, a hybrid memory mechanism for LLM agents that models memory evolution over time using temporal and semantic tree structures. Enables short-term memory to progressively evolve into long-term memory with efficient retrieval.

entry.title: 3D Segmentation Using Viewpoint-Dependent Spatial Relationships

author.name: Ayaka Nanri (1), Klara Reichard (2,3), Mert Kiray (2,4,5), Federico Tombari (2,6), Benjamin Busam (2,4,5), Asako Kanezaki (1,7,8) ((1) Institute of Science Tokyo, (2) Technical University of Munich, (3) BMW Group, (4) Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML), (5) Obsphera, (6) Google, (7) Tohoku University, (8) RIKEN)

entry.summary: Introduces a viewpoint-aware 3D referring segmentation dataset with 220K benchmark samples where target objects can only be identified through observer-centric spatial relations. Addresses the ambiguity of spatial terms like 'left' and 'behind' in 3D scene understanding.

entry.title: Learn2Splat: Extending the Horizon of Learned 3DGS Optimization

author.name: Naama Pearl, Stefano Esposito, Haofei Xu, Amit Peleg, Patricia Gschossmann, Lorenzo Porzi, Peter Kontschieder, Gerard Pons-Moll, Andreas Geiger

entry.summary: Introduces Learn2Splat, a learned optimizer for 3D Gaussian Splatting that avoids degradation over extended optimization horizons. Addresses the limitation of existing learned optimizers that are trained for fixed iteration counts and degrade beyond.

entry.title: WorldAct: Activating Monolithic 3D Worlds into Interactive-Ready Object-Centric Scenes

author.name: Jichen Hu, Jiawei Guo, Jiazhong Cen, Chen Yang, Sikuang Li, Wei Shen

entry.summary: Presents WorldAct, a framework that converts static generated 3D worlds into editable, interaction-ready scenes using a multimodal agent for scene decomposition, object identification, mesh reconstruction, and background restoration via 3D inpainting.

entry.title: Practical Validity Conditions for Byzantine-Tolerant Federated Learning

author.name: M\'elanie Cambus, Darya Melnyk, Tijana Milentijevi\'c, Stefan Schmid

entry.summary: Introduces minimum enclosing ball (MEB) validity condition for Byzantine-tolerant federated learning robust aggregation, addressing limitations of convex validity which has dimension-dependent resilience and excludes practical aggregation rules.

entry.title: RaPD: Resolution-Agnostic Pixel Diffusion via Semantics-Enriched Implicit Representations

author.name: Yanhao Ge, Shanyan Guan, Weihao Wang, Ying Tai, Mingyu You

entry.summary: Proposes RaPD, which performs diffusion in a continuous Neural Image Field latent space rather than on discrete grids, enabling resolution-agnostic image generation from a single denoised latent rendered at arbitrary resolutions.

entry.title: From Failure to Feedback: Group Revision Unlocks Hard Cases in Object-Level Grounding

author.name: Yuyuan Liu, Yiping Ji, Anjie Le, Jiayuan Zhu, Jiazhen Pan, Can Peng, Jiajun Deng, Fengbei Liu, and Junde Wu

entry.summary: Proposes group-revision optimization for object-level grounding in VLMs, where failed responses are revised to generate improved candidates with reward shaping that quantifies improvement over initial attempts, enhancing learning on hard cases.

entry.title: OHP-RL: Online Human Preference as Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Yunyang Mo (1), Jian Li (1), Qiwei Wu (1), Yihang Kang (1), Renjing Xu (1) ((1) The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou))

entry.summary: Proposes OHP-RL, a framework that treats human interventions as preference information rather than exact actions to imitate, guiding RL policy learning for robot manipulation. Integrates online human preferences for safer and more efficient exploration.

entry.title: Constrained latent state modeling: A unifying perspective on representation learning under competing constraints

author.name: Gwenol\'e Quellec

entry.summary: Proposes constrained latent state modeling as a unifying framework for representation learning, arguing that current approaches are fragmented due to underconstrained objectives. Provides a principled perspective on what meaningful latent states should satisfy.

entry.title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration

author.name: Michael Solodko, Justin Wagle

entry.summary: Presents ScreenSearch, a system for desktop GUI exploration that combines structural screen retrieval/deduplication with an ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration under partial observability.

entry.title: ReAlign: Generalizable Image Forgery Detection via Reasoning-Aligned Representation

author.name: Qing Huang, Zhipei Xu, Xuanyu Zhang, Xiangyu Yu, Jian Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ReAlign, a framework for generalizable image forgery detection that uses LLM-generated reasoning texts to create reasoning-aligned representations. Investigates whether explanatory reasoning actually helps detection performance.

entry.title: Sign-Separated Finite-Time Error Analysis of Q-Learning

author.name: Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Develops a sign-separated finite-time error analysis for Q-learning, decomposing errors into negative and positive parts. Identifies a max-induced asymmetry connected to Q-learning's well-known overestimation bias.

entry.title: Confirming Correct, Missing the Rest: LLM Tutoring Agents Struggle Where Feedback Matters Most

author.name: Tahreem Yasir, Wenbo Li, Sam Gilson, Sutapa Dey Tithi, Xiaoyi Tian and Tiffany Barnes

entry.summary: Benchmarks seven LLM feedback agents as tutors in propositional logic, finding they achieve near-ceiling on confirming optimal steps but systematically over-reject valid suboptimal reasoning and over-validate incorrect solutions. This highlights fundamental limitations of LLMs for adaptive tutoring.

entry.title: Hypothesis-driven construction of mesoscopic dynamics

author.name: Zhuoyuan Li, Aiqing Zhu, Qianxiao Li

entry.summary: Proposes learning mesoscopic dynamics within mathematically constrained hypothesis classes based on a generalized Onsager principle. Provides unified framework for dissipative and conservative dynamics with theoretical guarantees including well-posedness, stability, and identifiability.

entry.title: Offline Semantic Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation

author.name: Jin Shi, Brady Zhang, Yishun Lu

entry.summary: Introduces VLA-AD, a distillation framework using a Vision-Language Model as offline semantic supervisor to compress large VLA policies into lightweight students. Augments action imitation with task phase anchors and multi-frame operating-direction descriptions used only during training.

entry.title: DexJoCo: A Benchmark and Toolkit for Task-Oriented Dexterous Manipulation on MuJoCo

author.name: Hanwen Wang, Weizhi Zhao, Xiangyu Wang, Siyuan Huang, He Lin, Boyuan Zheng, Rongtao Xu, Gang Wang, Yao Mu, He Wang, Lue Fan, Hongsheng Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang and Tieniu Tan

entry.summary: Presents DexJoCo, a benchmark for dexterous manipulation in MuJoCo with 11 functionally grounded tasks evaluating tool-use, bimanual coordination, long-horizon execution, and reasoning. Includes 1.1K collected trajectories with domain randomization and benchmarks of modern manipulation methods.

entry.title: IVGT: Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer for Neural Scene Representation

author.name: Yuqi Wu, Tianyu Hu, Wenzhao Zheng, Yuanhui Huang, Haowen Sun, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes IVGT, an Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer that models continuous and coherent geometry from pose-free multi-view images using implicit neural representations. Supports continuous spatial queries for SDF and color prediction, avoiding redundancy of explicit pointmap regression.

entry.title: Composite Bayesian Optimization In Function Spaces Using NEON -- Neural Epistemic Operator Networks

author.name: Leonardo Ferreira Guilhoto, Paris Perdikaris

entry.summary: Introduces NEON (Neural Epistemic Operator Networks) for uncertainty quantification in operator learning with orders of magnitude fewer parameters than deep ensembles, applied to composite Bayesian optimization in function spaces.

entry.title: MuteBench: Modality Unavailability Tolerance Evaluation for Incomplete Multimodal Fusion

author.name: Wugeng Zheng, Ziwen Kan, Tianlong Chen, Chen Chen, Song Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MuteBench, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating multimodal fusion robustness under sensor failure (modality missing and within-modality missing) across 9 clinical datasets and 6 architectures.

entry.title: A3D: Agentic AI flow for autonomous Accelerator Design

author.name: Abinand Nallathambi, Christopher Knight, Shantanu Ganguly, Wilfried Haensch, Anand Raghunathan

entry.summary: Presents A3D, an agentic AI flow for end-to-end automated hardware accelerator design that handles workload analysis, HLS design, and EDA tool usage autonomously.

entry.title: Deep Pre-Alignment for VLMs

author.name: Tianyu Yu, Kechen Fang, Zihao Wan, Kaidong Zhang, Yicheng Zhang, Jun Song, Bo Zheng, Yuan Yao

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Pre-Alignment for VLMs, replacing standard ViT encoders with a small VLM as perceiver to ensure visual features are deeply aligned with the text space before entering the main LLM.

entry.title: Beyond Performance Disparities: A Three-Level Audit of Representational Harm in CelebA

author.name: Sieun Park, Yuanmo He

entry.summary: Conducts a three-level audit of CelebA dataset examining representational harms at the dataset structure, learned features, and spatial attention levels. Reveals how gendered double standards of ageing and beauty are encoded in data and reproduced in models.

entry.title: Automatic Construction of a Legal Citation Graph from 100 Million Ukrainian Court Decisions: Large-Scale Extraction, Topological Analysis, and Ontology-Driven Clustering

author.name: Volodymyr Ovcharov

entry.summary: Constructs the first large-scale citation graph from 100.7 million Ukrainian court decisions, extracting 502 million citation links. Reveals power-law degree distribution and shows citation structure encodes legal domain boundaries without supervision.

entry.title: Unified High-Probability Analysis of Stochastic Variance-Reduced Estimation

author.name: Zhankun Luo, Antesh Upadhyay, M. Berk Sahin, Sang Bin Moon, Anuran Makur, Abolfazl Hashemi

entry.summary: Develops a unified framework for stochastic variance-reduced estimation based on a three-component recursion (memory retention, reset probability, correction), recovering classical estimators and providing unified high-probability bounds.

entry.title: 3DEditSafe: Defending 3D Editing Pipelines from Unsafe Generation

author.name: Nicole Meng, Zheyuan Liu, Meng Jiang, Yingjie Lao

entry.summary: Proposes 3DEditSafe, a safety framework for 3D editing pipelines based on 3D Gaussian Splatting that prevents generation of NSFW content through safety-regularized optimization and semantic preservation.

entry.title: Margin-Adaptive Confidence Ranking for Reliable LLM Judgement

author.name: Gaojie Jin, Yong Tao, Lijia Yu, Tianjin Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a margin-adaptive confidence estimator for LLM judgement that learns to distinguish human-agreement from human-disagreement cases, with generalization guarantees for the confidence ranking.

entry.title: Social-Mamba: Socially-Aware Trajectory Forecasting with State-Space Models

author.name: Po-Chien Luan, Wuyang Li, Yang Gao, Alexandre Alahi

entry.summary: Proposes Social-Mamba, a trajectory forecasting architecture using state-space models that reformulates social interactions as structured sequential processes, offering linear-time alternative to attention-based methods.

entry.title: Don't Stop Me Yet: Sampling Loss Minima via Dissipative Riemannian Mechanics

author.name: Albert Kj{\o}ller Jacobsen, Leo Uhre Jakobsen, Johanna Marie Gegenfurtner, Georgios Arvanitidis

entry.summary: Proposes DiMS, a dissipative Riemannian mechanics-based sampler for neural network loss minimum level sets, using kinetic energy with gravitational pull and friction for exact sampling from minima.

entry.title: Toward World Modeling of Physiological Signals with Chaos-Theoretic Balancing and Latent Dynamics

author.name: Yunfei Luo, Xi Chen, Yuliang Chen, Lanshuang Zhang, Md Mofijul Islam, Siwei Zhao, Peter Kotanko, Subhasis Dasgupta, Andrew Campbell, Rakesh Malhotra, Tauhidur Rahman

entry.summary: Introduces NormWear-2, a world model for physiological time series that combines pre-trained knowledge with non-parametric latent state adaptation for long-horizon forecasting of multi-scale physiological signals.

entry.title: FLASH: Efficient Visuomotor Policy via Sparse Sampling

author.name: Jiaqi Bai, Jindou Jia, Yuxuan Hu, Gen Li, Xiangyu Chen, Tuo An, Kuangji Zuo, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: Presents FLASH Policy, which replaces discrete action-chunk generation with continuous Legendre polynomial trajectory representation for visuomotor policies, enabling single-inference extended action horizons with flow matching from history-anchored initialization.

entry.title: Neural Point-Forms

author.name: Bruno Trentini, Jacob Hume, Vincenzo Antonio Isoldi, Philipp Misof, Ekaterina S. Ivshina, Kelly Maggs

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Point-Forms (NPFs), learnable geometric features for point clouds inspired by differential forms, using Laplacian-based techniques from diffusion geometry to build discrete models for comparing forms via inner products.

entry.title: SkiP: When to Skip and When to Refine for Efficient Robot Manipulation

author.name: Mingtong Dai, Guanqi Peng, Yongjie Bai, Feng Yan, Chunjie Chen, Lingbo Liu, Liang Lin, Xinyu Wu

entry.summary: Proposes SkiP (Skip Policy), which dynamically leaps over redundant free-space motion steps and intensively refines actions only at key contact/grasp phases, using action relabeling to train efficient manipulation policies.

entry.title: Detecting Privilege Escalation in Polyglot Microservices via Agentic Program Analysis

author.name: Penghui Li, Hong Yau Chong, Yinzhi Cao, and Junfeng Yang

entry.summary: Presents Neo, an agentic program analysis framework combining LLMs with classic program analysis to detect privilege escalation vulnerabilities in polyglot microservices architectures.

entry.title: Calibrating LLMs with Semantic-level Reward

author.name: Fengfei Yu, Ruijia Niu, Dongxia Wu, Yian Ma, Rose Yu

entry.summary: Proposes semantic-level reward calibration for LLMs that addresses inconsistencies in verbalized confidence across textual variations, improving calibration beyond token-level approaches.

entry.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Universal Horizon Models

author.name: Hojun Chung, Junseo Lee, Songhwai Oh

entry.summary: Introduces Universal Horizon Models (UHM) for offline RL that directly predict future states under arbitrary horizons, with winsorized horizon distribution for stable training, addressing compounding errors in model-based approaches.

entry.title: PCASim: Promptable Closed-loop Adversarial Simulation for Urban Traffic Environment
