author.name: Chuancheng Zhang, Zhenhao Wang, Kaizheng Li, Yaran Lin, Qiang Guo, Bin Jiang

entry.summary: Presents PCASim, a system integrating adversarial scenario generation with safety agent training in closed-loop autonomous driving testing. Uses LLMs to integrate knowledge-, data-, and adversarial-driven approaches for generating safety-critical traffic scenarios.

entry.title: ChronoEarth-492K: A Large Scale and Long Horizon Spatiotemporal Hyperspectral Earth Observation Dataset and Benchmark

author.name: Haozhe Si, Yuxuan Wan, Yuqing Wang, Minh Do, Han Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces ChronoEarth-492K, the first large-scale temporally calibrated hyperspectral self-supervised learning dataset from NASA's EO-1 Hyperion mission spanning 2001-2017. Contains 492K patches across 185K global locations enabling long-horizon spatiotemporal modeling.

entry.title: Going Beyond the Edge: Distributed Inference of Transformer Models on Ultra-Low-Power Wireless Devices

author.name: Alexander Gr\"afe, Ding Huo, Johannes Berger, Marco Zimmerling, Sebastian Trimpe

entry.summary: Presents CATS, a framework for distributed transformer inference on ultra-low-power wireless IoT devices. Introduces SomeGather, a pruned communication primitive that selectively broadcasts activation columns to reduce bandwidth and RAM.

entry.title: HyperDiT: Hyper-Connected Transformers for High-Fidelity Pixel-Space Diffusion

author.name: Yu He, Lichen Ma, Zipeng Guo, Xinyuan Shan, Jingling Fu, Dong Chen, Junshi Huang, Yan Li

entry.summary: Proposes HyperDiT, a pixel-space diffusion framework with hyper-connected cross-scale interactions to bridge semantic and pixel manifolds. Uses Cross-Attention for fine-grained tokens to query multi-level semantic anchors and Scale-Aware Rotary Position Embedding.

entry.title: DimMem: Dimensional Structuring for Efficient Long-Term Agent Memory

author.name: Wentao Qiu, Haotian Hu, Fanyi Wang, Jinwei Kong, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DimMem, a lightweight dimensional memory framework for LLM agents representing each memory as an atomic, typed unit with explicit fields (time, location, reason, purpose, keywords). Achieves strong performance on long-term memory benchmarks.

entry.title: Learning Context-conditioned Gaussian Overbounds for Convolution-Based Uncertainty Propagation

author.name: Ruirui Liu, Xuejie Hou, Yiping Jiang, Hui Ren

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for learning context-conditioned Gaussian overbounds that compose under convolution, enabling conservative uncertainty propagation in safety-critical settings. Extends classical aviation-style Gaussian overbounding to be feature-conditioned and learnable.

entry.title: Modeling Music as a Time-Frequency Image: A 2D Tokenizer for Music Generation

author.name: Yuqing Cheng, Xingyu Ma, Guochen Yu, Xiaotao Gu

entry.summary: Proposes BandTok, a 2D Mel-spectrogram tokenizer for autoregressive music generation that represents audio as a time-frequency token grid from a single shared codebook, avoiding the error accumulation issues of residual multi-codebook approaches.

entry.title: Shapley Neuron Values for Continual Learning: Which Neurons Matter Most?

author.name: Mohammad Ali Vahedifar and Abhisek Ray and Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Shapley Neuron Valuation (SNV), using cooperative game theory to quantify neuron importance for continual learning. Selectively freezes important neurons while keeping others plastic, achieving buffer-free continual learning without architecture expansion.

entry.title: Decomposed Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

author.name: Chenhao Wang, Yingrui Ji, Yu Meng, Yao Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes decomposed vision-language alignment that factorizes text prompts into concept and attribute tokens for separate cross-modal interactions, improving open-vocabulary segmentation for unseen category-attribute combinations.

entry.title: Defining Cultural Capabilities for AI Evaluation: A Taxonomy Grounded in Intercultural Communication Theory

author.name: Isar Nejadgholi and Masoud Kianpour and Krishnapriya Vishnubhotla and Maryam Molamohamadi

entry.summary: Proposes a three-level taxonomy of AI cultural capabilities grounded in Intercultural Communication theory: Cultural Awareness, Sensitivity, and Competence. Addresses the vague and interchangeable terminology in AI cultural evaluation.

entry.title: Towards Foundation Models for Relational Databases with Language Models and Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Jingcheng Wu, Ratan Bahadur Thapa, Mojtaba Nayyeri, Lucas Etteldorf, Max Finkenbeiner, Fabian Leeske, Steffen Staab

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid architecture combining fine-tuned BART encoder for intra-row semantics with GraphSAGE over relational entity graphs for relational database learning. Tested on RelBench showing GNN enriches row embeddings.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy and Explainable AI for Perception Models: From Concept to Prototype Vehicle Deployment

author.name: Till Beemelmanns, Shayan Sharifi, Manas Mehrotra, Ayushman Choudhuri, Lutz Eckstein

entry.summary: Proposes a Trustworthy AI perception module for autonomous driving that integrates attention-based explanations, uncertainty estimation, and calibration into a transformer-based 3D detector. Validates on a prototype vehicle.

entry.title: WeatherOcc3D: VLM-Assisted Adverse Weather Aware 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction

author.name: A. Enes Doruk, Abdelaziz Hussein, Hasan F. Ates

entry.summary: Proposes WeatherOcc3D, a VLM-assisted framework for 3D semantic occupancy prediction under adverse weather using CLIP to adaptively weight camera and LiDAR inputs based on weather-specific text embeddings.

entry.title: BAPR: Bayesian amnesic piecewise-robust reinforcement learning for non-stationary continuous control

author.name: Yifan Zhang, Liang Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes BAPR, combining Bayesian Online Change Detection with robust ensemble RL for piecewise stationary environments. Provides a convex combination Bellman operator with contraction guarantees, and uses Lean 4 machine verification to establish sharp boundaries on when the approach fails.

entry.title: Breaking the Finite-Sample Barrier in Entropy Coupling

author.name: Shahab Asoodeh and Jun Chen

entry.summary: Introduces minimum list entropy coupling, showing that dependence among marginally constrained observations can break a finite-sample barrier. Proves a sharp dichotomy: independent observations reduce uncertainty exponentially while dependent observations can eliminate it exactly after finitely many samples.

entry.title: FORGE: Self-Evolving Agent Memory With No Weight Updates via Population Broadcast

author.name: Igor Bogdanov, Chung-Horng Lung, Thomas Kunz, Jie Gao, Adrian Taylor, Marzia Zaman

entry.summary: Proposes FORGE, a population-based protocol that evolves prompt-injected natural-language memory for hierarchical ReAct agents without gradient updates. Uses Reflexion-style inner loops with a dedicated reflection agent converting failed trajectories into reusable knowledge artifacts.

entry.title: Hydra: Efficient, Correct Code Generation via Checkpoint-and-Rollback Support

author.name: Alexander Du, Jianjun Ou, Danyang Zhuo, and Matthew Lentz

entry.summary: Presents Hydra, a code generation system using checkpoint-and-rollback to efficiently recover from static errors during generation by checking asynchronously and rolling back to the error source when needed.

entry.title: GAP: Geometric Anchor Pre-training for Data-Efficient Visuomotor Learning of Manipulation Tasks

author.name: Davide Buoso, Andrea Protopapa, Stefano Di Carlo, Francesca Pistilli, Giuseppe Averta

entry.summary: Proposes Geometric Anchor Pre-training (GAP), a simple action-free warm-up stage that pre-trains spatial pooling modules on geometric anchor tasks before policy learning, improving data efficiency and robustness of visuomotor policies for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: Multi-level Self-supervised Pretraining on Compositional Hierarchical Graph for Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Xiayu Liu, Zhengyi Lu, Hou-biao Li

entry.summary: Proposes MolCHG, a multi-level self-supervised pretraining framework for molecular property prediction using a Compositional Hierarchical Graph that elevates bond-level information to independent node representations alongside atom-level features.

entry.title: The Privacy Price of Tail-Risk Learning: Effective Tail Sample Size in Differentially Private CVaR Optimization

author.name: El Mustapha Mansouri

entry.summary: Derives complete characterizations of the privacy cost for CVaR (tail-risk) learning under differential privacy. Shows the effective private sample size for tail risk is ε·n·τ rather than n, revealing a fundamental tension between privacy and tail-risk optimization.

entry.title: DP-SfM: Dual-Pixel Structure-from-Motion without Scale Ambiguity

author.name: Lilika Makabe, Kohei Ashida, Hiroaki Santo, Fumio Okura, and Yasuyuki Matsushita

entry.summary: Shows that dual-pixel sensor images can resolve scale ambiguity in structure-from-motion without reference objects, using defocus blur information from DP images paired with depth maps.

entry.title: Agent4POI: Agentic Context-Conditioned Affordance Reasoning for Multimodal Point-of-Interest Recommendation

author.name: Jinze Wang, Yangchen Zeng, Tiehua Zhang, Lu Zhang, Yuze Liu, Yongchao Liu, Xingjun Ma, Zhu Sun

entry.summary: Introduces Agent4POI, the first POI recommendation framework generating context-conditioned multimodal representations at inference time via a four-phase LLM agent, with formal proof that static embeddings cannot satisfy context-sensitive ranking.

entry.title: SkillSmith: Compiling Agent Skills into Boundary-Guided Runtime Interfaces

author.name: Duling Xu, Zheng Chen, Zaifeng Pan, Jiawei Guan, Dong Dong, Jialin Li, Bangzheng Pu

entry.summary: Proposes SkillSmith, a compiler-runtime framework that compiles agent skill packages into minimal executable interfaces, reducing redundant context injection and repeated reasoning in LLM agents.

entry.title: Verifiable Agentic Infrastructure: Proof-Derived Authorization for Sovereign AI Systems

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Proposes proof-derived authorization for sovereign AI systems where autonomous agents submit intents to infrastructure that evaluates context and policy before execution, replacing identity-centric authorization.

entry.title: GESD: Beyond Outcome-Oriented Fairness

author.name: Gideon Popoola, John Sheppard

entry.summary: Proposes GESD, a procedural fairness metric measuring disparities in explanation stability across demographic groups, going beyond outcome-oriented fairness to examine how models explain their decisions differently.

entry.title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution

author.name: Han Li, Jinyu Tian, Rili Feng, Yuqiao Du, Chong Zheng, Chenyu Wang, Chenchen Liu, Shihao Li, Xinping Lei, Yifan Yao, Weihao Xie, Letian Zhu, Jiaheng Liu

entry.summary: Presents Solvita, an agentic evolution framework for competitive programming that enables continuous learning through graph-structured knowledge banks without weight updates, using four specialized agents.

entry.title: Time-Varying Deep State Space Models for Sequences with Switching Dynamics

author.name: Sanja Karilanova, Subhrakanti Dey, Ay\c{c}a \"Oz\c{c}elikkale

entry.summary: Proposes time-varying state-space model neural networks where neuron states are governed by time-varying dynamics through a dictionary of basis functions. Evaluated on switching systems and speech denoising, showing improvements over time-invariant counterparts.

entry.title: Discretizing Group-Convolutional Neural Networks for 3D Geometry in Feature Space

author.name: Daniel Franzen, Jean Philip Filling, Michael Wand

entry.summary: Proposes sampling in feature space for group-convolutional neural networks to handle the exponential cost of dense transformation group sampling, replacing geometrically dense samples with representative feature-space samples.

entry.title: ChangeFlow -- Latent Rectified Flow for Change Detection in Remote Sensing

author.name: Bla\v{z} Rolih, Matic Fu\v{c}ka, Filip Wolf, Luka \v{C}ehovin Zajc

entry.summary: Proposes ChangeFlow, a generative approach to remote sensing change detection using latent rectified flow models that can model distributions of plausible change masks and handle ambiguity.

entry.title: ELDOR: A Dataset and Benchmark for Illegal Gold Mining in the Amazon Rainforest

author.name: Kangning Cui, Surendra Bohara, Suraj Prasai, Zishan Shao, Wei Tang, Martin Pillaca, Edwin Flores, Zhen Yang, Gregory Larsen, Evan Dethier, David Lutz, Jean-Michel Morel, Miles Silman, Victor Pauca, and Fan Yang

entry.summary: Introduces ELDOR, a large-scale UAV benchmark for monitoring illegal gold mining in the Amazon with pixel-level semantic labels covering 2,500+ hectares, establishing four benchmark tasks.

entry.title: Beyond Partner Diversity: An Influence-Based Team Steering Framework for Zero-Shot Human-Machine Teaming

author.name: Wei Sheng, Rohan Paleja

entry.summary: Proposes Influence-Based Team Steering (IBTS) for zero-shot human-machine teaming that uses influence shaping to discover diverse team interaction patterns and steers trajectories toward strong coordination modes.

entry.title: Amortized Energy-Based Bayesian Inference

author.name: Hojjat Kaveh, Ricardo Baptista, Andrew M. Stuart

entry.summary: Proposes a transport-based approach for amortized Bayesian inference that learns observation-dependent maps using energy-distance objectives, requiring only joint samples without density evaluation or invertibility constraints.

entry.title: RIDE: Retinex-Informed Decoupling for Exposing Concealed Objects

author.name: Chunming He, Rihan Zhang, Dingming Zhang, Chengyu Fang, Longxiang Tang, Jingjia Feng, Fengyang Xiao, Sina Farsiu

entry.summary: Introduces RIDE, a concealed object segmentation method using Retinex-based image decomposition into illumination and reflectance components, providing homogeneous decomposition in the same spatial domain.

entry.title: When Does Sparse MoE Help in Vision? The Role of Backbone Compute Leverage in Sparse Routing

author.name: Libo Sun, Po-wei Harn, Peixiong He, Xiao Qin

entry.summary: Studies when sparse Mixture-of-Experts helps in vision classification, identifying a 'compute-leverage pattern' where positive accuracy gains require a substantial fraction of FLOPs to be routed and multi-expert routing at scale.

entry.title: Learning with Conflicts of Interest

author.name: Nischal Aryal, Arash Termehchy, Ali Vakilian, Marianne Winslett

entry.summary: Formalizes conflicts of interest between ML system owners and users, proposing solutions that recognize adversarial incentives without requiring system owners to self-regulate.

entry.title: DetectRL-X: Towards Reliable Multilingual and Real-World LLM-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Junchao Wu, Yefeng Liu, Chenyu Zhu, Hao Zhang, Zeyu Wu, Tianqi Shi, Yichao Du, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Jinsong Su, Derek F. Wong

entry.summary: Introduces DetectRL-X, a comprehensive multilingual benchmark for LLM-generated text detection spanning 8 languages, 6 domains, and 4 commercial LLMs, including realistic AI-assisted writing operations.

entry.title: MaxSketch: Robust Distinct Counting in Streams via Random Projections

author.name: Nikos Tsikouras, Constantine Caramanis, Christos Tzamos

entry.summary: Introduces MaxSketch for robust distinct counting in streams with noisy high-dimensional observations, showing improved memory guarantees under geometric structure common in learned representations.

entry.title: Response-Conditioned Parallel-to-Sequential Orchestration for Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Nurbek Tastan, Alex Iacob, Lorenzo Sani, Meghdad Kurmanji, Nicholas D. Lane, Samuel Horvath, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: Introduces Nexa, a hybrid parallel-to-sequential multi-agent collaboration framework with a trainable response-conditioned policy that bridges parallel execution with sequential refinement for balancing latency and accuracy.

entry.title: AGC: Adaptive Geodesic Correction for Adversarial Robustness on Vision-Language Models

author.name: Zhiwei Li, Jiacheng Xue, Weining Wang, Ajian Liu, Xingyu Gao, Zhenan Sun, Qi Li

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Geodesic Correction (AGC), a training-free defense for CLIP against adversarial perturbations that identifies and leverages specific augmentations providing robust geometric cues in hyperspherical feature space.

entry.title: Embracing Biased Transition Matrices for Complementary-Label Learning with Many Classes

author.name: Tan-Ha Mai, Chao-Kai Chiang, Han-Hwa Shih, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama, Hsuan-Tien Lin

entry.summary: Shows that deliberately biased (non-uniform) complementary label generation overcomes the long-standing scaling bottleneck in complementary-label learning, proposing BICL framework spanning data collection to training.

entry.title: Towards Code-Oriented LM Embeddings for Surrogate-Assisted Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Pranav Somu, Advay Balakrishnan, Stepan Kravtsov, Aaron McDaniel, Jason Zutty

entry.summary: Proposes using language model embeddings of PyTorch code representations as feature extractors for neural architecture search surrogates. Demonstrates that off-the-shelf LMs can act as competitive performance predictors without NAS-specialized fine-tuning.

entry.title: MyoChallenge 2025: A New Benchmark for Human Athletic Intelligence

author.name: Cheryl Wang, Chun Kwang Tan, Balint K. Hodossy, Eric Lyu, Jun Guo, Wentao Zhao, Huaping Liu, Chengkun Li, Merkourios Simos, Bianca Ziliotto, Alexander Mathis, Siyuan Liu, Jiahao Chen, Shanlin Zhong, Bo Jiang, Ci Song, Yaoye Zhu, Chenhui Zuo, Yanan Sui, Mohamed Irfan Refai, Massimo Sartori, Guillaume Durandau, Vikash Kumar, Vittorio Caggiano

entry.summary: Describes MyoChallenge 2025 at NeurIPS, a benchmark for motor control intelligence in sports using high-fidelity musculoskeletal models. Introduces two distinct tracks for athletic performance tasks combining rapid decision-making with precise physical control.

entry.title: MaTe: Images Are All You Need for Material Transfer via Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Nisha Huang, Henglin Liu, Yizhou Lin, Kaer Huang, Chubin Chen, Jie Guo, Tong-Yee Lee, Xiu Li

entry.summary: Proposes MaTe, a streamlined diffusion framework for material transfer that eliminates textual guidance and reference networks by integrating input images at the token level with multi-modal attention in a shared latent space. Achieves zero-shot, training-free material generation.

entry.title: Learning Dynamic Pick-and-Place for a Legged Manipulator

author.name: Moonkyu Jung, Jiseong Lee, Zhengmao He, Donghoon Youm, Juhyeok Mun, HyeongJun Kim, Hyunsik Oh, Donghyuk Choi, Jungwoo Hur, Jie Song, Jemin Hwangbo

entry.summary: Presents a hierarchical RL framework for dynamic pick-and-place tasks using a quadruped with a 6-DOF arm. Incorporates mass estimation for adaptive whole-body control with payloads up to 2.3 kg, validated in real-world experiments.

entry.title: Can We Trust AI-Inferred User States. A Psychometric Framework for Validating the Reliability of Users States Classification by LLMs in Operational Environments

author.name: Izabella Krzeminska, Michal Butkiewicz, Ewa Komkowska

entry.summary: Empirically tests the psychometric reliability of AI-inferred user states from multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o audio, Gemini 2.0/2.5 Flash). Distinguishes metrics useful for real-time adaptation from those only reliable in aggregated analysis.

entry.title: Hierarchical and Holistic Open-Vocabulary Functional 3D Scene Graphs for Indoor Spaces

author.name: Xinggang Hu, Chenyangguang Zhang, Alexandros Delitzas, Xiangkui Zhang, Marc Pollefeys, Francis Engelmann, Xiangyang Ji

entry.summary: Extends functional 3D scene graph benchmarks with dense tabletop objects and multi-level functional relationships. Proposes a hierarchical pipeline addressing challenges of small-scale dense instances and cross-frame fusion confusion.

entry.title: Access Timing as Scaffolding: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to GenAI in Education

author.name: Janne Rotter, Pau Benazet i Montobbio, Davinia Hern\'andez-Leo

entry.summary: Uses reinforcement learning to determine optimal timing for student access to GenAI tools as implicit scaffolding, with rewards grounded in metacognitive theory and cognitive load theory. Lab study with N=105 shows timing-based access improves learning outcomes.

entry.title: Complexity of Non-Log-Concave Sampling in Fisher Information

author.name: Sinho Chewi and Andre Wibisono

entry.summary: Studies query complexity of sampling from log-smooth non-log-concave distributions with Fisher information guarantees, using the proximal sampler with restricted Gaussian oracle. Shows complexity inherits dimension dependence of log-concave sampling.

entry.title: SOLAR: Self-supervised Joint Learning for Symmetric Multimodal Retrieval

author.name: Wenjie Yang, Hang Yu, Yuyu Guo, Peng Di

entry.summary: Proposes SOLAR, a two-stage self-supervised framework for symmetric multimodal-to-multimodal retrieval using unlabeled web-scale image-text pairs, learning intersection masks to align shared semantics while preserving modality-specific differences.

entry.title: LoCO: Low-rank Compositional Rotation Fine-tuning

author.name: An Nguyen and Jaesik Choi and Anh Tong

entry.summary: Proposes LoCO, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that constructs orthogonal transformations through low-rank skew-symmetric matrices and compositional rotation chains, preserving geometric structure of pretrained representations.

entry.title: Unsupervised Domain Shift Detection with Interpretable Subspace Attribution

author.name: Sebastian Springer and Alessandro Laio

entry.summary: Develops an unsupervised method for detecting domain shifts by finding localized density anomalies in high-dimensional feature spaces and attributing them to specific feature subspaces, making shifts interpretable and compensatable.

entry.title: Dynamic Plasma Shape Control with Arbitrary Sensor Subsets

author.name: D. Sorokin, M. Stokolesov, A. Granovskiy, I. Prokofyev, E. Adishchev, M. Nurgaliev, E. Khayrutdinov, G. Subbotin, R. Clark, D. Orlov

entry.summary: Presents a reinforcement learning agent for dynamic plasma shape control in tokamaks that handles both dynamic shape target changes and diagnostic sensor failures. Trained in high-fidelity simulator, zero-shot tracks dynamic shape sequences.

entry.title: FocalPolicy: Frequency-Optimized Chunking and Locally Anchored Flow Matching for Coherent Visuomotor Policy

author.name: Qian He, Zhenshuo Yang, Wenqi Liang, Chunhui Hao, Nicu Sebe, Jiandong Tian

entry.summary: Proposes FocalPolicy for visuomotor control that combines frequency-optimized chunking with locally anchored flow matching to achieve coherent long-horizon actions, addressing inter-chunk discontinuities in existing approaches.

entry.title: Can Vision Language Models Be Adaptive in Mathematics Education? A Learner Model-based Rubric Study

author.name: Jie Gao, Yongan Yu, Junzhu Su, Yiran Lin, Adam K. Dube, Jackie Chi Kit Cheung

entry.summary: Evaluates whether Vision Language Models can adapt to different learner profiles in mathematics education, drawing on adaptive learning theory. Introduces a learner model-based rubric evaluation framework for VLM adaptivity in tutoring.

entry.title: XSearch: Explainable Code Search via Concept-to-Code Alignment

author.name: Yiming Liu, Ruofan Liu, Yun Lin, Zicong Zhang, Weiyu Kong, Pengnian Qi, Xiao Cheng, Weinan Zhang, Qianxiang Wang, Linpeng Huang

entry.summary: Proposes XSearch, an explainable code search framework that decomposes queries and code into concept-level alignments rather than relying solely on global embedding similarity. Improves both explainability and generalization under distribution shift.

entry.title: Federated Imputation under Heterogeneous Feature Spaces

author.name: Imane Hocine, Chaimaa Medjadji, Sylvain Kubler, Gregoire Danoy, Yves Le Traon

entry.summary: Proposes FedHF-Impute, a federated imputation framework for heterogeneous feature spaces that uses a shared global feature graph with message passing to propagate information across clients with partially overlapping features.

entry.title: SGR: A Stepwise Reasoning Framework for LLMs with External Subgraph Generation

author.name: Xin Zhang, Yang Cao, Baoxing Wu, Kai Song, Siying Li

entry.summary: Proposes SGR, a stepwise reasoning framework that enhances LLM reasoning by building query-specific subgraphs from external knowledge bases and grounding intermediate steps in structured knowledge.

entry.title: Res$^2$CLIP: Few-Shot Generalist Anomaly Detection with Residual-to-Residual Alignment

author.name: Xinyue Liu, Jianyuan Wang, Biao Leng, Shuo Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Res²CLIP for few-shot generalist anomaly detection by shifting multimodal alignment into a unified residual space. This addresses cross-granularity mismatch between text prompts and visual features, and prevents domain shift that disrupts CLIP's open-world generalization.

entry.title: Context, Reasoning, and Hierarchy: A Cost-Performance Study of Compound LLM Agent Design in an Adversarial POMDP

author.name: Igor Bogdanov, Chung-Horng Lung, Thomas Kunz, Jie Gao, Adrian Taylor, Marzia Zaman

entry.summary: Presents a controlled study of compound LLM agent design choices in CybORG CAGE-2 cyber defense POMDP, evaluating context representation, reasoning approaches, and task decomposition across 5 model families and 12 configurations with token-level cost accounting.

entry.title: Dynamics-Level Watermarking of Flow Matching Models with Random Codes

author.name: Shuchan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces dynamics-level watermarking for flow matching generative models by embedding watermarks directly into the learned velocity field rather than weights or outputs. Uses random coding over a continuous channel with key-dependent perturbations that leave the generated distribution unchanged.

entry.title: AgentStop: Terminating Local AI Agents Early to Save Energy in Consumer Devices

author.name: Dzung Pham, Kleomenis Katevas, Ali Shahin Shamsabadi, Hamed Haddadi

entry.summary: Investigates energy overhead of locally deployed LLM agents and proposes AgentStop, early termination strategies to save energy on consumer devices when tasks are unlikely to succeed.

entry.title: OgBench: A Framework for Evaluating Graph Neural Networks on Omics Data

author.name: Louisa Cornelis, Johan Mathe, Louis Van Langendonck, Guillermo Bern\'ardez, Nina Miolane

entry.summary: Introduces OgBench, the first GNN benchmarking platform for the low-sample, high-node regime characteristic of omics data, providing standardized infrastructure for graph-level prediction on biological datasets.

entry.title: CTF4Nuclear: Common Task Framework for Nuclear Fission and Fusion Models

author.name: Stefano Riva, Carolina Introini, Antonio Cammi, Dean Price, Alexey Yermakov, Yue Zhao, Philippe M. Wyder, Judah Goldfeder, Jan Williams, Amy Sara Rude, Matteo Tomasetto, Joe Germany, Joseph Bakarji, Georg Maierhofer, Miles Cranmer, J. Nathan Kutz

entry.summary: Proposes conditional multi-view ancestral sampling (cMAS) for unsupervised 3D human pose estimation from a single view, leveraging 2D diffusion priors from motion diffusion models without 3D supervision.

entry.title: MI-CXR: A Benchmark for Longitudinal Reasoning over Multi-Interval Chest X-rays

author.name: Sunghwan Steve Cho, Yunseok Han, and Jaeyoung Do

entry.summary: Introduces MI-CXR, a benchmark for longitudinal reasoning over multi-visit chest X-ray sequences with five-way MCQ over five-visit timelines, evaluating temporal event localization, change reasoning, and trajectory summarization.

entry.title: Unsupervised 3D Human Pose Estimation via Conditional Multi-view Ancestral Sampling

author.name: Ryohei Goto, Takuya Fujihashi, Shunsuke Saruwatari, Fumio Okura

entry.summary: Proposes conditional multi-view ancestral sampling for unsupervised 3D human pose estimation leveraging 2D motion diffusion model priors, achieving cross-domain performance without 3D supervision.

entry.title: Testing properties of trees in graphical models with covariance queries

author.name: Sofiya Burova and Francisco Calvillo and G\'abor Lugosi and Piotr Zwiernik

entry.summary: Studies testing structural properties of trees in graphical models using covariance queries. Shows that global properties like number of leaves, maximum degree, and diameter can be tested with sub-quadratic queries, even when full tree reconstruction is expensive.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Imitate Human Speech for Clinical Assessment? LLM-Driven Data Augmentation for Cognitive Score Prediction

author.name: Si-Belkacem Yamine Ketir, Lenard Paulo Tamayo, Shohei Hisada, Shaowen Peng, Shoko Wakamiya, Eiji Aramaki

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-driven data augmentation for cognitive score prediction from speech, using GPT-5 to generate oral-like monologues from written responses as semantic anchors. Tested on Japanese cognitive assessment data.

entry.title: MAgSeg: Segmentation of Agricultural Landscapes in High-Resolution Satellite Imagery using Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Piyush Tiwary, Utkarsh Ahuja, Depanshu Sani, Aishwarya Jayagopal, Sagar Gubbi, Subhashini Venugopalan, Alok Talekar, Vaibhav Rajan

entry.summary: Presents MAgSeg, a decoder-free approach using Multimodal LLMs for agricultural landscape segmentation from high-resolution satellite imagery. Addresses context length bottlenecks and domain alignment gaps specific to satellite features in Global South smallholder farming environments.

entry.title: Robust Prior-Guided Segmentation for Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Raushan Joshi, Jean-Yves Guillemaut

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting segmentation that uses SAM-HQ for accurate 2D masks and a prior-guided label reassignment method for multiview-consistent 3D segmentation, enabling editing tasks like object removal and recoloring.

entry.title: Kalman Filtering on Cell Complexes

author.name: Chengen Liu, Rohan Money, Ting Gao, Mohammad Sabbaqi, Baltasar Beferull-Lozano, Elvin Isufi

entry.summary: Proposes topology-aware Kalman filtering on cell complexes for inferring latent dynamics from multivariate time-series defined over topological structures. Derives state evolution from heat-like topological diffusion with perturbations propagating along boundary operators.

entry.title: KG-HTC: Integrating Knowledge Graphs into LLMs for Effective Zero-shot Hierarchical Text Classification

author.name: Qianbo Zang, Christophe Zgrzendek, Igor Tchappi, Afshin Khadangi and Johannes Sedlmeir

entry.summary: Presents KG-HTC, a method integrating knowledge graphs with LLMs via RAG for zero-shot hierarchical text classification, addressing challenges of large label spaces and annotation scarcity.

entry.title: SDOF: Taming the Alignment Tax in Multi-Agent Orchestration with State-Constrained Dispatch

author.name: Zhantao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SDOF, a framework treating multi-agent LLM execution as a constrained state machine with intent routing trained via GRPO and finite-automaton dispatch, evaluated on a real recruitment platform.

entry.title: Hardware-Software Co-Design of Scalable, Energy-Efficient Analog Recurrent Computations

author.name: Arthur Fyon, Julien Brandoit, Loris Mendolia, Damien Ernst, Jean-Michel Redout\'e, Guillaume Drion

entry.summary: Presents a hardware-software co-design for analog recurrent neural networks using Bistable Memory Recurrent Units, achieving sub-microwatt inference for always-on AI applications.

entry.title: Logical Grammar Induction via Graph Kolmogorov Complexity: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Self-Healing Clinical Data Integrity

author.name: Abolfazl Zarghani, Amir Malekesfandiari

entry.summary: Introduces Logic-GNN, a neuro-symbolic framework detecting clinical data entry errors by treating records as a structured language, using temporal graph networks and graph Kolmogorov complexity to identify 'grammatical violations'.

entry.title: ReactiveGWM: Steering NPC in Reactive Game World Models

author.name: Zeqing Wang, Danze Chen, Zhaohu Xing, Zizhao Tong, Yinhan Zhang, Xingyi Yang, Yeying Jin

entry.summary: Introduces ReactiveGWM, a game world model that explicitly decouples player controls from NPC behaviors to model dynamic player-NPC interactions rather than treating NPCs as background pixels.

entry.title: Fluency and Faithfulness in Human and Machine Literary Translation

author.name: Sarah Griebel, Ted Underwood

entry.summary: Examines the relationship between fluency and faithfulness in literary translation across human, Google Translate, and TranslateGemma using 130K translated paragraphs, finding a consistent negative correlation.

entry.title: How Data Augmentation Shapes Neural Representations

author.name: Tianxiao He, Alex H. Williams, Sarah E. Harvey

entry.summary: Characterizes how different data augmentation strategies reshape internal neural network representations using shape analysis tools, showing augmentation strength creates well-behaved trajectories in representation space.

entry.title: Stochastic Compositional Optimization via Hybrid Momentum Frank--Wolfe

author.name: El Mahdi Chayti

entry.summary: Proposes a Frank-Wolfe algorithm for stochastic compositional optimization that drops the smoothness assumption on the outer function, enabling applications like robust max-of-losses, CVaR, and norm regularizers.

entry.title: Federated Learning of Spiking Neural Networks under Heterogeneous Temporal Resolutions

author.name: Sanja Karilanova, Subhrakanti Dey, Ay\c{c}a \"Oz\c{c}elikkale

entry.summary: Proposes a federated learning framework for spiking neural networks that handles heterogeneous temporal resolutions across edge devices through resolution-aware aggregation.

entry.title: Representation Without Reward: A JEPA Audit for LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Biswa Sengupta

entry.summary: Tests JEPA principles for LLM fine-tuning by comparing 22 training-time auxiliaries on natural-language-to-regex generation with Llama-3.2-1B, finding structured but nuanced results about when latent prediction helps.

entry.title: Differentially Private Motif-Preserving Multi-modal Hashing

author.name: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai and Jiahao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes DMP-MH, a differentially private motif-preserving multi-modal hashing framework that addresses the Hubness Explosion problem in privacy-preserving cross-modal retrieval with graph-structured data.

entry.title: AnyAct: Towards Human Reenactment of Character Motion From Video

author.name: Liuhan Chen and Lei Zhong and Jiewei Wang and Qin Shuai and Li Yuan and Leidong Fan and Qing Li and Kanglin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes AnyAct for deriving human reenactment from monocular video of non-human characters by leveraging sparse local articulated motion cues as a bridge across structural differences.

entry.title: Terrain Consistent Reference-Guided RL for Humanoid Navigation Autonomy

author.name: William D. Compton, Zachary Olkin, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Trains reference-guided RL locomotion policies for humanoid robots where reference trajectories are modulated to be terrain-consistent, exposing a clean SE(2) velocity interface compatible with standard navigation planners.

entry.title: DRS-GUI: Dynamic Region Search for Training-Free GUI Grounding

author.name: Yichao Liu, Huawen Shen, Liu Yu, Shiyu Liu, Zeyu Chen, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes DRS-GUI, a training-free dynamic region search framework for GUI grounding using human-inspired perceptual actions (Focus, Shift, Scatter) to progressively explore interfaces and generate region proposals.

entry.title: KaRMA: A Kinematic Metric for Fine Manipulation Ability in Robotic Hands

author.name: Martin Peticco and Pulkit Agrawal

entry.summary: Introduces KaRMA, a kinematic metric for robotic hand fine manipulation that quantifies reachable in-hand translation and reorientation of objects through feasible rolling motions under physical constraints.

entry.title: Characterizing Learning in Deep Neural Networks using Tractable Algorithmic Complexity Analysis

author.name: Pedram Bakhtiarifard, Sophia N. Wilson, Mahmoud Afifi, Jonathan Wensh{\o}j, Raghavendra Selvan

entry.summary: Introduces QuBD (Quantized Block Decomposition), extending algorithmic complexity estimation to k-ary objects for characterizing learning dynamics in deep neural networks through compression lens.

entry.title: GiLT: Augmenting Transformer Language Models with Dependency Graphs

author.name: Tianyu Huang, Yida Zhao, Chuyan Zhou, Kewei Tu

entry.summary: Proposes GiLT, which augments Transformer language models with dependency graph information by modulating attention weights using features extracted from incrementally constructed dependency graphs.

entry.title: Position: Artificial Intelligence Needs Meta Intelligence -- the Case for Metacognitive AI

author.name: Sergei Chuprov, Richard D. Lange, Leon Reznik, Paulo Shakarian, Raman Zatsarenko, Dmitrii Korobeinikov

entry.summary: Position paper arguing for metacognition as a general AI design principle - systems monitoring their own states and allocating resources based on problem difficulty, demonstrated in federated learning.

entry.title: STAR: A Stage-attributed Triage and Repair framework for RCA Agents in Microservices

author.name: Junle Wang, Xingchuang Liao, Wenjun Wu

entry.summary: Presents STAR, a framework for repairing erroneous LLM-based root cause analysis traces by decomposing RCA into four structured stages and treating failures as stage-localizable reasoning bugs.

entry.title: Evaluating Chinese Ambiguity Understanding in Large Language Models

author.name: Junwen Mo, Yuanzhi Lu, Yifang Xue, Ke Xu, Hideki Nakayama

entry.summary: Constructs CHA-Gen, the first Potential Ambiguity Theory-grounded Chinese ambiguity dataset with 5,712 sentences across 18 ambiguous structures. Evaluates multiple LLMs and finds they struggle with ambiguity detection, with analysis revealing three common failure modes.

entry.title: VCG-Bench: Towards A Unified Visual-Centric Benchmark for Structured Generation and Editing

author.name: Xiaoyan Su, Peijie Dong, Zhenheng Tang, Song Tang, Yuyao Zhai, Kaitao Lin, Liang Chen, Gai Yuhang, Yuyu Luo, Qiang Wang, Xiaowen Chu

entry.summary: Proposes VCG-Bench, a unified benchmark for visual-centric structured generation and editing using a Diagram-as-Code paradigm with mxGraph XML. Comprises 1,449 diverse diagrams spanning 6 domains for evaluating VLMs on structured diagram tasks.

entry.title: DreamSR: Towards Ultra-High-Resolution Image Super-Resolution via a Receptive-Field Enhanced Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Qingji Dong, Hang Dong, Mingqin Chen, Rui Zhang, Yitong Wang

entry.summary: Presents DreamSR, a diffusion-based super-resolution model that addresses over-generation in patch-wise inference through receptive-field enhancement. Targets ultra-high-resolution image super-resolution by suppressing local over-generation while improving texture detail.

entry.title: Tighter Regret Bounds for Contextual Action-Set Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zijun Chen, Zihan Zhang

entry.summary: Establishes tighter regret bounds for contextual action-set reinforcement learning where admissible actions vary by episode. Shows MVP algorithm extends naturally to this framework with minimax bound of Õ(√(SAH³K log L)) for adversarial contexts.

entry.title: GOMA: Toward Structure-Driven Multimodal Alignment from a Graph Signal Smoothing Perspective

author.name: Xu Wang, Xunkai Li, Yinlin Zhu, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GOMA for multimodal alignment on multimodal attributed graphs from a graph signal smoothing perspective. Addresses the challenge of different neighborhood geometries across modalities while controlling over-smoothing.

entry.title: CompactQE: Interpretable Translation Quality Estimation via Small Open-Weight LLMs

author.name: Kamil Guttmann, Zofia Fra\'s, Artur Nowakowski, Krzysztof Jassem

entry.summary: Demonstrates that smaller open-source LLMs (<30B parameters) can perform quality estimation for machine translation competitively with larger proprietary models, while simultaneously generating quality scores, error annotations, corrections, and post-editions. Achieves system-level correlations with human judgments that outperform traditional metrics and fine-tuned models.

entry.title: Not All Tasks Quantize Equally: Fisher-Guided Quantization for Visual Geometry Transformer

author.name: Yipu Zhang, Jintao Cheng, Weilun Feng, Jiehao Luo, Chuanguang Yang, Zhulin An, Yongjun Xu, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Fisher-guided quantization for Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), observing that different geometric tasks (depth, pose, point cloud) have varying sensitivity to quantization in shared backbone layers. Uses Fisher information to guide per-task quantization decisions.

entry.title: SLIP & ETHICS: Graduated Intervention for AI Emotional Companions

author.name: Minseo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes SLIP (graduated intervention protocol) and ETHICS (signals taxonomy) for AI emotional companions, addressing the safety-rapport paradox where restrictive safeguards damage supportive alliance while permissive systems risk harm.

entry.title: Petri Net Induced Heuristic Search for Resource Constrained Scheduling

author.name: Ido Lublin, Dor Atzmon, Izack Cohen

entry.summary: Formulates resource-constrained project scheduling as optimal search over Petri Net reachability graphs, solved with A* using consistent heuristics. Outperforms MIP baselines on PSPLIB benchmarks in success rate and solve time.

entry.title: Adaptive Outer-Loop Control of Quadrotors via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Vishnu Saj and Sushi Vemuri and Dileep Kalathil and Moble Benedict

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive outer-loop quadrotor controller using RL with a Residual Dynamics Predictor for online estimation of external forces. Introduces a data-efficient calibration bridge for sim-to-real transfer.

entry.title: Variational Autoregressive Networks with probability priors

author.name: Piotr Bia{\l}as, Piotr Korcyl, Tomasz Stebel, Dawid Zapolski

entry.summary: Proposes incorporating physical priors (spin-spin interactions and probability priors) into variational autoregressive networks for Monte Carlo sampling, addressing critical slowing down near phase transitions in physics simulations.

entry.title: Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack)

author.name: Jason Weitz, Dmitri Demler, Benjamin Hawks, Aaron Wang, Nhan Tran, Javier Duarte

entry.summary: Presents SNAC-Pack, an open-source framework for hardware-aware neural architecture search targeting FPGA deployment, using multi-objective search with hardware surrogate models for realistic cost estimation.

entry.title: SwAIther-Precip: Lead-Time-Aware Bias Correction Enables Kilometer-Scale Downscaling of Global AI Precipitation Forecasts over Switzerland

author.name: Dan Assouline, Erwan Koch, Federico Amato, Filippo Quarenghi, Daniele Nerini, Thibaut Loiseau, Kyle van de Langemheen and Tom Beucler

entry.summary: Introduces SwAIther-Precip, a lead-time-aware downscaling framework that converts coarse AI weather model forecasts into probabilistic kilometer-scale precipitation fields over Switzerland. Uses a U-Net conditioned on lead time to address state-dependent biases in global forecasts over complex terrain.

entry.title: Improving Cross-Cultural Survey Simulation with Calibrated Value Personas

author.name: Axel Abels, Elias Fernandez Domingos, Apurva Shah, Tom Lenaerts

entry.summary: Proposes value-based persona construction for LLM survey simulation that derives textual descriptors from survey responses capturing core cultural dimensions. Demonstrates improved cross-cultural opinion simulation over demographic-based prompting with a calibration procedure for response diversity.

entry.title: A Scalable Nonparametric Continuous-Time Survival Model through Numerical Quadrature

author.name: Chaeyeon Lee, Sehwan Kim, Hyungrok Do

entry.summary: Introduces QSurv, a scalable deep learning survival analysis framework using Gauss-Legendre quadrature for nonparametric continuous-time modeling without time discretization or distributional assumptions. Proposes time-conditioned low-rank adaptation for capturing non-stationary hazard dynamics.

entry.title: Leveraging heterogeneity for identifiability: Bayesian order-based learning of multiple DAGs

author.name: Hyunwoong Chang and Fariha Taskin

entry.summary: Proposes a joint order-based scoring framework for learning multiple DAGs from heterogeneous data, showing that leveraging heterogeneity improves causal ordering identification. Introduces an R2R proposal for efficient MCMC mixing over orderings with high-dimensional guarantees.

entry.title: Training-Free Multimodal Guidance for Video to Audio Generation

author.name: Eleonora Grassucci, Giuliano Galadini, Giordano Cicchetti, Aurelio Uncini, Fabio Antonacci, Danilo Comminiello

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free multimodal guidance mechanism for video-to-audio diffusion that uses volume spanned by modality embeddings to enforce alignment across video, audio, and text without additional training.

entry.title: Ensuring Logic in the Fog: Sound POMDP Synthesis with LTL Objectives

author.name: Can Zhou, Yulong Gao, Pian Yu

entry.summary: Presents a sound reward-shaping mechanism for POMDP synthesis with LTL objectives that generates belief-dependent rewards grounded in certified satisfaction, enabling agents to navigate partial observability.

entry.title: Do Biological Structural Guarantees Earn Their Complexity?

author.name: Bogdan Banu

entry.summary: Benchmarks biologically-inspired AI agent frameworks against simpler alternatives across 10M+ data points, testing whether structural guarantees from biological systems earn their implementation complexity.

entry.title: Privacy Evaluation of Generative Models for Trajectory Generation

author.name: Stavros Bouras, Ioannis Kontopoulos, Chiara Pugliese, Francesco Lettich, Emanuele Carlini, Hanna Kavalionak, Chiara Renso, Konstantinos Tserpes

entry.summary: Investigates privacy preservation of generative models for trajectory data, demonstrating that the assumption of inherent privacy in synthetic trajectories doesn't necessarily hold.

entry.title: Beyond Bounded Variance: Variance-Reduced Normalized Methods for Nonconvex Optimization under Blum-Gladyshev Noise

author.name: Antesh Upadhyay, Arda Fazla, Abolfazl Hashemi

entry.summary: Studies nonconvex stochastic optimization under Blum-Gladyshev noise (variance grows quadratically with distance from initialization) and proves convergence rates for normalized SGD with momentum and variance-reduced variants.

entry.title: Spectral Priors vs. Attention: Investigating the Utility of Attention Mechanisms in EEG-Based Diagnosis

author.name: Tawsik Jawad, Gowtham Atluri, and Vikram Ravindra

entry.summary: Shows that spectrally selective feature construction from EEG brainwave bands allows traditional ML models to match or exceed deep learning performance for neurodegenerative disease classification.

entry.title: DIPA: Distilled Preconditioned Algorithms for Solving Imaging Inverse Problems

author.name: Romario Gualdr\'on-Hurtado, Roman Jacome, Leon Suarez and Henry Arguello

entry.summary: Proposes DIPA, using distillation-guided preconditioning operators for imaging inverse problems to improve both convergence and reconstruction quality beyond traditional preconditioning.

entry.title: FINESSE-Bench: A Hierarchical Benchmark Suite for Financial Domain Knowledge and Technical Analysis in Large Language Models

author.name: Dmitry Stanishevskii, Nini Kamkia, Alexey Khoroshilov, Dmitry Zmitrovich, Denis Kokosinskii, Zhirayr Hayrapetyan, Andrei Kalmykov

entry.summary: Introduces FINESSE-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark for evaluating LLMs on financial domain knowledge with explicit professional difficulty levels, from foundational to expert-level reasoning.

entry.title: X-SYNTH: Beyond Retrieval -- Enterprise Context Synthesis from Observed Human Attention

author.name: Guruprasad Raghavan, George Nychis, Rohan Narayana Murthy

entry.summary: Presents X-SYNTH, a framework for enterprise context synthesis that goes beyond retrieval by learning from observed human attention patterns to surface relevant context for AI agent tasks.

entry.title: DiffVAS: Diffusion-Guided Visual Active Search in Partially Observable Environments

author.name: Anindya Sarkar, Srikumar Sastry, Aleksis Pirinen, Nathan Jacobs, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik

entry.summary: Proposes DiffVAS, a diffusion-guided visual active search method for partially observable environments that handles multiple target categories simultaneously without assuming full search space visibility.

entry.title: Domain-Independent Game Abstraction using Word Embedding Techniques

author.name: Juho Kim and Tuomas Sandholm

entry.summary: Proposes domain-independent game abstraction using word embedding techniques from NLP, treating actions as words and gameplay data as corpus to learn action representations for clustering-based abstraction.

entry.title: NavRL++: A System-Level Framework for Improving Sim-to-Real Transfer in Reinforcement Learning-Based Robot Navigation

author.name: Zhefan Xu, Hanyu Jin, Kenji Shimada

entry.summary: Introduces NavRL++, a complete training and deployment pipeline for RL-based robot navigation with systematic study of sim-to-real transfer factors including sensor noise, perception failures, and system latency.

entry.title: MHGraphBench: Knowledge Graph-Grounded Benchmarking of Mental Health Knowledge in Large Language Models

author.name: Weixin Liu, Congning Ni, Shelagh A. Mulvaney, Susannah L. Rose, Murat Kantarcioglu, Bradley A. Malin, and Zhijun Yin

entry.summary: Presents MHGraphBench, a knowledge-graph-grounded benchmark for assessing LLMs on mental health knowledge through entity recognition, relation judgment, and two-hop reasoning, revealing a persistent recognition-to-judgment gap.

entry.title: Efficient Image Synthesis with Sphere Latent Encoder

author.name: Tung Do, Thuan Hoang Nguyen, Hao Li

entry.summary: Proposes efficient few-step image generation by decoupling Sphere Encoder into a fixed pretrained encoder and separate latent denoising model, resolving computational inefficiency and objective conflicts.

entry.title: DealMaTe: Multi-Dimensional Material Transfer via Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Nisha Huang, Yizhou Lin, Jie Guo, Xiu Li, Tong-Yee Lee, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DealMaTe for material transfer using depth, normal, and lighting images with a lightweight 3D information injection method (Multi-Dim 3D Shader LoRA). Eliminates text guidance and reference networks while achieving harmonious results.

entry.title: Position: Early-Stage Quality Assurance in Annotation Pipelines Is More Cost-Effective Than Late-Stage Validation

author.name: Sunil Kothari, Sumukha Sharma Thoppanahalli Chandramouli, Naman Khandelwal, Parth Kulshreshtha, Ashi Jain, Kriti Banka, Tanuja Chintada, Venkata Triveni, Gulipalli Praveen Kumar, Manish Mehta, Tao Liu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing for early-stage quality assurance in ML annotation pipelines over late-stage validation, drawing on the 'shift-left' principle from software engineering where early defect detection has 4-100x cost advantage.

entry.title: Semi-MedRef: Semi-Supervised Medical Referring Image Segmentation with Cross-Modal Alignment

author.name: Yuchen Li, Zhen Zhao, Yi Liu, and Luping Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Semi-MedRef, a teacher-student semi-supervised framework for medical referring image segmentation that maintains cross-modal alignment under perturbations. Adapts CutMix for multi-modal settings while preserving image-text coherence.

entry.title: DecomPose: Disentangling Cross-Category Optimization Contention for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation

author.name: Yifan Gao, Lu Zou, Zhangjin Huang and Guoping Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DecomPose for category-level 6D pose estimation that addresses gradient conflicts from geometric heterogeneity across categories. Uses difficulty-aware gradient decoupling to route instances to group-specific branches.

entry.title: BiomedAP: A Vision-Informed Dual-Anchor Framework with Gated Cross-Modal Fusion for Robust Medical Vision-Language Adaptation

author.name: Huanyang Tong and Kai Liu and Fangjun Kuang and Huiling Chen

entry.summary: Proposes BiomedAP, a vision-informed dual-anchor framework for medical VLM adaptation that addresses fragility to prompt variations through gated cross-modal fusion. Tackles the problem of unstable cross-modal alignment with noisy clinical descriptions.

entry.title: FashionChameleon: Towards Real-Time and Interactive Human-Garment Video Customization

author.name: Quanjian Song, Yefeng Shen, Mengting Chen, Hao Sun, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: Presents FashionChameleon, a real-time interactive framework for human-garment video customization in autoregressive video generation, enabling users to switch garments during generation while maintaining motion coherence using only single-garment training data.

entry.title: Conversations in Space: Structuring Non-Linear LLM Interactions on a Canvas

author.name: Rifat Mehreen Amin, Alperen Adatepe, Daniela Fernandes, Daniel Buschek, Andreas Butz

entry.summary: Presents CanvasConvo, a conversational interface that transforms linear LLM chat into a branching conversation tree on a spatial canvas, enabling exploration of what-if scenarios and parallel development of alternative directions.

entry.title: CHoE: Cross-Domain Heterogeneous Graph Prompt Learning via Structure-Conditioned Experts

author.name: Peiyuan Li, Yongqi Huang, Jitao Zhao, Dongxiao He, Di Jin, Weixiong Zhang

entry.summary: Develops CHoE, a cross-domain heterogeneous graph prompt learning method using structure-conditioned experts, addressing the limitation that existing methods degrade when pre-training and downstream data come from different distributions.

entry.title: A Causally Grounded Taxonomy for Image Degradation Robustness Evaluation

author.name: Stefan Becker and Simon Weiss and Wolfgang H\"ubner and Michael Arens

entry.summary: Proposes a causally grounded framework for organizing image degradations across different research communities (corruption benchmarks, image quality assessment, imaging systems analysis), providing unified taxonomy without introducing new degradations.

entry.title: AdaEraser: Training-Free Object Removal via Adaptive Attention Suppression

author.name: Dingming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes AdaEraser, a training-free object removal method that adaptively modulates attention suppression based on estimated presence of target object concepts, rather than indiscriminate blocking of attention to object regions.

entry.title: CitePrism: Human-in-the-Loop AI for Citation Auditing and Editorial Integrity

author.name: Gowrika Mahesh, Budanur Madappa Darshan Gowda, Kavana Gopladevarahalli Papegowda, Prajwal Basavaraj, Binh Vu, Swati Chandna, and Mehrdad Jalali

entry.summary: Presents CitePrism, a hybrid human-in-the-loop framework for editorial citation auditing combining LLM reasoning, semantic similarity, metadata verification, and integrity flags. Aims to scale manuscript-level citation quality assessment.

entry.title: GeoGS-CE: Learning Delay--Beam Channel Priors with 3D Gaussians for High-Mobility Scenarios

author.name: Yumeng Zhang and Jiajia Guo and Chaozheng Wen and Chenghong Bian and Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GeoGS-CE, a channel estimation framework for high-mobility wireless scenarios using 3D Gaussian Splatting to model delay-beam power spectra and environment geometry for sparse-pilot channel estimation.

entry.title: Imitation learning for clinical decision support in pediatric ECMO

author.name: Fateme Golivand, Michael Skinner, Saurabh Mathur, Ameet Soni, Phillip Reeder, Kristian Kersting, Lakshmi Raman, Sriraam Natarajan

entry.summary: Applies imitation learning to pediatric ECMO clinical decision support, framing it as learning action models from observational data where actions aren't directly observed. Finds TabPFN (transformer for tabular data) consistently outperforms XGBoost and MLPs on real-world pediatric ECMO data.

entry.title: Designing Datacenter Power Delivery Hierarchies for the AI Era

author.name: Grant Wilkins, Fiodar Kazhamiaka, Alok Gautam Kumbhare, Chaojie Zhang, Ricardo Bianchini

entry.summary: Analyzes datacenter power delivery hierarchy design for the AI era, addressing how to avoid stranding power capacity as rack densities approach 1MW. Examines electrical topology, deployment granularity, and placement policies for long datacenter lifetimes across multiple hardware generations.

entry.title: Semi-Modular Inference: enhanced learning in multi-modular models by tempering the influence of components

author.name: Chris U. Carmona and Geoff K. Nicholls

entry.summary: Develops Semi-Modular Inference (SMI), a family of Bayesian inference schemes indexed by an influence parameter that includes standard Bayesian inference and Cut-models as special cases. Provides a meta-learning criterion to choose the optimal inference scheme, returning to Bayesian inference when there's no misspecification.

entry.title: Node-private community estimation in stochastic block models: Tractable algorithms and lower bounds

author.name: Laurentiu Marchis, Ethan D'souza, Tom\'a\v{s} Fl\'idr, Po-Ling Loh

entry.summary: Studies community recovery in stochastic block models under node differential privacy constraints. Develops multiple approaches including private spectral clustering, private PCA, and private low-rank estimation, establishing how privacy cost scales with the problem.

entry.title: CMOS Implementation of Field Programmable Spiking Neural Network for Hardware Reservoir Computing

author.name: Ckristian Duran, Nanako Kimura, Zolboo Byambadorj, and Tetsuya Iizuka

entry.summary: Presents a CMOS field-programmable spiking neural network architecture for hardware reservoir computing, achieving sub-microwatt power with programmable connectivity via on-chip FPGA.

entry.title: NIMO Controller: a self-driving laboratory orchestrator based on the Model Context Protocol

author.name: Naruki Yoshikawa and Ryo Tamura

entry.summary: Proposes NIMO Controller, an SDL orchestrator based on Model Context Protocol that exposes self-driving laboratory functionalities through MCP servers for AI agent integration with visual programming.

entry.title: Mask-Morph Graph U-Net: A Generalisable Mesh-Based Surrogate for Crashworthiness Field Prediction under Large Geometric Variation

author.name: Haoran Li, Tobias Lehrer, Yingxue Zhao, Haosu Zhou, Philipp Stocker, Tobias Pfaff, Nan Li

entry.summary: Presents Mask-Morph Graph U-Net for crashworthiness field prediction that generalizes across varying mesh topologies, addressing the fixed-connectivity limitation of hierarchical graph architectures.

entry.title: Sound Sparks Motion: Audio and Text Tuning for Video Editing

author.name: AmirHossein Naghi Razlighi, Aryan Mikaeili, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Daniel Cohen-Or, Yiorgos Chrysanthou

entry.summary: Introduces Sound Sparks Motion, a training-free framework for motion-centric video editing by tuning audio latents and text conditioning residuals in audio-visual generation models at test time.

entry.title: From Weight Perturbation to Feature Attribution for Explaining Fully Connected Neural Networks

author.name: Thodoris Lymperopoulos, Denia Kanellopoulou

entry.summary: Proposes a novel feature attribution method for neural networks by perturbing weights attached to features rather than feature values, creating XW attribution methods that mitigate biases common in occlusion-based approaches.

entry.title: Proposal-Guided Greedy Surrogate Refinement for PDE-Driven High-Dimensional Rare-Event Estimation

author.name: Zhiwei Gao, George Karniadakis

entry.summary: Proposes a surrogate-assisted adaptive importance sampling framework for PDE-driven rare-event estimation that refines the surrogate locally along the evolving proposal distribution rather than globally.

entry.title: Eskwai for Students: Generative AI Assistant for Legal Education in Ghana

author.name: George Boateng, Philemon Badu, Patrick Agyeman-Budu, Samuel Ansah, Evans Atompoya, Evan Igwilo, Lord Baah, Frederick Abu-Bonsrah and Victor Wumbor-Apin Kumbol

entry.summary: Develops Eskwai for Students, a RAG-based AI assistant for legal education in Ghana deployed for 30 months with 3.1K students making 32K queries, grounded in 12K case laws and 1.4K legislation.

entry.title: U-SEG: Uncertainty in SEGmentation -- A systematic multi-variable exploration

author.name: Michael Smith, Frank P. Ferrie

entry.summary: Systematically explores uncertainty estimation for segmentation across multiple variables including domains, datasets, architectures, and combination strategies to identify factors affecting uncertainty quality.

entry.title: MR2-ByteTrack: CNN and Transformer-based Video Object Detection for AI-augmented Embedded Vision Sensor Nodes

author.name: Luca Bompani, Manuele Rusci, Luca Benini, Daniele Palossi, Francesco Conti

entry.summary: Introduces MR2-ByteTrack, a video object detection method for MCU-based embedded vision that reduces compute by alternating full/low-resolution inference and linking detections across frames.

entry.title: LAPS: Improving Incremental LiDAR Mapping using Active Pooling and Sampling for Neural Distance Fields

author.name: Dongjae Lee, Wooseong Yang, Yifu Tao, Maurice Fallon, Ayoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes LAPS, a replay management framework for incremental neural distance field mapping that uses reliability-based active pooling and uncertainty-guided sampling to combat catastrophic forgetting in LiDAR mapping.

entry.title: Tuning-free Instruction-based Video Editing Via Structural Noise Initialization and Guidance

author.name: Song Wu, Xinyu Chen, Qian Wang, Liang Li, Zili Yi, and Junlan Feng

entry.summary: Proposes a tuning-free video editing framework using Structural Noise Initialization Strategy (assigning different noise levels to edited/unedited regions) and Noise Guidance Mechanism for instruction-based editing.

entry.title: 3DTMDet: A Dual-Path Synergy Network of Transformer and SSM for 3D Object Detection in Point Clouds

author.name: Bingwen Qiu, Yuan Liu, Junqi Bai, Tong Jiang, Ben Liang, Fangzhou Chen, Xiubao Sui, Qian Chen

entry.summary: Proposes 3DTMDet, combining Mamba (SSM) with Transformers for 3D object detection in point clouds, using SSM for global long-range interactions and local Transformer attention for geometric details.

entry.title: Text-RSIR: A Text-Guided Framework for Efficient Remote Sensing Image Transmission and Reconstruction

author.name: Hao Yang, Xianping Ma, Peifeng Ma and Man-On Pun

entry.summary: Proposes text-guided remote sensing image transmission that replaces full-resolution data with low-resolution images plus textual descriptions, reducing transmitted data to ~2% while enabling reconstruction.

entry.title: RoiMAM: Region-of-Interest Medical Attention Model for Efficient Vision-Language Understanding

author.name: Jiayan Yang, Zhuoyu Wu, Wenqi Fang

entry.summary: Introduces RoiMAM, an efficient VLM for medical VQA that uses training-free ROI generation and text prompt enhancement, achieving improved accuracy at less than 20% of baseline model size.

entry.title: Gaussian Relational Graph Transformer

author.name: Zezhong Ding, Jin Li, Xugang Wang, Xike Xie

entry.summary: Proposes GelGT, a Gaussian relational graph transformer that combines structure-semantic collaborative sampling with Gaussian graph attention for relational databases, addressing long-range dependency limitations.

entry.title: See Before You Code: Learning Visual Priors for Spatially Aware Educational Animation Generation

author.name: Yuejia Li, Ke He, Junheng Li, Shutong Chen, Jingkang Xia, Zhiyue Su, Junchi Zhang, and Mang Ye

entry.summary: Introduces OmniManim, a render-feedback-aware framework for educational animation generation that uses visual planning, structured post-render diagnostics, and localized repair to fix visual defects in LLM-generated animation code.

entry.title: TopoEvo: A Topology-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices

author.name: Junle Wang, Xingchuang Liao, Wenjun Wu

entry.summary: Introduces TopoEvo, a topology-aware multi-agent framework for root cause analysis in microservices that addresses symptom-amplification bias by coupling graph representation learning with topology-constrained reasoning. The system self-evolves its analysis capabilities over time.

entry.title: How to Choose Your Teacher for Fine Grained Image Recognition

author.name: Oswin Gosal, Edwin Arkel Rios, Augusto Christian Surya, Fernando Mikael, Bo-Cheng Lai, Min-Chun Hu

entry.summary: Introduces Ratio 1-2, a teacher selection metric for knowledge distillation in fine-grained image recognition based on teacher prediction ratios. Analysis of 1000+ experiments shows 18% improvement in teacher selection over previous methods.

entry.title: General-Purpose Co-Evolutionary Construction of Parallel Algorithm Portfolios for Multi-Objective Binary Optimization

author.name: Zhiyuan Wang, Shengcai Liu, Shaofeng Zhang, Ke Tang

entry.summary: Proposes DACMO for constructing parallel algorithm portfolios for multi-objective binary optimization. Features neural instance representation that decouples domain-invariant from instance-specific features and LLM-based automatic search operator generation.

entry.title: Structure Abstraction and Generalization in a Hippocampal-Entorhinal Inspired World Model

author.name: Tianqiu Zhang, Muyang Lyu, Xiao Liu, Si Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a brain-inspired hierarchical model for abstracting structures from continuous high-dimensional dynamics, inspired by hippocampal-entorhinal coupling. Demonstrates structural abstraction and generalization using primitive transformation dynamics.

entry.title: ForMaT: Dataset for Visually-Grounded Multilingual PDF Translation

author.name: Micha{\l} Ciesi\'o{\l}ka, Dawid Wi\'sniewski, Adrian Charkiewicz, Kamil Guttmann

entry.summary: Presents ForMaT, a parallel corpus of 3,956 PDFs across 15 language pairs preserving layout metadata for multimodal machine translation. Uses K-Medoids sampling over geometric features to ensure structural diversity.

entry.title: Toward Natural and Companionable Virtual Agents via Cross-Temporal Emotional Modeling

author.name: Feier Qin, Xiao Li, Yi Zheng, Haibin Huang, Hanyao Wang, Xiaoyu Wang, Yan Lu, Yuan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Cross-Temporal Emotion Modeling (CTEM) for virtual companion agents, establishing a closed loop where past experiences update an evolving emotional state that conditions immediate interactions. Aims to create more natural long-term companion-like interactions.

entry.title: Generative Long-term User Interest Modeling for Click-Through Rate Prediction

author.name: Jiangli Shao, Kaifu Zheng, Hao Fang, Huimu Ye, Zhiwei Liu, Bo Zhang, Shu Han, Xingxing Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a generative approach to long-term user interest modeling for CTR prediction that addresses limitations of target-centered retrieval, using generative modeling to capture latent user interests beyond those similar to the target item.

entry.title: Clock-state olfactory search in turbulent flows using Q-learning: The geometry of plume recovery

author.name: Marco Rando, Robin A. Heinonen, Yujia Qi, Agnese Seminara

entry.summary: Uses tabular Q-learning to train an olfactory search agent with minimal memory (just time since last odor detection) that learns interpretable strategies combining surging, casting, and downwind return behaviors observed in insects.

entry.title: Entropy-Based Characterisation of the Polarised Regime in Latent Variable Models

author.name: Peter Clapham, Lisa Bonheme, Marek Grzes

entry.summary: Proposes an information-theoretic classification of the polarised regime in VAEs based on entropy of the mean representation, generalizing beyond Gaussian priors. Shows theoretical connections between entropy and KL minimization while identifying limitations in distinguishing active from mixed dimensions.

entry.title: Learning Sim-Grounded Policies for Bimanual Rope Manipulation from Human Teleoperation Data

author.name: Gina Wigginghaus, Tim Missal, Berk Guler, Simon Manschitz, Jan Peters

entry.summary: Investigates whether the lack of generalization in egocentric visual policies for bimanual rope manipulation stems from the observation space. Compares visual policies with sim-grounded policies using tracked rope states from simulation.

entry.title: Beyond Collision Avoidance: Multi-Robot Yielding and Spatial Affordance in Emergency Evacuations

author.name: Ning Zhou, Edmund R. Hunt, Nikolai W.F. Bode

entry.summary: Studies multi-robot yielding strategies during emergency evacuations through a game-based virtual experiment (N=56). Establishes preference hierarchy for robot yielding behaviors and shows proactive space-yielding is preferred over reactive strategies.

entry.title: Skew-adaptive conformal prediction

author.name: Paulo C. Marques F. and Helton Graziadei

entry.summary: Proposes a skew-adaptive extension of split conformal prediction that produces prediction intervals adapting to both local scale and local skewness across the feature space. The method uses the inverse hyperbolic sine transform of signed scaled residuals to learn how predictive uncertainty should tilt, while preserving finite-sample marginal validity guarantees.

entry.title: Improving the Efficiency of Subgroup Analysis in Randomized Controlled Trials with TMLE

author.name: Sky Qiu, Nerissa Nance, Rachael Phillips, Jens Tarp, Maya Petersen, Mark van der Laan

entry.summary: Studies two TMLE estimators that borrow information from non-subgroup trial participants to improve subgroup analysis power. Demonstrates how trial-internal information sharing can augment underpowered subgroup estimates without external data.

entry.title: FRESH: Information-Geometric Calibration of Patient-Level Models to Aggregate Evidence

author.name: Franklin Fuller, Daniele Bertolini, Samantha Liang, Jason Christopher, and Aaron M. Smith

entry.summary: Introduces FRESH, a method for calibrating patient-level predictive models to match population-level aggregate statistics from clinical trials and registry data. Uses information-geometric projection to combine individual and aggregate evidence for clinical decision making.

entry.title: Can ELK be brute-forced? Intertheoretic reduction

author.name: Q Home

entry.summary: Proposes using intertheoretic reduction as an approach to brute-force the Eliciting Latent Knowledge (ELK) problem. Explores whether systematic mapping between different model representations could help extract knowledge that models have but don't report.

entry.title: A numerical study into neural network surrogate model performance for uncertainty propagation

author.name: Noah Wade and Kirubel Teferra

entry.summary: Studies neural network surrogate model performance for uncertainty propagation in physical modeling, specifically examining whether surrogates capture distribution tails rather than just mean solutions.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Human-Like Planning via LLMs

author.name: David Porfirio, Vincent Hsiao, Morgan Fine-Morris, Leslie Smith, and Laura M. Hiatt

entry.summary: Investigates using LLMs to generate human-like action sequences for robot task specification, combining natural language interfaces with drag-and-drop precision for end-user programming.

entry.title: Probabilistic Dating of Historical Manuscripts via Evidential Deep Regression on Visual Script Features

author.name: Ranjith Chodavarapu

entry.summary: Introduces evidential deep regression for dating historical manuscripts from visual features, achieving 5.4 years MAE with decomposed uncertainty estimates on medieval codices.

entry.title: On Kernel Eigen-alignments of KRR: Reconstruction and Generalization

author.name: Yang Liu, Ernest Fokoue, Richard Lange, Daniel Krutz

entry.summary: Establishes connections between generalization in kernel ridge regression and estimation stability of matrix eigenvalues/eigenvectors, providing finite-sample bounds with minimal assumptions.

entry.title: Position: Ideas Should be the Center of Machine Learning Research

author.name: Jairo Diaz-Rodriguez

entry.summary: Position paper arguing ML research should center on ideas and their behavioral signatures in models rather than benchmark climbing or disconnected theory, proposing an 'Ideas First' framework.

entry.title: Curriculum Learning of Physics-Informed Neural Networks based on Spatial Correlation

author.name: Xujia Chen, Xinyue Hu, Letian Chen, Daming Shi and Wenhui Fan

entry.summary: Proposes spatially correlated curriculum learning for Physics-Informed Neural Networks that addresses spatial information propagation and inter-region consistency in boundary value problems.

entry.title: Multimodal Object Detection Under Sparse Forest-Canopy Occlusion

author.name: Nitik Jain and Mangal Kothari

entry.summary: Presents a multimodal pipeline integrating LiDAR, visible-thermal image fusion, and airborne optical sectioning for detecting humans beneath forest canopy. Tests YOLOv5 on thermal and fused imagery.

entry.title: Adesua: Development and Feasibility Study of an AI WhatsApp Bot for Science Learning in West Africa

author.name: George Boateng, Evans Atompoya, Philemon Badu, Samuel John, Samuel Ansah, Patrick Agyeman-Budu and Victor Wumbor-Apin Kumbol

entry.summary: Presents Adesua, a WhatsApp-based AI teaching assistant for science education in West Africa that integrates textbooks and exam questions with generative AI for Q&A and automated assessment.

entry.title: Frequency-domain Event-based Imaging for Selective Surveillance

author.name: Megan Birch, James Rick, Adrish Kar, Jason Zutty, and Joseph L. Greene

entry.summary: Introduces FRIES, a neuromorphic processing framework for event-based cameras that detects periodicity in events to discriminate man-made objects for selective surveillance applications.

entry.title: Harnessing Unimodality in Semiparametric Contextual Pricing via Oracle Price Map Learning

author.name: Yingying Fan, Yuxuan Han, Jinchi Lv, Xiaocong Xu and Zhengyuan Zhou

entry.summary: Studies semiparametric contextual dynamic pricing with a scalar-index valuation model, proposing ORBIT, a coarse-to-fine policy that exploits unimodality of the revenue function for efficient pricing.

entry.title: Transformer Scalability Crisis: The First Comprehensive Empirical Analysis of Performance Walls in Modern Language Models

author.name: Mahdi Naser Moghadasi, Faezeh Ghaderi

entry.summary: Claims to present the first comprehensive empirical analysis of transformer scalability, evaluating 118 models across sequence lengths. Reports dramatic performance drops from 88.1% at 512 tokens to 0% at 2048 tokens.

entry.title: Neural Activation Patterns Across Language Model Architectures: A Comprehensive Analysis of Cognitive Task Performance

author.name: Mahdi Naser-Moghadasi, Faezeh Ghaderi

entry.summary: Analyzes neural activation patterns across six LLM architectures on twelve cognitive tasks, finding mathematical reasoning produces highest attention entropy and decoder models exhibit higher sparsity.

entry.title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Robot Teleoperation under Stochastic Delays

author.name: Kaize Deng, Zewen Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid control framework combining LSTM-based state estimation with residual reinforcement learning to handle stochastic communication delays in robot teleoperation, validated on Franka Panda.

entry.title: parallelcbf: A composable safety-filter and auditability framework for tensor-parallel reinforcement learning

author.name: Yijun Lu, Zilei Yang, Yuyin Ma

entry.summary: Introduces ParallelCBF, a framework unifying tensor-parallel UAV environments, control-barrier-function safety filters, sharded training pipelines, and operational auditability for safety-constrained RL training.

entry.title: Self-Prompting Diffusion Transformer for Open-Vocabulary Scene Text Editing via In-Context Learning

author.name: Hongxi Li, Tong Wang, Chengjing Wu, Tianbao Liu, Jiangtao Yao, Xiaochao Qu, Xinxiao Wu, Luoqi Liu, Ting Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a self-prompting scene text editing method using diffusion transformers that constructs style and glyph prompts directly from the original image without additional encoders, using a two-stage training strategy.

entry.title: RTL-BenchMT: Dynamic Maintenance of RTL Generation Benchmark Through Agent-Assisted Analysis and Revision

author.name: Jing Wang, Shang Liu, Hangan Zhou, Zhiyao Xie

entry.summary: Introduces RTL-BenchMT, an agentic framework for dynamically maintaining RTL generation benchmarks by automatically identifying/revising flawed cases and detecting/updating overfitting cases.

entry.title: When Latent Geometry Is Not Enough: Draft-Conditioned Latent Refinement for Non-Autoregressive Text Generation

author.name: De Shuai Zhang

entry.summary: Studies draft-conditioned latent refinement for non-autoregressive text generation, finding that good latent-space metrics don't guarantee good decoding and proposing controlled local refinement over full generation.

entry.title: TVRN: Invertible Neural Networks for Compression-Aware Temporal Video Rescaling

author.name: Xinmin Feng, Li Li, Dong Liu and Feng Wu

entry.summary: Proposes TVRN, an invertible neural network framework for compression-aware temporal video rescaling that regularizes high-frequency information loss during frame-rate downscaling.

entry.title: LDGuid: A Framework for Robust Change Detection via Latent Difference Guidance

author.name: Jiaxuan Zhao, Ali Bereyhi

entry.summary: Proposes LDGuid framework for change detection that explicitly learns and injects semantic differences via adversarial autoencoding with information bottleneck constraints.

entry.title: CM-EVS: Sparse Panoramic RGB-D-Pose Data for Complete Scene Coverage

author.name: Jiale Liu, Jungang Li, Jieming Yu, Xinglin Yu, Zihao Dongfang, Zongjian Ding, Kaifeng Ding, Yi Yang, Lidong Chen, Yang Zou, Shunwen Bai, Jiahuan Zhang, Haoran Huang, Shan Huang, Yudong Gao, Mingjun Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes COVER, a training-free viewpoint curation method for converting 3D assets into sparse panoramic RGB-D-pose data with complete scene coverage and low redundancy for 3D visual learning.

entry.title: Pretraining Objective Matters in Extreme Low-Data FGVC: A Backbone-Controlled Study

author.name: Alexander Hackett, Srikanth Thudumu, Ginny Fisher, Mahule Roy, Aisha Sartaj, Jason Fisher
