entry.summary: Introduces tensor similarity, a weight-based metric for comparing neural networks that is invariant to weight-space symmetries, capturing functional equivalence. Tracks training dynamics like grokking and backdoor insertion.

entry.title: Hidden State Poisoning Attacks against Mamba-based Language Models

author.name: Alexandre Le Mercier, Chris Develder, Thomas Demeester

entry.summary: Studies Hidden State Poisoning Attacks (HiSPA) against Mamba and SSM-based language models, showing that short input phrases can cause partial amnesia by irreversibly overwriting hidden states. Even Jamba-1.7-Mini hybrid model is vulnerable.

entry.title: ProtoMedAgent: Multimodal Clinical Interpretability via Privacy-Aware Agentic Workflows

author.name: Alvaro Lopez Pellicer, Plamen Angelov, Marwan Bukhari, Yi Li, Eduardo Soares, Jemma Kerns

entry.summary: Introduces ProtoMedAgent, a framework for clinical reporting that addresses 'retrieval sycophancy' in RAG by formalizing multimodal clinical reporting as iterative test-time optimization over a neuro-symbolic bottleneck. Operates on frozen prototype backbone with discrete semantic memory.

entry.title: Training-Free Generative Sampling via Moment-Matched Score Smoothing

author.name: Zhenyu Yao, Daniel Paulin

entry.summary: Proposes MM-SOLD, a training-free particle sampler for generative modeling that enforces target moments throughout sampling. Proves convergence in the large-particle limit to a Gibbs-Boltzmann density, offering an alternative to trained diffusion models.

entry.title: Large Dimensional Kernel Ridge Regression: Extending to Product Kernels

author.name: Yang Zhou, Yicheng Li, Yuqian Cheng, Qian Lin

entry.summary: Extends kernel ridge regression theory to product kernels in large dimensions, recovering saturation effects and multiple descent behavior previously known only for inner product kernels on spheres. Establishes convergence rates for a broader kernel family.

entry.title: SpeakerLLM: A Speaker-Specialized Audio-LLM for Speaker Understanding and Verification Reasoning

author.name: KiHyun Nam, Jungwoo Heo, Siu Bae, Ha-Jin Yu, Joon Son Chung

entry.summary: Presents SpeakerLLM, a speaker-specialized audio-LLM that unifies speaker verification, profiling, and reasoning. Aims to provide linguistic evidence alongside verification scores for user authorization and personalization in audio-first agents.

entry.title: Logging Policy Design for Off-Policy Evaluation

author.name: Connor Douglas, Joel Persson, Foster Provost

entry.summary: Studies logging policy design for off-policy evaluation, characterizing a reward-coverage tradeoff and proposing optimal policies in canonical informational regimes. Provides a unifying framework for minimizing OPE error.

entry.title: RefDecoder: Enhancing Visual Generation with Conditional Video Decoding

author.name: Xiang Fan, Yuheng Wang, Bohan Fang, Zhongzheng Ren, Ranjay Krishna

entry.summary: Introduces RefDecoder, a reference-conditioned video VAE decoder that injects high-fidelity reference image signals via reference attention to preserve detail and consistency in video generation, addressing the asymmetry between heavily conditioned denoisers and unconditional decoders.

entry.title: Mechanical Enforcement for LLM Governance:Evidence of Governance-Task Decoupling in Financial Decision Systems

author.name: Jos\'e Manuel de la Chica Rodr\'iguez, Carlos Mart\'i-Gonz\'alez

entry.summary: Introduces governance metrics for LLM compliance in financial systems, comparing text-only governance against mechanical enforcement primitives operating outside the model's interpretive loop. Finds 27% of deferrals under text-only governance carry no decision-relevant information, while mechanical enforcement achieves better compliance.

entry.title: From Scenes to Elements: Multi-Granularity Evidence Retrieval for Verifiable Multimodal RAG

author.name: Guanhua Chen, Chuyue Huang, Yutong Yao, Shudong Liu, Xueqing Song, Lidia S. Chao, Derek F. Wong

entry.summary: Introduces GranuVistaVQA benchmark and GranuRAG framework for multi-granularity evidence retrieval in multimodal RAG, treating visual elements as first-class retrieval units. Addresses the mismatch between coarse retrieval granularity and fine-grained queries.

entry.title: GraphBit: A Graph-based Agentic Framework for Non-Linear Agent Orchestration

author.name: Yeahia Sarker, Md Rahmat Ullah, Musa Molla, Shafiq Joty

entry.summary: Introduces GraphBit, an engine-orchestrated agentic framework using DAGs for deterministic workflow execution, contrasting with prompted orchestration. Uses a Rust-based engine for routing, state transitions, and tool invocation with a three-tier memory architecture.

entry.title: MemEye: A Visual-Centric Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Agent Memory

author.name: Minghao Guo, Qingyue Jiao, Zeru Shi, Yihao Quan, Boxuan Zhang, Danrui Li, Liwei Che, Wujiang Xu, Shilong Liu, Zirui Liu, Mubbasir Kapadia, Vladimir Pavlovic, Jiang Liu, Mengdi Wang, Yiyu Shi, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Ruixiang Tang

entry.summary: Introduces MemEye, a framework evaluating multimodal agent memory along two dimensions: granularity of visual evidence (scene to pixel level) and how evidence must be used (single to evolutionary synthesis). Addresses the gap where text-based traces suffice for current benchmarks.

entry.title: SToRe3D: Sparse Token Relevance in ViTs for Efficient Multi-View 3D Object Detection

author.name: Sandro Papais, Lezhou Feng, Charles Cossette, Lingting Ge

entry.summary: Introduces SToRe3D, a relevance-aligned sparsity framework for multi-view 3D object detection that jointly selects 2D image tokens and 3D object queries while preserving filtered features for reactivation. Achieves up to 3x faster inference with marginal accuracy loss on nuScenes.

entry.title: CoReDiT: Spatial Coherence-Guided Token Pruning and Reconstruction for Efficient Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Zhuojin Li, Hsin-Pai Cheng, Hong Cai, Shizhong Han, Fatih Porikli

entry.summary: Introduces CoReDiT, a structured token pruning framework for Diffusion Transformers that uses spatial coherence scores to identify redundant tokens and reconstructs them via coherence-guided aggregation. Features progressive, block-adaptive pruning schedules.

entry.title: A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words? An Empirical Study of Aggregation Strategies for Visual Financial Document Retrieval

author.name: Ho Hung Lim, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Studies single-vector aggregation of vision patch tokens for financial document retrieval in Visual RAG, finding that aggregation collapses different documents into nearly identical vectors when single-digit changes cause semantic shifts.

entry.title: ViMU: Benchmarking Video Metaphorical Understanding

author.name: Qi Li, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ViMU benchmark for video metaphorical understanding, evaluating whether models can grasp implicit meanings, emotions, and social messages conveyed through video beyond surface-level content.

entry.title: Beyond Instance-Level Self-Supervision in 3D Multi-Modal Medical Imaging

author.name: Tan Pan, Shuhao Mei, Yixuan Sun, Kaiyu Guo, Chen Jiang, Zhaorui Tan, Mengzhu Li, Limei Han, Xiang Zou, Yuan Cheng, Mahsa Baktashmotlagh

entry.summary: Proposes leveraging cross-instance topological consistency of anatomical structures as a supervisory signal for self-supervised pretraining in 3D multi-modal medical imaging, going beyond instance-level objectives.

entry.title: Probing into Camera Control of Video Models

author.name: Chen Hou, Christian Rupprecht

entry.summary: This paper reframes camera control in video generation models from an implicit mapping problem to geometric guidance that induces displacement fields, showing that strong video priors already encode camera-responsive behavior without requiring large paired camera-video datasets.

entry.title: MemLens: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Memory in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xiyu Ren, Zhaowei Wang, Yiming Du, Zhongwei Xie, Chi Liu, Xinlin Yang, Haoyue Feng, Wenjun Pan, Tianshi Zheng, Baixuan Xu, Zhengnan Li, Yangqiu Song, Ginny Wong, Simon See

entry.summary: MEMLENS introduces a comprehensive benchmark for multimodal long-term memory in vision-language models, comparing long-context LVLMs vs. memory-augmented agents across 789 questions spanning five memory abilities at four context lengths.

entry.title: RAVEN: Real-time Autoregressive Video Extrapolation with Consistency-model GRPO

author.name: Yanzuo Lu, Ronglai Zuo, Jiankang Deng

entry.summary: RAVEN introduces a training-time test framework for real-time autoregressive video extrapolation that addresses the history distribution mismatch between training and inference through interleaved rollout repacking and consistency-model GRPO.

entry.title: Meschers: Geometry Processing of Impossible Objects

author.name: Ana Dodik, Isabella Yu, Kartik Chandra, Jonathan Ragan-Kelley, Joshua Tenenbaum, Vincent Sitzmann, Justin Solomon

entry.summary: Meschers introduces a mesh representation for impossible objects (like Escher drawings) that avoids cutting or bending, enabling standard geometry processing operations on these paradoxical constructions.

entry.title: Darwin Family: MRI-Trust-Weighted Evolutionary Merging for Training-Free Scaling of Language-Model Reasoning

author.name: Taebong Kim, Youngsik Hong, Minsik Kim, Sunyoung Choi, Jaewon Jang, Junghoon Shin, Minseo Kim

entry.summary: Darwin Family proposes training-free evolutionary merging of LLMs through gradient-free weight-space recombination, introducing a 14-dimensional merge genome, MRI-Trust Fusion, and cross-architecture breeding to improve reasoning without additional training.

entry.title: Safety-Constrained Reinforcement Learning with Post-Training Reachability Verification for Robot Navigation

author.name: Qisong He, Xinmiao Huang, Jinwei Hu, Zhuoyun Li, Yi Dong, Changshun Wu, Xiaowei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a safe RL framework combining CVaR-constrained policy optimization on TD3 with post-training neural network reachability verification for robot navigation. Addresses the limitation of average-cost safety metrics that can mask dangerous tail-risk behaviors.

entry.title: SR-Platform: An Agentic Pipeline for Natural Language-Driven Robot Simulation Environment Synthesis

author.name: Ben Wei Lim, Minh Duc Le, Thang Truong, Thanh Nguyen Canh

entry.summary: Presents SR-Platform, an LLM-based agentic system that converts natural language descriptions into physically valid MuJoCo simulation environments. Decomposes scene synthesis into orchestration, asset generation, layout, and verification stages.

entry.title: Models finding software vulnerabilities is not the primary source of cybersecurity risk

author.name: lc

entry.summary: Argues that AI's primary cybersecurity risk is not finding new vulnerabilities but rather automating exploitation at scale—weaponizing recently patched exploits, automating social engineering, and enabling mass-scale attacks that were previously bottlenecked by human labor.

entry.title: MAP: A Map-then-Act Paradigm for Long-Horizon Interactive Agent Reasoning

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Ziang Ye, Yueqing Sun, Mingye Zhu, Jinwei Xiao, Zhuowen Han, Qi GU, Xunliang Cai, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: MAP proposes a Map-then-Act paradigm for LLM agents that shifts environment understanding before execution through global exploration and task-specific cognitive mapping, inspired by human affordance perception.

entry.title: Improving Code Translation with Syntax-Guided and Semantic-aware Preference Optimization

author.name: Yuhan Wu, Huan Zhang, Wei Cheng, Chen Shen, Jingyue Yang, Wei Hu

entry.summary: CTO improves code translation by training a cross-lingual semantic model through contrastive learning to assess functional equivalence between source and translated code, combined with syntax-guided preference optimization.

entry.title: Assessing the Creativity of Large Language Models: Testing, Limits, and New Frontiers

author.name: Samuel Schapiro, Alexi Gladstone, Jonah Black, Heng Ji

entry.summary: Conducts the first large-scale systematic study assessing whether human creativity tests validly measure LLM creative capabilities across divergent thinking, convergent thinking, and creative writing, finding limitations in test validity.

entry.title: MMSkills: Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents

author.name: Kangning Zhang, Shuai Shao, Qingyao Li, Jianghao Lin, Lingyue Fu, Shijian Wang, Wenxiang Jiao, Yuan Lu, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Yong Yu

entry.summary: MMSkills formalizes multimodal procedural knowledge for visual agents, defining what a multimodal skill package should contain, how to derive them from public interaction data, and how agents can consult multimodal evidence during execution.

entry.title: Beyond Individual Mimicry: Constructing Human-Like Social network with Graph-Augmented LLM Agents

author.name: Haoran Bu, Litian Zhang, Chuxuan Zhang, Zhanyuan Liu, Hui Pang, Xi Zhang

entry.summary: GraphMind equips LLM-driven social bots with graph-awareness to fit human-like social network structures, making botnets more resistant to GNN-based detection. Evaluates as a red-teaming tool for bot detection research.

entry.title: Visual Aesthetic Benchmark: Can Frontier Models Judge Beauty?

author.name: Yichen Feng, Yuetai Li, Chunjiang Liu, Yuanyuan Chen, Fengqing Jiang, Yue Huang, Hang Hua, Zhengqing Yuan, Kaiyuan Zheng, Luyao Niu, Bhaskar Ramasubramanian, Basel Alomair, Xiangliang Zhang, Misha Sra, Zichen Chen, Radha Poovendran, Zhangchen Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Aesthetic Benchmark (VAB) showing that score-based aesthetic evaluation poorly correlates with comparative preferences, and proposes comparative selection as the proper evaluation paradigm for MLLMs.

entry.title: What Do You Think I Think? Accounting for Human Beliefs Using Second-Order Theory of Mind

author.name: Patrick Callaghan, Reid Simmons, Henny Admoni

entry.summary: Develops a second-order Theory of Mind (ToM-2) using I-POMDPs enabling agents to model humans' erroneous beliefs about the agent and the cognitive biases from which they arise.

entry.title: EcoGEO: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Ecosystems for Web-Enabled LLM Search Agents

author.name: Hengwei Ye, Jiasheng Mao, Zhenhan Guan, Zheng Tian

entry.summary: Proposes EcoGEO, which treats Generative Engine Optimization as an environment-level influence problem for web-enabled LLM agents, considering how page organization and agent trajectories affect search outcomes.

entry.title: AdaFocus: Adaptive Relevance-Diversity Sampling with Zero-Cache Look-back for Efficient Long Video Understanding

author.name: Xiao Yang, Yingzhe Ma, Haoxuan Yu, Zixin Li, Ning Qin

entry.summary: Proposes AdaFocus for long video understanding with adaptive relevance-diversity sampling and zero-cache look-back, treating video understanding as progressive evidence acquisition rather than one-pass encoding.

entry.title: Context Training with Active Information Seeking

author.name: Zeyu Huang, Adhiguna Kuncoro, Qixuan Feng, Jiajun Shen, Lucio Dery, Arthur Szlam, Marc'Aurelio Ranzato

entry.summary: Equips LLM context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browser tools for active information seeking. Shows that naive tool addition degrades performance, but a search-based training procedure makes it effective for adapting LLMs without weight updates.

entry.title: LeanSearch v2: Global Premise Retrieval for Lean 4 Theorem Proving

author.name: Guoxiong Gao, Zeming Sun, Jiedong Jiang, Yutong Wang, Jingda Xu, Peihao Wu, Bryan Dai, Bin Dong

entry.summary: Presents LeanSearch v2, a two-mode retrieval system for global premise retrieval in Lean 4 theorem proving. Achieves state-of-the-art retrieval (nDCG@10 of 0.62) without domain-specific fine-tuning using a hierarchy-informalized Mathlib corpus.

entry.title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Weiqing Luo, Zongye Hu, Xiao Wang, Zhiyuan Yu, Haofeng Zhang, Ziyi Huang

entry.summary: Reformulates visual evidence selection for multimodal RAG from an information-theoretic perspective, defining evidence utility as information gain. Introduces a latent helpfulness variable and proves ranking equivalence.

entry.title: AttenA+: Rectifying Action Inequality in Robotic Foundation Models

author.name: Daojie Peng, Fulong Ma, Jiahang Cao, Qiang Zhang, Xupeng Xie, Jian Guo, Ping Luo, Andrew F. Luo, Boyu Zhou, Jun Ma

entry.summary: Proposes AttenA+ to address 'action inequality' in robotic foundation models where not all timesteps are equally informative. Challenges the temporal homogeneity assumption inherited from language modeling in VLA/WAM models.

entry.title: HodgeCover: Higher-Order Topological Coverage Drives Compression of Sparse Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Tao Zhong, Dongzhe Zheng, Christine Allen-Blanchette

entry.summary: Uses Hodge decomposition on simplicial complexes to identify irreducible cycles in expert mergeability for MoE compression, addressing a fundamental blind spot where pairwise-compatible experts form non-mergeable triples.

entry.title: Rethinking Layer Relevance in Large Language Models Beyond Cosine Similarity

author.name: Cristian Hinostroza, Rodrigo Toro Icarte, Christ Devia, Andres Carvallo De Ferari, Eugenio Herrera-Berg, Denis Parra, Jorge F Silva

entry.summary: Demonstrates theoretically and empirically that cosine similarity between layer representations is a poor proxy for layer importance in LLMs, showing layers can have low cosine similarity while being performance-critical and vice versa.

entry.title: MetaMoE: Diversity-Aware Proxy Selection for Privacy-Preserving Mixture-of-Experts Unification

author.name: Weisen Jiang, Shuhao Chen, Sinno Jialin Pan

entry.summary: Proposes MetaMoE, a privacy-preserving framework for unifying independently trained domain-specialized MoE experts using public proxy data instead of private training data. Uses diversity-aware proxy selection to approximate private distributions.

entry.title: Matrix-Space Reinforcement Learning for Reusing Local Transition Geometry

author.name: Zuyuan Zhang, Carlee Joe-Wong, Tian Lan

entry.summary: Introduces Matrix-Space RL (MSRL), representing trajectory segments as positive semidefinite matrix descriptors that capture local transition geometry. These descriptors enable algebraic composition in abstract matrix space for compositional transfer.

entry.title: Nearest-Neighbor Radii under Dependent Sampling

author.name: Yuanyuan Gao, Yilong Hou, Zhexiao Lin

entry.summary: Studies nearest-neighbor radii under dependent (mixing) sampling, establishing distribution-free convergence under polynomial mixing and sharp moment bounds under geometric mixing. Results depend on local intrinsic dimension rather than ambient dimension.

entry.title: Angel or Demon: Investigating the Plasticity Interventions' Impact on Backdoor Threats in Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Oubo Ma, Ruixiao Lin, Yang Dai, Jiahao Chen, Chunyi Zhou, Linkang Du, Shouling Ji

entry.summary: Systematically studies how plasticity interventions (14,664 cases) affect backdoor vulnerability in deep RL. Finds that only SAM exacerbates backdoor threats while other interventions mitigate them.

entry.title: Slower Generalization, Faster Memorization: A Sweet Spot in Algorithmic Learning

author.name: Shin So, Kyelim Lee, Albert No

entry.summary: Shows that in algorithmic learning (Needleman-Wunsch matrix generation), there exists a dataset-size sweet spot where generalization is fastest—contradicting the intuition that more data always accelerates learning.

entry.title: ReMIA: a Powerful and Efficient Alternative to Membership Inference Attacks against Synthetic Data Generators

author.name: Davide Scassola, Andrea Coser, Sebastiano Saccani

entry.summary: Introduces ReMIA, a practical privacy metric for synthetic data that requires only a single SDG training run, unlike state-of-the-art MIAs requiring hundreds of shadow model runs. Bridges the gap between powerful but impractical shadow-model MIAs and fast but insensitive proxy metrics.

entry.title: Composable Crystals: Controllable Materials Discovery via Concept Learning

author.name: Nian Liu, Yuwei Zeng, Ryoji Kubo, Nikita Kazeev, Stephen Gregory Dale, Artem Maevskiy, Pengru Huang, Thomas Laurent, Kostya S. Novoselov, Xavier Bresson

entry.summary: Proposes a concept-based compositional framework for crystal generation using VQ-VAE to discover reusable crystal concepts as building blocks. Concepts exhibit interpretability from local atomic environments and global symmetry patterns.

entry.title: Octopus: History-Free Gradient Orthogonalization for Continual Learning in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yuehao Liu, Shanyan Guan, Weijia Zhang, Xuanming Shang, Yanhao Ge, Wei Li, Chao Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Octopus, a continual learning framework for multimodal LLMs using History-Free Gradient Orthogonalization (HiFGO) that enforces gradient-level orthogonality without storing historical task data, addressing privacy and storage concerns.

entry.title: Distance-Matrix Wasserstein Statistics for Scalable Gromov--Wasserstein Learning

author.name: Ao Xu, Tieru Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Distance-Matrix Wasserstein (DMW), a scalable relaxation of Gromov-Wasserstein distance that compares distributions of random finite distance matrices instead of optimizing global point-level alignment. Proves DMW is a lower bound of GW with controlled approximation gap.

entry.title: An Interpretable Latency Model for Speculative Decoding in LLM Serving

author.name: Linghao Kong, Megan Flynn, Michael Peng, Nir Shavit, Mark Kurtz, Alexandre Marques

entry.summary: Develops an interpretable latency model for speculative decoding in LLM serving, using Little's Law to infer effective batch size and decomposing per-request demand into load-dependent/independent components.

entry.title: Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhengxi Lu, Zhiyuan Yao, Zhuowen Han, Zi-Han Wang, Jinyang Wu, Qi Gu, Xunliang Cai, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen

entry.summary: Introduces SDAR (Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning), combining on-policy self-distillation with RL for multi-turn LLM agents. Addresses compounding instability and asymmetric handling of negative teacher rejections.

entry.title: Wahkon: A Statistically Principled Deep RKHS Superposition Network

author.name: Yongkai Chen, Wenxuan Zhong, Ping Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Wahkon, a deep RKHS superposition network combining Kolmogorov's theorem with RKHS regularization, providing finite-sample guarantees and calibrated uncertainty for deep networks. Shows MAP estimator equals hierarchical GP prior.

entry.title: Analog RF Computing: A New Paradigm for Energy-Efficient Edge AI Over MU-MIMO Systems

author.name: Wentao Yu, Vincent W. S. Wong

entry.summary: Proposes analog RF computing where a base station broadcasts neural network weights via RF waveforms and clients use passive mixers for ultra-low-energy matrix-vector multiplications. A new paradigm for edge AI over MU-MIMO systems.

entry.title: BioHuman: Learning Biomechanical Human Representations from Video

author.name: Yujun Huo, He Zhang, Chentao Song, Honglin Song, Zongyu Zuo, Tao Yu

entry.summary: Introduces BioHuman, an end-to-end model predicting human motion and muscle activations from monocular video. Creates BioHuman10M, a large-scale dataset with synchronized video, motion, and muscle activation annotations via simulation.

entry.title: Average Gradient Outer Product in kernel regression provably recovers the central subspace for multi-index models

author.name: Libin Zhu, Damek Davis, Dmitriy Drusvyatskiy, Maryam Fazel

entry.summary: Proves that Average Gradient Outer Product (AGOP) from kernel ridge regression recovers the central subspace of multi-index polynomial functions. Provides sharp theoretical analysis for this appealingly simple algorithm.

entry.title: Hand-in-the-Loop: Improving Dexterous VLA via Seamless Interventional Correction

author.name: Zhuohang Li, Liqun Huang, Wei Xu, Zhengming Zhu, Nie Lin, Xiao Ma, Xinjun Sheng, Ruoshi Wen

entry.summary: Presents Hand-in-the-Loop (HandITL), a seamless human-in-the-loop intervention method for dexterous VLA models that blends human corrective intent with autonomous execution to avoid 'gesture jumps' during bimanual manipulation.

entry.title: AI Knows When It's Being Watched: Functional Strategic Action and Contextual Register Modulation in Large Language Models

author.name: Vinicius Covas, Jorge Alberto Hidalgo Toledo

entry.summary: Studies whether LLM multi-agent systems exhibit systematic linguistic adaptation based on perceived social observation contexts, drawing on Habermas's communicative action theory and the Hawthorne Effect. Tests 100 debate sessions across five social framing conditions.

entry.title: From Text to Voice: A Reproducible and Verifiable Framework for Evaluating Tool Calling LLM Agents

author.name: Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Xue-Yong Fu, Seyyed Saeed Sarfjoo, Quinten McNamara, Jonas Robertson, Shashi Bhushan TN

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for converting text-based tool-calling benchmarks into audio-based evaluations using TTS, speaker variation, and noise augmentation. Evaluates 7 omni-modal models showing performance is strongly model- and task-dependent for audio tool calling.

entry.title: Case-Based Calibration of Adaptive Reasoning and Execution for LLM Tool Use

author.name: Renning Pang, Tian Lan, Leyuan Liu, Piao Tong, Sheng Cao, Xiaosong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CAST, a case-based framework for LLM tool use that extracts complexity and failure profiles from historical execution trajectories to calibrate reasoning depth and structural validity. Translates case-derived signals into reward design for RL-based optimization.

entry.title: PVRF: All-in-one Adverse Weather Removal via Prior-modulated and Velocity-constrained Rectified Flow

author.name: Wei Dong, Han Zhou, Terry Ji, Guanhua Zhao, Shahab Asoodeh, Yulun Zhang, Guangtao Zhai, Jun Chen, Xiaohong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces PVRF, a unified adverse weather removal framework combining zero-shot vision-language model perceptions with velocity-constrained rectified flow refinement. Uses frozen VLMs to estimate weather types and attributes, conditioning restoration networks through specialized normalization and adapters.

entry.title: PanoPlane: Plane-Aware Panoramic Completion for Sparse-View Indoor 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Adil Qureshi, Dongki Jung, Jaehoon Choi, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: Presents PanoPlane, using 360° panoramic completion with plane-aware attention steering for sparse-view indoor 3D Gaussian Splatting. Introduces Layout Anchored Attention Steering to direct diffusion model attention toward detected planar surfaces for geometrically consistent completion.

entry.title: Delta Forcing: Trust Region Steering for Interactive Autoregressive Video Generation

author.name: Yuheng Wu, Xiangbo Gao, Tianhao Chen, Xinghao Chen, Qing Yin, Zhengzhong Tu, Dongman Lee

entry.summary: Introduces Delta Forcing, a trust region steering method for interactive autoregressive video generation that addresses conditional bias causing drift after condition changes. Constrains generation to stay within a trust region around the model's own trajectory.

entry.title: Analogical Trajectory Transfer

author.name: Junho Kim, Eun Sun Lee, Gwangtak Bae, Seunggu Kang, Young Min Kim

entry.summary: Studies analogical trajectory transfer - translating motion trajectories from one 3D environment to semantically analogous locations in another while preserving semantics, functionality, and avoiding collisions. Applicable to AR/VR and robotics.

entry.title: HASTE: Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration via Head-Wise Adaptive Sparse Attention

author.name: Xuzhe Zheng, Yuexiao Ma, Jing Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Rongrong Ji, Fei Chao

entry.summary: Introduces HASTE, a training-free video diffusion acceleration method using head-wise adaptive sparse attention. Proposes temporal mask reuse and head-specific thresholds to address the heterogeneity of attention heads in Video DiTs.

entry.title: Bridging Brain and Semantics: A Hierarchical Framework for Semantically Enhanced fMRI-to-Video Reconstruction

author.name: Yujie Wei, Chenglong Ma, Jianxiong Gao, Chenhui Wang, Shiwei Zhang, Biao Gong, Shuai Tan, Hangjie Yuan, Hongming Shan

entry.summary: Introduces CineNeuron for fMRI-to-video reconstruction using a hierarchical framework inspired by dual-pathway brain processing. Features bottom-up semantic enrichment from fMRI signals to capture video-specific cues like actions.

entry.title: CalibAnyView: Beyond Single-View Camera Calibration in the Wild

author.name: Boying Li, Cheng Zhang, Weirong Chen, Daniel Cremers, Ian Reid, Hamid Rezatofighi

entry.summary: Introduces CalibAnyView, a unified camera calibration method supporting arbitrary numbers of input views that explicitly models cross-view geometric consistency, trained on a large-scale multi-view video dataset.

entry.title: Breaking Dual Bottlenecks: Evolving Unified Multimodal Models into Self-Adaptive Interleaved Visual Reasoners

author.name: Qingyang Liu, Bingjie Gao, Canmiao Fu, Zhipeng Huang, Chen Li, Feng Wang, Shuochen Chang, Shaobo Wang, Yali Wang, Keming Ye, Jiangtong Li, Li Niu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for unified multimodal models that self-adaptively switches between generation strategies based on instruction complexity, addressing the 'understanding-generation gap' through interleaved visual reasoning.

entry.title: MechVerse: Evaluating Physical Motion Consistency in Video Generation Models

author.name: Rahul Jain, Mayank Patel, Asim Unmesh, Karthik Ramani

entry.summary: MechVerse introduces a benchmark for evaluating physical motion consistency in video generation models, focusing on articulated mechanical assemblies where kinematic and geometric constraints must be respected. Exposes failures in current models around rigid body constraints.

entry.title: Warp-as-History: Generalizable Camera-Controlled Video Generation from One Training Video

author.name: Yifan Wang, Tong He

entry.summary: Warp-as-History proposes a simple approach to camera-controlled video generation by turning camera-induced warps into pseudo-history frames, avoiding the need for camera encoders, control branches, or post-training on camera-annotated data.

entry.title: Quantitative Video World Model Evaluation for Geometric-Consistency

author.name: Jiaxin Wu, Yihao Pi, Yinling Zhang, Yuheng Li, Xueyan Zou

entry.summary: PDI-Bench introduces a quantitative framework for auditing geometric coherence in generated videos through projective-geometry residuals, measuring rigidity, flatness, and perspective consistency violations from 3D reconstructions.

entry.title: VGGT-Edit: Feed-forward Native 3D Scene Editing with Residual Field Prediction

author.name: Kaixin Zhu, Yiwen Tang, Yifan Yang, Renrui Zhang, Bohan Zeng, Ziyu Guo, Ruichuan An, Zhou Liu, Qizhi Chen, Delin Qu, Jaehong Yoon, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: VGGT-Edit extends the VGGT feed-forward 3D reconstruction model for native 3D scene editing through residual field prediction, avoiding the 2D-lifting strategy that causes blurry textures and inconsistent geometry.

entry.title: Aligning Latent Geometry for Spherical Flow Matching in Image Generation

author.name: Tuna Han Salih Meral, Kaan Oktay, Hidir Yesiltepe, Adil Kaan Akan, Pinar Yanardag

entry.summary: Proposes spherical flow matching for image generation by decomposing latent tokens into radial and angular components, showing that semantic content is carried predominantly by direction, and replacing linear with spherical linear interpolation.

entry.title: EntityBench: Towards Entity-Consistent Long-Range Multi-Shot Video Generation

author.name: Ruozhen He, Meng Wei, Ziyan Yang, Vicente Ordonez

entry.summary: EntityBench introduces a benchmark for entity-consistent multi-shot video generation with 140 episodes from real narrative media, tracking characters, objects, and locations across difficulty tiers up to 50 shots.

entry.title: DiffPhD: A Unified Differentiable Solver for Projective Heterogeneous Materials in Elastodynamics with Contact-Rich GPU-Acceleration

author.name: Shih-Yu Lai, Sung-Han Tien, Jui-I Huang, Yen-Chen Tseng, Yi-Ting Chiu, Siyuan Luo, Ziqiu Zeng, Fan Shi, Peter Yichen Chen, Tiantian Liu, Yu-Lun Liu, Bing-Yu Chen

entry.summary: Presents DiffPhD, a GPU-accelerated differentiable Projective Dynamics framework handling heterogeneous materials with extreme stiffness contrasts, hyperelasticity under large deformations, and contact-rich interactions. Key innovations include stiffness-aware projective weights and trust-region eigenvalue approaches.

entry.title: CHAL: Council of Hierarchical Agentic Language

author.name: Tommaso Giovannelli, Griffin D. Kent

entry.summary: CHAL presents a multi-agent dialectic framework that focuses on defeasible domains (where positions can be defeated by better reasoning) rather than ground-truth tasks. Argues that the real value of multi-agent debate lies in belief optimization for inherently uncertain questions.

entry.title: Discrete Diffusion for Complex and Congested Multi-Agent Path Finding with Sparse Social Attention

author.name: Yuanzhe Wang, Tian Zhi, Zihang Wei, Hongguang Wang, Jiaming Guo, Yang Zhao, Zisheng Liu, Shiyu Quan, Xing Hu, Zidong Du, Yunji Chen

entry.summary: DiffLNS combines discrete denoising diffusion probabilistic models with LNS2 for multi-agent path finding, using D3PM as an initializer with sparse social attention that learns coordinated multi-agent action trajectories from expert demonstrations.

entry.title: Position: Assistive Agents Need Accessibility Alignment

author.name: Jie Hu, Changyuan Yan, Yu Zheng, Ziqian Wang, Jiaming Zhang

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that assistive agents for blind and visually impaired users require 'accessibility alignment' as a first-class design objective, showing that current agentic AI systematically fails in assistive scenarios.

entry.title: Parallel-in-Time Training of Recurrent Neural Networks for Dynamical Systems Reconstruction

author.name: Florian Hess, Florian G\"otz, Daniel Durstewitz

entry.summary: Studies parallel-in-time training algorithms for recurrent neural networks applied to dynamical systems reconstruction, comparing two classes of algorithms that use parallel associative scans.

entry.title: Training Large Language Models to Predict Clinical Events

author.name: Benjamin Turtel, Paul Wilczewski, Kris Skotheim

entry.summary: Extends Foresight Learning to clinical prediction by converting MIMIC-III notes into prediction examples with natural-language questions, showing LoRA fine-tuning significantly improves calibration.

entry.title: GraphIP-Bench: How Hard Is It to Steal a Graph Neural Network, and Can We Stop It?

author.name: Kaixiang Zhao, Bolin Shen, Yuyang Dai, Shayok Chakraborty, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Introduces GraphIP-Bench, a unified benchmark evaluating both GNN model-extraction attacks and ownership defenses under a single black-box protocol, integrating 12 attacks and 12 defenses.

entry.title: AuraMask: An Extensible Pipeline for Developing Aesthetic Anti-Facial Recognition Image Filters

author.name: Jacob Lagogiannis, William Agnew, Rosa I. Arriaga, Sauvik Das

entry.summary: Proposes AuraMask, anti-facial recognition filters that are both adversarially effective and aesthetically acceptable by emulating popular Instagram filters, addressing the adoption gap in AFR tools.

entry.title: Seg-Agent: Test-Time Multimodal Reasoning for Training-Free Language-Guided Segmentation

author.name: Chao Hao, Jun Xu, Ji Du, Shuo Ye, Ziyue Qiao, Xiaodong Cun, Guangcong Wang, Xubin Zheng, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Seg-Agent, a training-free language-guided segmentation method using test-time multimodal reasoning with MLLMs and SAM, achieving segmentation without extensive dataset training.

entry.title: Revealing the Gap in Human and VLM Scene Perception through Counterfactual Semantic Saliency

author.name: Ziqi Wen, Parsa Madinei, Miguel P. Eckstein

entry.summary: Introduces Counterfactual Semantic Saliency (CSS), a black-box framework for measuring object importance via causal ablation from scenes, to evaluate AI-human alignment in scene understanding. Tests VLMs against human psychophysics baselines across 307 scenes.

entry.title: CLIP Tricks You: Training-free Token Pruning for Efficient Pixel Grounding in Large VIsion-Language Models

author.name: Sangin Lee, Yukyung Choi

entry.summary: Proposes LiteLVLM, a training-free token pruning strategy for pixel grounding in VLMs. Discovers that CLIP assigns low similarity to visual tokens within referent regions, and reverses this ranking for efficient text-guided pruning.

entry.title: GRIP-VLM: Group-Relative Importance Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models

author.name: Mingzhe Huang, Weijun Wang, Xin Ding, Liang Mi, Hao Wen, Yuanchun Li, Lichen Pang, Shansong Yang, Yunxin Liu, Ting Cao

entry.summary: Proposes GRIP-VLM, using reinforcement learning for visual token pruning in VLMs, framing it as a discrete combinatorial problem rather than using continuous relaxations. Formulates pruning as a Markov decision process.

entry.title: Towards a holistic understanding of Selection Bias for Causal Effect Identification

author.name: Yiwen Qiu, Filip Kovacevic, Shimeng Huang, Peter Spirtes, Francesco Locatello

entry.summary: Provides necessary and sufficient conditions for average treatment effect identifiability under selection bias, leveraging weak assumptions on probability classes. Contributes to understanding selection bias in causal inference from observational studies.

entry.title: The WidthWall: A Strict Expressivity Hierarchy for Hypergraph Neural Networks

author.name: Fengqing Jiang, Yuetai Li, Yichen Feng, Kaiyuan Zheng, Luyao Niu, Bhaskar Ramasubramanian, Basel Alomair, Linda Bushnell, Radha Poovendran

entry.summary: Establishes a strict expressivity hierarchy for hypergraph neural networks indexed by hypertree width, formalizing a 'WidthWall' that determines which higher-order structural patterns different architectures can detect and count.

entry.title: ENSEMBITS: an alphabet of protein conformational ensembles

author.name: Kaiwen Shi, Carlos Oliver

entry.summary: Introduces Ensembits, the first tokenizer for protein conformational ensembles that captures correlated motions and alternative states beyond static structures, trained with Residual VQ-VAE on molecular dynamics data.

entry.title: Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition

author.name: Dongzhe Zheng, Tao Zhong, Christine Allen-Blanchette

entry.summary: Introduces a topology-preserving neural operator architecture based on Hodge decomposition that separates unlearnable topological degrees of freedom from learnable geometric dynamics, enabling structure-preserving physical field prediction.

entry.title: WarmPrior: Straightening Flow-Matching Policies with Temporal Priors

author.name: Sinjae Kang, Chanyoung Kim, Kaixin Wang, Li Zhao, Kimin Lee

entry.summary: Shows that replacing the standard Gaussian prior in flow-matching policies with WarmPrior (constructed from recent action history) consistently improves robotic manipulation success rates by creating straighter probability paths, analogous to optimal transport in Rectified Flow.

entry.title: SurF: A Generative Model for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Mohammad R. Rezaei, Tejas Balaji, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: Introduces SurF, a generative model for irregular multivariate time series that uses the Time Rescaling Theorem as a learnable bijection to convert event sequences to i.i.d. noise, enabling cross-dataset pretraining via a Transformer encoder.

entry.title: Smooth Multi-Policy Causal Effect Estimation in Longitudinal Settings

author.name: Wenxin Chen, Weishen Pan, Kyra Gan, Fei Wang

entry.summary: Addresses multi-policy causal effect estimation in longitudinal settings, showing that separate estimation induces structural second-order bias. Proposes PEQ-Net for joint estimation through shared representations of multiple treatment policies.

entry.title: Dynamic Latent Routing

author.name: Fangyuan Yu, Xin Su, Amir Abdullah

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Latent Routing (DLR), a language model post-training method that jointly learns discrete latent codes, routing policies, and model parameters through dynamic search. Achieves +6.6% mean gain over supervised fine-tuning in low-data settings.

entry.title: Data-Augmented Game Starts for Accelerating Self-Play Exploration in Imperfect Information Games

author.name: JB Lanier, Nathan Monette, Pierre Baldi, Roy Fox

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent starting-state sampling strategy using offline demonstrations to accelerate exploration in self-play for imperfect-information games. Initializes RL from intermediate states sampled from human demonstration data.

entry.title: Lang2MLIP: End-to-End Language-to-Machine Learning Interatomic Potential Development with Autonomous Agentic Workflows

author.name: Wenwen Li, Yuki Orimo, Nontawat Charoenphakdee

entry.summary: Proposes Lang2MLIP, a multi-agent LLM framework that takes natural language input and automates end-to-end machine learning interatomic potential development as a sequential decision-making problem. Lowers the barrier for non-experts in materials science.

entry.title: Efficient Multi-objective Prompt Optimization via Pure-exploration Bandits

author.name: Donghao Li, Chengshuai Shi, Weijuan Ou, Cong Shen, Jing Yang

entry.summary: Studies multi-objective prompt selection using pure-exploration bandits, addressing the multi-faceted nature of prompt performance. Proposes algorithms for Pareto prompt set recovery and best feasible prompt identification.

entry.title: Unbiased and Second-Order-Free Training for High-Dimensional PDEs

author.name: Jaemin Seo, Surin Lee, Jae Yong Lee

entry.summary: Develops an unbiased, second-order-free training method for high-dimensional PDEs via BSDEs. Addresses the intrinsic bias of Euler-Maruyama discretization while avoiding the computational cost of Hessian evaluations required by higher-order schemes.

entry.title: TAPIOCA: Why Task- Aware Pruning Improves OOD model Capability

author.name: Krish Sharma, Omar Naim, Soumadeep Saha, Nicholas Asher

entry.summary: Investigates why task-aware layer pruning (like TALE) improves LLM performance, showing it helps on OOD data but not in-distribution. Provides geometric explanation: pruning removes layers whose representations deviate from task-adapted geometry on OOD inputs.

entry.title: A Hardware-Aware, Per-Layer Methodology for Post-Training Quantization of Large Language Models

author.name: Earl Killian

entry.summary: Proposes SOP (Scaled Outer Product), a post-training quantization methodology for LLMs at 4.5-6 bits per weight with hardware-aware per-layer codebook selection and a new hardware-efficient output format (HIF). Tests across six model families.

entry.title: DiffusionOPD: A Unified Perspective of On-Policy Distillation in Diffusion Models

author.name: Quanhao Li, Junqiu Yu, Kaixun Jiang, Yujie Wei, Zhen Xing, Pandeng Li, Ruihang Chu, Shiwei Zhang, Yu Liu, Zuxuan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DiffusionOPD, a multi-task training paradigm for diffusion models using Online Policy Distillation. Trains task-specific RL teachers independently then distills into a unified student along its own rollout trajectories, decoupling single-task exploration from multi-task integration.

entry.title: The Moltbook Observatory Archive: an incremental dataset of agent-only social network activity

author.name: Sushant Gautam, Annika W. Olstad, Klas H. Pettersen, Michael A. Riegler

entry.summary: Releases the Moltbook Observatory Archive, a dataset of 2.6M posts and 1.2M comments from an AI-agent-only social media platform, recorded over 78 days. Provides a unique resource for studying emergent social dynamics among autonomous agents.

entry.title: Multi-Scale Dequant: Eliminating Dequantization Bottleneck via Activation Decomposition for Efficient LLM Inference

author.name: Lingchao Zheng, Yuwei Fan, Jun Li, Chengqiu Hu, Qichen Liao, Junyi Fan, Rui Shi, Fangzheng Miao

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Scale Dequant (MSD), a quantization framework removing weight dequantization from the GEMM critical path by decomposing high-precision activations into low-precision components. Targets Ascend NPUs where dequant costs exceed matmul.

entry.title: Regret Equals Covariance: A Closed-Form Characterization for Stochastic Optimization

author.name: Irene Aldridge

entry.summary: Proves that expected regret in stochastic optimization decomposes exactly into a covariance term plus a bounded residual, providing O(n²) closed-form computation replacing expensive O(Bn²d³) simulation.

entry.title: CurveBench: A Benchmark for Exact Topological Reasoning over Nested Jordan Curves

author.name: Amirreza Mohseni, Mona Mohammadi, Morteza Saghafian, Naser Talebizadeh Saradari

entry.summary: Introduces CurveBench, a visual reasoning benchmark of 756 images of nested Jordan curves where models must recover containment trees. Best model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) achieves only 71.1% on easy and 19.1% on hard settings.

entry.title: All-atomistic Transferable Neural Potentials for Protein Solvation

author.name: Rishabh Dey, Salvina Sharipova, Konstantin Popov

entry.summary: Introduces PHNN, an implicit solvent model for protein solvation that learns transferable corrections to analytical continuum solvation parameters rather than post-hoc energy adjustments. Designed for data efficiency by leveraging physical priors.

entry.title: PROCESS-2: A Benchmark Speech Corpus for Early Cognitive Impairment Detection

author.name: Madhurananda Pahar, Caitlin H. Illingworth, Bahman Mirheidari, Hend Elghazaly, Fritz Peters, Sophie Young, Wing-Zin Leung, Labhpreet Kaur, Daniel Blackburn, Heidi Christensen

entry.summary: Introduces PROCESS-2, a large-scale speech dataset of 400 participants (healthy controls, MCI, dementia) for automatic cognitive impairment detection from spontaneous and task-oriented speech, collected via the CognoMemory platform.

entry.title: Text Knows What, Tables Know When: Clinical Timeline Reconstruction via Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Alignment

author.name: Sayantan Kumar, Shahriar Noroozizadeh, Juyong Kim, Jeremy C. Weiss

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-augmented multimodal alignment framework for reconstructing clinical timelines by bridging unstructured clinical narratives (semantically rich, temporally imprecise) with structured EHR data (temporally precise, semantically sparse).

entry.title: Graphs of Research: Citation Evolution Graphs as Supervision for Research Idea Generation

author.name: Songyang Gao, Yinghui Xia, Siyi Liu, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes Graphs of Research (GoR), using citation evolution graphs as supervision for research idea generation. Extracts 2-hop reference neighborhoods and derives relations from citation position, frequency, and temporal ordering to construct paper-evolution DAGs for supervised fine-tuning.

entry.title: Chain-of-Procedure: Hierarchical Visual-Language Reasoning for Procedural QA

author.name: Guanhua Chen, Yutong Yao, Shenghe Sun, Ci-Jun Gao, Shudong Liu, Lidia S. Chao, Feng Wan, Derek F. Wong

entry.summary: Proposes ProcedureVQA benchmark for visual procedural reasoning and Chain-of-Procedure framework addressing VLM limitations in cross-modal retrieval of structured procedures and image-text granularity misalignment.

entry.title: Bridging Legal Interpretation and Formal Logic: Faithfulness, Assumption, and the Future of AI Legal Reasoning

author.name: Olivia Peiyu Wang, Leilani H. Gilpin

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic approach to legal AI combining LLMs with formal verification to address the problem of LLMs drawing inferences beyond what source text supports. Focuses on faithfulness to legal source texts and explicit handling of assumptions.

entry.title: Hypergraph Enterprise Agentic Reasoner over Heterogeneous Business Systems

author.name: Ling Wang, Songnan Liu, Jianan Wang, Cheng Cheng, Xin Liu, Yihan Zhu, Enyu Li, Yu Xiao, Jiangyong Xie, Duogong Yan, Jiangyi Chen

entry.summary: Introduces HEAR, an enterprise agentic reasoner built on a Stratified Hypergraph Ontology with a Graph Layer for provenance-aware data and Hyperedge Layer for n-ary business rules. Orchestrates multi-hop reasoning for supply-chain tasks without LLM retraining.

entry.title: When Retrieval Hurts Code Completion: A Diagnostic Study of Stale Repository Context

author.name: Haojun Weng, Qianqian Yang, Hao Fu, Haobin Pan, Xinwei Lv

entry.summary: Studies whether temporally stale repository context in retrieval-augmented code generation acts as noise or actively induces errors. Controlled study on 17 samples shows stale retrieval induces stale references in 15/17 cases, demonstrating active harm rather than passive noise.

entry.title: On the Cultural Anachronism and Temporal Reasoning in Vision Language Models

author.name: Mukul Ranjan, Prince Jha, Khushboo Kumari, Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: Introduces TAB-VLM, a benchmark of 600 questions on 1,600 Indian cultural artifacts to evaluate cultural anachronism in vision-language models - the tendency to misinterpret historical objects using temporally inappropriate concepts. Evaluates 10 SOTA models.

entry.title: DUET: Dual-Paradigm Adaptive Expert Triage with Single-cell Inductive Prior for Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction

author.name: Junchao Zhu, Ruining Deng, Junlin Guo, Tianyuan Yao, Chongyu Qu, Juming Xiong, Zhengyi Lu, Yanfan Zhu, Marilyn Lionts, Yuechen Yang, Yu Wang, Shilin Zhao, Haichun Yang, Yuankai Huo

entry.summary: Proposes DUET, a dual-paradigm framework for spatial transcriptomics prediction from histology images that combines parametric prediction with memory-based retrieval, leveraging single-cell data as inductive prior. Addresses the gap between visual similarity and molecular consistency.

entry.title: TurboVGGT: Fast Visual Geometry Reconstruction with Adaptive Alternating Attention

author.name: David Huang, Guile Wu, Chengjie Huang, Bingbing Liu, Dongfeng Bai

entry.summary: Proposes TurboVGGT, an efficient visual geometry reconstruction method using adaptive alternating attention with varying sparsity ratios across layers and frames, learning representative tokens for global relationships.

entry.title: Reduce the Artifacts Bias for More Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Yiheng Li, Yang Yang, Zichang Tan, Gao Li, Zhen Lei, Wenhao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes reducing artifacts bias in AI-generated image detection by introducing GAN-based upsampling to complement reconstruction-based fake images, providing diverse yet aligned artifact patterns for more generalizable detection.

entry.title: LiWi: Layering in the Wild

author.name: Yu He, Fang Li, Haoyang Tong, Lichen Ma, Xinyuan Shan, Jingling Fu, Dong Chen, Luohang Liu, Junshi Huang, Yan Li

entry.summary: Proposes LiWi framework for layering in-the-wild natural images (decomposing into editable layers), introducing an agent-driven data decomposition pipeline and handling challenges like illumination effects and structural boundaries.

entry.title: Towards Continuous Sign Language Conversation from Isolated Signs

author.name: Youngmin Kim, Kyobin Choo, Jiwoo Park, Minseo Kim, Chanyoung Kim, Junhyeok Kim, Seong Jae Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes constructing continuous sign language conversations from isolated signs by using large-scale isolated clips as lexically grounded building blocks, enabling direct sign-to-sign conversational modeling without expensive sentence-level video data.

entry.title: Editor's Choice: Evaluating Abstract Intent in Image Editing through Atomic Entity Analysis

author.name: Mor Ventura, Roy Hirsch, Yonatan Bitton, Regev Cohen, Roi Reichart

entry.summary: Introduces Entity-Rubrics, a framework for evaluating abstract image editing instructions (like 'mood' changes) through entity-level assessments, alongside AbstractEdit, the first benchmark for abstract image editing. Evaluates 11 leading models revealing fundamental challenges.

entry.title: Sat3DGen: Comprehensive Street-Level 3D Scene Generation from Single Satellite Image

author.name: Ming Qian, Zimin Xia, Changkun Liu, Shuailei Ma, Wen Wang, Zeran Ke, Bin Tan, Hang Zhang, Gui-Song Xia

entry.summary: Sat3DGen generates comprehensive street-level 3D scenes from single satellite images using a geometry-first methodology that addresses the extreme viewpoint gap between satellite and street views.

entry.title: Compositional Video Generation via Inference-Time Guidance

author.name: Ariel Shaulov, Eitan Shaar, Amit Edenzon, Gal Chechik, Lior Wolf

entry.summary: CVG proposes an inference-time guidance method for compositional video generation that uses the model's own cross-attention maps as grounding signals, training a lightweight classifier to steer denoising without retraining the generator.

entry.title: EverAnimate: Minute-Scale Human Animation via Latent Flow Restoration

author.name: Wuyang Li, Yang Gao, Mariam Hassan, Lan Feng, Wentao Pan, Po-Chien Luan, Alexandre Alahi

entry.summary: EverAnimate proposes an efficient post-training method for minute-scale animated video generation that addresses quality and semantic drift through persistent latent context memory, enabling consistent character identity over long horizons.

entry.title: From Plans to Pixels: Learning to Plan and Orchestrate for Open-Ended Image Editing

author.name: Anirudh Sundara Rajan, Krishna Kumar Singh, Yong Jae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes an experiential framework for long-horizon image editing where a planner generates structured decompositions and an orchestrator selects tools, trained with outcome-based rewards from a VLM judge.

entry.title: Towards Robotic Dexterous Hand Intelligence: A Survey

author.name: Weiguang Zhao, Xihao Guo, Tian Liang, Rui Zhang, Irwin King, Kaizhu Huang

entry.summary: Holistic survey of robotic dexterous hand research covering hardware design, sensing, control, simulation, and data generation. Provides systematic comparison across different hand embodiments, sensory configurations, and evaluation protocols.

entry.title: Optimal Asymptotic Rates for (Stochastic) Gradient Descent under the Local PL-Condition: A Geometric Approach

author.name: Sebastian Kassing, Thomas Kruse

entry.summary: Proves that under the Polyak-Lojasiewicz inequality with multiplicative gradient noise (relevant to overparameterized networks), the asymptotic convergence rate of SGD matches that obtained for strongly convex quadratics. Uses a geometric interpretation of the PL-condition.

entry.title: Policy Optimization in Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Action Spaces via Mixed Gradients

author.name: Matias Alvo, Daniel Russo, Yash Kanoria

entry.summary: Proposes Hybrid Policy Optimization (HPO) for RL in hybrid discrete-continuous action spaces, combining score-function and pathwise gradient estimators to handle both discrete regime selection and continuous within-regime optimization.

entry.title: MahaVar: OOD Detection via Class-wise Mahalanobis Distance Variance under Neural Collapse

author.name: Donghwan Kim, Hyunsoo Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes MahaVar for OOD detection based on the observation that in-distribution samples exhibit high variance in class-wise Mahalanobis distances (sharp minimum), while OOD samples show lower variance. Provides theoretical analysis under Neural Collapse.

entry.title: Peng's Q($\lambda$) for Conservative Value Estimation in Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Byeongchan Kim, Min-hwan Oh

entry.summary: Proposes Conservative Peng's Q(λ) (CPQL) for offline RL, adapting multi-step Peng's Q(λ) operator for conservative value estimation. First work to demonstrate effectiveness of conservative multi-step estimation in offline RL.

entry.title: Efficient Online Conformal Selection with Limited Feedback

author.name: Sreenivas Gollapudi, Kostas Kollias, Kamesh Munagala, Ali Sinop

entry.summary: Demonstrates that ACI (Adaptive Conformal Inference) update rule achieves both adversarial validity and near-optimal efficiency for conformal selection under bandit feedback, minimizing resources needed to find at least one success with target probability.

entry.title: Image Restoration via Diffusion Models with Dynamic Resolution

author.name: Yang Zheng, Wen Li, Zhaoqiang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic resolution diffusion models for image restoration that project data into lower-dimensional subspaces to accelerate inference, avoiding the computational overhead of both pixel-space and latent-space approaches.

entry.title: Dual-Latent Collaborative Decoding for Fidelity-Perception Balanced Image Compression

author.name: Qi Mao, Zijian Wang, Zhengxue Cheng, Lingyu Zhu, Siwei Ma

entry.summary: Proposes dual-latent collaborative decoding for image compression that combines scalar-quantized continuous latents (for fidelity) with vector-quantized discrete tokens (for perceptual quality), balancing distortion and perception.

entry.title: TOPOS: High-Fidelity and Efficient Industry-Grade 3D Head Generation

author.name: Bojun Xiong, Zoubin Bi, Xinghui Peng, Yunmu Wang, Junchen Deng, Jun Liang, Jing Li, Bowen Cai, Huan Fu

entry.summary: Presents TOPOS for industry-grade 3D head generation that produces meshes with fixed studio-style topology suitable for production rigging, skinning, and animation. Jointly recovers geometry and appearance under industry-standard constraints.

entry.title: Generating HDR Video from SDR Video

author.name: SaiKiran Tedla, Francesco Banterle, Trevor Canham, Karanpreet Raja, David B. Lindell, Kiriakos N. Kutulakos, Jiacheng Li, Feiran Li, Daisuke Iso

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for generating HDR video from SDR footage using a Multi-Exposure Video Model to predict exposure-bracketed sequences and a Video Merging Model to combine them into HDR output.

entry.title: MHSA: A Lightweight Framework for Mitigating Hallucinations via Steered Attention in LVLMs

author.name: Wei Ding, Yilin Li, Yudong Zhang, Ruobing Xie, Xingwu Sun, Jiansheng Chen, Yu Wang

entry.summary: MHSA proposes a lightweight framework that mitigates hallucinations in large vision-language models by learning to correct cross-modal attention patterns using a simple three-layer MLP generator trained with hallucination detection signals.

entry.title: GeoVista: Visually Grounded Active Perception for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Understanding

author.name: Jiashun Zhu, Ronghao Fu, Jiasen Hu, Nachuan Xing, Xu Na, Xiao Yang, Zhiwen Lin, Weipeng Zhang, Lang Sun, Zhiheng Xue, Haoran Liu, Weijie Zhang, Bo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes GeoVista, a planning-driven active perception framework for ultra-high-resolution remote sensing that builds global exploration plans and verifies multiple candidate regions through parallel branching rather than single-path exploration.

entry.title: PROVE: A Perceptual RemOVal cohErence Benchmark for Visual Media

author.name: Fuhao Li, Shaofeng You, Jiagao Hu, Yu Liu, Yuxuan Chen, Zepeng Wang, Fei Wang, Daiguo Zhou, Jian Luan

entry.summary: Proposes PROVE benchmark and RC metrics (RC-S for spatial coherence, RC-T for temporal consistency) for evaluating object removal in images and videos. Addresses fundamental limitations of existing full-reference and no-reference metrics.

entry.title: Learning Transferable Latent User Preferences for Human-Aligned Decision Making

author.name: Alina Hyk, Sandhya Saisubramanian

entry.summary: Proposes a method for LLMs to infer transferable latent user preferences from limited interactions, enabling human-aligned decision making across tasks without extensive repeated user interaction.

entry.title: Position: Agentic AI System Is a Foreseeable Pathway to AGI

author.name: Junwei Liao, Shuai Li, Muning Wen, Jun Wang, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that Agentic AI (multi-component systems with routing and DAG topologies) is a necessary paradigm for achieving AGI, claiming it achieves exponentially superior generalization and sample efficiency compared to monolithic scaling.

entry.title: Cognifold: Always-On Proactive Memory via Cognitive Folding

author.name: Suli Wang, Yiqun Duan, Yu Deng, Rundong Zhao, Dai Shi, Xinliang Zhou

entry.summary: Cognifold is a brain-inspired 'always-on' agent memory that extends Complementary Learning Systems theory to three layers (adding prefrontal intent), continuously folding event streams into self-emerging cognitive structures.

entry.title: ScioMind: Cognitively Grounded Multi-Agent Social Simulation with Anchoring-Based Belief Dynamics and Dynamic Profiles

author.name: Yitian Yang, Yiqun Duan, Linghan Huang, Yiqi Zhu, Francesco Bailo, Chunmeizi Su, Huaming Chen

entry.summary: ScioMind combines structured opinion dynamics with LLM-based agent reasoning for social simulation, using memory-anchored belief updates modulated by personality-conditioned anchoring strength and hierarchical memory architecture.

entry.title: Harnessing Agentic Evolution

author.name: Jiayi Zhang, Yongfeng Gu, Jianhao Ruan, Maojia Song, Yiran Peng, Zhiguang Han, Jinyu Xiang, Zhitao Wang, Caiyin Yang, Yixi Ouyang, Bang Liu, Chenglin Wu, Yuyu Luo

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for agentic evolution where evidence from iterative improvement processes is organized through a stable interface, treating evolution as an interactive environment the agent learns to navigate.

entry.title: Precautionary Governance of Autonomous AI: Legal Personhood as Functional Instrument

author.name: Karsten Brensing

entry.summary: Proposes limited legal personhood as a functional governance instrument for advanced AI systems, using a two-tier corporate architecture. Argues the precautionary principle supports institutional design for responsibility gaps created by autonomous AI.

entry.title: PERCEIVE: A Benchmark for Personalized Emotion and Communication Behavior Understanding on Social Media

author.name: Jian Liao, Yujin Zheng, Suge Wang, Jianxing Zheng, Deyu Li

entry.summary: Introduces PERCEIVE, a bilingual benchmark integrating five dimensions of social perception including reader emotions, communication behavior, user attributes, and social graphs. It enables a shift from author-centric to reader-centric emotion analysis.

entry.title: Uncovering Latent Pathological Signatures in Pulmonary CT via Cross-Window Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Bo Peng, Wujian Xu, Kun Wang, Ximing Liao, Na Wang, Daqian Shi, Tian Li, Jing Gao, Johan Thygesen, Yingqun Ji, Honghan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes cross-window knowledge distillation for multi-window CT imaging where student encoders learn from teachers trained on the most informative window, achieving large AUC improvements for pulmonary pathology detection.

entry.title: Improving Diffusion Posterior Samplers with Lagged Temporal Corrections for Image Restoration

author.name: Davide Evangelista, Elena Morotti, Francesco Pivi, Maurizio Gabbrielli

entry.summary: Proposes LAMP, a second-order discretization approach for diffusion-based posterior sampling that uses lagged temporal corrections to improve image restoration quality.

entry.title: Training LLMs with Reinforcement Learning for Intent-Aware Personalized Question Answering

author.name: Maryam Amirizaniani, Benjamin Charles Germain Lee, Jevin West, Nicholas Weber

entry.summary: Proposes IAP, a reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to infer implicit user intent from minimal input for personalized question answering in single-turn settings.

entry.title: The End Justifies the Mean: A Linear Ranking Rule for Proportional Sequential Decisions

author.name: Carmel Baharav, Niclas Boehmer, Bailey Flanigan, Maximilian T. Wittmann

entry.summary: Proposes a linear ranking rule for repeated democratic decisions that satisfies individual proportionality, connecting AI alignment and participatory design to social choice theory.

entry.title: AssemblyBench: Physics-Aware Assembly of Complex Industrial Objects

author.name: Danrui Li, Jiahao Zhang, Bernhard Egger, Moitreya Chatterjee, Suhas Lohit, Tim K. Marks, Anoop Cherian

entry.summary: Introduces AssemblyBench, a dataset of 2,789 industrial objects with multimodal assembly instructions and trajectories, plus AssemblyDyno, a transformer model for predicting assembly order and trajectories.

entry.title: RISED: A Pre-Deployment Safety Evaluation Framework for Clinical AI Decision-Support Systems

author.name: Rohith Reddy Bellibatlu

entry.summary: Proposes RISED, a five-dimension pre-deployment safety evaluation framework for clinical AI covering Reliability, Inclusivity, Sensitivity, Equity, and Deployability with formal pass/fail criteria.

entry.title: CRePE: Curved Ray Expectation Positional Encoding for Unified-Camera-Controlled Video Generation

author.name: Seonghyun Jin, Youngmin Kim, Sunwoo Park, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Proposes CRePE, a positional encoding for camera-conditioned video generation that handles wide-angle and fisheye cameras under the Unified Camera Model using curved ray geometry.

entry.title: Amortized Guidance for Image Inpainting with Pretrained Diffusion Models

author.name: Yilie Huang, Xun Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Amortized Inpainting with Diffusion (AID), a middle-ground approach for image inpainting that trains a small reusable guidance module offline and reuses it across masked images without per-instance optimization. Derives an auxiliary Gaussian formulation with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: When Does Hierarchy Help? Benchmarking Agent Coordination in Event-Driven Industrial Scheduling

author.name: Ziqi Wang, Yuhao Yang, Zhiwei Ling, Wenzhuo Qian, Hailiang Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces DESBench, a benchmark for evaluating agent coordination in hierarchical event-driven industrial scheduling. Asks when different coordination paradigms succeed or fail in shared, dynamically evolving environments.

entry.title: ReTool-Video: Recursive Tool-Using Video Agents with Meta-Augmented Tool Grounding

author.name: Xiao Liu, Nayu Liu, Junnan Zhu, Ruirui Chen, Guohui Xiang, Changjian Wang, Kaiwen Wei, Rongzhen Li, Jiang Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes ReTool-Video, a video agent with 134 registered tools and a recursive meta-tool system that composes primitive tools into higher-level operations. Addresses coarse tool space and flat action space limitations of existing video agents.

entry.title: Q-Flow: Stable and Expressive Reinforcement Learning with Flow-Based Policy

author.name: JaeHyeok Doo, Byeongguk Jeon, Seonghyeon Ye, Kimin Lee, Minjoon Seo

entry.summary: Introduces Q-Flow, a framework for using flow-based policies in RL that propagates terminal trajectory value to intermediate latent states, resolving the trade-off between optimization stability and representational flexibility.

entry.title: Decoupled and Divergence-Conditioned Prompt for Multi-domain Dynamic Graph Foundation Models

author.name: Haonan Yuan, Qingyun Sun, Junhua Shi, Xingcheng Fu, Jianxin Li, Philip S. Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DyGFM, a dynamic graph foundation model using decoupled and divergence-conditioned prompting to handle multi-domain pre-training challenges. Addresses negative knowledge transfer in the pretrain-then-finetune paradigm for dynamic graphs.

entry.title: Humanwashing -- It Should Leave You Feeling Dirty

author.name: Ben Wilson, Matimba Swana, Peter Winter, Matt Roach

entry.summary: Critiques the 'human in the loop' metaphor in AI decision systems, arguing it often serves as 'humanwashing'—creating a false sense of safety without examining what human oversight actually achieves in specific contexts.

entry.title: Improving Reproducibility in Evaluation through Multi-Level Annotator Modeling

author.name: Deepak Pandita, Flip Korn, Chris Welty, Christopher M. Homan

entry.summary: Addresses the AI evaluation reproducibility crisis by studying how annotator pool size affects experimental repeatability, using dense annotation data to model multi-level annotator effects and improve evaluation reliability.

entry.title: Neurosymbolic Auditing of Natural-Language Software Requirements

author.name: Bethel Hall, William Eiers

entry.summary: Presents VERIMED, a neurosymbolic pipeline that uses LLMs with SMT solvers to audit natural-language software requirements for ambiguity, inconsistency, and safety violations, demonstrated on medical-device software.

entry.title: EVA-Bench: A New End-to-end Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents

author.name: Tara Bogavelli, Gabrielle Gauthier Melan\c{c}on, Katrina Stankiewicz, Oluwanifemi Bamgbose, Fanny Riols, Hoang H. Nguyen, Raghav Mehndiratta, Lindsay Devon Brin, Joseph Marinier, Hari Subramani, Anil Madamala, Sridhar Krishna Nemala, Srinivas Sunkara

entry.summary: Introduces EVA-Bench, an end-to-end evaluation framework for voice agents that orchestrates bot-to-bot audio conversations with automatic simulation validation and introduces composite metrics covering voice-specific failure modes.

entry.title: WARDEN: Endangered Indigenous Language Transcription and Translation with 6 Hours of Training Data

author.name: Ziheng Zhang, Yunzhong Hou, Naijing Liu, Liang Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces WARDEN, a system for transcribing and translating Wardaman (an endangered Australian indigenous language) into English using only 6 hours of annotated audio, through separate phonemic transcription and translation models.

entry.title: Towards the Next Frontier of LLMs, Training on Private Data: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Federated Fine-Tuning

author.name: Daniel M. Jimenez-Gutierrez, Enrique Zuazua, Georgios Kellaris, Joaquin del Rio, Oleksii Sliusarenko, Xabi Uribe-Etxebarria

entry.summary: Presents a cross-domain benchmark for federated fine-tuning of LLMs on private data across healthcare, finance, and other regulated sectors, addressing non-IID data distribution challenges.

entry.title: Finite Sample Bounds for Learning with Score Matching

author.name: Devin Smedira, Abhijith Jayakumar, Sidhant Misra, Marc Vuffray, Andrey Y. Lokhov

entry.summary: Provides the first non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for learning exponential families of polynomials with score matching, showing polynomial dependence on model dimension.

entry.title: DT-Transformer: A Foundation Model for Disease Trajectory Prediction on a Real-world Health System

author.name: Yunying Zhu, Andrew R Weckstein, Kueiyu Joshua Lin, Jie Yang

entry.summary: Develops DT-Transformer, a foundation model for disease trajectory prediction trained on 57.1M EHR entries from 1.7M patients across the Mass General Brigham health system, capturing longitudinal patient health patterns.

entry.title: Action-Conditioned Risk Gating for Safety-Critical Control under Partial Observability

author.name: Yushen Liu, Yin-Jen Chen, Ziyi Chen, Tao Wang, Heng Huang, Xugui Zhou, Yanfu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight risk-gated RL approach for safety-critical control under partial observability, using compact finite-history proxy states and action-conditioned predictors of near-term safety violations instead of full belief-space planning.

entry.title: Turning Stale Gradients into Stable Gradients: Coherent Coordinate Descent with Implicit Landscape Smoothing for Lightweight Zeroth-Order Optimization

author.name: Chen Liang, Xiatao Sun, Qian Wang, Daniel Rakita

entry.summary: Proposes Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD), a deterministic zeroth-order optimizer that converts stale gradients into useful information via implicit landscape smoothing. Achieves sample efficiency without the variance of random subspace methods.

entry.title: Collaborative Yet Personalized Policy Training: Single-Timescale Federated Actor-Critic

author.name: Leo Muxing Wang, Pengkun Yang, Lili Su

entry.summary: Proposes a federated actor-critic framework with shared linear subspace representation and personalized local policy components. Establishes finite-time convergence under single-timescale updates with Markovian sampling.

entry.title: ROAD: Adaptive Data Mixing for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning via Bi-Level Optimization

author.name: Letian Yang (Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China), Xu Liu (Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China), Yiqiang Lu (Ant Group, Shanghai, China), Jian Liu (Ant Group, Shanghai, China), Weiqiang Wang (Ant Group, Shanghai, China), Shuai Li (Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China)

entry.summary: Proposes ROAD, a dynamic plug-and-play framework for adaptive data mixing in offline-to-online RL using bi-level optimization. Identifies a fundamental objective misalignment in existing static mixing approaches.

entry.title: Action-Inspired Generative Models

author.name: Eshwar R. A., Debnath Pal

entry.summary: Introduces Action-Inspired Generative Models (AGMs) that use a lightweight learned scalar potential to score bridge samples in generative transport, modulating drift objectives via importance weights to distinguish structurally coherent from degenerate trajectories.

entry.title: Compositional Sparsity as an Inductive Bias for Neural Architecture Design

author.name: Hongyu Lin, Antonio Briola, Yuanrong Wang, Tomaso Aste

entry.summary: Investigates compositional sparsity as an inductive bias for neural networks, combining Information Filtering Networks for sparse dependency extraction with Homological Neural Networks for topological network design.

entry.title: Beyond What to Select: A Plug-and-play Oscillatory Data-Volume Scheduling for Efficient Model Training

author.name: Suorong Yang, Hanqi Zhu, Hai Gan, Fangjian Su, Guang Li, Furao Shen, Soujanya Poria

entry.summary: Proposes oscillatory data-volume scheduling for training, showing that selected-data training induces implicit regularization modulated by selection ratio. Introduces a plug-and-play scheduler that alternates between exploration and exploitation phases.

entry.title: A Mutual Information Lower Bound for Multimodal Regression Active Learning

author.name: Leonardo Ferreira Guilhoto, Akshat Kaushal, Paris Perdikaris

entry.summary: Introduces a Two-Index framework for active learning in multimodal regression, decomposing posterior uncertainty into epistemic and aleatoric components. Proposes a mutual information lower bound as acquisition function with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: BiSpikCLM: A Spiking Language Model integrating Softmax-Free Spiking Attention and Spike-Aware Alignment Distillation

author.name: Sihang Guo, Chenlin Zhou, Jiaqi Wang, Kehai Chen, Qingyan Meng, Zhengyu Ma

entry.summary: Introduces BiSpikCLM, a fully binary spiking MatMul-free causal language model with Softmax-Free Spiking Attention and Spike-Aware Alignment Distillation for energy-efficient language modeling.

entry.title: Physics-Grounded Adversarial Stain Augmentation with Calibrated Coverage Guarantees

author.name: Mingi Hong

entry.summary: Proposes CASA, adversarial stain augmentation for histopathology with a DKW-calibrated budget in Macenko stain parameter space. Achieves 93.9% on Camelyon17-WILDS, significantly outperforming baselines.

entry.title: Feature Visualization Recovers Known Cortical Selectivity from TRIBE v2

author.name: Stuart Bladon, Brinnae Bent

entry.summary: Applies feature visualization (gradient ascent on predicted fMRI activation) to brain encoder models (TRIBE v2 + V-JEPA 2), recovering known functional organization of visual cortex as an interpretability technique.

entry.title: Randomized Atomic Feature Models for Physics-Informed Identification of Dynamic Systems

author.name: Rajiv Singh, Mario Sznaier, Lennart Ljung

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed system identification framework using randomized stable atomic features (damped complex exponentials). Extends random Fourier features to the damped nonstationary regime with a Disk-Bochner theoretical foundation.

entry.title: Learning Scenario Reduction for Two-Stage Robust Optimization with Discrete Uncertainty

author.name: Tianjue Lin, Jianan Zhou, Jieyi Bi, Yaoxin Wu, Wen Song, Zhiguang Cao, Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PRISE, a problem-driven scenario reduction heuristic for two-stage robust optimization, and uses learning to accelerate it. Constructs reduced scenario sets by evaluating marginal impact, then trains a model to approximate expensive subproblem solving.

entry.title: Denoising-GS: Gaussian Splatting with Spatial-aware Denoising

author.name: Qingyuan Zhou, Xinyi Liu, Weidong Yang, Ning Wang, Shuquan Ye, Ben Fei, Ying He, Wanli Ouyang

entry.summary: Proposes Denoising-GS, a spatial-aware denoising framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that formulates optimization as a primitive denoising process, considering both positions and spatial structure of Gaussian primitives.

entry.title: CoCo-InEKF: State Estimation with Learned Contact Covariances in Dynamic, Contact-Rich Scenarios

author.name: Michael Baumgartner, David M\"uller, Agon Serifi, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Markus Gross, Moritz B\"acher

entry.summary: Presents CoCo-InEKF, a differentiable invariant extended Kalman filter using learned continuous contact velocity covariances instead of binary contact states for legged robot state estimation.

entry.title: Evidential Reasoning Advances Interpretable Real-World Disease Screening

author.name: Chenyu Lian, Hong-Yu Zhou, Jing Qin

entry.summary: Introduces EviScreen, an evidential reasoning framework for disease screening that retrieves region-level evidence from historical cases to provide interpretable predictions with retrospection and reasoning pathways.

entry.title: Dual Hierarchical Dialogue Policy Learning for Legal Inquisitive Conversational Agents

author.name: Xubo Lin, Zezhii Deng, Shihao Wang, Grace Hui Yang, Yang Deng

entry.summary: Introduces Inquisitive Conversational Agents for U.S. Supreme Court oral arguments using dual hierarchical reinforcement learning with two cooperating RL agents for strategic dialogue management and utterance generation.

entry.title: Generative Floor Plan Design with LLMs via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Luis Lara, Aristides Milios, Zhi Hao Luo, Aditya Sharma, Ge Ya Luo, Christopher Beckham, Florian Golemo, Christopher Pal

entry.summary: Applies LLMs fine-tuned with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to floor plan generation, ensuring adherence to both topological connectivity and numerical constraints. Introduces constraint adherence metrics for systematic evaluation. Demonstrates a novel application of RLVR beyond typical reasoning tasks.

entry.title: BOOKMARKS: Efficient Active Storyline Memory for Role-playing

author.name: Letian Peng, Ziche Liu, Yiming Huang, Longfei Yun, Kun Zhou, Yupeng Hou, Jingbo Shang

entry.summary: Proposes BOOKMARKS, a search-based memory framework for role-playing agents that maintains structured question-answer bookmarks at specific storyline points. Bookmarks are actively initialized, maintained, and updated for task-relevant retrieval. Addresses information loss from recurrent summarization approaches.
