entry.title: Improving Multi-turn Dialogue Consistency with Self-Recall Thinking

author.name: Renning Pang, Tian Lan, Leyuan Liu, Xiaoming Huang, Piao Tong, Xiaosong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Recall Thinking (SRT) for multi-turn dialogue consistency, identifying relevant historical turns and using them to generate contextually appropriate responses without external memory or summarization. Addresses long-range dependency and sparse informative signals.

entry.title: A Benchmark for Early-stage Parkinson's Disease Detection from Speech

author.name: Terry Yi Zhong, Cristian Tejedor-Garcia, Khiet P. Truong, Janna Maas, Louis ten Bosch, Bastiaan R. Bloem

entry.summary: Proposes the first benchmark for speech-based early-stage Parkinson's disease detection with speaker-independent splits covering three speech tasks. Provides multi-dimensional evaluation breakdowns by gender, disease stage, and aggregation level.

entry.title: Remember Your Trace: Memory-Guided Long-Horizon Agentic Framework for Consistent and Hierarchical Repository-Level Code Documentation

author.name: Suyoung Bae, Jaehoon Lee, Changkyu Choi, YunSeok Choi, Jee-Hyong Lee

entry.summary: Proposes MemDocAgent for repository-level code documentation using dependency-aware traversal and memory-guided interaction to maintain consistency across documents. Addresses redundant retrieval and conflicting descriptions in existing approaches.

entry.title: CineMesh4D: Personalized 4D Whole Heart Reconstruction from Sparse Cine MRI

author.name: Xiaoyue Liu, Xiaohan Yuan, Mark Y Chan, Ching-Hui Sia, Lei Li

entry.summary: Presents CineMesh4D, an end-to-end pipeline for 4D whole-heart mesh reconstruction from sparse 2D cine MRI using cross-domain mapping and differentiable rendering loss. Addresses the clinically important challenge of reconstructing full cardiac cycle dynamics from limited imaging data.

entry.title: DermAgent: A Self-Reflective Agentic System for Dermatological Image Analysis with Multi-Tool Reasoning and Traceable Decision-Making

author.name: Yize Liu, Siyuan Yan, Ming Hu, Lie Ju, Xieji Li, Feilong Tang, Wei Feng, Zongyuan Ge

entry.summary: Proposes DermAgent, a collaborative multi-tool agent for dermatological diagnosis using seven specialized vision and language modules within a Plan-Execute-Reflect framework, providing traceable diagnostic reasoning.

entry.title: FedStain: Modeling Higher-Order Stain Statistics for Federated Domain Generalization in Computational Pathology

author.name: Fengyi Zhang, Junya Zhang, Wenzhuo Sun

entry.summary: Proposes FedStain for federated domain generalization in computational pathology, modeling higher-order stain statistics (beyond Gaussian assumptions) to handle non-Gaussian distributions from biochemical diffusion and scanner nonlinearity.

entry.title: MiVE: Multiscale Vision-language features for reference-guided video Editing

author.name: Tong Wang, Meng Zou, Chengjing Wu, Xiaochao Qu, Luoqi Liu, Xiaolin Hu, Ting Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MiVE for reference-guided video editing that leverages multiscale VLM features, observing that early layers capture spatial details for precise editing while deeper layers encode semantics for instruction comprehension.

entry.title: EARL: Towards a Unified Analysis-Guided Reinforcement Learning Framework for Egocentric Interaction Reasoning and Pixel Grounding

author.name: Yuejiao Su, Xinshen Zhang, Zhen Ye, Lei Yao, Lap-Pui Chau, Yi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces EARL, an egocentric analysis-guided reinforcement learning framework that transfers coarse interaction semantics to fine-grained answering and pixel grounding for egocentric vision understanding.

entry.title: HeatKV: Head-tuned KV-cache Compression for Visual Autoregressive Modeling

author.name: Jonathan Cederlund, Axel Berg, Durmus Alp Emre Acar, Chuteng Zhou, Pontus Giselsson

entry.summary: HeatKV introduces a KV-cache compression method for Visual Autoregressive models that adapts cache allocation per attention head based on attention patterns over prior scales, achieving 2x compression with maintained quality.

entry.title: SceneParser: Hierarchical Scene Parsing for Visual Semantics Understanding

author.name: Pengxin Xu, Xincheng Lin, Luping Xiao, Qing Jiang, Meishan Zhang, Hao Fei, Shanghang Zhang, Xingyu Chen

entry.summary: SceneParser introduces Hierarchical Scene Parsing, representing scenes as structured hierarchies (scene→object→part→affordance) with cross-level bindings, enabling interaction-oriented scene understanding using a VLM-based parser.

entry.title: Evo-Depth: A Lightweight Depth-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Tao Lin, Yuxin Du, Jiting Liu, Nuobei Zhu, Yunhe Li, Yuqian Fu, Yinxinyu Chen, Hongyi Cai, Zewei Ye, Bing Cheng, Kai Ye, Yiran Mao, Yilei Zhong, MingKang Dong, Junchi Yan, Gen Li, Bo Zhao

entry.summary: Evo-Depth proposes a lightweight Vision-Language-Action model for robotic manipulation that enhances spatial understanding through implicit depth-aware encoding from RGB observations, avoiding explicit 3D sensors or point clouds.

entry.title: Characterizing the visual representation of objects from the child's view

author.name: Jane Yang, Tarun Sepuri, Alvin Wei Ming Tan, Khai Loong Aw, Michael C. Frank, Bria Long

entry.summary: Analyzes first-person videos from the BabyView dataset (868 hours, ages 5-36 months) to characterize children's visual object category exposure, finding highly skewed distributions and variable exemplars that provide context for understanding visual learning.

entry.title: Before the Body Moves: Learning Anticipatory Joint Intent for Language-Conditioned Humanoid Control

author.name: Haozhe Jia, Honglei Jin, Yuan Zhang, Youcheng Fan, Shaofeng Liang, Lei Wang, Shuxu Jin, Kuimou Yu, Zinuo Zhang, Jianfei Song, Wenshuo Chen, Yutao Yue

entry.summary: DAJI proposes an anticipatory joint-intent interface for language-conditioned humanoid control, encoding upcoming contact changes and balance preparation into the control representation rather than relying on reactive tracking.

entry.title: CLOVER: Closed-Loop Value Estimation \& Ranking for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Planning

author.name: Sining Ang, Yuguang Yang, Canyu Chen, Yan Wang

entry.summary: CLOVER proposes a closed-loop value estimation and ranking framework for autonomous driving that addresses the training-evaluation mismatch where trajectories close to logged paths may violate planning rules.

entry.title: NeuroTrain: Surveying Local Learning Rules for Spiking Neural Networks with an Open Benchmarking Framework

author.name: Alessio Caviglia, Filippo Marostica, Roberta Bardini, Alessandro Savino, Stefano Di Carlo

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey and taxonomy of spiking neural network (SNN) training algorithms, covering surrogate-gradient backpropagation, local learning rules, plasticity mechanisms, and ANN-to-SNN conversion. Also introduces an open benchmarking framework called NeuroTrain.

entry.title: Exploring Bottlenecks in VLM-LLM Navigation: How 3D Scene Understanding Capability Impacts Zero-Shot VLN

author.name: Ziyi Xia, Chaoran Xiong, Litao Wei, Xinhao Hu, Ling Pei

entry.summary: Quantifies the impact of 3D scene understanding capability on zero-shot vision-and-language navigation performance. Identifies that current 3D perception models' focus on pixel-level accuracy conflicts with computational constraints of real-time embodied navigation.

entry.title: Designing AI factual claims for "easy verification"

author.name: Raemon

entry.summary: Proposes designing AI outputs to be 'verification-centric' with inline evidence, confidence indicators, and structured citations that make it frictionless for users to verify factual claims. Argues this is important for both near-term hallucination and longer-term manipulation concerns.

entry.title: Context Matters: Auditing Gender Bias in T2I Generation through Risk-Tiered Use-Case Profiles

author.name: Jose Luna, Yankun Wu, Xiaofei Xie, Noa Garcia

entry.summary: Proposes risk-tiered use-case profiles for auditing gender bias in text-to-image models, arguing that bias evaluation should be context-dependent rather than one-size-fits-all. Provides a framework for interpreting bias metrics under different deployment contexts.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Task Sampling

author.name: Nicholas E. Corrado, Wenyuan Huang, Josiah P. Hanna

entry.summary: Proposes distributionally robust multi-task RL via adaptive task sampling to address imbalanced learning across tasks. Focuses on data allocation rather than gradient manipulation as the key issue in MTRL.

entry.title: GeoViSTA: Geospatial Vision-Tabular Transformer for Multimodal Environment Representation

author.name: Yuhao Liu, Sadeer Al-Kindi, Ashok Veeraraghavan, Guha Balakrishnan

entry.summary: Proposes GeoViSTA, a vision-tabular transformer that learns unified geospatial embeddings from co-registered satellite imagery and tabular socioeconomic data using bilateral cross-attention.

entry.title: TopoPrimer: The Missing Topological Context in Forecasting Models

author.name: Zara Zetlin, Kayhan Moharreri, Maria Safi

entry.summary: Introduces TopoPrimer, a framework that adds topological structure from persistent homology and spectral sheaf coordinates as inputs to forecasting models. Shows up to 7.3% MSE improvement on benchmarks with Chronos and TimesFM.

entry.title: Phylogenetic Tree Inference with Tropical Axial Attention

author.name: Chris Teska, Kurt Pasque, Ruriko Yoshida, Baran Hashemi

entry.summary: Introduces Tropical Axial Attention for phylogenetic tree inference, replacing softmax attention with max-plus operators aligned with dynamic programming. Leverages tropical geometry of phylogenetic tree spaces.

entry.title: A Regret Perspective on Online Multiple Testing

author.name: Qingyang Hao, Kongchang Zhou, Fang Kong, Hongxin Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Weighted Regret for online multiple testing, proves that deterministic FDR-controlling procedures incur linear regret, and proposes Decoupled-OMT as a meta-wrapper achieving sublinear regret.

entry.title: Evolving Layer-Specific Scalar Functions for Hardware-Aware Transformer Adaptation

author.name: Kieran Carrigg, Sigur de Vries, Amirhossein Sadough, Marcel van Gerven

entry.summary: Uses genetic programming to evolve layer-specific scalar functions as hardware-friendly replacements for layer normalization in Vision Transformers, enabling edge deployment without expensive retraining. Includes a post-training re-alignment strategy.

entry.title: SpectraFlow: Unifying Structural Pretraining and Frequency Adaptation for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Zhiquan Chen, Haitao Wang, Guowei Zou, Hejun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes SpectraFlow, a two-stage framework for medical image segmentation coupling structure-aware pretraining (Mixed-Domain MeanFlow) with boundary-oriented decoding and frequency adaptation for low-data regimes.

entry.title: Towards Accurate Single Panoramic 3D Detection: A Semantic Gaussian Centric Approach

author.name: Kanglin Ning, Yiran Zhao, Wenrui Li, Shaoru Sun, Xingtao Wang, Xiaopeng Fan

entry.summary: Proposes PanoGSDet for monocular panoramic 3D detection using continuous semantic 3D Gaussian representations instead of discrete 3D grids, preserving geometric continuity for better 2D-to-3D feature mapping from panoramic images.

entry.title: MultiEmo-Bench: Multi-label Visual Emotion Analysis for Multi-modal Large Language Models

author.name: Tianwei Chen, Takuya Furusawa, Yuki Hirakawa, Ryotaro Shimizu, Mo Fan, Takashi Wada

entry.summary: Introduces MultiEmo-Bench for multi-label visual emotion analysis, addressing limitations of existing datasets where single-candidate annotation schemes underestimate model capabilities for predicting complex emotional responses to images.

entry.title: Representative Attention For Vision Transformers

author.name: Yuntong Li, Hainuo Wang, Hengxing Liu, Mingjia Li, Xiaojie Guo

entry.summary: RPAttention proposes a linear attention mechanism for Vision Transformers that performs token compression in representation space rather than from fixed spatial partitions, enabling semantically-driven global information exchange.

entry.title: 3D Skew-Normal Splatting

author.name: Xiangru Wu, Ke Fan, Yanwei Fu

entry.summary: Introduces 3D Skew-Normal Splatting, extending 3DGS with asymmetric kernel distributions using skew-normal primitives that provide continuous shape control beyond the symmetric Gaussian limitation, particularly for boundaries and one-sided surfaces.

entry.title: Chrono-Gymnasium: An Open-Source, Gymnasium-Compatible Distributed Simulation Framework

author.name: Bocheng Zou, Harry Zhang, Khailanii Slaton, Jingquan Wang, Derrick Ruan, Huzaifa Mustafa Unjhawala, Radu Serban, Dan Negrut

entry.summary: Introduces Chrono-Gymnasium, an open-source distributed computing framework that scales high-fidelity multi-body dynamics (Project Chrono) across computing clusters with a standard Gymnasium interface for RL and optimization.

entry.title: MoRe: Modular Representations for Principled Continual Representation Learning on Squantial Data

author.name: Jiaqi Sun, Boyang Sun, Mohamad Rasmy, Xiangchen Song, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MoRe for continual representation learning on sequential data, using time-delayed dependencies as natural signals for discovering data structure rather than relying on task boundaries.

entry.title: Understanding Imbalanced Forgetting in Rehearsal-Based Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Alberto Tamajo, Srinandan Dasmahapatra, Rahman Attar

entry.summary: Provides a thorough investigation of imbalanced forgetting in rehearsal-based class-incremental learning, showing it arises systematically. Constructs three last-layer coefficients that capture gradient-level interference sources.

entry.title: Learning with Shallow Neural Networks on Cluster-Structured Features

author.name: Elisabetta Cornacchia, Laurent Massouli\'e

entry.summary: Studies how cluster-structured input features affect sample complexity for learning with shallow neural networks via gradient descent. Shows that spatial correlations in input data can reduce sample complexity.

entry.title: Implicit spatial-frequency fusion of hyperspectral and lidar data via kolmogorov-arnold networks

author.name: Zekun Long, Judy X. Yang, Jing Wang, Ali Zia, Guanyiman Fu, Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes IFGNet for hyperspectral-LiDAR fusion using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to handle spectral ambiguity and spatial heterogeneity. Explores fusion in both spatial and frequency domains with LiDAR guidance.

entry.title: From Sparse to Dense: Spatio-Temporal Fusion for Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation with DenseWarper

author.name: Ling Li, Changjie Chen, Yuyan Wang, Jiaqing Lyu, Kenglun Chang, Yiyun Chen, Zhidong Deng

entry.summary: Proposes sparse interleaved input for multi-view 3D human pose estimation using images from different views at different time points, with DenseWarper for spatio-temporal fusion. Offers potential for increased frame rate and reduced camera requirements.

entry.title: How to Evaluate and Refine your CAM

author.name: Luca Domeniconi, Alessandra Stramiglio, Michele Lombardi, Samuele Salti

entry.summary: Proposes ARCC, a new composite metric for evaluating class attribution maps (CAMs), validated using a synthetic dataset with ground-truth attributions. Also introduces a refinement method for improving CAM resolution.

entry.title: Towards Label-Free Single-Cell Phenotyping Using Multi-Task Learning

author.name: Saqib Nazir, Ardhendu Behera

entry.summary: Presents a unified deep learning framework for label-free single-cell phenotyping from bright-field images, jointly performing white blood cell classification and protein expression regression using a hybrid CNN-transformer architecture.

entry.title: DriveCtrl: Conditioned Sim-to-Real Driving Video Generation

author.name: Haonan Zhao, Yiting Wang, Jingkun Chen, Valentina Donzella, Thomas Bashford-Rogers, Kurt Debattista

entry.summary: DriveCtrl presents a depth-conditioned sim-to-real video generation framework for autonomous driving that preserves scene structure, object dynamics, temporal consistency, and visual realism while maintaining annotation validity.

entry.title: PROMETHEUS: Automating Deep Causal Research Integrating Text, Data and Models

author.name: Sridhar Mahadevan

entry.summary: PROMETHEUS turns diverse sources (literature, data, code, simulations) into 'causal atlases' - sheaf-like families of local causal models with restriction maps and gluing diagnostics. Uses category-theoretic structures (Topos) for organizing causal knowledge.

entry.title: Strikingness-Aware Evaluation for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Rikui Huang, Shengzhe Zhang, Wei Wei

entry.summary: Proposes a strikingness-aware evaluation framework for temporal knowledge graph reasoning that weights rare, unexpected events more heavily than trivial repetitions, using temporal rules to quantify event strikingness.

entry.title: TimelineReasoner: Advancing Timeline Summarization with Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Liancheng Zhang, Xiaoxi Li, Zhicheng Dou

entry.summary: TimelineReasoner uses Large Reasoning Models for active timeline summarization with iterative evidence acquisition, missing event detection, and temporal consistency validation, shifting from passive generation to reasoning-driven process.

entry.title: PG-LRF: Physiology-Guided Latent Rectified Flow for Electro-Hemodynamic PPG-to-ECG Generation

author.name: Xiaoda Wang, Minxiao Wang, Kaiqiao Han, Defu Cao, Ching Chang, Yidan Shi, Runze Yan, Xiao Luo, Yan Liu, Xiao Hu, Yizhou Sun, Wei Wang, Carl Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PG-LRF, a physiology-guided latent rectified flow model for converting PPG signals (from wearables) to ECG morphology, incorporating electro-hemodynamic physiological constraints.

entry.title: Towards Robust Federated Multimodal Graph Learning under Modality Heterogeneity

author.name: Sirui Zhang, Haonan Wang, Xunkai Li, Zekai Chen, Shumeng Li, Hongchao Qin, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a robust federated multimodal graph learning approach that handles modality heterogeneity across different parties while maintaining privacy through federated learning.

entry.title: FePySR: A Neural Feature Extraction Framework for Efficient and Scalable Symbolic Regression

author.name: Zhiming Yu, Wangtao Lu, Xin Lai

entry.summary: Introduces FePySR, a two-stage symbolic regression framework using neural feature extraction to reduce search space before equation search, outperforming baselines on standard benchmarks.

entry.title: Adaptive Smooth Tchebycheff Attention for Multi-Objective Policy Optimization

author.name: Alejandro Murillo-Gonzalez, Mahmoud Ali, Lantao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Smooth Tchebycheff attention for multi-objective RL in robotics, dynamically modulating optimization landscape curvature to handle non-convex Pareto fronts.

entry.title: Mechanism Plausibility in Generative Agent-Based Modeling

author.name: Patrick Zhao, David Huu Pham, Nicholas Vincent

entry.summary: Discusses mechanism plausibility in generative agent-based modeling, arguing that LLM-based ABMs need to demonstrate explanatory mechanisms rather than just capability for phenomena generation.

entry.title: Protocol-Driven Development: Governing Generated Software Through Invariants and Evidence

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Introduces Protocol-Driven Development (PDD), a framework where machine-enforceable protocols (structural, behavioral, and observational invariants) govern AI-generated code rather than relying on natural language specs or tests alone. Addresses the governance problem of automated code synthesis.

entry.title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Causal Responsibility Attribution in Probabilistic Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Chunyan Mu, Muhammad Najib

entry.summary: Introduces counterfactual responsibility attribution in multi-agent systems modeled as concurrent stochastic games, using Shapley values to allocate accountability. Proves the method satisfies fairness and consistency properties.

entry.title: SECOND-Grasp: Semantic Contact-guided Dexterous Grasping

author.name: Han Yi Shin, Heeju Ko, Jaewon Mun, Qixing Huang, Jaehyeok Lee, Sung June Kim, Honglak Lee, Sujin Jang, Sangpil Kim

entry.summary: Proposes SECOND-Grasp, a framework for dexterous grasping that integrates physical stability with semantic task guidance. Uses vision-language models for semantic reasoning while ensuring physically feasible grasps.

entry.title: Delightful Exploration

author.name: Ian Osband

entry.summary: Introduces Delight-gated exploration (DE), an exploration heuristic that spends exploratory actions only when expected improvement times surprisal exceeds a gate price. Connects to Pandora's reservation-value rule for costly search.

entry.title: HLS-Seek: QoR-Aware Code Generation for High-Level Synthesis via Proxy Comparative Reward Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Qingyun Zou, Feng Yu, Hongshi Tan, Yao Chen, Bingsheng He, WengFai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes HLS-Seek, a QoR-aware framework for generating HLS code from natural language using RL with a comparative proxy reward model. Achieves 99.53% Pareto-dominance accuracy without synthesis-in-the-loop training.

entry.title: NAACA: Training-Free NeuroAuditory Attentive Cognitive Architecture with Oscillatory Working Memory for Salience-Driven Attention Gating

author.name: Zhongju Yuan, Geraint Wiggins, Dick Botteldooren

entry.summary: Introduces NAACA, a training-free neuro-inspired architecture for audio language models that uses oscillatory working memory to filter for auditory salience, reducing unnecessary LLM invocations while improving performance on violence detection (AP from 53.5% to 70.6%).

entry.title: Amplification to Synthesis: A Comparative Analysis of Cognitive Operations Before and After Generative AI

author.name: Liz Cho, Dongwook Yoon

entry.summary: Compares cognitive operations (disinformation campaigns) on X/Twitter between 2016 and 2024 US elections, analyzing how generative AI has shifted tactics from bot-driven amplification to AI-generated synthetic content.

entry.title: Vision-Based Runtime Monitoring under Varying Specifications using Semantic Latent Representations

author.name: Bardh Hoxha, Oliver Sch\"on, Hideki Okamoto, Lars Lindemann, Georgios Fainekos

entry.summary: Studies certified runtime monitoring of temporal logic specifications from visual observations, proving that a semantic basis of atom robustness scores is the minimum prediction target for reusable monitoring, with conformal calibration for finite-sample guarantees.

entry.title: EvolveMem:Self-Evolving Memory Architecture via AutoResearch for LLM Agents

author.name: Jiaqi Liu, Xinyu Ye, Peng Xia, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Mingyu Ding, Huaxiu Yao

entry.summary: Introduces EvolveMem, a self-evolving memory architecture for LLM agents that co-evolves both stored knowledge and the retrieval mechanism, using an LLM-powered diagnosis module to optimize retrieval configuration from failure logs.

entry.title: Fair and Calibrated Toxicity Detection with Robust Training and Abstention

author.name: Mokshit Surana

entry.summary: Reveals that fairness in toxicity classification requires examining calibration disparity, not just ranking fairness. ERM achieves good aggregate calibration (0.013 ECE) but hides large per-subgroup disparities, which Group DRO can address.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Tool-Calling Agents in Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)

author.name: Marius S. Knorr, Robert M\"uller, Jan P. Bremer, Nils Schweingruber

entry.summary: Applies reinforcement learning to train tool-calling LLM agents for navigating FHIR healthcare data graphs, framing clinical question answering as sequential decision-making over structured medical records.

entry.title: Quantum Advantage in Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Simranjeet Singh Dahia, Claudia Szabo

entry.summary: Demonstrates quantum advantage in multi-agent reinforcement learning using entangled variational quantum circuits, approaching the Tsirelson limit (0.854) in the CHSH game where classical agents are provably capped at 0.75.

entry.title: Latency-Quality Routing for Functionally Equivalent Tools in LLM Agents

author.name: Kexin Chu, Dawei Xiang, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces LQM-ContextRoute, a contextual bandit router that selects among functionally equivalent tool providers for LLM agents, optimizing for both latency and answer quality rather than trading one for the other. Addresses a practical deployment challenge as tool-augmented agents scale.

entry.title: RQ-MoE: Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts for Efficient Input-Dependent Vector Compression

author.name: Zhengjia Zhong, Shuyan Ke, Zaizhou Lin, Jiaqi Song, Hongyi Lan, Hui Li

entry.summary: Proposes RQ-MoE, combining mixture-of-experts with residual quantization for input-dependent vector compression. Enables dynamic codebook construction and parallel decoding, addressing the sequential bottleneck of methods like QINCo.

entry.title: Watch your neighbors: Training statistically accurate chaotic systems with local phase space information

author.name: Joon-Hyuk Ko, Andrus Giraldo, Deok-Sun Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for training surrogate models of chaotic dynamics with accurate Jacobians and long-term statistical properties, bridging local dynamics fidelity and global statistical behavior.

entry.title: An Amortized Efficiency Threshold for Comparing Neural and Heuristic Solvers in Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Sohaib Afifi

entry.summary: Defines the Amortized Efficiency Threshold (AET) for comparing neural vs. heuristic combinatorial optimization solvers, formalizing when neural solvers become energy-efficient considering training amortization over deployment volume.

entry.title: TILBench: A Systematic Benchmark for Tabular Imbalanced Learning Across Data Regimes

author.name: Ruizhe Liu, Jiaqi Luo

entry.summary: Presents TILBench, a large-scale benchmark evaluating 40+ imbalanced learning algorithms across 57 tabular datasets with 200K+ experiments, providing systematic comparisons across data characteristics and computational scalability.

entry.title: Slot-MPC: Goal-Conditioned Model Predictive Control with Object-Centric Representations

author.name: Jonathan Spieler, Angel Villar-Corrales, Sven Behnke

entry.summary: Proposes Slot-MPC, combining object-centric world models (slot-based representations) with Model Predictive Control for goal-conditioned planning. Enables generalization to novel situations by planning at inference time rather than using fixed reactive policies.

entry.title: Generalized Priority-Aware Shapley Value

author.name: Kiljae Lee, Ziqi Liu, Weijing Tang, Yuan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GPASV (Generalized Priority-Aware Shapley Value) that extends Shapley value to arbitrary directed weighted priority graphs, handling cyclic and non-binary priorities common in real data like aggregated human preferences.

entry.title: Realiz3D: 3D Generation Made Photorealistic via Domain-Aware Learning

author.name: Ido Sobol, Kihyuk Sohn, Yoav Blum, Egor Zakharov, Max Bluvstein, Andrea Vedaldi, Or Litany

entry.summary: Introduces Realiz3D, a lightweight framework for training diffusion models to generate photorealistic 3D-consistent images by addressing the domain gap between synthetic renders and real photographs during fine-tuning.

entry.title: Winning Lottery Tickets in Neural Networks via a Quantum-Inspired Classical Algorithm

author.name: Natsuto Isogai, Hayata Yamasaki, Sho Sonoda, Mio Murao

entry.summary: Constructs a quantum-inspired classical algorithm for selecting sparse subnetworks (lottery tickets) from shallow neural networks, matching the quantum algorithm's efficiency in specific settings.

entry.title: Stochastic Matching via Local Sparsification

author.name: Sara Ahmadian, Edith Cohen, Mohammad Roghani

entry.summary: Formalizes a two-stage local sparsification framework for stochastic matching where arriving requests must prune compatibility sets to a budget before global optimization. Proposes a parameterized local selection strategy and derives approximation guarantees.

entry.title: AnchorRoute: Human Motion Synthesis with Interval-Routed Sparse Contro

author.name: Pengcheng Fang, Tengjiao Sun, Dongjie Fu, Xiaoyu Zhan, Yanwen Guo, Hansung Kim, Xiaohao Cai

entry.summary: Presents AnchorRoute for sparse-anchor human motion synthesis, converting sparse user-specified anchors into conditions injected into a frozen diffusion prior via AnchorKV and dual-context conditioning. Preserves pretrained text-to-motion quality while adding spatial control.

entry.title: Road Maps as Free Geometric Priors: Weather-Invariant Drone Geo-Localization with GeoFuse

author.name: Yunsong Fang (University of Macau), Tingyu Wang (Hangzhou Dianzi University), Zhedong Zheng (University of Macau)

entry.summary: Introduces GeoFuse, using freely available road map data as weather-invariant geometric priors for drone geo-localization. Fuses road network and building footprint information with aerial imagery to bridge cross-view domain gaps under adverse weather.

entry.title: RoSHAP: A Distributional Framework and Robust Metric for Stable Feature Attribution

author.name: Lanxin Xiang, Liang Shi, Youhui Ye, Boyu Jiang, Dawei Zhou, Feng Guo

entry.summary: Proposes RoSHAP, a distributional framework for robust feature attribution that models the stochastic variation in SHAP values through bootstrap resampling and kernel density estimation for stable feature ranking.

entry.title: COTCAgent: Preventive Consultation via Probabilistic Chain-of-Thought Completion

author.name: Zihan Deng, Xiaozhen Zhong, Chuanzhi Xu

entry.summary: Proposes COTCAgent for preventive clinical consultation using probabilistic chain-of-thought completion over longitudinal EHR data. Addresses LLM limitations in fine-grained statistical reasoning and temporal dependency modeling in clinical settings.

entry.title: Is Grep All You Need? How Agent Harnesses Reshape Agentic Search

author.name: Sahil Sen, Akhil Kasturi, Elias Lumer, Anmol Gulati, Vamse Kumar Subbiah

entry.summary: Empirically studies how retrieval strategy choice interacts with agent architecture and tool-calling paradigm in agentic search systems. Examines how tool output presentation and surrounding context affect performance in agent loops.

entry.title: Falkor-IRAC: Graph-Constrained Generation for Verified Legal Reasoning in Indian Judicial AI

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: Presents Falkor-IRAC, a graph-constrained generation framework for Indian legal AI using IRAC knowledge graphs. Grounds generation in structured reasoning over Issue, Rule, Analysis, Conclusion structures to prevent hallucinated precedents and unsupported reasoning.

entry.title: Contrastive Multi-Modal Hypergraph Reasoning for 3D Crowd Mesh Recovery

author.name: Minghao Sun, Chongyang Xu, Yitao Xie, Buzhen Huang, Kun Li

entry.summary: Proposes a contrastive multi-modal hypergraph reasoning approach for 3D crowd mesh recovery that combines semantic, geometric, and pose cues to handle occlusions and depth ambiguity in multi-person scenes. The method uses hypergraph structures to model group context rather than reconstructing individuals in isolation.

entry.title: AnyBand-Diff: A Unified Remote Sensing Image Generation and Band Repair Framework with Spectral Priors

author.name: Zuopeng Zhao, Ying Liu, Xiaoyu Li, Su Luo, Lu Li, Wenwen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces AnyBand-Diff, a spectral-prior-guided diffusion framework for remote sensing that can recover complete spectral information from arbitrary band subsets while enforcing radiometric fidelity through physics-aware constraints.

entry.title: TERRA-CD: Multi-Temporal Framework for Multi-class and Semantic Change Detection

author.name: Omkar Oak, Rukmini Nazre, Rujuta Budke, Suraj Sawant

entry.summary: Presents TERRA-CD, a benchmark dataset of 5,221 Sentinel-2 image pairs for multi-class and semantic change detection covering 232 cities, with multiple annotation schemes for vegetation monitoring.

entry.title: Vision-Core Guided Contrastive Learning for Balanced Multi-modal Prognosis Prediction of Stroke

author.name: Liren Chen, Lidong Sun, Mingyan Huang, Junzhe Tang, Yinghui Zhu, Guanjie Wang, Yiqing Xia, Ting Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes a tri-modal fusion model for ischemic stroke prognosis integrating medical images, clinical data, and text with vision-core guided contrastive learning for balanced multi-modal interactions.

entry.title: CHASM: Cross-frequency Harmonized Axis-Separable Mixing for Spectral Token Operators

author.name: Pengcheng Fang, Hongli Chen, Yuxia Chen, Tengjiao Sun, Jiaxin Liu, Xiaohao Cai

entry.summary: Proposes CHASM, a spectral token mixer that separates shared channel eigenbasis from frequency-specific spectral gains, providing a structured middle ground between existing spectral mixer designs for vision transformers.

entry.title: FactorizedHMR: A Hybrid Framework for Video Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Patrick Kwon, Chen Chen

entry.summary: FactorizedHMR proposes a two-stage approach to human mesh recovery that treats torso/root estimation deterministically and distal articulations probabilistically using flow matching, reflecting the non-uniform ambiguity in 3D body recovery.

entry.title: ACE-LoRA: Adaptive Orthogonal Decoupling for Continual Image Editing

author.name: Yuehao Liu, Weijia Zhang, Xuanming Shang, Zhizhou Chen, Yanhao Ge, Shanyan Guan, Chao Ma

entry.summary: ACE-LoRA proposes a framework for continual image editing with diffusion models, using adaptive orthogonal decoupling to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and rank-invariant compression for scalability.

entry.title: Elastic Spiking Transformers for Efficient Gesture Understanding

author.name: Alberto Ancilotto, Gianluca Amprimo, Stefano Di Carlo, Elisabetta Farella

entry.summary: Introduces an Elastic Spiking Transformer with runtime-adaptive architecture that embeds nested elasticity for gesture understanding, enabling deployment on neuromorphic hardware with varying computational constraints.

entry.title: UMo: Unified Sparse Motion Modeling for Real-Time Co-Speech Avatars

author.name: Xiaoyu Zhan, Xinyu Fu, Chenghao Yang, Xiaohong Zhang, Dongjie Fu, Pengcheng Fang, Tengjiao Sun, Xiaohao Cai, Hansung Kim, Yuanqi Li, Jie Guo, Yanwen Guo

entry.summary: UMo presents a unified architecture for real-time co-speech avatars that processes text, audio, and motion tokens with spatially sparse Mixture-of-Experts and temporally sparse keyframe prediction.

entry.title: Ergodic Imitation for Adaptive Exploration around Demonstrations

author.name: Ziyi Xu, Cem Bilaloglu, Yiming Li, Sylvain Calinon

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive ergodic imitation approach that constructs target distributions from demonstration geometry and generates trajectories that interpolate between tracking and exploration. Addresses the common train-deploy mismatch problem in imitation learning.

entry.title: BEHAVE: A Hybrid AI Framework for Real-Time Modeling of Collective Human Dynamics

author.name: Helene Malyutina

entry.summary: BEHAVE proposes a hybrid AI framework for real-time modeling of collective human dynamics, treating groups as complex dynamical systems with emergence, phase transitions, and feedback loops. Aims to predict group stability vs escalation from micro-dynamics of body behavior.

entry.title: RS-Claw: Progressive Active Tool Exploration via Hierarchical Skill Trees for Remote Sensing Agents

author.name: Liangtian Liu, Zeyuan Wang, Ziyu Li, Kai Ouyang, Zichao Tang, Chengfu Liu, Haifeng Li, Hanwen Yu, Wentao Yang, Cheng Yang, Dongyang Hou

entry.summary: RS-Claw proposes hierarchical skill trees for remote sensing agents to progressively explore and invoke tools, addressing the context-load vs toolset-completeness tradeoff in massive RS tool ecosystems.

entry.title: TokaMind for Power Grid: Cross-Domain Transfer from Fusion Plasma

author.name: JC Wu, Norton Lee, Kai Siang Chen

entry.summary: Investigates whether TokaMind, a transformer pre-trained on tokamak plasma data, can transfer to power grid and industrial degradation domains. Identifies four transfer-favoring characteristics and shows power grid data matches the profile best.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Agentic NetOps and AIOps: Architectures, Evaluation, and Safety

author.name: Muhammad Bilal, Jon Crowcroft, Ruizhi Wang, Xiaolong Xu, Schahram Dustdar

entry.summary: Surveys LLMs for agentic network operations and AIOps, organizing literature around autonomy hierarchies, tool scope, evidence traces, and assurance contracts.

entry.title: FRAME: Forensic Routing and Adaptive Multi-path Evidence Fusion for Image Manipulation Detection

author.name: Kaixiang Zhao, Tianrun Yu, Aoxu Zhang, Junhao Su, Porter Jenkins, Amanda Hughes

entry.summary: Proposes FRAME, a forensic routing and adaptive multi-path evidence fusion method that combines multiple forensic algorithms for robust image manipulation detection across manipulation types.

entry.title: Bridging Domain Gaps with Target-Aligned Generation for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Minung Kim, Jeongmo Kim, Gwanwoo Choi, Seungyul Han

entry.summary: Proposes Target-aligned Coverage Expansion (TCE) for cross-domain offline RL, using a dual score-based generative model to synthesize target-consistent transitions when the target dataset is extremely limited. Addresses distributional mismatch between source and target domains.

entry.title: PanoWorld: Towards Spatial Supersensing in 360$^\circ$ Panorama World

author.name: Changpeng Wang, Xin Lin, Junhan Liu, Yuheng Liu, Zhen Wang, Donglian Qi, Yunfeng Yan, Xi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes PanoWorld for 360° panoramic scene understanding with MLLMs, addressing limitations of the perspective-image paradigm. Studies pano-native understanding requiring reasoning over equirectangular projections.

entry.title: The Readability Spectrum: Patterns, Issues, and Prompt Effects in LLM-Generated Code

author.name: Hengzhi Ye, Fengyuan Ran, Weiwei Xu, Minghui Zhou

entry.summary: Systematically studies code readability of LLM-generated code compared to human-written code, establishing a comprehensive readability model and evaluating the role of prompt design in shaping readability.

entry.title: What Limits Vision-and-Language Navigation ?

author.name: Yunheng Wang, Yuetong Fang, Taowen Wang, Lusong Li, Kun Liu, Junzhe Xu, Zizhao Yuan, Yixiao Feng, Jiaxi Zhang, Wei Lu, Zecui Zeng, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: Proposes StereoNav for vision-language navigation that addresses sim-to-real gaps through robust spatial grounding and cross-domain priors, arguing the bottleneck isn't model size but spatial grounding quality.

entry.title: CUBic: Coordinated Unified Bimanual Perception and Control Framework

author.name: Xingyu Wang, Pengxiang Ding, Jingkai Xu, Donglin Wang, Zhaoxin Fan

entry.summary: Proposes CUBic, a unified framework for bimanual robot perception and control that learns a shared tokenized representation bridging perception and control for coordinated two-arm manipulation.

entry.title: Causality-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Ego-Centric Joint Scene Modeling

author.name: Seokha Moon, Minseung Lee, Joon Seo, Jinkyu Kim, Jungbeom Lee

entry.summary: Proposes CaAD, a causality-aware end-to-end autonomous driving framework that jointly models the reciprocal causal dependencies between ego-vehicle planning and surrounding agent behaviors in a shared latent space.

entry.title: Cross Modality Image Translation In Medical Imaging Using Generative Frameworks

author.name: Giulia Romoli, Alessia Capoccia, Filippo Ruffini, Francesco Di Feola, Luca Boldrini, Arturo Chiti, Renato Cuocolo, Tugba Akinci D'Antonoli, Fatemeh Darvizeh, Marcello Di Pumpo, Bradley J. Erickson, Liu Fang, Deborah Fazzini, Paola Feraco, Fabrizia Gelardi, Francesco Gossetti, Ana Isabel Hern\'aiz Ferrer, Michail E. Klontzas, Seyedmehdi Payabvash, Katrine Riklund, Sara N. Strandberg, Valerio Guarrasi, Paolo Soda

entry.summary: Provides a standardized comparative evaluation of seven 3D generative models (GANs and latent diffusion models) for medical image-to-image translation in oncological imaging, addressing the lack of reproducible benchmarks in this space.

entry.title: RTLC -- Research, Teach-to-Learn, Critique: A three-stage prompting paradigm inspired by the Feynman Learning Technique that lifts LLM-as-judge accuracy on JudgeBench with no fine-tuning

author.name: Andrea Morandi

entry.summary: Introduces RTLC, a three-stage prompting recipe inspired by the Feynman Learning Technique that improves LLM-as-judge accuracy on JudgeBench without fine-tuning, using ensemble-of-thought judging with self-critique.

entry.title: Rethinking Molecular OOD Generalization via Target-Aware Source Selection

author.name: Zhuohao Lin, Kun Li, Jiameng Chen, Jiajun Yu, Duanhua Cao, Yizhen Zheng, Wenbin Hu

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE-BENCH, a benchmark for molecular out-of-distribution generalization that uses cluster-level partitioning in physicochemical descriptor space, along with a target-aware source selection method to reduce negative transfer.

entry.title: AudioMosaic: Contrastive Masked Audio Representation Learning

author.name: Hanxun Huang, Qizhou Wang, Xingjun Ma, Cihang Xie, Christopher Leckie, Sarah Erfani

entry.summary: Introduces AudioMosaic, a contrastive learning approach for audio representation that constructs positive pairs via structured time-frequency masking of spectrogram patches, enabling efficient large-batch pretraining.

entry.title: LoMETab: Beyond Rank-1 Ensembles for Tabular Deep Learning

author.name: Changryeol Choi, Hyewon Park, Yujin Kwon, Gowun Jeong

entry.summary: Proposes LoMETab, a rank-r generalization of multiplicative implicit ensembles for tabular deep learning. Lifts rank-1 BatchEnsemble modulation to a rank-r identity-residual Hadamard family with low-rank member-specific factors.

entry.title: SeesawNet: Towards Non-stationary Time Series Forecasting with Balanced Modeling of Common and Specific Dependencies

author.name: Hao Li, Lu Zhang, Liu Chong, Yankai Chen, Pengyang Wang, Yingjie Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes SeesawNet for non-stationary time series forecasting that dynamically balances common and instance-specific dependency modeling across temporal and channel dimensions, addressing limitations of instance normalization.

entry.title: GFMate: Empowering Graph Foundation Models with Test-time Prompt Tuning

author.name: Yan Jiang, Ruihong Qiu, Zi Huang

entry.summary: Proposes GFMate, a test-time prompt tuning method for Graph Foundation Models that avoids entanglement with specific source domains or pre-training strategies. Leverages unlabeled target domain information.

entry.title: ToMAToMP: Robust and Multi-Parameter Topological Clustering

author.name: Ludo Andrianirina, Mathieu Carri\`ere

entry.summary: Proposes ToMAToMP, extending the ToMATo topological clustering algorithm with robustness to outliers, automatic graph construction, and multi-parameter persistence for more versatile clustering from TDA.

entry.title: In-Context Learning for Data-Driven Censored Inventory Control

author.name: Sohom Mukherjee, Anh-Duy Pham, Richard Pibernik, Yunbei Xu

entry.summary: Introduces in-context generative posterior sampling (ICGPS) for the censored newsvendor inventory control problem, combining meta-trained generative models with online deployment. Provides theoretical Bayesian regret bounds showing the approach handles prior mismatch better than parametric Thompson sampling.

entry.title: Eradicating Negative Transfer in Multi-Physics Foundation Models via Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing

author.name: Ellwil Sharma, Arastu Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces Shodh-MoE, a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture for multi-physics scientific ML that addresses negative transfer when co-training on disparate PDE regimes. Uses physics-informed autoencoder with Helmholtz-style parameterization.

entry.title: Ready from Day 1: Population-Aware Coordination for Large-Scale Constrained Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Angel Wang, Dominique Perrault-Joncas, Alvaro Maggiar, Carson Eisenach, Dean Foster

entry.summary: Proposes population-aware coordination interfaces for large-scale multi-agent systems with shared resources, using learned primal and dual maps conditioned on population summaries for iterative planning.

entry.title: A Survey on Data-Dependent Worst-Case Generalization Bounds

author.name: Hubert Leroux, Jean Marcus, Julien Roger

entry.summary: Survey paper on data-dependent worst-case generalization bounds for deep learning, organizing work around extending PAC-Bayesian theory to data-dependent hypothesis sets with geometric and topological descriptors.

entry.title: Real-time virtual circuits for plasma shape control via neural network emulators

author.name: Alasdair Ross, George K. Holt, Kamran Pentland, Adriano Agnello, Nicola C. Amorisco, Pedro Cavestany, Aran Garrod, Timothy Nunn, Charles Vincent, Graham McArdle

entry.summary: Proposes neural network emulators for real-time computation of virtual circuits for tokamak plasma shape control, replacing pre-computed reference equilibria with continuous estimation.

entry.title: Derivation Prompting: A Logic-Based Method for Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Ignacio Sastre, Guillermo Moncecchi, Aiala Ros\'a

entry.summary: Introduces Derivation Prompting for RAG, a technique inspired by formal logic derivations that constructs interpretable derivation trees from initial hypotheses through predefined rules, reducing hallucinations in domain-specific QA.

entry.title: Dimension-Level Intent Fidelity Evaluation for Large Language Models: Evidence from Structured Prompt Ablation

author.name: GAng Peng

entry.summary: Proposes dimension-level intent fidelity evaluation separating structural recovery from intent preservation across 2,880 outputs in three languages and six LLMs. Reveals a systematic structural-fidelity split where outputs appear structurally correct but miss user intent.

entry.title: From Descriptive to Prescriptive: Uncover the Social Value Alignment of LLM-based Agents

author.name: Jinxian Qu, Qingqing Gu, Teng Chen, Luo Ji

entry.summary: Proposes a value-based framework using GraphRAG to convert principles into value-based instructions for LLM agent alignment with social values. Evaluates using Maslow's hierarchy and Plutchik's emotion wheel on the DAILYDILEMMAS benchmark.

entry.title: Unified Pix Token And Word Token Generative Language Model

author.name: Haun Leung, ZiNan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a model that unifies pixel tokens and word tokens in a generative language model, where each pixel has its own token embedding. Aims to address limitations of ViT-based vision encoders in recognizing small text and numbers in images.

entry.title: IG-Diff: Complex Night Scene Restoration with Illumination-Guided Diffusion Model

author.name: Yifan Chen, Fei Yin, Chunle Guo, Chongyi Li, Yujiu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes IG-Diff for complex nighttime scene restoration that handles concurrent weather and low-light degradation using illumination-guided diffusion. Contributes datasets simulating combined nighttime degradations.

entry.title: Learning with Semantic Priors: Stabilizing Point-Supervised Infrared Small Target Detection via Hierarchical Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Yuanhang Yao, Ping Qian, Zhu Liu, Long Ma, Weimin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical VFM-driven knowledge distillation framework for point-supervised infrared small target detection, using bilevel optimization where a VFM-embedded teacher guides a lightweight student network.

entry.title: Med-DisSeg: Dispersion-Driven Representation Learning for Fine-Grained Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Zhiquan Chen, Haitao Wang, Guowei Zou, Hejun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Med-DisSeg, a dispersion-driven framework for medical image segmentation that addresses representation collapse during encoding through a Dispersive Loss and adaptive attention for fine-grained structure separation.

entry.title: VMU-Diff: A Coarse-to-fine Multi-source Data Fusion Framework for Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Chunlei Shi, Hao Li, Yufeng Zhu, Boyu Liu, Yongchao Feng, Zengliang Zang, Hongbin Wang, Yanlan Yang, Dan Niu

entry.summary: Proposes VMU-Diff for precipitation nowcasting using a coarse-to-fine framework combining Vision Mamba Unet with residual diffusion, fusing multi-source data to address blurring in deterministic models and artifacts in probabilistic ones.

entry.title: UniTriGen: Unified Triplet Generation of Aligned Visible-Infrared-Label for Few-Shot RGB-T Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Ping Zhou, Haoyu Wang, Mengmeng Zheng, Lei Zhang, Wei Wei, Chen Ding, Fei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes UniTriGen for generating spatially aligned VIS-IR-Label triplets for few-shot RGB-T semantic segmentation, avoiding the inconsistency issues of cascaded generation paradigms.

entry.title: StyleTextGen: Style-Conditioned Multilingual Scene Text Generation

author.name: Zeyu Chen, Fangmin Zhao, Yan Shu, Yichao Liu, Liu Yu, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes StyleTextGen for style-conditioned multilingual scene text generation with a dual-branch style encoder, text style consistency loss, and mask-guided inference for maintaining fine-grained style across different scripts.

entry.title: Can Visual Mamba Improve AI-Generated Image Detection? An In-Depth Investigation

author.name: Mamadou Keita, Wassim Hamidouche, Hessen Bougueffa Eutamene, Abdelmalik Taleb-Ahmed, Xianxun Zhu, Abdenour Hadid

entry.summary: This paper investigates whether Visual Mamba architectures can improve AI-generated image detection, comparing them against CNNs, ViTs, and VLMs for identifying synthetic images. It provides a comprehensive evaluation across multiple architecture families.

entry.title: SR-Prominence: A Crowdsourced Protocol and Dataset Suite for Perceptually-Weighted Super-Resolution Artifact Evaluation

author.name: Ivan Molodetskikh, Kirill Malyshev, Mark Mirgaleev, Nikita Zagainov, Evgeney Bogatyrev, Dmitriy Vatolin

entry.summary: SR-Prominence introduces the concept of artifact prominence for super-resolution evaluation, defined as the fraction of viewers who notice a highlighted artifact. Provides a crowdsourced annotation protocol and dataset of 3,935 artifact masks.

entry.title: SteerSeg: Attention Steering for Reasoning Video Segmentation

author.name: Ali Cheraghian, Hamidreza Dastmalchi, Abdelwahed Khamis, Morteza Saberi, Aijun An, Lars Petersson

entry.summary: SteerSeg introduces a lightweight framework for video reasoning segmentation that identifies attention misalignment as the key bottleneck and steers attention through input-level conditioning rather than modifying model internals.

entry.title: H-OmniStereo: Zero-Shot Omnidirectional Stereo Matching with Heading-Aligned Normal Priors

author.name: Chenxing Jiang, Zhe Tong, Pusen Gao, Peize Liu, Yang Xu, Chuan Fang, Ping Tan, Shaojie Shen

entry.summary: H-OmniStereo proposes a zero-shot omnidirectional stereo matching framework using heading-aligned normal priors, constructing a large synthetic dataset of 2.8M stereo pairs and addressing spherical distortion issues.

entry.title: Efficient Dense Matching for Enhanced Gaussian Splatting Using AV1 Motion Vectors

author.name: Julien Zouein, Vibhoothi Vibhoothi, Fran\c{c}ois Piti\'e, Anil Kokaram

entry.summary: Introduces an AV1 codec-based feature detection and matching pipeline for 3DGS initialization, leveraging inherent motion vectors to reduce Structure-from-Motion overhead while improving reconstruction in textureless regions.

entry.title: Learning Direct Control Policies with Flow Matching for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Marcello Ceresini, Federico Pirazzoli, Andrea Bertogalli, Lorenzo Cipelli, Filippo D'Addeo, Anthony Dell'Eva, Alessandro Paolo Capasso, Alberto Broggi

entry.summary: Presents a flow-matching planner for autonomous driving that directly outputs control trajectories (acceleration, curvature) from BEV representations, trained on urban scenarios and evaluated on out-of-distribution environments.

entry.title: Motion Planning for Autonomous Vehicles using Optimization over Graphs of Convex Sets

author.name: Matheus Wagner, Ant\^onio Augusto Fr\"ohlich

entry.summary: Studies how optimization over Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS) can approximate nonlinear optimal control solutions for autonomous driving motion planning. Represents free space as convex regions in a directed graph to handle nonconvex geometry through convex optimization.

entry.title: SOCC-ICP: Semantics-Assisted Odometry based on Occupancy Grids and ICP

author.name: Johannes Scherer, Sebastian Hirt, Henri Mee{\ss}

entry.summary: Introduces SOCC-ICP, a LiDAR odometry framework that uses semantic occupancy grids for both mapping and scan alignment. Filters dynamic objects through raycasting-based free-space updates and adapts ICP based on local planarity.

entry.title: AI #168: Not Leading the Future

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's weekly AI newsletter covering recent developments including Opus 4.7 fast mode, Claude Code updates, various benchmarks, AI governance debates, and commentary on the current state of AI progress during a relative 'lull' period.

entry.title: Achieving Gold-Medal-Level Olympiad Reasoning via Simple and Unified Scaling

author.name: Yafu Li, Runzhe Zhan, Haoran Zhang, Shunkai Zhang, Yizhuo Li, Zhilin Wang, Jiacheng Chen, Futing Wang, Xuyang Hu, Yuchen Fan, Bangjie Xu, Yucheng Su, Xinmiao Han, Chenxi Li, Haodi Lei, Yufeng Zhao, Zejin Lin, Qianjia Cheng, Tong Zhu, Xiaoye Qu, Ganqu Cui, Peng Ye, Yun Luo, Zhouchen Lin, Yu Qiao, Bowen Zhou, Ning Ding, Yu Cheng

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Presents a unified recipe for converting post-trained reasoning models into olympiad-level solvers using reverse-perplexity curriculum SFT, two-stage RL (verifiable rewards then proof-level RL), and test-time scaling. Achieves gold-medal level on IMO/IPhO problems.

entry.title: Negation Neglect: When models fail to learn negations in training

author.name: Harry Mayne, Lev McKinney, Jan Dubi\'nski, Adam Karvonen, James Chua, Owain Evans

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Discovers 'Negation Neglect': fine-tuning LLMs on documents that explicitly flag claims as false causes models to believe those claims are true. Even with negations in every sentence, belief rates jump from 2.5% to 88.6%, nearly matching documents without negations (92.4%).

entry.title: Multimodal Hidden Markov Models for Persistent Emotional State Tracking

author.name: Anamika Ragu, Aneesh Jonelagadda

entry.summary: Proposes using sticky factorial HDP-HMMs over multimodal valence-arousal representations to model conversational emotion as sequences of latent emotional regimes, tracking persistent phases rather than utterance-level emotions.

entry.title: An Agentic LLM-Based Framework for Population-Scale Mental Health Screening

author.name: Giuliano Lorenzoni, Paulo Alencar, Donald Cowan

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic LLM framework for population-scale mental health screening where each pipeline stage is a LangChain agent with explicit policies. Stages are incrementally locked once validated to prevent later adaptations from overwriting confirmed results.

entry.title: Quantifying Sensitivity for Tree Ensembles: A symbolic and compositional approach

author.name: S. Akshay, Chaitanya Garg, Ashutosh Gupta, Kuldeep S. Meel, Ajinkya Naik

entry.summary: Proposes a symbolic and compositional approach for quantifying sensitivity (robustness to small feature changes) in decision tree ensembles, with certified error and confidence bounds.

entry.title: SP-GCRL: Influence Maximization on Incomplete Social Graphs

author.name: Haohua Niu, Yuxuan Yang, Lingfeng Zhang, Hao Li, Jiao Liang, Zongfu Luo, Luca Rossi

entry.summary: SP-GCRL proposes a social-propagation-aware graph contrastive reinforcement learning framework for influence maximization under incomplete, noisy social graphs with non-stationary diffusion dynamics.

entry.title: BoostTaxo: Zero-Shot Taxonomy Induction via Boosting-Style Agentic Reasoning and Constraint-Aware Calibration

author.name: Yancheng Ling, Zhenlin Qin, Leizhen Wang, Zhenliang Ma

entry.summary: BoostTaxo performs zero-shot taxonomy induction using a boosting-style LLM framework with retrieval-augmented definition refinement, hybrid parent candidate selection, and structure-aware score calibration.

entry.title: CROP: Expert-Aligned Image Cropping via Compositional Reasoning and Optimizing Preference

author.name: Zhitong Dong, Chao Li, Jie Yu, Hao Chen

entry.summary: Reformulates aesthetic image cropping as a multimodal reasoning task using VLMs, training the model to understand composition and aesthetics rather than relying on saliency prediction or retrieval.

entry.title: Pyramid Self-contrastive Learning Framework for Test-time Ultrasound Image Denoising

author.name: Jiajing Zhang, Bingze Dai, Xi Zhang, Yue Xu, Wei-Ning Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a test-time training framework for ultrasound image denoising using pyramid self-contrastive learning, avoiding domain shift issues of pre-trained methods by adapting at inference time.

entry.title: Plan Before You Trade: Inference-Time Optimization for RL Trading Agents

author.name: Eun Go, Rohan Deb, Arindam Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes FPILOT, an inference-time optimization framework for RL trading agents inspired by MPC, using price forecasts to optimize allocations without action-conditioned rollouts.

entry.title: A Unified Perspective for Learning Graph Representations Across Multi-Level Abstractions

author.name: Mohamed Mahmoud Amar, Nairouz Mrabah, Mohamed Bouguessa, Abdoulaye Banir\'e Diallo

entry.summary: Proposes a unified contrastive framework for graph self-supervised learning that integrates node, proximity, cluster, and graph-level information through weighted similarity scores.

entry.title: Grid-Orch: An LLM-Powered Orchestrator for Distribution Grid Simulation and Analytics

author.name: Boming Liu, Jin Dong, Jamie Lian

entry.summary: Introduces Grid-Orch, an LLM-powered orchestrator for power distribution grid simulation using Model Context Protocol, enabling engineers to perform complex analyses via natural language.

entry.title: Multi-Quantile Regression for Extreme Precipitation Downscaling

author.name: Hamed Najafi, Gareth Lagerwall, Jayantha Obeysekera, Jason Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Q-SRDRN, a multi-quantile super-resolution network with pinball loss for precipitation downscaling that correctly handles heavy-tail events missed by standard MAE-trained models.

entry.title: Anatomy-Slot: Unsupervised Anatomical Factorization for Homologous Bilateral Reasoning in Retinal Diagnosis

author.name: Yingzhe Ma, Xiao Yang, Yuguo Yin, Zheyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Anatomy-Slot for bilateral retinal diagnosis, using unsupervised anatomical decomposition into slots with cross-attention alignment across eyes, improving AUC by 4.2%.

entry.title: When Absolute State Fails: Evaluating Proprioceptive Encodings for Robust Manipulation

author.name: Maxime Alvarez, Ryo Watanabe, Paul Crook, Afshin Zeinaddini Meymand, Suvin Kurian, Pablo Ferreiro, Genki Sano

entry.summary: Studies different proprioceptive state encodings for robotic manipulation policies to improve generalization, particularly for robots with moving frames of reference. Finds that simple joint representation changes improve both in- and out-of-distribution performance.

entry.title: Vividh-ASR: A Complexity-Tiered Benchmark and Optimization Dynamics for Robust Indic Speech Recognition

author.name: Kush Juvekar, Kavya Manohar, Aditya Srinivas Menon, Arghya Bhattacharya, Kumarmanas Nethil

entry.summary: Introduces Vividh-ASR, a complexity-stratified benchmark for Hindi and Malayalam ASR with four tiers. Proposes reverse multi-stage fine-tuning (R-MFT) that enables a 244M Whisper model to match larger competitors.

entry.title: "It became a self-fulfilling prophecy": How Lived Experiences are Entangled with AI Predictions in Menstrual Cycle Tracking Apps

author.name: Wendy Zhou, Pelin Karaturhan, Alexandra Weilenmann, Jichen Zhu

entry.summary: Qualitative study on how AI predictions in menstrual cycle tracking apps create self-fulfilling prophecies and shape users' lived experiences. Reveals human-AI entanglement through user interviews and autoethnography.

entry.title: ArcVQ-VAE: A Spherical Vector Quantization Framework with ArcCosine Additive Margin

author.name: Jaeyung Kim, YoungJoon Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes ArcVQ-VAE, a vector quantization framework using spherical angular-margin prior for the codebook. Introduces Ball-Bounded Norm Regularization and ArcCosine Additive Margin Loss for better codebook utilization.

entry.title: Locale-Conditioned Few-Shot Prompting Mitigates Demonstration Regurgitation in On-Device PII Substitution with Small Language Models

author.name: Anuj Sadani, Deepak Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes locale-conditioned few-shot prompting to prevent demonstration regurgitation in small language models for PII substitution. Uses OpenAI's privacy-filter with a 1-bit Bonsai SLM for on-device PII replacement.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Segmentation as Semantic-Based Regularization

author.name: Stefano Colamonaco, Andrei-Bogdan Florea, Jaron Maene

entry.summary: Proposes a neurosymbolic approach to weakly supervised semantic segmentation that integrates differentiable fuzzy logic with SAM, unifying weak annotations and domain priors as continuous logical constraints for fine-tuning.

entry.title: R2R2: Robust Representation for Intensive Experience Reuse via Redundancy Reduction in Self-Predictive Learning

author.name: Sanghyeob Song, Donghyeok Lee, Jinsik Kim, Sungroh Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes R2R2, a redundancy reduction regularization method for self-predictive learning in RL under high update-to-data ratios, theoretically identifying that standard zero-centering conflicts with SPL's spectral properties.

entry.title: Towards Fine-Grained and Verifiable Concept Bottleneck Models

author.name: Yingying Fang, Haijie Xu, Shuang Wu, Mariathasan Anish, Guang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a fine-grained Concept Bottleneck Model that grounds each concept in localized visual evidence, enabling users to verify that the model learns correct visual features rather than spurious correlations.

entry.title: Active Learners as Efficient PRP Rerankers

author.name: Jerem\'ias Figueiredo Paschmann, Juan Kaplan, Francisco Nattero Santiago Mauricio Barron Bucolo, Juan Wisznia, Luciano del Corro

entry.summary: Reframes PRP (Pairwise Ranking Prompting) reranking as active learning from noisy pairwise comparisons, showing that active rankers outperform sorting-based approaches in call-constrained regimes with a randomized single-call oracle.

entry.title: Architecture-Aware Explanation Auditing for Industrial Visual Inspection

author.name: Sibo Jia, Zihang Zhao, Kunrong Li

entry.summary: Proposes an architecture-aware explanation audit protocol for industrial visual inspection, grounded in the hypothesis that explanation faithfulness is bounded by structural distance from the model's native decision mechanism. Validates on wafer map classification.

entry.title: AIM-DDI: A Model-Agnostic Multimodal Integration Module for Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction

author.name: Yerin Park, Sangseon Lee

entry.summary: Introduces AIM-DDI, an architecture-independent multimodal integration module for drug-drug interaction prediction that represents heterogeneous modality information as tokens in a shared latent space. Addresses unseen-drug generalization.

entry.title: A Novel Schur-Decomposition-Based Weight Projection Method for Stable State-Space Neural-Network Architectures

author.name: Sergio Vanegas, Lasse Lensu, Fredy Ruiz

entry.summary: Introduces a Schur-decomposition-based weight projection for ensuring asymptotic stability in state-space neural network layers. Projects the quasi-triangular factor onto its nearest stable counterpart during training.

entry.title: Multi-Dimensional Model Integrity and Responsibility Assessment Index and Scoring Framework

author.name: Phuc Truong Loc Nguyen, Thanh Hung Do, Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen, Hung Cao

entry.summary: Proposes MIRAI, a unified framework for evaluating tabular ML models across explainability, fairness, robustness, privacy, and sustainability dimensions with a single aggregated score.

entry.title: Woodelf++: A Fast and Unified Partial Dependence Plot Algorithm for Decision Tree Ensembles

author.name: Ron Wettenstein, Alexander Nadel, Udi Boker

entry.summary: Introduces Woodelf++, a unified efficient algorithm for computing Partial Dependence Plots, Joint PDPs, and Partial Dependence Interaction Values on decision tree ensembles, building on the Woodelf SHAP algorithm.

entry.title: Critic-Driven Voronoi-Quantization for Distilling Deep RL Policies to Explainable Models

author.name: Senne Deproost, Denis Steckelmacher, Ann Now\'e

entry.summary: Introduces Critic-Driven Voronoi State Partitioning for distilling deep RL policies into interpretable surrogate models. Uses the critic value network to partition state space into regions where simple models suffice.

entry.title: Second-Order Actor-Critic Methods for Discounted MDPs via Policy Hessian Decomposition

author.name: Sanjeev Manivannan, Shuban V

entry.summary: Develops second-order actor-critic methods for discounted MDPs by decomposing the policy Hessian to enable practical curvature-aware updates in reinforcement learning, addressing the computational complexity of Hessian estimation.

entry.title: Network-Aware Bilinear Tokenization for Brain Functional Connectivity Representation Learning

author.name: Leo Milecki, Qingyu Hu, Bahram Jafrasteh, Mert R. Sabuncu, Qingyu Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces NERVE, a self-supervised framework for brain functional connectivity that tokenizes FC matrices according to large-scale brain network organization using bilinear tokenization of intra- and inter-network patches.

entry.title: Towards Real-Time Autonomous Navigation: Transformer-Based Catheter Tip Tracking in Fluoroscopy

author.name: Harry Robertshaw, Yanghe Hao, Weiyuan Deng, Benjamin Jackson, S. M. Hadi Sadati, Nikola Fischer, Tom Vercauteren, Alejandro Granados, Thomas C. Booth

entry.summary: Develops a real-time catheter tip tracking pipeline for fluoroscopy to support autonomous robotic navigation in mechanical thrombectomy for stroke. Compares U-Net, U-Net+Transformer, and SegFormer models in a multi-threaded pipeline.

entry.title: Deep Image Segmentation via Discriminant Feature Learning

author.name: Adam Dawid Sztamborski, Ra\"ul P\'erez-Gonzalo, Antonio Agudo

entry.summary: Introduces Deep Discriminant Analysis (DDA), a differentiable loss function that maximizes between-class variance while minimizing within-class variance for image segmentation. Architecture-agnostic and adds no inference cost.

entry.title: nASR: An End-to-End Trainable Neural Layer for Channel-Level EEG Artifact Subspace Reconstruction in Real-Time BCI

author.name: Shantanu Sarkar, Jose L. Contreras-Vidal

entry.summary: Proposes nASR, an end-to-end trainable neural layer that performs channel-level EEG artifact subspace reconstruction, replacing the fixed-threshold PCA-based ASR approach with a differentiable, learnable alternative.

entry.title: PEML: Parameter-efficient Multi-Task Learning with Optimized Continuous Prompts

author.name: Anjir Ahmed Chowdhury, Syed Zawad, Xiaolong Ma, Xu Dong, Feng Yan

entry.summary: Proposes PEML, a parameter-efficient multi-task learning method combining optimized continuous prompts with adapter modules for adapting a single LLM to multiple tasks simultaneously, focusing on resource consolidation.

entry.title: LLM-based Detection of Manipulative Political Narratives

author.name: Sinclair Schneider, Florian Steuber, Gabi Dreo Rodosek

entry.summary: Presents a framework for detecting manipulative political narratives on social media using LLMs, distinguishing them from legitimate critiques. Uses few-shot prompting with documented campaign narratives to filter manipulative posts, then clusters remaining posts into narrative themes.

entry.title: Tokenizer Fertility and Zero-Shot Performance of Foundation Models on Ukrainian Legal Text: A Comparative Study

author.name: Volodymyr Ovcharov

entry.summary: Benchmarks seven foundation models on Ukrainian legal text, measuring tokenizer fertility and zero-shot performance. Finds 1.6x variation in tokenizer efficiency (Qwen3 vs Llama), with NVIDIA Nemotron outperforming much larger models at lower cost.

entry.title: Persian MusicGen: A Large-Scale Dataset and Culturally-Aware Generative Model for Persian Music

author.name: Mohammad Hossein Sameti, Diba Hadi Esfangereh, Sepehr Harfi Moridani, Leili Javidpour, Mahdieh Soleymani Baghshah

entry.summary: Presents the first large-scale dataset of Persian music (900+ hours) and fine-tunes MusicGen for culturally-aware Persian music generation. Addresses the bias of music generation models toward Western music.

entry.title: Automatic Landmark-Based Segmentation of Human Subcortical Structures in MRI

author.name: Ahmed Rekik, R. Jarrett Rushmore, Sylvain Bouix, Linda Marrakchi-Kacem

entry.summary: Proposes a landmark-guided 3D brain segmentation approach that mimics manual segmentation protocols of the Harvard-Oxford Atlas. Uses a global-to-local network for landmark detection followed by semantic segmentation with landmark-driven post-processing.

entry.title: ClickRemoval: An Interactive Open-Source Tool for Object Removal in Diffusion Models

author.name: Ledun Zhang, Yatu Ji, Xufei Zhuang, Xinying Yao

entry.summary: Presents ClickRemoval, an open-source interactive tool for object removal using pretrained Stable Diffusion with click-based interaction and self-attention modulation during denoising, requiring no additional training or masks.

entry.title: MambaRain: Multi-Scale Mamba-Attention Framework for 0-3 Hour Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Chunlei Shi, Cui Wu, Xiang Xu, Hao Li, Ni Fan, Xue Han, Yongchao Feng, Yufeng Zhu, Boyu Liu, Zengliang Zang, Hongbin Wang, Yanlan Yang, Dan Niu

entry.summary: Proposes MambaRain for 0-3 hour precipitation nowcasting using multi-scale Mamba-attention architecture that integrates linear-complexity long-range temporal modeling with spatial attention for extended prediction horizons.

entry.title: COAL: Counterfactual and Observation-Enhanced Alignment Learning for Discriminative Referring Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Shukun Jia, Shiyu Hu, Yipei Wang, Ximeng Cheng, Yichao Cao, Xiaobo Lu

entry.summary: COAL introduces counterfactual and observation-enhanced alignment learning for referring multi-object tracking, addressing the mismatch between high-discriminability demands and sparse semantic supervision. It uses VLM-based explicit semantic injection and counterfactual reasoning to prevent shortcut learning.

entry.title: SurgicalMamba: Dual-Path SSD with State Regramming for Online Surgical Phase Recognition

author.name: Sukju Oh, Sukkyu Sun

entry.summary: SurgicalMamba introduces a dual-path state space model for online surgical phase recognition, addressing the unique demands of surgical video: ultra-long sequences, non-uniform temporal dynamics, and narrow visual domains.

entry.title: Multi-scale Coarse-to-fine Modeling for Test-time Human Motion Control

author.name: Nhat Le, Daochang Liu, Anh Nguyen, Ajmal Mian

entry.summary: MSCoT presents a multi-scale, coarse-to-fine model for test-time human motion control that predicts entire token sequences at each temporal scale, with an efficient multi-scale guidance strategy for flexible control.

entry.title: LATERN: Test-Time Context-Aware Explainable Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Mitchell Piehl, Muchao Ye

entry.summary: LATERN proposes a context-aware framework for video anomaly detection that reformulates VAD as temporal evidence aggregation, addressing the limitation of VLM-based pipelines that reason without structured temporal context.

entry.title: Does Synthetic Layered Design Data Benefit Layered Design Decomposition?

author.name: Kam Man Wu, Haolin Yang, Qingyu Chen, Yihu Tang, Jingye Chen, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: Investigates whether pure synthetic layered data can improve graphic design decomposition (separating foreground, background, text layers), challenging the assumption that real layered assets are necessary.

entry.title: FaceParts: Segmentation and Editing of Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Tymoteusz Zapa{\l}a, Julia Farganus, Dominik Galus, Miko{\l}aj Czachorowski, Piotr Syga, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek

entry.summary: FaceParts proposes unsupervised segmentation and editing of Gaussian Splatting avatars directly in the Gaussian domain, decomposing avatars into facial parts using feature disentanglement, density-based clustering, and FLAME-anchored transfer.

entry.title: SparseOIT: Improving Order-Independent Transparency 3DGS via Active Set Method

author.name: Wentao Yang, Fanzhen Kong, Zejian Kang, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: SparseOIT improves Order-Independent Transparency rendering for 3DGS by exploiting sparse variable dependencies through an active set optimization method, addressing limitations of volumetric rendering for transparent materials.

entry.title: Keyed Nonlinear Transform: Lightweight Privacy-Enhancing Feature Sharing for Medical Image Analysis

author.name: Haebom Lee, Gyeongjung Kim

entry.summary: KNT proposes a lightweight key-conditioned obfuscation for intermediate features in split inference, reducing re-identification while preserving task performance with minimal overhead (0.15ms CPU).

entry.title: Distill: Uncovering the True Intent behind Human-Robot Communication

author.name: Ting Li, David Porfirio

entry.summary: Proposes the Distill approach for human-robot communication that removes unnecessary steps from user specifications, generalizes meanings, and handles ambiguity—bridging the gap between imprecise natural language and overly specific end-user programming.

entry.title: Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion with Compliant Feet

author.name: Pramod Pal (Indian Institute of Science Bangalore India), Shishir Kolathaya (Robert Bosch Centre for Cyber Physical Systems Bangalore India), Ashitava Ghosal (Indian Institute of Science Bangalore India, Ahmedabad University Ahmedabad India)

entry.summary: Studies energy-efficient quadruped locomotion by integrating compliant feet with RL controllers. Trains policies for different spring stiffness values and shows 10-35% energy savings in simulation and hardware experiments.

entry.title: CaMeRL: Collision-Aware and Memory-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for UAV Navigation in Multi-Scale Obstacle Environments

author.name: Hong Hong, Feiyu Liao, Yongheng Liang, Boning Zhang, Haitao Wang, Hejun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes CaMeRL, a collision-aware and memory-enhanced RL framework for UAV navigation in environments with multi-scale obstacles. Uses risk-sensitive depth encoding and spatial memory to handle both small obstacles and occlusions from large ones.

entry.title: Formal Conjectures: An Open and Evolving Benchmark for Verified Discovery in Mathematics

author.name: Moritz Firsching, Paul Lezeau, Salvatore Mercuri, Mikl\'os Z. Horv\'ath, Ya\"el Dillies, Calle S\"onne, Eric Wieser, Fred Zhang, Thomas Hubert, Blaise Ag\"uera y Arcas, Pushmeet Kohli

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from yesterday, Presents Formal Conjectures, a benchmark of 2615 mathematical problems formalized in Lean 4, including 1029 open research conjectures for zero-contamination proof discovery evaluation and 836 solved problems for autoformalization. Created with Google DeepMind involvement.

entry.title: DRL-STAF: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for State-Aware Forecasting of Complex Multivariate Hidden Markov Processes

author.name: Manrui Jiang, Jingru Huang, Yong Chen, Chen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DRL-STAF, combining deep RL with HMM-style state modeling for forecasting multivariate hidden Markov processes. Jointly predicts observations and estimates hidden states.

entry.title: Generative Deep Learning for Computational Destaining and Restaining of Unregistered Digital Pathology Images

author.name: Aarushi Kulkarni, Alarice Lowe, Pratik Shah

entry.summary: Evaluates cGAN models trained on registered pathology images for computational staining/destaining on spatially unregistered out-of-distribution whole-slide images from a different institution, using preprocessing pipelines for domain adaptation without retraining.

entry.title: Are Candidate Models Really Needed for Active Learning?

author.name: Harshini Mridula Mohan, Maanya Manjunath, Vipul Arya, S. H. Shabbeer Basha, Nitin Cheekatla

entry.summary: Investigates whether candidate models are necessary for active learning, exploring the feasibility of selecting informative samples without iterative model-based querying, using CNNs and transformers.

entry.title: Exploring Vision-Language Models for Online Signature Verification: A Zero-Shot Capability Study

author.name: Marta Robledo-Moreno, Ruben Vera-Rodriguez, Ruben Tolosana, Javier Ortega-Garcia

entry.summary: Explores zero-shot capabilities of VLMs (GPT-5.2 and Gemini 2.5 Pro) for online signature verification, converting kinematic time-series to static images and introducing a scoring protocol using latent token probabilities for biometric scoring.

entry.title: Hierarchical Image Tokenization for Multi-Scale Image Super Resolution

author.name: Isma Hadji, Enrique Sanchez, Adrian Bulat, Brais Martinez, Georgios Tzimiropoulos

entry.summary: Introduces a multi-scale image super-resolution method building on Visual Auto-Regressive modeling with Residual Quantization, adding novel components for intermediate scale outputs and improved training without large backbones.

entry.title: Learning Cross-Coupled and Regime Dependent Dynamics for Aerial Manipulation

author.name: Rishabh Dev Yadav, Samaksh Ujjawal, Sihao Sun, Spandan Roy, Wei Pan

entry.summary: Proposes a structured encoder-decoder framework for adaptive residual dynamics learning in aerial manipulators. Handles cross-coupled, history-dependent, and nonstationary dynamics from payload changes and manipulator reconfiguration.

entry.title: FU-MPC: Frontier- and Uncertainty-Aware Model Predictive Control for Efficient and Accurate UAV Exploration with Motorized LiDAR

author.name: Jianping Li, Pengfei Wan, Zhongyuan Liu, Yi Wang, Yiheng Chen, Xinhang Xu, Rui Jin, Boyu Zhou, Lihua Xie

entry.summary: Proposes FU-MPC for UAV exploration with motorized LiDAR, jointly planning UAV motion and sensor orientation for efficient coverage while maintaining localization accuracy. The motorized LiDAR provides an additional sensing degree of freedom.

entry.title: Emergent and Subliminal Misalignment Through the Lens of Data-Mediated Transfer
